rgyud gsungs tshugshig /ces bka' bsgo bar mdzad ba'i phyir te/ gtam rgyud las/ rdo rje 'jigs byed chen 4 yis/ /chos kyi rgyal 4 la sogs pa/ /gshin rje'i 'o nya thams cad kun/ /slol pa'i gying du byin gyis brlabs/ /ma dang sring mo bu mo rnams/ /lha'or bcas kun la bka' bsgo ba/ /lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /nga yi bstan pa 'byung ba'i tshe/ /rnal 'byor rig 'dzin mang ldan pas/ /bka' bsgo'i las rnams tshul bzhin gyis/ /zhes gsungs te mnan bzhin du mna' bor ro/ /zhesadang/ slob dpon zhi ba ye shes kyis/ g.yas kyi zhabs brgyad bskums pa ni/ /dregs pa'i lha brgyad thabs kyis gnon/ /g.yon kyi zhabs brgyad brkyangs pa ni/ /dregs pa'i lha mo brgyad la rol/ /zhes se gas gsungs 〈sna/ /( lnga ba rdo rje gdan du bdud 'dul ba'i tshe yang dmar nag la)gas gsum sogs sna tshogs su sprul te/ bdud kyis kho kho bo de dang des btul snyam pa'i snang ba skyes nas kyang btul bar mdzad pas/ phyis kyi rjes 'jug gi gdul byas kyang de bsgom na 'dul bar spyan gyis brlabs pa'i phyir/ dper na mdo phyogs phal cher du byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis btul ba ltar dgra nag gi rgyud las gzhin rje gshed dgra nag bcu gsum ma sprul nas btul bar mdzad pa'i phyig dgra nag gi rgyud las/ de nas gtam rgyud bshad par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das mngon par byang chub pa'i dus su bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen 4 la byang chub kyi bar du gcod ba'i phyig shin tu 'jigs su rung ba'i 'jigs pa chen ṭo ston cing bdud kyi dpung chen 4 lhags te/de'i dus na bdud chen 4 las mtshog tu rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'itingange 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi sku gsung zugs rdo rje rnams las gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo nges par smyung lte/ brtsom ldan gas kyis nges par phyung nas kyang lag na rdo rje thub pa chen po'i bka' bzhin byed pa la phyagan rdo rje khyod 'di lta bu'i gshin rje gshed kyi kho bo'i gzugs su 15
'jigs cad chos 'byung /bsgyur te/ bdud dang klu dang gnod sbyon dang lha ma yin dang / lha rnams kyang choms zhig /chings shig/gtogs shig/ces gsungs pa'i mig 'dis sngags kyi gdul bya la sde brgyad 〈snad par yang shes 〈sna/ /༈gnyis pa gdul bya rab kyi blo tsur gnas dus mtha' yas par gdul bya mtha'alpus par dus gcig sesnags la gsungs tshul zhib mo rgyud dang 'grel pa bstan bcos du ma'i dgongs par bshad pa ni/ bskyed rim chen mo las/ rgyud rgya gzhung gang nas kyang zur tsam yang ma byung zhing khungs rnamadag gang gis kyang yid ches bskyed par byar med pa'i gtam rgyud snga ma dag la tshad mar bzung na mdo rgyud bstan bcos dang legs par 'gal ba'i cal col du ma smra dgos pa 'byung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ltar mdo rgyud bstan bcos tshad ldan gang nas kyang mi 'byung ba'i chos kyi lo rgyus dang / lha'i mdzad pa la tshad mar byas na gnas skabs dang mthar zug gi don ma yin pa chen 4 bskyed pas/ de dag spangs te rgyud dang 'grel pa gzhan gyis zur tsam bshad pa mang la/ 'jam dpal zhi drag gi rgyud dang 'grel pa skor nas ci tsam byung ba'i phyogs gcig mkhas grubaphunangs kyi gagor los bsgyur ba chen po'i bskyed rim gyi man ngag mkhas pa'i dbang 4 rgyun ma chad pa'i gsung rgyun rtsaba'i bla ma srad rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun bzhin brjod na/ de yang sbyor 'jam dbal mtshan brjod la bkral tshul mang yang / 'phags yul gyi mkhas grub chen po 'jam dpal grags pa'i gsung dngaka zhi ba ye shes sogs kyi gzhung la brten nas bshad tshul ni/ gnasadag ma dag gi 'jig rten gyi khams nam mkha'i mtha' yas par dus gang la gang 'dul gyi dus su lubor gdul bya rab sa yi dbang phyug thob pa'i rgyal sras chen po mtha' yas pa rnams dang] de 'dra'i dpa' 'o mkha' 'gyo sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams kyi rdul snyed dang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' chen 4 rnams kyi sgyu 'phrul gyis sprul pa'i lha'i rnam 16
rgyudagasungs tshul/can dang] de bzhin du klu'i dang] gnod sbyin gyidang / srin po'i dang] ma mo'i dang/ gshin rje'i dang / gzugs dang rgyud pa ma nges pa'i 'byung po'i rnam can re re la mtha' yas pa'i gshor pho nya bka' nyan ci bgyi tshogs dpag med dang / gdul bya'i 'gro bar gtogs pa'i lha klu gnod sbyon gshin rje ma mo lha ma yin srin po sogs sde brgyad dang] dregs byed so gnyis sogs kyi dbus la sogs par nam mkha'i mtha' khyab tu gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi mdzad pa rim dang gcig char du sku gsung zugs zhi drag gi rol pa mtha'alpus pas gdul bya 'dul bar mdzad pa gangor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar du ston pa'i sgyid ji skad du lan+dam dpal las/ dpa' 'o bdud dgra bdud 'dul ba/ /bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa sel bar byed/ /ces dang / 'grel chen las/de ltar re zhig nang gi nyon mongs pa rnams las nges par rgyal nas sgyi rol gyi lha'i bu'i bdud la rtsogs pa rnam par bzlog cing brtsom par bstan pa'i pyid dpa' 4 zhes bya ba la rtsogs pa gsungs te/ bdud rnams dgrar gyur pa gang yin pa'am bdud rnams kyi dgrasan pasan bdud kyi dgra'o/ /bdud las rgyal bar mdzad bas na bdud thul ba'o/ /de nyid kyis na sgyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can gyi dgra bo nges par bzlog par mdzad pa'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pas na dpa' bo'o/ /yang na tshangs pa dang] dbang phyug chen po dngaka khyab 'jug mchus zil gyis gnon par mdzad nas/ tshangs ma dang / dbang snyog ma dang/ khyab 'jug ma dang / 'dod pa'i lha'i dga' ba mo mthu stobs kyis de rnams blangs pa lte/ drag po'i stobs kyis len par mdzad pas na dpa' ṭo ste/ 'jig rten pa'i dpa' 4 rnams kyang 'jigs pa med pa dang / snying stobs dang ldan pas gzhan dag zil gyis gnon pa'i rang bzhin can ladapa' 'o zhes bya'o/ /bdud bzhi ni phung po'i bdud dang/nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang] 'chi bdag gi bdudadang/ lha'i bu'i bdud ces grags pa ste/de rnams las 'jigs pa gang dag yod pa de dag mthar 'byin cing sel bar mdzad bas 17
'jigs byed chos 'byung /na/ bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa sel bar byed/ /ces bya'o/ /gang gi phyir bdud thams cad kyi dpung ste/ bdud thams cad kyi lde las rgyal bar mdzad cing] pham par byed de/de nyid kyis na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'drin/ /zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang] yang de nyid las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gro ba rnams kyi bla ma de sems can thams cad kyi don gyi pyida'ogs pa med par bzhud pa nyid du bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ 'jig rten gsum 4 gom gcig bzod/ /mkha' ltar mtha' med rnam par gnon/ /zhes bya ba gsungs te/ 'jig rten gsum po thams cad cig car gom pa gcig pa'i gom pas 'gro ba gang yin ba de la de skad ces bya'o/ /de bzhin du nam mkha' la ni mtha' med pas de'i mthar thug pa'i rnam par gnon pa ldan pas na/ mkha' ltar mtha' med rnam par gnon/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di bshad gzhir byas nas 'og ma dag gis rgyas par rim pas bshad par bya'o/ /de yang yin lte/ phyogs bcu'i 'dzig rten gyi khams rnams su skal pa dang ldan pa la chos ston pas na/ 'jam dpal las/ phyogs bcu'i chos kyi rnga bo che/ /zhes dang] 'grel chen las/ phyogs bcu'i 'dzig rten gyi khams rnams su skal ba dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos ston pa'i sgras mngon par dga' bar mdzad pas na/ phyogs bcu'i chos kyi rnga 'o che/ /zhes gsungs/ de yang chos sku'i gzugs med pa dang / longs sku mtshan dpes sbras pas na gzugs bzang ba dang / 'jam dpal las/ gzugs med gzugs bzang dam pa nye/ /zhes so/ /sprul sku chu nang gi gza' dang rgyu skar ltar zhi drag gang 'dul ston pas na sna tshogs gzugs can yin pa ni/ 'jam dpal 'grel chen las/ sprul pa'i sku gdul bya rnams dang mthun par sna tshogs pa'i gzugs kyi sku yang dag par ston par mdzad pas na/ sna tshogs gzugs canano/ /zhes so/ /deyanga'ad ltarasad tsam gyis skyed padang/ brtan g.yo'i gzugs thams cad la dbang bsgyur pa thob pas na / 'jam dpal las/ yid las skyes/ /gzugs 18
rgyud gsungs tshugrnams thams cad snang ba'i dpal/ /zhes gsungs/ de yang snga pyi mi dgos par cig car du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gdul bya'i rgyud dang 'tsham pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi bkod pa ston pas na/ gzugs brnyan ma lus 'chang ba/ zhes mtshan gadrenal ba ni/ 'grel chen las/'dzig rten gyi khams ma lus pa rnams su cig car 'dul bya'i skye 'o dri ma med pa'i chu lta bu'i rgyud la gzugs brnyan 'char ba so sor snang bar mdzad pas na/ gzugs brnyan ma lus 'chang ba po/ /zhes gsungs/ de yang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du thogs pa med pa'i nus pa mi g.yo bas na/ tshugs pa med pa'i mtshan dang / khams gsum gyi bdag 4 tshangs pa dang dbang phyug chen po rtsogs kyi lha rnams sku khro bo sna tshogs pas zil gyis gnon pas na che bar grags pa khams gsum dbang phyug chen po'i mtshan 'chang ba'i sgyid 'jam dpal las/ tshugs pa med cing che bar grags/ /khams gsum dbang phyug chen 4 lte/ /zhes dang] 'grel chen las/ khams gsum ma lus pa'i bdag po nyid du byed pa'i dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa rnams kyi yang de nyid gcig mu dbang snyog chen 4 yin zhing / zil gyis mi gnon pa'i sku mnga' bas na/ che bar grags/ khams gsum dbang phyug chen 'o lte/ /zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs dren/ /de ltar gdul bya sna tshogs kyi don cig car mdzad pa yang stobs bcu'i dbang gis yin te/ 'grel chen las/de ltar stobs bcu dang ldan pas ril gyis mi gnon cing chags pa dang thogs pa med pa'i nus pas 'ju ba ma lus shing sna tshogs pa mos pa tha dad pa'i dbye bas phye ba'i don thar pa thob pa'i mtshan nyid can skal ba ji lta ba bzhin mdzad pas na/ kun gyi don ni ma lus byed/ /ces bya ste/'jam pa'i dbyangs so/ /zhes gsungs/ mā ya zhes pa sgyu 'phrul dang sprul pa gnyis dar 'jug cing sprul pa'am sgyu 'phrul mtha' yas pas sems can gyidon mdzad pasan mtshanayang sgyu 'phrul du btags pa du ma yod pa'i don bzhin skye bo'iyid du 'thad bar sprul pas na mkhas pa'i mtshan 19
'jigs byed chos 'byung /dngaka gdul byadang mthun par gzugs ston pas na sgyu 'phrul chen 4 'chang dang] gdul bya ngan mi bhe+e traṃ // dī paX spra sna traṃ snronā ṭ+wāṃ pa( rnyi lha( ༵ spyanā dīpa shā/ ṭ+wāṃ ༵༵ sbyo/ sna // /shā dga' dang / de ltar sna tshogs sprul pas sgyu 'phrul chen 4 mig 'phrul can zhes bya ba yin te/'jamadapal 'grel chen las/ sprul pa'i lha'i khyad par du gyur par bstan pa'i phyig mkhas pa sgyu snyu ༷// ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ pyā / keṃ/ ༷/(sde spyi phyi ṭ+wāṃ ༷'o/ /ñtsā spu ༷ ༷༷ ༷ ༷ nāṃ nāṃ ༷ smo/ /m+p+raṃ ba dang rjes su mthun pa'i gzugs sprul pa ste/ de lta bu'i sgyu 'phrul mnga' bas na sgyu 'phrul chen ṅgi ༵༵ ngo]des/ sna sna rmo /shā shāX snro shākyisnri swāX dz+nyo dwo spyu sta pa~X ṭ+wāṃ /ca/shā ༵༵ shā/du/n+d+ra rdzu 'dul par mdzad pa thams cad kyang cho 'phruladang ② 'phrul gnyis su 'du zhing] rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig rje btsun 'dis sems can gyidabye bdang mthun par rdzu 'phruladang cho 'phrul mdzad pa snro/ rnorno pashā rnyipa ༵/ ṭ+wāṃ /sna k+ṣiṃ pa/( r+sha spyu dzo ma krā rdzu ts+tsha shāshārnyi sdu snronā paX (( ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ kyi don mdzad pas na/ stobs chen pha rol gnon pa 4/ /zhes bya ba gsungs te/ de la rdzu 'phrul chen po'i rnal 'phyor pa la bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/desang sku gsung thugs kyi rdzu 'phrul gsum las/sku'i rdzu 'phrul ni/ 'grel chen las/ de yang rnam pa gsum lte/ lus kyi rdzu 'phrul ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa na gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyi lus dang rjes su mthun pa'i sku'i mchog cig car ston zhing 'dul bar mdzad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing/ de'i rgyas par bshad 20
rgyud gsungs tshul/pa ni/ 'jam dpal las/ kun tu 'gro ba'i don yod stobs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yid ltar mgyogs/ /rgyal bdagra rgyal rnam par rgyal/ /gsor los bsgyur ba stobs 'o che//zhes gsungs pa yin te/ 'grel chen las/ rje btsun 'jam dpal gyis 'gro ba thams cad kyi don/ don yod par mdzad pa la sogs pa'i khyad par gyis phul du byung ba'i ngo bo nyid du bsnyan par bya ba'i phyigzhes sogs dang]de nyid las thams cad du cig car gdul bya rnams la snang zhing gshegs pas na kun tu 'bro ba'o/ /zhesadang/de nyid las/don yod pa ni 'bras bu yod pa lte/gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa ji ltab bzhin du rdzogs pa'i 'ju ba gang lawend pa de ni stobs so/ /bshad pa gnyis pa ltar na yang chos kyi sku la mnga' brnyes pas don yod/ thogs pa med par gshegs pa ni thugs su chud pa ste/ de bzhin nyid thugs su chud pas/ skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la yid bzhin nor bu rin po che dang 'dra bar gyur pas na/ kun tu 'phyo ba'i don yod stobs/ /zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ sku'i ② 'phrul rgyas pa dang] khro po'i skor 'og tu 'chad/gsung gi rdzu 'phrul ni/ 'grel chen las/ ngag gi ② 'phrul ni/ sems can thams cad kyi skad dang brdas chos ston par mdzad pa'o/ /zhes dang / de'i rgyas bshad ni/ 'jam dpal las/bdag med seṅge'i sgra dang ldan/ /mu stegs ri dwags ngan 'jigs byed/ /ces sogs rtsa'agrel dang] yang 'grel chen las/ da ni ngag gi rab tu dbye bas bdag khor gyur pa nyid du bstan par bya ba'i pyid tshig rje tshig bdag smra mkhas pa/ /tshig la dbang ba tshig mtha' yas/ /tshig bden pa dang bden par spya /bden pa bzhi ni ston pa po/ /zhes pa nas/don so rtso yang dag par rig pa de ni don thams cad bltan pa la mi zad pa yin te/ de lta bu'i mi zad par bstan pa'i tshig rnams la dbang phyug tu gyur pas na tshig rje'o/ /zhes dang] yang de nyid las/ chos so so yang dag par rig pa ni/ gang chos thams cad la rjes su 'jug pa shes pa nas/ ji srid du sems can gyi 21
'jigs byed chos 'byung /rgyud pa brgyad khri bzhi stong po de dag gi sems kyi 'jug ba dang] 'bab pa shes pa dngaka so so ci rigs par chos ston pa shes pa dang / dus las mi 'da' bar shes pa dang / snod kyi bye brag ji lta ba bzhin du shes pa dang] 'bras bu yod par chos ston ba shes pa dngan ma chad ma lhag par chos ston pa shes pa lte/ de ltar tshig rnams kyi bdag sar gyur pas na tshig bdag go/de langes pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pa ni/gang sems can thams cad kyi skad la 'jug pa shes pa lte/ lha'i skadadang] klu dngaka gnod sgyin dang] dri za dang] lha ma yinadang] nam mkha' lding dang/mi'am ci dang/ sto 'tshe chen 4 dngad mi dang] mi ma yin pa'i skad la 'jug pa shes pa lte/ mdor na ji snyed du 'gro ba lngar skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi skad dang/ sgra dang/ dbyangs dang] tshig gi lam dang/nges pa'i tshig dang/ brdadangaka bh+yod pa ji snyed pade dag thams cad rab tu shes te/shes nas kyang sgradedangadedag dang]nges pa'i tshigadedangadedag gis sems canadedangadedag la sgra ji lta ba bzhin du 'jug pas lngastos ston pas na smra mkhas pa'o/ /zhes pa nas/ saṃ skṛ ta dang]skad tha mal pa dang] zur chag pa dang/ sha za'i skad dang/ ma ga ṅga pa'i skad dang/ zung du 'jug pa'i skad dang] tha dad pa la 〈snags pa'i skad thams cad la mkhas shing thams cad du tshig gis ston nus pas na tshig la dbang ba'o/ /zhes pa nas/de bsan yul dang dus kyi gnas skabs kyi bye brag gis rgyun chad ba med par rnam pa thams cad du rgyun mi 'chad pa'i tshig rgyun 'byung bas na tshig mtha' yas zhes bya lte/ zhes gsungs/gsum pa zugs kyi rdzu 'phrulani/ 'grel chen las/yid kyi sprul pani/ sems can gyi snyungad pa'i rjes su zhugs nas yangadag par bskul zhing snang bar byas te/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la rab tu 'jog par mdzad pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de skad cig ma gcig la chos thams cad cig char du rnam rtog med par mngon sum du rtogs pas na lha klu nyan rang kun gyi dbang khor gyur pas thub 22

rgyudagasungs tshugdang phyag drug gshin rje pho brgyad rnams kyi dngor can dngaka zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rgya gzhung sogs kyang 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur pa ltar yin no/ /rtog bdun las/ desa'i lha rnams thams ca da la//drug shul che zhing 'jigs par byed/ /cesadang/ lā lita chung ba'i rgyud 'grel las kyangakadenas zhes bya bani tshig gi phradate/rim padang rgyu'idonate/de'i 'og nyuzhes pa'idonato//de bas na snga ma la ltos pa'i bkra shis pa45 dbang du byed pa'idon to//rdo rje 'jigs byedani drag 4 chen po'i gzugs 'dzin pas 'jigs pa'o/ /tshangs padang khyab 'jug la sogs ba'i lharnamasadanganma hwade ba la sogs pa drag po 'jigs par byed pas 'jigs byedade/ yohe'i zhal lo//zhesadang/slobadapon mi bskyod pa'i 'grel pa las kyangad 'jig rten gsum zhes bya ba ni bdag 4 ste/ rgyal bar byed pa dang sbrang rtsir byed pa dang/ don kun grub par ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lta khyad par bzhi pa skra sen ba spu'i khyad par rdo rje ltar thogs pa med par sreg pa'i dus mtha'i me'i gzi bajid 'bar bas tshangs pa'i 'dzig rten bar du khyab pa'i skra'i khyad par ni/lan+dam dpal las/ smra yang rdo rje 'bar ba ste/ /zhes dang] 'grel chen las/ khro bo do rje me ltar rab tu 'bar ba'i gzugs kyis tshangs pa'i 'dzig rten mthar zug pa 'bar zhing sreg pa'ingo bo nyid kyi skra gang la mnga' ba de ni/ skra yang rdo rje 'bar ba zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ ba b+thā de ltar 'bar ba'i khyad paraming/rdo rje'i spuni gcig bu'i lus/ /zhesadangaka 'grel chen las/rdo rje'i gzugs can gyi ba spu ni rdo rje'i spu ste/deyang shin tu rno ba'i myu gu ltabudang ldan pa'i lus gangasan pade'i/lus ni rdo rje'i ba spru can zhes bya'o/ /mi mthun pa'i ba spu med pas na rda 3'i spu zhes bya lte/ de ltabu'i gcig pu gnyis su med pa'i lus gang yin pa de la ni/ rdo rje'i spru ni gcig bu'i lus zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ phyag sen rdo rje ltar rno ba'i rtsemo dang ldan zhing dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i khyad par ni/ 'jam dpal las/ sen mo skyes pa rdo rje'i smra /zhes dang / 'grel chen las/33
'jigs byedachos 'byung /rdo rje'i rtsemo rnams kyis shin tu brtan zhing sra bar byas pa'i sen mo skye zhing rtserno ba gang yin pa de ni/ sen mo skyes ba rdo rje'i smra /zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/: khyad par lnga pa zhal gdangs pas khams gsum za bar nus pa ni/ rtog bdun las/ rdo rje'i 'dzigs byed khams gsum ṭo za bar nus pa/ zhes so/ /zhalade'i dbugs sreg pa'i dud pa ltar 'phyo bayang/ 'jamadapal las/ ha la ha la gdong brgya pa/ /gzhin rje gshed 4 bgegs kyi rgyal/ /zhesadang/ 'grel chen las/ ltabadangan mche ba dang/ kha chu dang/ reg pa'i dug dang ldan pa'i klu chen po rnamasani ha la ha la zhes pa ste/ me 'bar ba ltar dug 'bar zhing rnam par 'phro bas gzengs pa mig shin nyugadug pa lce shin 4bskyod cing slog ltar 'gyu ba shin tu 'jigs su rung ba zhes panas/sbrul chen po'i gdengs spu'i gdong brgya snyed 'dus par ston pa'i sku dang ldan pasan ha la ha la gdong brgya pa/zhes bya'o/ /zhes pa nas/ 'jigs byed pa zhes bya ba la gdug pa rnams zhes bya bani lhag ma'o/ /zhes gsungs then/ /de nyid lnga pa las kyangacad /1khyad par drug pa sminadabus kho gnyerani/rtog bdun las/rnam par gcig pa'i khro gnyer 'jigs pa zhes so//spyan rdo rje'i kha gyes pa brtsegs pa'i 'od zer 'bar ba khro bo'i gzi bajid nyi ma brgya ltar 'bar ba ni/ slob dpon zhi ba ye shes kyis/ mi bzad dus mtha'i bskal pa'i me ltar 'bag /zhal gdangs kho gnyer smin ma slog ltar dbyug /sbyan bgrad mche ba gtsigs pa rab tu 'bag /zhesadang/ 'jamadabal las/rdo rje 'bar ba mig mi bzad/ /cesadang] 'grel chen las/rdo rje 'bar ba'i kha rnam par gyes pa shin tu drag cing dmar la ser skyadang] dmar ser gyi spyan gang la mnga' bdeni rdo rje 'bar ba mig mi bzang/ ces bya'o/ /nang gi tingange 'edzin nam mkha'i sgron ma sogs brgya phragadang mthun par mi rusang gdul bya 'dul ba'i rdo rje'i 'od zer spyan brgya sogs mnga' ba ni/ 'jamadapal las/ mig brgya pa lte rdo rje'i mig/ces dngan 'grel chen las/34
rgyudagasungs tshugnam mkha'i sgron ma zhes bya ba la sogs pa grangs brgyar chad pa'iltangange 'edzin gyingo bo nyid kyis dngos po'i don ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du gzigs pa'i ngo bo nyid du gyur pa'i mig gang la yod pade ni mig brgya pa ste/de yang rdo rje chen po 'bar ba dang ldan pas na rdo rje'i mig go/zhes dang /'jam dpal las/ keng rus mche ba gtsigs pa 4/ /zhes dngan 'grel chen las/ mi mgo rlon dang skam 4 dang] /yi dwags 'tsheng bas brgyan par bsgom/ /zhes gsungs pas na keng rus kyi rgyan dang ldan pa'i phyir keng rus so/ /nges par 'byed pa'i shes rab non po'i mche ba gtsigs pa'i tshems mthon po mnga' bas na mche ba gtsigs pa 4/ keng rus can yang yin la mche ba gtsigs pa yang yin pas na/ keng rus mche ba gtsigs pa po/ /zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ /zhes gsungs/de ltabu'i skra spyan tshems smin ma rdzi ma rdo rje'i 'od zer re res kyang gdug pa can thams cad kyi g.yul ma lus pa sel ba ni/ 'jam dpal las/ lda ྅ gcig pu g.yul sel ba/ /zhes dngad 'grel chen las/rdo rje gcig pus bdud dang mu stegs dang nyon mongs pa'i dgra rnam par 'joms par mdzad pasan/ do re'i gcig pu g.yul sel ba/ /zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs serdzo/ /: khyad par bdun pa zhabs kyi stabs tsam gyis 'jig rten thams cad mnan pa dang /zhabs re re'i mazil tsam gyis 'jig rten gsum gnon pa dang g.yo bar mdzad nas 'chad 'gyur ltar bka' bsgodang rgyud gsungs dus kyi tsho 'phrul du lan bcan te/ slobadapon zhi bas shes kyis/ khos pa'i stabs chen bangabs pas sa gsum gnon/ /zhes dang/ 'jamadapal las/'jig rten gsum po gom gcig bzod/ /mkha' ltar mtha' med rnam par gnon/ /zhes dngadslob dpon zhi ba ye shes kyis/ bdud rigs gnon pa'i zhabs ni brkyangs bskum mdzad/ /ces dang] 'grel chen las/ 'jig rten gsum 4 thams cad du cig car du gom pa gcig pa'i gom pas 'gro ba gang yin pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ /de bzhin du nam mkha' la mtha' med pasade'i 35
'jigasabyed chos 'byung/mthar zug pa'i rnam par gnon pa dang ldan pas na/ mkha' ltar mtha' med rnam par gnon/ /zhes bya'o/ /zhes dngan 'jam dpal las/ rkang mazel sen mo'i khyon gyis kyang / /tshangs pa'i yul sa 〉nas gnon/ /sa yi dkyil gshor gzhi yi khyon/ /rkang pa ya gcig mthil gyis gnon/ /zhes dang] 'grel chen las/ sa yi dkyil gshor ni sa chen po'idakyil gshor ro/ /de'i gzhi ni steng gi cha lte/ de zhabs gcig gi mazil gyis gnon cing ldid kyis phab pas bzung nas bzhugs pas na/ sa yi dkyil dngor bzhi yi khyon/ /rkang pa ya gcig mthil gyis gnon/ /zhes bya'o/ /tshangs pa'i yul sa'i sgras ni/ srid pa'i rtsemo'i steng nas nam mkha'i mthar zug pa'i thod pa'i gzugs su mu stegs pa rnams kyisawenangs su brtags pa'o/ /de'i rtseponi steng gi cha ste/deni tshangs pa'i yul sa'i rtsemo'o/ /gnon pa ni mnan pa'o/ zhabs gang gis tshangs pa'i yul sa'i rtsenas gnon pa'i zhabs de'i mthe bo'i sen po der 'jog pa gang yin pa de ni/ rkang mtheb sen mo'i khyon gyis kyang] /tshangs pa'i yul sa rtsenas gnon/ /zhes bya'o/ /'di skad ston par 'gyurate/ zhabs gcig gi mthil gyis sa gzhi'i 'og nas mnan nas zhabs gnyis pa'i mthe bo'i sen mos tshangs pa'i rtsemo nas mnan lte/ gar gyi byed pa sna tshogs pa'i thabs kyis rnam par gnon cing / zab cing brtan pas nam mkha'i khongs thams cad khyab pa'i gar gyis 'gengs la/ dri ma med cing mtha' yas pa'i sgyu rtsal dang ldan pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs rab tu gar mdzad cing bzhugs pa'o/ /la la las ni/ rkang mtheb sen mo gnas pa ni/ /tshangs pa'i yul sa rtsenas gnon/ /zhes zer te/der sa'i dkyil dngor du rkang pa gcig gis mnan nas gnas pa'o/ /de gang yin zhes dris pa la/ rkang mazeb sen mo zhes bya ba ni lan no/ /des ci tsam khyab nas gnas dren zhes rtog pa la tshangs pa'i yul sa rtsonas gnon/ zhes bya ba ni lan no/ /der de ltabu'i khyad par can gyi zhabs kyi maze bo'i sen mos bcom ldan 'das bzhugs sem/ /zhes bya ba ni/ tshig gi lhag ma'o/ /yang 36

rgyudagasungs tshugpa'o/ /skyes bu gsal shing la bskyon pas ni mi dge ba bcudang] chos spongadangan mtshams med sogs byas pa'i sdig po che btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya bar ston pa'o/ /zhesadangan grub chenadapal 'dzin gyi bstod pa de nyid lnga pa las kyang] mnyam nyid mi g.yo dur khrod rje/ /lhung ba'i lha gnyis sdigs pa'i sku/ /sdigs mdzub drag pos gdul dka' 'dul/ /mgo ldog mnan nas rab tu gathenal/ /zhes gsungs zug/ /:khyad par dgu ba zhabs g.yas bskum padang] g.yon brkyangs pas gdul bya lha brgyad pho mo/ gshin rje pho mo/ nad gdon rnams brgyad brgyad sogs btul bsan te/ rtsargyud las/brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang] khyab 'jugadangan gzhon nu rnams kha spub tu byas nas zhabs kyi 'og tu mnan pa/ zhes dang / saṃ bu 9ga tshangs pa dang bcas pa nye dbang dang drag po la sogs pa 'jig rten gsum 4 za ba dang] zhes dang] de'i 'grel pa man snye las/ tshangs bdangan dbang 4 dang/ nyedabang dang drag 4 dang] nyi ma dang] gzhon nu la sogs pa kha spub tu zhabs 'og tu spya ༵༵ ltu ༷/ smaṃ ṭī |// / ྅ gh+nā bhe+e //༈/ ༷༷ ṭī |༷smo ṭ+wāṃ/ smru] ba dang]nyi mdangaka gzhon nu dang] nag 4 la 〈snags pa kha zur tu bltas pa zhabs 'og tu mnan pa/zhesadang/ slobadapon zhi bas shes kyis kyang] bajid rngam zhabs kyi tsham rngam las/ /g.yas skya zhabs brgyad bskums pas ni/ /dregs pa'i ltabargyad thabs kyis gnon/ /ga'adon gyi zhabs brgyad brkyangs pas ni/ /dregs pa'i lha mo brgyad la rol/ /zhes gsungs la/ mngon brjod du /gārdzu klidī pa rnyi zi rnyishā shā sra sna shā ༵ ༵༵༷ ༵ ༵ shā (shā sha/ḍi ṭ+wāṃ zla sna snropa paspyu mas 39
'jigasabyed chosa'abyung /lta khyad par bcu pa gsung gi drag shul nam mkha'i mthar khyab pa'i bzhad pa brgyad sogs kyis tshangs pa sogs btul tshul 'thad de/ ma he'i zhal gyis ha ha drag tu bzhad pas sa steng gi nad brgyad gdon brgyad sogs 'byung po'i dkyil ga'or dang bcas pa'i chags can dbang rgyug btul ba ni/ 'jam dpal las/ drag chen ha ha zhes slogs pa/ /zhes dngaka 'grel chen las/ 'byung po'i dkyil gabor du phra men mar gtogs pa'i ha ha'i sgra'i ngo bo nyid drag 4 chen ngos sems canadaman pa brgyal bar bya ba'i phyir drag chen ha ha zhes ba'am/ zhes gsungs/ rta mchog gam rta mgrin gyi ngo 4 dbang gi zhal dmar 4 khrag 'dzag cing mche bgatsigs pas hi hi zhes bya bas tshangs pa sogs sam he he zhes pas khyab 'jug nyi zla zugags dang ho ho zhes pas gzhon nu log 'dren srin 4 brgyal zhing sgyung bar byas pa ni/ 'jam dpal las/ hi hi zhes snyogs 'jigs par byed/ /ces dang / 'grel chen las/ rta mchog gi gzugs kyis hi hi zhes bya ba'i sgras tshangs pa la sogs pa ltang bar byed cing / gzhan rnams kyang 'jigs pa bskyed par mdzad pa'am/ zhes dang/ rtog bdun las/ zhal rnam par 'gyur pa/ ha ha zhes slog cing ljags 'dril ba/ zhes dngaka rong 'gyur las/ zhal gtsigs pa/ ha ha zhes ljags 'dril ba/ zhesadang] zhang 'gyur rtog pa dang 4 las/ ha ha zhes sgrog cing/ de chung dkrol nas/ zhes dang] rwa 'gyur las/ mtshan phyed na cang te'u dkrol bas ha ha zhes bya zhing shin tu mnyam par bzhag lte/ zhes dang/de'i thad kyi rdo rje grub pa'i 'grel las/ ha ha zhes slog cing zhes pa gad mo brgyad kyi rnam par byed pa'o/ /zhes dang] rtson shrīs/ ha ha zhes bya ba ni gad mo rnam par brgyad spyashā ṭ+wāṃ dī]ra shārnyi /dar+sha]/lha /ga hā spyashā (pa/ rdo /|te rnyi/ kau hā pa ) spra rnyi /hūṃ/ spyu spyu )sna sngusna/ ces dang] nag 'o zhabs kyi dgra nag gi 'grel par dam ba dang po'i lung drangs pag ha ha sdig 40
rgyudagasungs tshugpa'i gad mo dang] /he he rab tu dgyes pa dang / /hi hi bde bar sgeg pa nyid/ /ho lha zil gyis gnon ba'o/ /zhes gsungs la/ bde mtshog skor nas kyang] ha ha he he ho ho haṃ haḥbargyad la bzhad pa brgyad du lu ba pa dang lha sbas kyis bshad la/ 'jam dpal las kyang] drag chen ha ha zhes rdzogs pa/ /hi hi zhes sgrogs 'jigs par byed/ /gad mo chen mo gad rgyangs can/ /rdo rje gad mo cher sgrogs pa/ /zhesadang/rdo rje hūṃ ste hūṃ zhes sgogs/ /zhes dang] gad rgyangs ha ha nges par slogs/ /yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgro/ /'jam dbyangs chen 4 sgra che ba/ /'jig rten gsuman sgra gcig pa/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas sgra sgrogs pa/ /sgra dang ldan pa rnams kyi mtshog /ces dang/'grel chen las kyangaka hi hi zhes slogs 'jigs par byed/ /ces bya'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams ma lus par khyab par mdzad pas na gad mo chen po'o/ /rdo rje bzhad pa'i gzugs kyis shin tu rmad du byung ba'idon ston par mdzad pas na gad rgyangs can zhes bya'o/ /gzhan gyi dbye bas mi phyed pa'iwe shes kyi bdag nyid canayin pasan rdo rje'i gad mo'o//7chen po nyidadang ldan pasan cher sgrogs pa'o/ /zhes dngan 'grel chen las/ sems can shin tu gtum 4 rnams gdul bar bya ba'i phyir drag po'i gzugs 7)na par mdzad pas na rdo rje drag po'o/ /zhes dang/ de nyid las/khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi gzugs kyis/ srid gsum ma lus pa rnams su yang yi ge hūṃ spro bar mdzad pas na/ rdo rje hūṃ lte hūṃ zhes sgrogs/ /zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zhi ba ye shes kyis/ spyan bgrad mche ba ga②gas pa rab tu 'bag /rdo rje'i rta skad drag 4 ha har bzhad/ /ces gsungs dreg/ /ltakhyad par bcu gcig padabang gi zhal gtso 'or gyur pa'i zhal thams cadanas cadang phaṭa ces drag tu nam mkha'i khams khyad par bsgrags pas/ mkha' khyab kyi sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' 4 mkha' 'gro regs pa can thams cad til gang ltar bsdus nas sgrub pa po la dngos grub 41
'jigs byedachos 'byung /myur du stsol cig gi bka' bsgos pas dngos grub shin tu myur khyad yod de/ 'jam dpal las/nam mkha'i mtha' klas sgra sgrogs pa/ /sgra dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog/ces pa rtsa'agreladang/ zhi bas shes kyis/ dbus kyi zhal gsum 'bar bani/ /khrodang chags dang zhi ba'i tshul/ /zhesadang]ཿ hūṃ/ skyo keṃ ṭ+wāṃ snye ṭ+wāṃ sgyi ༷/sdi/ /l+lī ṭ+wāṃ mū / / ༷ sde do da rdo sto po'i sgradang ldan/ /zhes dang] slob dasan las kyi rgyal po'i bstod pa las kyangaka zhaladagu khos smraX/ rnyi sna rnyi r+shadīlha /sna dzoñdza/sna ñtsā hūm̐ shā ༵ shāshā ṭā zlo m+b+ya snashā ṭ+wāṃ pag/shā tshin+dha/ he he dza/ /zhes dngad dzā dzā ke ke hūṃ hūṃ ha la ha/ /ha ha ya ya ma ma ra ra zhes/ /tsa tsha las rnams ma lus kun mdzad pa/ /zhes gsungs sem/ /lta khyad par bcu gnyis pa thugs kyi drag shul sku dang gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin du mdzad kyang zugs rje dang mnyam nyid las mi g.yo ba yin te/ thugs rje chen sos gdul bya 'dul ba'i sku'i zlos gar 'dzigs su rung ba rgyal ba rnams kyang skrag pa skyed pa ltabu du mas ma rung ba tshar gcod pa sogs gdul bya gang 'tshams su 'dul bdang/ gsung gi drag shul sngar bshad pa lta bu'i snod bcud rnams kyis bzod par dka' ba'i rdo rje'i sgra 'byon par mdzad pa lta bu sogs kyis gdug pa can rnams brgyal sngangs skrag pa sogs gdul bya gang 'tshams su 'dul bar mdzad kyang zugs chosadabyings mnyam bzhag las mi g.yo ba rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs bzhin du g.yo yang gting 'i 'khrag pa la thugs rje chen po'i rlan gsher gyi phung po mi zad par rtag tu bzhugs 42
rgyudagasungs tshugr+shaspriswā thastan+dha )pa pas/ /da /lha ༵ r+yaṃ spri tsho/ ṭ+wāṃ pa/ ṇā/ zloshā/ /padī lha ༵ spyu ༵༵ r+yaṃ//〉spra dasan gzhon nu zla ba'i 'grel pa las/ rdo rje ni shes rab kyis so/ /thabs kyi phyir na 'jigs byed do/ /de yang shin tu drag po'i lha thams cad 'jigs par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang snying rje'i 'bras bu nyid do/ /gang rdo rje can gyis gsungs pa/ snang ba'i sems can rnams la snying rje can du min/ /gang phyiradelang zhi ba'iyonatan gyis mdzes min/ /de phyir rdo rje canadesangadag 'jigs su rung bar gyur /thod pa'i 'tsheng bas brgyan pa'i pyiran 'tsheng ba can/nyi ma'i 'od zer tsha ba rgya mtsho cher mnyam pa/ /rgyas par byed pas kyang ni snying rjes sku grub pa/ /nang du kha ba'i ba mo 'bab 'gyur ba/ /pyi yi ri mo 'phyo ba rnams la 'babs/ /zhes dngaka yang de nyid las/ rang dbang can gyi 'jigs byed la sogs pa rnams kyis gzhan gyi srog chags la sogs pa rnams kyis rtso/ /gsal bar byed pa'idon gyis lha'o/ /de rnams kyis shin tu drag 4 sems can gyidon du gnod par byed pa 'jigs par byed pa ste/ 'jigs pa 'tshams su byed pa'o/ /zhesadang/grub chen lā li tas zhe dgu ma las/ gzugs mchog mchog tu drag po che/ /dpa' po mchog gi sprengad yul can/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba'i don mdzad pa/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ces dang / grub chen don yod zhabs kyis kyang] ngo bo nyid med sku mnga' zhingad /sgyu ma'i gzugs can 'byung gnas che/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sprul pa yi/ /sras kyi shu 'or rab tu grags/ /bcom ldan mgon 4 de nyid mkhyen/ /dpal ldan khyab bdag las kyi bdag /yid bzhin nor bu chen 4 ltas /ji ltar sbyo dā ༷ r+ṇi dzi ny+pha/na/ n+tā ༵ shās] dzo( (spya /pa( ñtsā ༈ spya spya pazhi( pa/ pas lhapa zhing gzhanadon 'jug/sgra gug la sogs mtshan ma 'dzin cing kho bcas thun mong min/ /'jigs 43
'jigs byed chos 'byung /byed zhaladagu pa la mgo pos phyag 'tshal lo//zhesadang zhi bas shes kyis kyang/ zugs mchog 'jam ba'ingang las ma g.yos kyangaka/zugs rje gdug pa ma lus 'dul ba'i phyis /zhesadang/ye shes shugs kyidakyil lta'or ni/ /ji ltaburani sprul gyur kyang] /rnamadag dbyings las ma g.yos te/ /mnyam nyid khyod/ ces dang] slob dpon rdo rje grub pa'i 'grel pa las kyang]rdo rje stong pa nyid du brjod/ /'dzigs byed snying rjer medod pa lte/ /rdo rje 'dzigs byed bh+yor ba las/ /gnyis ka de yi bdag nyid 'grub/ /ces pa nas/ drag shul zhes bya ba ni kho bo'i thugs nyid las so/ /'jigs byed ces pani rnam par 'gyur ba'i gzugs las so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rtson shrīdang ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta yang bzhed cing] lā li ta'i 'grel ba'i lung drangs zin/ man snye dpang 'gyur las kyang]nyi ma'idakyil 'khor las bzhengs pa de'i steng gi hūṃ yig las so/ /rdo rjeni shes rab nyid kyi phyir te/ 'dzigs byed ni thabs nyid kyi mig shin tu drag cing la)gas par byed pa nyid ni zugs rje kho na las so/ /de gsungs pa/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis gdung ba'i mtsho chen dngaka /mnyam pa'i sku chen zugs rje'i bdag gang rnams/ /nang du ba mo lta bur bsil yin yang / /phyi rol kho na 'gro ba rtsub par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de'i phyir stong pa nyid dang snying rje chen 4 dbyer med pa'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje 'jigs byed do/ /ma he'i gzugs can zhes pa rtsaba'i zhal te/ sprul gyi mchod phyir thogs pa can/ tshangs pa dang/ dbang 4 dang/nye dbang dang/ drag 4 dang]nyi ma dang] gzhon nu la sogs pa kha spub tu zhabs 'og tu lhung pa rnams 'jigs par mdzad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltabu mang la/do rje 'jigs byedade ltar yin tshul ma shes par zhe snang dam 4 gcig la bskyed rim snyam pa ni/ lha'i cod pan dang khyi'i rnga ma nor ba ltabu yin no/ /༈bcagasum pa 'phrin las kyi khyad parade yan chad kyi mdzad pa der ma zad/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyilabadang yumadang sras su gyur pa'i khyad paralang lan pasan te/ rgyal 44
rgyudagasungs tshugba thams cad kyang slob lam gyi skabs su/ thabs kyi chos rdzogs par ston pas na pha lta bu/ 〈snas kyi dbyings rdzogs par ston pas na ma lta bu lte/ mdo las/ ma ni shes rab pha ni thabs/ zhes sogs lta bu dngaka sdong 4 bkod par nor bzang gis kyangaka 'di dag bskyed pas bdag gi ma lta (be+e/ /ñtsha shā shā dri ba sbyi (sna ༵ ma hūm̐/shā/ lha /da/ k+ṇi sdu byi zhugā kau ༵ ༵ buhā ga/༵/ /sra ni/ snazlo rgyal ba ches mang dpag tu med pa dang / da ltar dang ma 'ongs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi thabs sogs ston pa'i yab dang/ chos nyid sogs ston pa'i yum du gyur par ma zad/ de dag gi mdun du rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul bzung nas bstan 'gro mtha' yas pa'i don byed pa'i phyir te/ slob dpon zhi ba ye shes kyis/ gnyis med thun mong ma yin khyab pa'i sku/ /kun la snyoms mdzad rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /chos kyidabyings gyur rgyal ba kun kyi yum/ /yi shes sems dpa' rgyal ba kun gyi sras/ /zhes dang / de ltar 'gyur ba'i sems bskyed tshul las/ zhing bdod kyi mdo 'grel chen du drangs pa las/ sngon bcom ldan 'das laram pa'i dbyangs pangor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal 4 nam mkha' zhes bya bar gyur pa na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra'i dbyangs kyi rgyal po'i spyan sngar smon lam tshad med pa btab pa lta bu ste/ de yang de nas rgyal 4 nam mkha' sog chags bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cus yongs su bskor zhing mdun du bdar te/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra'i dbyangs kyi rgyal po ga la ba der dong ste/lhags nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la sbyo 'os phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das de la lan bdun skor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu dngod do/ /rigs kyi bu de nas rgyal 4 nam mkha' zhes bya bdes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra'i dbyangs kyi rgyal 4 ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol ba/ khyod 45
'jigasabyed chos 'byung /kyi spyan sngar dam chos zhu/ /skyes bu dam pa mchog skye bag /rnam pa gang gis gyur pa de/ /rnam par 'drin pas bdag la gsungs/ /rnam 'dron khyod la mngon sum gu /mchod pa yangs pa bgyid bgyid kyangan /mnges sems kyis bgyid gyur cing] /gang yangaskungangs su bgro ma bgyis/ /bdag ni gcig budabe+en gnas tshe//'de 'dra'i sems shig skyes par rgyug/bdag gis bsodanams che bsags na/ /ji ltar yongs su de bgro snyam/ /tshangs par bsngo 'am brgya spyan nam/ /gling bzhi'idabang snyog 'orgob pa'5/ /'onate ga thosadangos sor ram/ /rang rgyal lagab pa'i phyir bgro snyam/ /de ltar sems bskyed de ma thag /lha rnams sgra 'byin brjod pa ni/ /dam pa'i sems kyi bsod nams 'di/ /rnam par chud gzon ma byed cig /sems can kun la phan pa'i pyid /smon lam rlabs chen gdab par gyis/ /byang chub sems rab bskyed byas shingaka /la)ga rten rnams kyi don yang gyis/ /de bas chos kyi dbang phyug gtso/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la bdag zhu lte/ /thub pa ji ltar sems bskyed na/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub skyes par 'gyug /ye shes de ni gang gis 'jub/ /dedon bdag la bstan tu gsol/ /byang chub semasani bskyed bgyis shingan /zub pa khyod 'drar bdag kyang smon/ /de yi tshig de gsan gyur nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal pa/ /rgyal po chen pho shes par gyis/ /rim gyis khyod la bstan par sga /chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin te/ /'dun pa'i rtsal rab tu gnas/ /gang gis smon lam ci btab pa/ /de yi 'bras bu 'thob par gyur/ /rgyal bo ngas kyang gron chad ni/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed smyug /sems can kun la phan don pu /ngasani smon lam dam pa btab/ /smon lam ji ltar btab tshul pu/ngasani 'bus bu thob par gyug/byang chubadam pangs thob pas/ /ngayi bsam pa rdzogs par gyug /rgyal 4 chen 4 brtan gyis la/ /mi 'gyur sems ni bskyed par gyis/ /galate spyod ba spyad byasam/khyod kyangayangadag sangs rgyas 'gyug/thub pa'igasungani cas gyuranas//rgyal 46
rgyudagasungs tshul/po de ni dga' bar gyur/ /lajeg rten kun gyi mngon sum du/ /seng ge'i nga ror tshig 'di brjod/ /dngor ba'i tha ma med spru yi/ /gron gyi mtha'ani ji srid pa/ /de srid sems can phan don pu /spyod padapag yas spyad par sga /'jig rten mgon po'i spyan snga 'ded /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyedado/ /las ba thams cad mgron gnyer te/ /dbul zhing phongs lasadagrol bar s+pha /de ring phan chad gal te yang/ /bdag gis 'dod chags sems bskyed na/ /phyogs bcudagan gang bzhugs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bslus par gyug /byang chub nam zhig thob par pu /tha ba'i sems dang gnod sems dang / /phrag dog dang ni ser sna yang / /de ring phan chad mi bya'o/ /tshangs pa'i bh+yod pa bdag gis spyad/ /sdig pa'i spre1da pa yongs su btang / /tshul khrims sdom dang nges ba la/ /sangs rgyas rjes su bslab bar bya/ /bdag ni byang chub rings tshul gu /'tshang rgyar mos shing spro ba med/ /sgyi mthar thug gi bar du yangad /sems can gcig phyir spyad par sga /tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni sbyang bar sga /phyogs rnams bcu 4 thams cad pu /bdag gi ming ni thos par sga /bdag gis bdag la lung bston te/ /sangs rgyas 'gyur b.radogs ba med/ /bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag /bdag dbang 'di na 'dren ba rnams/ /lus dang ngag gi las rnams kyang / /rnam pa kun tu bdag gis kyangad /yid kyi las kyang sbyang bar sga /midage lasani spyad mi sga /ma 'ongs dusan sangs rgyas te/ /'jig rten mgon du gyur zhe na/ /bden pa desas sa 'di yang] /rnam pa drug tu g.yos gyur cig /bdag gis bden tshig gang brjod pa/ /ma nor yang dag smras she na/ /bden spru 'di yis mkha' dbyings las/ /sil snyan dag gi sgra grag zugag /bdag la gal te ga' med cing / /de bzhin tha ba med ce na/ /man dā ra ba'i me tog bzang] /bden pa 'di yis char du phob/ /yang dag don dunges pa yis/ /tshig bden 'di skad brjod pa dang / /phyogs bcu mtha' yas thams 47
'jigs byed chos 'byung /cad kyi/ /bye ba'i zhing rnams rab tu g.yos/ /de yi mod la mkha' dbyings las/ /sil snyan bye ba'i sgra yang byung / /me tog man dā ra ba dag /mi 'greng bdun srid bab par smyug /rgyal po de yi rjes bslabs te/ /srog chags bye ba nyi shu yis/ /'dren par bdag cag 'gyur smon zhes/ /yid du 'ong pa'i sgra yang bsgrags/ /zhes bya ba dang / gzhan yang de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'do skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs ma mchis pa nas nye bar bzung lte/ bdag gis smon lam btab pani nam bdag gis phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su sangs rgyas kyi spyan sgrib pa med pas bltas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad bdag gis byang chub la yang dag par btsud pa dngaka bdag gis byang chub kyi sems la bkod pa dngaka bdag gis sbyin spru la yang dag par btsud pa dang/ de bzhin du bdag gis tshul khrims dngaka bzod pa dang] brtson 'grus dang] bsam gtan dang] shes rab lalang dag bar btsud pa dang] bdag gis bskul ba dang/ bdag gis rjes su bstan par gyur pa ma mthong bde srid du bdag bla na med pamingadag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mi bya'o/ /nam bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi spyan sgrib pa med pas phyogs bcur rnam par bltas kyang bdag gis sangs rgyas nyid la ma bkod pa'i de bzhin gshegs bde lta bu gang yang mthong bar ma gyur pa de'i tshe bdag kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya'o/ /zhes mi bgyi bar smon lam btab 'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang bdag gis smon lam 'di skad ces btab lte/ bdag gisa'i bdag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig la gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing tsam gyi tha gru yangs par yongs su ma grub cing sangs rgyas kyi zhing de'i phyi rin 4 che 'bum phrag du ma las grub pa 48

'phags yul du byung tshugto/ /zhing ba pad+ma rdo rjes rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi rgyud pa rlabs 4 che/ sangs rgyas kyi yul lha skyo gh+nā sna dzo ༵ traṃ ṭ+wāṃ dz+nyo sna tram̐ /( dzo dh+ri hūm̐ k+ṣiṃ ( shā/shā ༵༵ sbyo/sna hāX ]ma〉spra lha sngu] gār+sha ṭ+wāṃ kyi tshul gyi spyad pa spyod pa'i rnal 'phyor pa dang rnal 'byor ma grub pa brnyes pa 'ba' zhig gis yongs su gang bar mthong lte/ rnal 'phyor pa pad+ma'i rdo rje'i tshul ni de tso'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /༈ de bzhin du de'i slob ma chang 'tshong lhan skyes rdo rje yang snga ma'i sbyangs 'phro can grub chen zhing ba rdo rjes rdzogs rim sgya sems dpen nas khrid par gsal te/ 'grel pa de nyid las/rigs kyi bu sus kyang ma byas pa'i chang] de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis gsol ba/ zad pa med ba ma rig pa'i gnyid sangs par byed pa lha'or ba'i 'brog dgon par ngal ba las dbugs 'don par byed pa 'thungs shig /de ni 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa mi zad pa'i za ma tog ces bya ba yin la/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul zhes bya ba yang yin te/rigs kyi bu tingasnga 'dzin de la mnyam par zhogadang] gdod lhan cig skyes pa'i gang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsol ba/ 'gro ba kun la 'gyed nus pa khyod kyis phyong zhingaka skom pa sel bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs shing de ltar ting nge bedzin skyes pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ de'i slob ma tha ga pa dga' ba'i rdo rje ni grub chen pad+ma rdo rjes dbang bskur nas bskyed rdzogs gnyis la khrid pasanate/ 'grel pade nyid las/ kye tha ga pa khyod kyi bsam pa rgya chen pode mtshog tu legs so/ /myur ba myur b.radakyil gshor gyi 'khor lodam pa zhugs shigadangan skyes budam pa khyod kyi bsam pa rgya chen 4 kho 'os myur du bskangango zhes smras pa dang] tha ga pa rab tu dga'anas zhabs la sbyo 4sa gnyugasate/ dkyil gsor rdzon du las bas mngon b.radabang bskur ba blangasanas/ tha ga pa de la mtshan ma med pa'i gnas la gnas pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 83
'jigasabyed chos 'byungakayul la 'jug pa yang dag par thob cing/ rnal 'byor pa gzhan dag la yang bsnyen bkur zhing /tha ga pa'i tshul spyod 'odzin cing / rdzas 'byor gyi rgyud pa byed de zhes gsungs pa'i phyig rdzas sems dpen zob par gsal lo/ /༈de'i slob ma bram ze me 3 3ni sngon gyi sbyangs 'phror grub chen tha ga pa rdo rjes rdzogs rim tsam nas khrid pas rtogs pa skyes par gsal te/ 'grel pa de nyid las/ bram ze mos smras pa/'o nagad gis nang gi bdag nyid dag par 'gyur ba'i khras de kho mo la bstan du gsol/ rnal 'phyor pas smras pa/ gang lus dang ngag gi 'bad pa med pa'i khrus kyis dag par gyis shig dang / khyod kyi pyi nang ma lus par 'dag par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ skyes bu chen po de lta bu'i khus de kho mo mi 'tshal gyi legs par bstan du gsol zhes smrasanas/ snyim ba me tog gis bkang ste rang nyid kyi stod g.yogs dang bcas pa phul lo/ /rnal 'byor pas smras pa/ bram ze mo nam mkha' yongs su dag pa'i dbyings nas sprin dag byung nas de nyid la thim pa'am/ chu klung yongs su dag pa las nya dag byung ba ji lta ba bzhin du bram ze mo khyod kyis sems la blta bar gyis dang / gdod sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug ba'i ye shes kyi chu zhes bya bas bdag tu lta ba'i dri ma ma lus par 'dag par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bsgo nas rang gi gnas su dengs te bram ze mo des kyang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi chu ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs te zhes gsungs shing gzhan la'ang bshad do/ /༈ de'i slob ma 'drig mkhan grub pa'i rdo rje ni grub chen bram ze rdo rje mos dge bsnyen nam gso bh+yong byin/ sangs rgyas mnyam bh+yor ram gsang 'dus kyidakyil mngor du zhugs nas dbang bskur te bskyed rdzogs bstan pa tsam gyis bskyed rdzogs rgyud la skyes pa'i skal ldan yin te/'grel pa de nyid las/ rnal 'byor ma des kyangade'i bsam pa rtogs nasade la gso spyong gi sdom 84
'phags yul du byung tshugpa byin te/ mthar gyis bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par 'dus pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor du bkod cing rtogs pa'i rtswal 'phyor mthar phyin par gyur te/ de'i sems kyi mos pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pa rgya chen po rnal 'gyor ma des mkhyen nas/ 'drig mkhan de la sangs rgyas kyi yul la 'jug par nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter zhes bya ba skad cig tsam gyis bstan pa dang 'drig mkhan des kyang skad cig de nyid la ting nge 'dzin de yid la byas pa tsam gyis lha'i mig la sogs pa'i mngon par shes pa dang yang ldan la rnal 'byor gyi rgyud pas 'gro ba gzhan gyi don mdzad cing / zhes gsungs so/ /des na pangor ba dang bdag 'edzin gshin rje yin la/ de dag lasams byed kyi blo ldadag la gzhin rje'i rgyal yodang gshin rje gshed ces bya bar gsungs lte/ 'grel pa de nyid las/ting nge 'dzin 'di nyid kyis khams gsum thams cad kyi bdag tu rtog pa'i bgegs mthar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na gshin rje lte gang la gshin rje'i ngang tshul yod padeni gshin rje zhes bya zhing/des bdag cag rnams kyisadapal du byed pasadapal gshin rje'i rgyal 4 zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ bar 'dir in+d+ra 'o rnyi bshad kyang go rim min tshul bshadado/ /༈ de'i slob ma dpal kun 'gro mdon po ni sngon gyi sbyangs pa'i 'phyo can du grub chen grub pa'i rdo rjes dpe'i 'od gsal nas khrid pa tsam gyis mngon du gyur pa yin te/ 'grel pa de nyid las/ rnal 'gyor pa grub pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i drung du phyin te/ lo du mar bsnyen bkur nas/ de kho na nyid stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba dang / rnal 'byor pa des 'di skad ces/ rigs kyi bu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang zugs kyi ye shes kyi de kho na nyid ni 'bad pa dang] yi ge dang / brda' dang] brjod padang] sgra'i yul ma yin te/ de kho nanyid ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa zhes bya ba yin pas/ 'bad pa dang / yi ge dngasga brda' dang] brjod pa dang] sgras rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod ma thag tu ting nge 'edzin 85
'jigs byed chos 'byung/de nyid mngon sum du gsal bar gyur te/ zhes so/ /༈ de'i slob ma rnal 'byor ba thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ sngon gyi rdzogs rim gyi 'phro can la grub chen kun 'gro mgon 4 zhes bya ba sems kyi rgyun la mkhas zhes thos nas/ de'i drung du phyin dpe don gyi 'od gsal gnyis bstan pasadon mngon du gyur payin te/ 'grel pade nyid las/de ga na ba der song nas rnal 'byor pa de la ji lta ba'i bsnyen bkur phul nas sems kyi rang bzhin dris pa dang] rnal 'byor pa kun 'ju mgon pos 'di skad ces/ rigs kyi bu dper na nam mkha' ni kha dog ma yin/ dbyibs ma yin/ skye mched ma yin/ bstan du med pa/ brjod du med pa/ rdzas su grub pa med pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du 'gro ba rnams kyi sems kyi rgyun gyi rang bzhin yang nam mkha' ltar kha dog ma yin/ dbyibs ma yin/ skye mched ma yin/ bstan du med pa/ brjod du med pa/ rdzas su grub pa med pa'o/ /zhes brjod pa tsam gyis/ rnal 'phyor pa des kyang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug spru zhes bya ba shes shing khong du chud la/ 'gro ba rnams kyi sems kyi rang bzhin yang ji lta ba bzhin du shes par gyur lte/ zhes gsungs so/ /༈ de'i slob ma la ṣ+ṭṛ ka ra 'am dge slong ma dpal mos kyang sngon gyi sbyangs 'phyo yod pas rnal 'byor pa zugs kyi rdo rjes sems kyi gdams pa bstan te dpal gyi rir bsgoms pas mngon du gyur pa yin te/ 'grel pa de nyid las/ de ltar kho mos kyang lhan cig skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa/ bsam du med pa/ thogs pa med pa/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter zhes bya ba 'gro ba thams cad kyi sems skya rgyun rtog par byed pa 'di 'tshol ba las/ rnal 'gyor pa zugs kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba zhig ting nge grodzin de'i rang bzhin la mkhas zhes bya ba thos nas/ de'i drung du phyin te kho mos lo du mar mtshog gi rnal 'byor pa de'i zhabs la bsnyen bkur te/ de'i mthar tingange 'dzin de gnang nas kho mosadapal gyi rirasad la 86
'phags yul du byung tshul/byas pa las mngon du gyur pa yin zhing / zhes so/ /༈ des rgyal po in+d+ra 'o rnyi'am byang chub dbang ṭo la bshad cing thabs sna tshogs kyis sngar ltar khong du chud par mdzad pa ni/ 'grel pa de nyid las/ sa'i bdag po dbang po slo la rnam grangs du mas bstan cing khong du chud par byas te/ rgyal srid kyi 'gyor pa dang bral nas/ dur khrod bsten pa las mngon du gyur pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs la/ rgyal po de dge slong mdzad pa la btsun mo phra men ma rnams kyis tho 'tshams/ ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pas ma rnyed par lha ba zos pa na ting nge 'dzin gyis bcing nas slar bkrol ba yin te/ 'grel pa de nyid las/ dur khod du song lte/ de nyid yid la byed cing gnas pa na/ rgyal po'i btsun mo'i tshogs sngags 'chang ma rnams kyis dge slong de'i sems kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa brtan nam mi brtan zhes co 'dri bar bsams pa la/dge slong de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin yid la byed pa'i stobs kyis sngags 'chang ma rnams kyis mthong bar ma gyur cing]dge slong de'i lu ba tsam zhig snang ba la 'di skad ces brjod de/ e ma shākya'i dge slong dag ni g.yo che ste/ lwa ba ltar lus bsgyur pa yin grang / lha ba de nyid za'o zhes/ lu ba dum bur byas te khar so sor bcug pa las/ sngags 'chang ma de rnams ma lus pa lug lta bur gyur te/ yul yul por gyur nas rgyal po'i thad du lhags te 'di skad ces/ mye rgyal 4 chen po bdag cag rnams dge slong dur khrod pas 'di ltar bgyis te/e ma kye hud rgyal pos bskyab tu gsol zhes brjod do/ /rgyal pos btsun mo rnams mthong bas mya ngan gyis gdungs nas dge slong ga la ba der khrid de zhabs la gtugs nas 'di skad ces/'phags pa'i rnal 'phyor la ca dris pa bzod par gsol zhes smras pa dang] dge slong gis rgyal po de la 'di skad ces/ kye rgyal po'i btsun mo 'di dag gis kho bo'i lha ba zos pa phyir byin cig ces smras pa dang/dedag gis lha ba'i dum bu rnams phyir skyugs te/ sngon ji ltab bzhin bsgrubs 87
'jigs byedachos 'byung /nas phul ba tsam gyis lug lta bu'i dngos po las slar log par gyur te/ dge slong rnal 'byor pa de la gzhan dag tu lha ba pa zhes kyang grags te/ ting nge 'dzin de'i byin gyis rlabs pa ni de tso'o/ /zhes gsungs rtso/ /7dor gtso bor rdzogs rim dang de'i nanganas kyang dpe don gyi 'od gsal gnyis kyi sgom tshul bshad kyangade'i ldon la lus kyi gnas so sor rtsadang yi gedang thig le dang drod sogs sgom pa dor na/ mi skye bar shin tu gsal te/ lhan cig skyes grub las/ theg chen shin tu yangs pa las/ /rgyal ba mtshog gis gron gsungs pa/ /de ltar gcig pu nyid kyis ni/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog /phyag na rdo rje rim las 'ongs/ /rna ba nas ni rna bar rnyed/ /ces dang] de'i 'grel pag theg chen shin tu yangs pa las/ /zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba ston par byed pa rnal 'phyor chen po'i rgyud do/ /zhes 〈snags kyis bla med kyi rgyud du ma'i gdams pa yin tshul bshad/ yang lhan cig skyes grub las/ji srid du ni rnam rtog pa/ /de srid du ni kun nas rdzun/ /zhes serdzogs kyi 'grel pa las/ thugs rje chen ṭo mnga' ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma 'ongs dus kyi skye 'o gdul bar dka' ba 'dod chags kyidabang du gyur pa rnams ladape'i ye shesadang mtshon par byed pa dang brid par gsungs pa kho na la/ mtshog dang] dam pa dang]gtso 'o dang] khyad par 'phags par 7)na par byedade/ de ni gnas sgyi ma phyi ma'idabang gis spang bar bya bar gsungs so/ /gang yangadape'i ye shesade yang gsang sngags kyi sgo nas spyad pa gyod pa las kyi dang phor gtogs pa rnams kyis dpe'i ye shes brtan par ma gyur gyi bar du bla ma dam padag gi zhal las rtogs par bya zhing] spang bar mi bya la/gang zhig yongs su shes pa'i rdzas la spang par bya zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang 'di na gang dag lam lado la smod cing bskur pa dag kyang phyi ma'i dus na 'byung bar gsungs la/de dag la ji skad du tsakra saṃ pa ra'i rgyud las gdams pa bstananye/ zab mo'i chos 'di ston pa la/ /gal te mos par 88

'phags yul du gang tshugmthar 'tshang nges par rgya bar bshad do/ /༈ de'i rjes su rtsargyud las/ thogs med ces bya'i dge slong ni/ /bstan bcos de ni don la mkhas/ /mdo lde nges don drang ba'i don/ /rnam pa mang 4'ang rab tu 'byed/ /'dzig lten rig pa ston bdag nyid/ /gzhung byed dang tshul can du 'gyug /de yi rig pa grub pa 'di/ /sā la'i pho nya mo zhes brjod/ /de yi sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /slo ni bzang 4 skye bar 'gyug /bstan ba yun r+shar+sha /spya rnyishākli ///rloX spya spyanāhā spyuhā na///hūm̐/ / spri/ /lha rdzu (rlo shās/ //de/ba/lha nyid chen 4 mthar gyis te/ /byang chub thob par 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ slob dpon 'ogs med kyi mkhas khyad dngaka drang nges 'byed pa dang/ tha snyad 'thad tshul ston pa dang/ gzhung lugs mang sa byed pa dang]/sā la'i pho nya grub padang]de'i sngags kyi mthus slo grerdzos 'phel tshul ( dī /cu dzor+sha ñtsā ༷dī /sdu /patshu ṭ+wāṃ pa shā dzo lha'i snatā ༷slo ༵༵ gh+nā gh+nā pri (/ma dwo paspri 4 yi/ /nga yi bstan la dge slong rnams/ /shes rab ldan nyid chos kyang spyodad/ /dus kyi mtha' la de tshe 'byung] /zhes gsungs/ shing rta chen 4 gnyis kyi gshor dang rjes 'jug gi dge slong shing rta chen 4 lta bu rnam pa mang po 'byung bar lung bstan pa yin no/ /༈de nas dge slong dgra bcom par grags pa'i grub thob chen 4 sngags kyi rgyud du ma shes shing grub pa gcig gis gnod sbyin bum bzangayang grub la/bum padenas mdo sogs chosagang medodadang] longs spyod thams cad 'byung ba gcig grub payinate/ rtsargyud las/ ñtsha mde tshe dus dag r+ya /dge slong dgra bcom zhes bya ba/ /deni sngagasadon bdag nyid ldan/ /rgyud shesade bzhin mang du thos/ /gnod sbyin sngags ni rab brjod pas/ /de la bum pa bzang 4 grub/ /sngon nings 97
'jigs byed chosa'abyung /ni gang bshad pa'i/ /zeg pa chen 4 mdo sde yang / /de yi tshe na bum pa las/ /dka' thub chen 4 'drin par byed/ /glegs bam de la des bltas nas/ /de la sngags ni zlos pa na/ /zhes gsungs/lan cig thugs bsnyel nas bum pa'i srung ba ma byas pas/ gnod sgyin gtsug spyod kyis bum pa brkus so/ /de nas sngags bzla tshe bum pa ma mthong bas/ dge slong kho bas mig dmar zhing /spyan gyi snang mig g.yo bas zhal nas tshig tshangs pa brgya byin sogs dang / dbang phyug chen 4 sogs sngags kyis ma bkug na dang de dag ma 'ong na bdag sngags pa min la sngags pa'i rgyal 'o min smras pa yin te/ rtsargyud las/ gnod sbyin bsgrubs pa'i bum pa la/ /der ni srung ba ma byas pas/ /zhes pa nas/ de nas kho bas mig dmar zhing / /rnam g.yo tshig tu smra ba ni/ /tshangs pa ka ba'i mthar gyur pas /brgya byin sogs bcas dbang phyug che/ /sngags kyis ma bkug ma 'do na/ /sngags pa bdag min sngags rgyal min/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du gdul dka' ba de dag ma btul na/ sangs rgyas dang de'i sras 'jam dbyangs sogs kyi sngags dag kyang sa steng na med pa'am yul de dag med pa yin zhes bsams shing smras nas drag shul gyi lhor bas rkun ma bkug par mdzad pa yin te/ rtsargyud las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas sras sngags dang / /rgyal ba mchog gis sngags dag ni/ /tshar gcod don du gang gsungs pa'am/ /gdul dka' 'dul bar byed pa'ang rung / /gal te rnam kun ma bkug na/ /sa steng ma lus de dag med/ /de nas sngags pa chen 4 langs/ /zhes pa nas/ rkun ma bkug pa de don gtsor/ /bh+yor ba rab tu byas par 'gyug /zhes so/ /de nas skad cig dran pa tsam gyis tshangs pa brgya pyinadabang rgyug sogs mtha' dag bkug pasan te/ yi ge hūṃ gcig gis sa steng tshangs pa sogasanas bgegs kyi bar thams cad bkug cing skrag nas bdag cag la nyes pa med par smra zhing myur du rings par 'ongs pa'i phyir te/ rtsargyud las/ skad cig dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /sdom brtson de ni las myur byed/ /yi ge 98
'phags yuladu byung tshul/hūṃ gi sngags gcig gis/ /tshangs sogs sa steng 'drin par byed/ /ltarnams ma lus rab bkug pa/ /tshangs sogs brgya byin dang yang bcas/ /ha ha zhes bya'i sgra 'don cing] /nyam thag 'dzigs pa'i sgralang sgrogs/ /ci bgyi zhes bya'i blo byed cing/ /bdag cag 'derani nyes med mi/myur zhing rab tu rings par yongs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas dge slong des lha rnams la bum pa slar byin cig so sor smras shing/ sus khyer ba lha dbang slos byas pas/ dpal lag na rdo rje'i bu n+ma bzad khro ba bgegs kyi gzugs can des khyer zhing/ des bdag la mi ster zhes smras nas lha rnams gshegs pa yin te/ rtsargyud las/ slo ldan dge slong 'jigs med pas/ /lha rnams la ni rab smras pa/ /'di ni bum pa slar byin zhes/ /lha rnams phan tshun thams cad la/ /dge slong des ni rab tu smras/ /gang gis bum pa bzang po khyed /khyod kyis myur du rab du snyos/ /lha rnams kun gyis bltas pa na/ /kun tu yang dag gis mthong rgyud /bum pa 'di ni su yis khyed /lha yi dbang po yang dag dgosnangs/ /zhes pa nas/ lha rnams ma lus slar gshegs gsesnal/ /zhes 〈sna/ /de nas skad cig la bgegs bum pa dang bcas pa bkug pas/ bgegs des bum pa yi dwags la byin nas 'ongs te bum pa yi dwags kyis khyed nga de la mi dga' smras pas/ dge slong gis bgegs de la song zhig song zhig phyin chad de ltar ma byed ces bka' bsgosanas bgegs bskrad pasan te/ rtsargyud las/ skad cig yud tsam nyid kyis ni/ /shin tu legs par yang dag bkug /de tshe dbang med bum par bcas/ /bgegs de nyid dang bcas par 'ongs/ /zhes pa nas/ song zhig song zhig bgegs chen po/ /phyin chad de ltar ma byed cig /ces so/ /de nas yi dwags bum pa dang bcas pa bkug pas lus rid pa gzugs che ba stogs pa nyam thag pas zugs rjes skyob ces smre sngags 'don pa mthonganas snying rjes de dag la byin pas khyod yun mi ring bar grol bar gyur cig ces smon lam btab pas yi dwags rnams la dus kun tu bza' btung gang 'dod byung 99
'jigs byedachos 'byung /zhing grol ba yin te/ gargyud las/ de nas de ni yi dwags dag /ces pa nas/ de dag bsams pa tsam gyis ni/ /bum pa las ni bza' bakhung byung / /zhes dren/ /༈ de'i 'og tu tsan dan skyong gis lo sum brgya dang mthar 'tshang rgya ba yin te/ rtsargyud las/ dge slong dga' ba'i 'og tu ni/ /tsan dan skyong ni 'byung bar 'gyug /de tshe dus ni tha ma la/ /lo ni sum brgya dag tu 'tsho/ /bdag nyid chen 4 byang chub ni/ /bgegs med myur du rnyed dka' 'thob/ /ces gsungs/ des na las tshogs de dag kyang 'byung la 'grub kyang sla lte/ rtsargyud las/ thub dbang yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /dam pa'i chos ni bsrung ba'i phyis /de tshe rtag tu bsrung bar ni/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni 'gyur ba yin/ /sngags ni rab tu dbye don pu /cho ga rgya chen bltan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs sem/ /yul ma la lhar bram ze legs grub kyis kyang gshin rje gshed grub/ las sna tshogs la thogs pa med/ yul ma ru'i hrong khyer la rig sngags kyis phan gdags/ rgyal 4 sogs chos la bkod/ mu stegs kyi slobadapon so ma a tsa bya'i g.yog gis dbu bcad khyer kyang ma shi bar sau daṇ+ḍar phyinanasamustegs mang 4 khrag phyugasate/grong khyer yang mes tsheg skad/denas rang gidabu phyug sngar gyi gnas su 'ongasanas/gzhin rje gshed kyi cho ga stong brgyad brgya pa bris/ slob ma gsum la bshad nas mi snang bar 'gyug yang dmangs rigs kyi slob dpon ka ma la ka ra zhes pa gcig gis kyang dge slong sngags mkhan gcig la gzhin rje gshed zhusanas bsgoms pas lo laga' zhig songanas sngags grub cing zhal mthong/ nub phyogs krong sde bcu gnyis yod parabasod snyoms byas/ phal cher chos la bkod/ skabs shig tshogs gshor gyi gas dang rnal 'byor ma zhabs 'bring du khrid pa rig nas kun gyis khel rgod thal rdeb byas/ slob dpon khos/ lhung bzed sa la brdabs pas sa g.yos/ zong sde bcu gnyis med par byas/ pho sum brgyar bzhugs/ yul sa dkar dngaka bha gar gyi ri la gnas shing longs spyod lha 100
'phags yul du byung tshugdang mnyam la gshin rje mkhan 4 tshe ring bar yangade nas grags skad/ dgongs pa lung ston las/ma 'ongs skye 4 ma'ong nas ni/ /zhes pa nas/ sna tshogs sdig pa byas nas kyang/ /sngags padangos grub 'dod par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lung bstan ltar de rigs bzang ngan sna tshogs yong 'gro bas mtha' khegs dka'o/ /'dir de ltar bshad pa ni gtso 'or rgyal ṭo sngags grub kyi lung bstan yin cing] ston pa nas rgyun ma chad par nang ba'i sngags grub ma byung bar 'dod pa dag mi 'thad par de dag gis shin tu grub pas rtso so la dgag pa ma smras se / /༈ rab tu byung ba sngags spyod ni sngar nas smyung yang bshad pa'i go rim/ gargyud las/ de bzhin shākya'i gsung rab la/ /nges par rab byung gnas nas ni/ /'jig rten mig gcig gyur pa yi/ /shub pa mtshog ni med pa na/ /rtag tu sngags smra la dad pas/ /bstan pa'i don ni byed par 'gyug /de dag gzhon nu bshad par sga /rtsegacig yid kyis mnyan bar gyis/ /zhes gsungs pasa'i/ bstan pa'i gsal byed 'jig rten mig gcig lta bu shākya'i rgyal po'i gsung rab la dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba mang 4 thub pa mtshog 'das nas med dus na rtag tu sngags smra la dad pas bstan latsho don rgya cher byed par 'argyur ba mtshan gyi zur dedangade zhes dedag 'jam dpal gzhon nu khyod la dgos pa'idabang gis bshad par bya yi/ zugs rtsegacig rnyi pa /sna ṭ+wāṃ pa/ ṅgi dz+nyo r+sha ༷byi ༈ /( shākli m+p+raṃ /lha sna pad+mo shā ༵ ṭ+wāṃ dzo:sna tshi pa/sa ༵ mtshan/ yi ge rnyi zhes sdom brtson nyid/ /sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /༈de nasadapal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud stong phrag bco brgyad pa'am/ rgyud 'bum padang rtog pa sum brgya pa sogs 'di'i rgyud che chung du ma dang dgra nag gi rgyud 'bum phrag drug pa sogs nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul du mkha' las ma rnams kyis rnyarma gaji chos mdzod du gnas 101
'jigasabyed chos 'byung /shing/sham+bha la nalang rgyal po so sos rnal 'byor rjes su rig pa'i rgyud stong phrag so drug pa 'chad pa dang grub pa brnyes pa mang yang 'phags yul dbus su lā yi ta badz+ra gyis rtog bdunadang /rtog gsum dang / tshu tshun ra'i rtog pa dang / chos kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa sogs u rgyan yul gyi rgyud 'bum pa las bton nas spyan drangs pa yin te/ de ltar du zhang dwa rong zom skyo chen po sogs 'dod pa'i phyig rwa 'gyur rgyud kyi zhal byang las/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i gshor lo rgyud 'bum pa nas phyung ba rtog pa'i phyogs bkrags pas grub pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ma he'i gdong can gyi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rtog pa dpalakhu rgyan gyi gnas chen po nas 'jam dpal gyi rgyud las phyung ba/ nas/ dpal lā i ta badz+ra gyis phyung nas mdzad pa rdzogs 〈sna/ /zhes dang / zhang 'gyur yang de dang mthun la/ rong zom gyi 'gyur gyi de las kyang / dpal khu rgyan gyi yul rnal 'byor chen po'i gnas nas/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis bstan pa 'jam dpal gyi rgyud las bla ma dam pa yul chen po'i slob dpon chen po shrī lā li ta badz+ra zhes bya bas phyung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig de la dgongs nas rje rin 4 ches kyang sa bzang lo ts+tsha ba'i dris lan du'ang slob dpon 'di rgyud spyan 'dren pa 'or gsungs la/ mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal po'i bskyed rim chen mo las kyang / rgyud 'di u rgyan gyi yul nas len pa po mchog gi dngos grub k+tarnyesna shāshā :dri /sna r+nghi / k+ṣiṃ ā n+dha kli snror dhī hūm̐ /snan dzī shā sta mi nilha pazlo m+p+raṃ rnyi lta gcig yin te/ 'khungs pa'i yul mo ṭi pi sha /rigs bram zer skyes par grags/ sngon shā ri'i bu 'khungs sa dang gshegs sa yang yin pas de'i mchod rten yod pa la gzhi byas nas gtsug lag khang byas par zeg chen thog mar dar sa/ ṭ+wā lan+d+ra'inā liṃ sdong bu 'dam bu sogs dang / dā sbyin pa'i ming ste zom bu sbyin zur chag nas na lan+daradangaka na la da yang zer ba der song] rig 102
'phags yul du byung tshul/pa'i gnas lngar mkhas par byas/ sngags kyi theg pa yang mang du thos/ slob dpon la dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dbang zhus/ me tog 'jam dpal la phog pas 'jam dpal lhag pa'i lhar bsnyen/gsang mtshan lā li ta badz+ra zhes bya ba/ mtshan brjod las/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'dzigs par byed/ /kho po'i rgyal po gdong drug 'jigs/ /mig drug lag drug stobs dang ldan/ /zhes pa'i don dris par pas ta phal cher la gsung rgyu med/ kha cig na re/ khu rgyan gyi yul na tshig 'di re re la rgyud re re yod pa mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi phyag na yod zed slob dpon la zhus pas de'i ched du r+shapa hār+shapa ba/ ༵ //rmo /pa ༵༵ pa (sna shā rnyigh+nā dzī lhag/ k+ṣiṃ ༵ /bya/ (lha dh+ri kār+shapa du 'gro 3ra / khu rgyan du chos tshol du 'gro byas pas/ mo na re/ u rgyan na yod pa'i bud med rnams mkha' 'gro ma yin/ lam na ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sgo srung gi tshuladu 'amad pas/ de dag gis brda' dris yong pas/ brda' dang brda'i lan shes dgos/ khyod kyi rkang par sin+dhu ra byugs pa 'de yang chus khus/ de rnams kyis mthong na khyod la rko long 'ong zeg slob dpon gyis ma gsan par phyin pas/ u rgyan dang nye bar sleb pa na bud med gzhon nu ma bzhi dang 'phrad de/ brda' ston kyang / slob dpon gyis ma mkhyen cing / brda' lan ma shes/ slob dpon gyi rkang par bltas te/sin+dhu ra byugs pa mthong nas/ de bzhi khros te/ khyod 'di ltar 'os zhes mgo mjug log bzhag pas/ rengs te sha la khad byung bad rgan po 3 ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma yin las che snyam nas gsol ba btab pas/ rgan mo de byung nas/ sa la sngags bzlas/ slob dpon la gtor bas sos/rgan mo na re/ khyod la nus pa yang med/ brda' dang brda'i lan kyang mi shes/ nga'i smras par yang mi nyan/ da yin na'ang spos chus khus kyis la/ yi dam la gsol ba thob/ brda' dang brda'i lan 'di dag shes par gyis zer nas legs par bslab/ 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'azo ma 'ching byed kyi 103
'jigs byed chos 'byung /sngags gcig kyang bslab nas/ rgan mo gar thenang cha med/ phyis su rgan med do yum bai ta li yin bar 'dug /de nas phyin nas 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma mang 4 dang 'phrad kyang 'ga' zhig la brda' byas pas btang / la lar sngags de bzlas pas btang ste/ u rgyan du byon nas/ sngar gyi rgan mo des tshogs gsor bskor tedabang bskug slob dpon gyi rgyud la dbang gi ye shes skyes/gnas der zla ba gsum bsgom/ drod rtags thob nas brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa yang mdzad de/ de nas khu rgyan gyi ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i pho brang dharma gajir byon nas/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems can la phan pa'i don du gshin rje gshed skor gsum gyi rgyud spyan 'dren par bzhed pa la/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams na re/ zhag bdun blo la ci tsam bzung bar nus pa de gnang zhes zer ba la/ slob dngon gyis rje btsun la gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung zugs gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud dang] gdong drug gi rgyud dang] rtog pa bdun pa dang] tshu tsan+ta ra'i rtog pa/ chos rgyal gyi rtog pa sogs dang / gzungs 'ga' zhig thugs su chud cing /rgyud kyi glegs bam so so'i kha yang rang phye nas thad ka thad ka ji bzhin gzigs/ da dung rgyud thams cad zin par gsol ba btab pas/ phyo rangs 'jam dbyangs byon nas/ 'dzam gling gi gdul bya'idon byed parade gsayong gsungasate/ rgyud 'bum pa'i nang gidon yang mang po rtogs par mngon te/ rgyu'i lha zhe dgu'i mngon rtogs sogs dang] 'bras bu'i ltazhe dgu dang] zhedagu ma'i dag pa brjod pa ltabu lte/de dag rtog bdun na med cing da lta'i rgyud gzhan las 4snang par ṭ+wāṃ sh+lau / ṭī ñdzaṃ nāṃ ༷/ rnyi ṭ+wāṃ ༷ keṃ ༷/༷ ༷ hūm̐/ dā /༷ rnyishā bhi ༷ nāṃ ༷༷ khro /hūm̐ bhe+e// zhes gsungs so/ /rje yab sras kyis slob dpon 'dis mtshog gi dngos grub brnyes par yang 104
'phags yul du byung tshugyang gsungs pas gdul bya dang mdzad pa'i cha dpag dka' yang lo rgyus snga pyi grags tshod la/de nas slar 'dzam gling du lhag par dar bar mdzad cing / nub phyogs kyi yul du mu stegs kyi rgyal phran na ra lnga rma'i sar mu stegs rnams dang nus pa 'gran pas/ mu stegs 'ga' zhig gis dug bre 4 re re zos/ slob dpon gyis dug mi khur bcu tsam gsol ba dang] dngul chu yang chang rdzaganyis 'thung bas mi gnod pa mthonganas/ rgyal pode lhag paradadade lan+damadabyangs kyi ltakhang bzhengs pa dngad grong khyer ha snyi na bu rar mu stegs sngags mkhan gyi sde gzhin rje'i dngor lo bskor nas brlag pa dang] shar phyogs pa ga la zhes bya bar klu bdud nang par shin tu gnod pa zhigacand palang sbyin sreg byas/ mtshoyang skagade'i shul du rdo ring chen po btsugs/ rtsol laram dpal gyi sku gzugs byas so/ /skabs der yul ba ren+d+ra na kla klo yod pa dang nye bar sbyin sreg mdzad pas mes tshig pa skad/ de nas ma ga har byon/ dpal ṭ+wā lan+dar 〈snang ba na/ bsgyu ta rnams kyis grub pa thob pa'i nus pa ston zhus nas/ rgyal po seng ge lnga ba'i blon 4 zhagar bcas ma ga tar 'phro 'dod nas zla phyed kyi lam nas chu tshod 'ga' zhig gis sleb par mdzad/ de bzhin du spyod pa'i skabs su chang dgug pa dang khrag dgug pa rgyud ltar mdzad pa'i lo rgyus kyang yod/mthar 'ja' lus brnyes par grags/ lā li ta dang / in+d+ra 'o rnyika sangs rgyas ye shes/ dge slong ma dpal mo dus rags pa mnyam par mngon te/ slob dpon 'di u rgyan na bzhugs dus su sangs rgyas ye shes dang yang 'phrad cing] dpal mo na gzhon pa dang 'phrad par bshad pa'i phyigzhal lung las/ de nas yon tan kun 'byung khu rgyan yul du bgrod/ /'jo sgeg rdo rje zhes byar mtshan gadregal rab tu grags/ /de la mang thos zhes pas la li ta badz+ra 'jo sgeg rdo rjer bsgyur ba dang / mjal tshul dang chos dpyad tshul yang gsungs pa'i phyig zhal lung las/ dza thib dza la zhes bya'i bu mo bcu drug pa/ /lak+ṣi chen mo mnyes byas zla ba brgyad kyi bag /de yi lung ni rab 105
'jigs byed chosa'abyung /thob gnod gnas grub pa thob/ /ces gsungs pas/ dpal mo dang mjal tshul bshad cing/ in+d+ra ṭo ti dang mjal bar mngon te/ khyung bo'i rnam thar khyung po rang gis gsungs pa las/ yang dpal lā li ta badz+ra/ pad+ma zhabs/ in+d+ra 'o sgyi chung ba/ dpal 'dzin/ a mo lha badz+ra/ bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta nas brgyud pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyig dus mnyam kyang yul dang rkyen gyis brgyud pa la gnyis gsum 'ong ba deng dus kyang mngon sum du grub pas bla brgyud snga 9 byas pyin dus rags pa'ang mi mnyam par 'dod pa shin tu gabrul lo/ /desan slob dpon rtog bdun gyi rtog pa dang po'i mtshan ma la brten nas rgyud rgyas pa'i bshad tshul bzhin gyi zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs dang / rtog bdun gyi rtog pa dang po'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs su/ sgo bzhi dang/ gla bzhir ro langs chen po bri'o/ /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas ro langs brgyad skor dang / gtor tshog dang] lha btsun ltar na rdzogs rim rnal 'gyor bzhi rim sogs mdzad/ slob dpon yang brgyud yig so sor dpag na/ lī la badz+ra/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ in+d+ra 4 nyi/ la〉/ mi pham bshes gnyen/ don sku(da rdo rje/ ba ling ta pa/ so so su ra pa/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ 'jam dpal grags pa rnams yin no/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje rnams mkhas pas gsungs/ 'jigs byed la rtso gru/ rong zom/ rā lo/ ba ri/ mal sprubyo/gyi jo/ khu dngos grub pa/ partsita sa man+da khyung 4/ ma nang chos bshes/ khyung ṭo chos brtsone/ gnyos/rdo lo/ skor ni ru ba sogs yod pa las grags che ba lnga dang de'i nang nas rwa lugs ni mchog yin par rje bdag nyid chen 4 yab sras bzhed pa ltar/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa dang bu rtsogs kyis kyang mchog tu byas pas de'i lugs kyi lo rgyus ltar na/ de ltar slob dpon 'dis dgra nag/lajogs byed rtog bdun rtog gsum sogs dang / gdong drug gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa rnams spyan drangs/de dus birla bas gshed dmar le'u nyer gnyis pa/ bi rū pas kyang gshed dmar gyi rgyud spyan drangs/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes dang / ba ling ta 106
