ra lugasadar tshugba/ ldan mda'i mchod rten gyi bum par bzhugs pa/ me pho sbre'u'i lo la sne'u rdzong nas drung chen nam mkha' bzang yos/ mtshan mo bum nang nas gdan drangs gzhung ko la spyan drangs lte 'bras spungs kyi yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku 'dra rin 4 che'i nang rten la da lta'i bar du ma nyams par bzhugs so/ /zhes gsungs shing) de las kyang rgyal ba gong ma rgyal ba 8(na tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar du'ang] 'bras spungs kyi 'jigs byed kyi nang rten rwa lo'i dmar gdung dang/ rje rin po ches sa maze song tsam las sprul pa'i ya ma rā dza stong phrag re'i ljags chab gnang nas bzhengs par gsungs te/ rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nor bu'i phreng ba las/ 'od 'dir dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi shing rta'i srol 'tshed chen po 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu rje btsun rwa chen zhabs kyi sbrur ril 4 nang rten la bzhugs shingaka 'jim pa 'azeb skyu re la rgyal ba tsong kha ba chen pos rdzu 'phrul gyis ya ma rā dza stong phrag re bzlas te ljags chab mdzad pa'i sku brnyan byin rlabs can de'i drung sa zhes gsungs so/ /deng dus ldan mda'i mchod lten la sku gdung med kyang gtsang 4 mi gnod pa ngo mtshar ba gcig snang ngo] /༈ de'i zugs sras lo ts+tsha ba chos rab ni/ rong gi rje'u me rtog ldan du sku zhakhrungs/ rwa chen po'i yon tan thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du byas/ rwa chen sho las lo ts+tsha yang mkhas par bslabs/ bla ma chen po gshegs pa'i sku ldad grub nas bal sar byon/ paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+tashrī la dus la'or gsan/ lo phyed dang lnga tsam nas sems 'grel skor gsum dbang khrid man ngag gi bshad pa cha lagadang bcas par ches mkhas shing] dus gzhur 'gyur gyi thog ma mdzad cing 'gyur yang don shin tu legs pa tshad mas grub pa 'di'o/ /shong 'gyur zur bde yang don gyi babs 'di legs pas kho 'os kyang/ rwa 'bro shong 'gyur mang bo dag las 'di drangs pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin la/bu rin so ches shong 'gyur gtso sar byas snang/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'od du spyan drangs/ dbus gtsang kun 139
'jigasabyed chos 'byung /tu phebs/ phyir phebs dus nyi ma gcig la gser srang sum brgya dus gcig la phul/ skyid grong gi bar du bla ma bskyal bar mdzad/ bla ma'ang dgyes nas dus nyanar lugs kyi dam tshig rdo dril/'bum phrag gsum pa'i brog zhu/ brgyad stong ba'i poti rnams gnang] yang phyir rgya gar du phebs/paṇ+ḍi ta wa 'i shwa ra gup+tal yang zug/phag mo so bdun ma sogs kyi chos skor bsgyug mgon po'i rgyud mngon byung bsgyur zhing dbang dang man ngag blangs/ de skabs he ru ka mngon byung / phag mo mngon byung / mgon 4 mngon byung gsum gyi tha snyad kyang byung / khams dbus kyi gdul bya la dbang bka' man ngag rgya cher gnangaka༈de'i slob ma nyid kyi sras rwa ye shes seng ge dang / rwa dharmā seng ge gnyis yod pa'i gcen rwa ye shes seng ge ni/ nub phyogs khu long gi se khyim zhes pa'i mkhar dang gzhis nyos nas phog /de nas brgyud pa la rwa nub par grags shing yab kyi chos ma lus pa mnga'/༈ de'i sras rwa 'grum seng yin/ gong ma'i bde mchog dus dngor gshed skor gyi dbang gdams ngag ma lus pa gsan cing nyams su bzhes/ 'phrin las rgya shin tu che bar bskyangs so/ /de'i slob brgyud kyang bzang la mkhas grub du ma gcig bzhugs tshul 'chang bar 'gyugltarwa dharmā seng ge ni/ yang yab kyi dbang gdamasangag ma lus pa mnga' ba ne'u metog ldan du bzhugs/ de'i srasadakon mchog seng ge/de'i sras shes rab rgyal mtshanasanate/dedag kyang nus mthu che ba dang yab mes gong ma'i dbang dang gdams ngag kun mnga' la/ de'i rjes su rwa /pas (5 dī ( shākli sdo dī shā rje r+yaṃ mas /spru gh+nā spyu (shā/ spyazlo sdi spri kau pa' zla r+shaX dīpa snang ngo / /rā shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi slob ma 'bring mtshams kyi rgya dbang phyug grags pas gdams pa thams cad gsan padang/de'i sras rgya ston kunadaga' brtson 'grus kyis thams cad 140
ra lugasadar tshuggsan/ nyams su bzhes/ mthu stobs che/ de khams su byon/ rgyal thang me 'o nga steng du bzhugs/mi nyag /mar khams sogs su phebs/ yig lasdog kyang rgyud 'grel man ngag sogs mang du mdzad pas rgya ston lugs su grags pa khams pa yon tan 'bum gyis dbus gtsang du'ang dar bar byas pa deng sang bar dudar zhing rgyas pa len yin la/ bsam yas kyi mchod rtenadakar po'i sangs rgyas skyabs sogs du ma la mnga' zhing/mchod rtenadakar po'i sangs rgyas skyabasadeyang lo drug 'jigs byed la mtshams byas pas/ rdo rje 'jigs byedadangos su gzigs pa zhig dang dbang mnangagawend tshul dang/ de la 'jamadabyangs chos rjes gsan tshul/ 'jamadabyangs chos rje3 gsan yig las/ bsam yas kyi mchod rten dkar po'i bla ma sangs rgyas skyabs zhes spru ༵༵༵ dī rnyi dz+nyo sdopa spyazlo k+ṣiṃ (dazlo ༵ shā ༵ /dro lhalhanag hūm̐ /pa shāt+na ]yo/ rdo )pa rmyo ṭ+wā ba dngos su gzigs pa la sogs paspenan tan mtha'alpus pa mnga' ba'i bla mde'i drung du 'jigs byed rwa lugs dang/ rgya lugs rdzogs par gsan pa la/ 'dzigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang/la)gas byed zhe dgu ma'i dbang / ro langs brgyad skor gyi dbang/ 'jigs byed lha bcu dgu'i dbang / 'jigs byed sngags btu'i rjes gnang / dug dbang rma bya chen mo/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i rjes gnang / de dag gi chos skor rwa los mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i mngon rtogs rin chen don 'dus/ 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i mngon rtogs dri med chu rgyun/ 'jigs byed zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i mngon rtogs khams gsum za byed/ 'jigs byed zhal dgu phyag so bzhi pa dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtogs dri med snang ba/'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi mngon rtogs yid bzhin gter mdzod de mngon rtogs lnga/ rtog bdun gyi 'grel pa la/ dka' 'grel/ nag 'grel/ barbad kyi thig pa lte gsum/ bcu gsum ma'i 141
'jigs byed chos 'byung /dkyil chog /'jigs byed kyi drag po'i sgyin sreg cha lag dang bcas pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mi mthun kun sel/ rdo rje 'dzigs byed kyi rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg 'dod pa kun lha/dīs/ ṭ+wāṃ sdo sbyo pa~X hā/ ༈ (snaX /'a lha/ dz+nyo pas n+d+ra ñtsā gh+nā r+shalha/ hūm̐ dz+nyo sgru r+sha k+ṣiṃ n+d+ra gsum gyi las rim/ rgya ston kyis mdzad pa la rtog bdun gyi ṭīk+ka/rtog gsum gyi ṭīk+ka/ 'jigs ñdzashā ༵cu ༵༵ ma/ /shā) /sdu/ r+shasna spras ༷snahā shā 4shā/ pasashā da snadzohūm̐ /shā bcu rtsadagu'i mngon rtogs/ 'jigs byed kho po'i ltabazhi bcu rtsadagu'i mngon rtogs/ 'dzigs ༷༷ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ྅ ṭ+wāṃ/ā+oṃ two ༷/ ṭ+wāṃ /spya ñdzaṃ ṭ+wāṃ na/ hūm̐ shā /rdo two smo rnyi/ ā+oṃ rdoXdī/ ñdzaṃ sogs so/ /'jigs byed kyi rtog bdun/rtog gsum/ gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa/ te'u lo ba'i rtog pa/ 'jigs byed kyi tshogs 'khor shān+tapas mdzad ba/ lā li tas mdzad pa la 'jigs byed zhe snyeX ñtsha dhī/ snyewa khri skyo ṭ+wāṃ /pa// s+t+ri | dhī t+t+waṃ ༷ byed kyi bsgom pa dang bzlas pa'i rim pa'i sgron ma/ 'jigs byed kyi rwa la brten pa'i rdzogs rim gyi mnangag gi sgron ma ste sgron ma drug /rdo rje 'jigs byed skya rtog pa bzhi pa las grub chen khar+ṇa shrīs snang ba'i rdzogs rim gyi man ngag /'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim mtshan ma gyen 'grengaka rwa 142
rwa lugasadar tshul/la sems bzung ba/ mtshan mo rgyu ba ste gsum 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim rdo rje tshig 'byed a mo gha badz+ras mdzad spru/ bshad rgyud rtog pa gsum pa'i don 'grel paṇa tsa ka ras sbyar ba/ zhi ba'i las kyi bya ba bdun/ bshad rgyud rtog gsum gyi drag po'i las bdun gyi cho ga mo rgyan par grags pas mdzad pa/ zhakhrul gangor bri ba'i gdams pa/ gtor ma'i man ngag /'jigs byed kyi 'chi kha ma'i man ngag /'jigs byed kyi phyag mtshan so gnyis la brten nas 'phrin las sna tshogs sgrub pa'i man ngag /'jigs byed kyi bsrung bzlog bsad gsum/ bsam gtan nyal chog /'jigs byed dmar po mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'i man ngag zhal shes dang bcas pa 'phags pas mdzad pa/'dzigs byed sngon po mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'i man ngag /'jigs byed sngags btu'i rjes gnang gi yi ge rwa chos rab kyis mdzad pa/te'u lo ba'i rtogs pa'i gsal bye da rwa rnyarma seng ges mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed kyi gabrul pangor gyi dpe ris rnams so/ /'jigs byed kyi bstod tshogs la/'dud nyi shu/ 'jigs byed la bstod pa rgyun chags sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa de nyid lnga ba dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed kyi mtshan gyi bstod pa las kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa/ 'jamadapal mkha' las byung ba'i zhes sogs lā li tas mdzad pa/ dur khrod chen po'idakyil dngoranas/ /zhes sogs/ bcom ldan ladas la bud pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod pa/rdo rje 'dzigs byed kyi bstod pa a mo gha badz+ras mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed la bstod pa shāsti dz+nyā nas mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed la bstod pa ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ 'dzigs byed la bstod pa pad+ma badz+ras mdzad pa gnyis/ gzhin rje pho brgyad mo brgyad kyi bskul sogs 'jigs byed kyi skor kun rdzogs par gsan to/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du 'jam dbyangs chos rjes kyang 'jigs byed la nus pa sbyangs pas dpal ldan 'bras spungs lta bu'i chos sde 'phel rgyas mdzad kyang / phyis su mkhan slob grwa rigs rta las babs nas 'ong bu zhon pa dang / rang gi 143
'jigs byed chos 'byung /gser dang mi'i btsag gi dpe mang zhig byung snang ba rang ngo shes 'tshal/ de dag nas brgyud pa yang gdamasangag phal cher rang cag gis kyang rbob par byas 〈sna/ /ltarwa 'bum seng la zur du byon pa'i sras blo gros seng ge rtsogs byung snang/ rwa 'bum seng la slog skya dbang phyug grags dang] rong ba rje btsun rga los gsan pa yin te/ rga lo ni sngags 'chang rdo rje seng ge zhes pa la sras bzhi byung ba las/ gcen sho ye shes lda ྅ zhes bya ba mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa zhig byung/ de grub thob dbang smyug rgyal 4 zhes bya ba'i gdan sa/ dbe+en dmar bzung ba de'i sras su 'khrungs/ khams pa rga lo'i skye bar grags pas rga lo 3da mtshan rnam rgyal rdo rje/ chung ngu'i dus su kha che paṇa chen dang mjal bas/ skyes bu khyad par can 'byung bar mkhyen nas/ phyag gis bzhams shing shis brjod mdzadade/ nyid kyi gsung las/ byis pa'i dus na kha che ba'i/ /bla ma paṇa chen nyid dang mjal/ /legs sbyar skad kyis dbugs dbyung mdzad/ /ces gsungs so/ /dpyal chos bzang gi drung du sgra dang] khyad par dgyes phag la sbyangs nas ngur sgrig tu yang bshad/ gzhan yang nā ro'i 'grel chen gdams ngag dang bcas pa bde mchog gzhung phran gdams ngag dang bcas pa gsan cing / dbang gsan tshe dkyil lha'or gyi dbus nas ngo mtshar ba'i sgra thos/ gshed dmar gyi dbang zhus tshe bdud las rgyal ba ste/ de'i tshul ni/ 'dol chung na bzhugs ba'i tshe/ cung zad bsnyung bar/ mthon btsun rgya dpe skong co gang khur ba gcig byung nas po ti bstan te/ khyod mkhas na 'di dag gi don smra bar gyis zer ba la nga na bas re zhig sdod gsungs pag yi ge la ni ma brten pag /dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyug /zhes rgol ba dang] mtshan mo gcer bu byas nas lha khang gi nang nas sam mdor bzhag nas/ nga ni 〈khur mgo zhes bsdigs par byed/ de nas dang por ngur smrig tu byon pa'i tshe/ 'i lam du btsun rgan lham mthil rdol gyi khres po khur ba zhig byung nas/ 'de dag zad zad du btsal 144
ra lugasadar tshugkyang ma rnyed pa/ da sdod pa dga' zer zhing/ phan phan ltar byed pa zhig yod/ de nas rang gi dgon par byon pas/ yab kyis gsung nas mdangs 'byung po'i cho 'phrul che ba la de ring dge bshes pa byon/ bgegs kyi bar gad yong nyen che bas/ de la zugs ma gtad par thugs dam mdzod gsungs pa ltag zugs kyi gdeng bskyed de bzlas pa dang bskad kyang zhum ba med par gtam sna tshogs smra zhingasga res bya'i gzugs kyis mi skad kyis lab yar sna tshogs byed pa la/ thar bar gshed dmar gyidabang zhu bar brtsams pa na/ yab yum na bas yul la 'gro rigs zer kyang ma gsan par yun ring gi grogs pos bslus/ da nga skyol zeg thar pa gling gi mgo bran sgang khar bskyal bas/ de na 'dug pa'i rta la zhon te/ nam mkha' la rta de seng ge'i rnam ba dang/ dasan gur mi zhes pa'i gnas brtan gyi rnam pas/ mgo se ye re la brgal nas 〈snang bsade phyin chad bar chad kyis ma tshugs so/ /'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul sa skya paṇa chen gar chang thang gi chos grwar mjal/ lnga sa zhus pas shes rab che bas kun mkhyen lta bu gcig bslab par bya zhes gsungakanag po'i skor gyi dbang dang/ gdugs dkar skog rnam lasams dang/ a ra pa tsa na'idabang dang snro3 kau ṭ+wāṃ /lha spra shā// byi/༵ ༷pa ṭ+wāṃ snam /lhar+sha spri gārdzu dri kau sna( r+ṇi lhamatsha /(( bka'/ dus pangor 'bro lugs kyi dbang dang/ bshad pa man ngag dngaka rwa 'bum seng la legs par brten nas rwa lugs rmya gshed skor bde mtshog skod dus dngor yang gsan to/ /khro lo la man ngag dang zab chos mang du gsan/ 'gro mgon 'phags pag bde mchog dril bu pa/ ma hā ma ya dbang dang chos skog dgyes rdor la sogs pa'i rgyud dngan mgon po'i skoradangan dam tshos pad dkag sgom rim gsum/ rigs gter rnams gsan/ dbyal a mo gha la zab rgyas mang 4 gsan te/ chos kyi mdzod du rgyud rang gi sras rgya gar grags pa dang / gzhon nu rgyal mtshan 145
'jigs byed chos 'byung /gnyis hor dmag gis khyer ba la sgrol ma'i btson 'don byas pas/ sgrol ma nam mkha'i khyon gang ba tsam gyi lte khung na byis pa gnyis mgosna rug gi 'dug pa gzigs pas zhag gsum na sras thadzla ba gcig na slob mas kyang 'dun pa bskyur te thar ro/ /bla ma 'di 'byud spyad la mkhas pas byis pa lo drug lon kyang 'ju ba dang smra brjod mi shes pa la/ rten 'brel cig mdzad pas de dag shes pa dang / ston pa gzhon brtson rma 'bras kyis slo ba mthong ba yang / rten 'brel gcig byas pas sos pa ltabu mang po snang la/ lan ni kun btus las/ rdzas dang sngags dang sman dang gabyud spyad sogs kyi nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab ces pa de yin la/ da lta'i rtsis kyi gto sdudags kyang gabyud spyad yin mod/ mkhas pa mang pos kyang / rdzas sogs dang zhakhyud spyad so sor ma shes snang bas/ mkhas pa stag tshang bas dus lubor sbyo don du ya mtshan par bsam nas bris pa ltagmkhan po rin po ches kyang ha las bar bris snang mod/ dus gshor ṭīka chen sogs su ma bris shing / gzugs brnyan gsal ba'i me long na yang rgyu mtshan ci yin gsungs yod pa shes par gyis/ gtso 'or gshed skor dang dus gtor bshad/ slob ma mkhas pa rang gi sras nam mkha' dpal dang / shes rab seng ge dang / slob dpon rnal 'phyor dang/ a ka ra pa bzhi dngan rje man lung gu ru/lho ba grub seng/thar ston lo ts+tsha ba sogs byung/rong ba shes rab seng genas grams shesadapal/ de nas chos rje don grub rin po che/ rje bdag nyid chen po la brgyudade dge lugs la brgyud/ yang sher seng nas/ mang mkhar lo ts+tsha ba dang] bla ma dpal ldan seng ge dang] seng ge rgyal mtshan sogs la brgyud/ yang sher seng dang bla ma a ka ra sirnyi gnyis la/ skyi ston grags rgyal dang / de la kun mkhyen jo nang pas gsan/ seng ge rgyal mtshan dang jo nang ba gnyis nar zhang ston rgyal 4 'am/ mkhas pa bsod nams grags kyis gsan cing rgya cher tshel/ de la 'bri khung dpal 'dzin gyis gsan/yang sher seng la rang gi snyan bzhi'i chung ba bla ma a ka ra pa'i sras 146
rwa lugs dar tshugrdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ de la rong pa bsod nams lhun 'grub kyis gsan/ de la bod kyi grub thobadapal 'dzin gyis gsan lte/rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhakhrul gshor sgyin sreg las tshogs sogs kyi po ti chung ngu gcig mdzad do/ /༈ yang rwa 'bum seng gi slob ma slog skya dbang phyug grags rgyud sne du ma dang] khyad par gshin rje gshed dang dus 'khor la mkhas shing / de la ldong ston shes rab dpal gyis gsan/des rgyud sde yang du ma mkhyen cing/ 'jigs byed la nus pa che/ 'jigs byed kyi zhabrul 'khor yig chung dus gangor gyi dgra grogs man ngag can sogs mdzad pas 'jigs byed ldong lugs su grags/ des na 'od du lagar ldong rgya gsum du grags pa'i rgya ni rwa lugs dang/ ldong ni dwa skyo gnyis lnga'i lugs yin/ 'garani gnyos lugasalgen la/ gzhanayang bodong 'jam ral lamanam mkha' smon lam/ 'bri lo ma ṇi da skyid rong lo ts+tsha/ sa skya gsungs kyidapal ba/ grub chen kun blo/bla ma chos dpal/ la stod sngags 'chang kun dga' zla ba/ slob dpon dge 'bum/ khras khang lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde sogs kyis kyang gshed skor la spyangs pa che chung mngayod /de lta na4de dus su sbyang gzhi grang byedango lalhod padang rgyudadonadang mthun pa'i sngags pa dgon par ni/ gzugs brnyan gsal ba'i me 'onangadang] rnam bshad khams gsum rnam rgyal las shes 〈sna/ /༈ de dag gi nang nas brgyud pa'i rnam thar rags rim tsam brjod na/ rong ba sher seng lcags mo phag la 'khrungs/ gzhon dus nas 'bri klog sogs la sbyangs nas gshed skor dang dus gangor la slob gnyer mdzad/ bcu drug pa la dus dngor gsungs/ nyi shu ba la thar par byon nas/ dpyal lugs kyi gshed skor sogs zhus/nyer gnyis pa la stag sde pa seng ge rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du byon te phar tshad lo lngar smyangs/ dbus gtsang du grwa skor mdzad/ sum cu pa la bla ma chos rgyal 'phags pa dang] mkhan 4 mchims kyi drung du rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ lo 147
'jigs byed chos 'byung /chen grags rgyan la rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang/ 'jam dpal rtsargyud sogs dang] dpen dmar gyi khrir phebs/ gshed skor dang dus lubor bshad/ thar pa/ kho phu/ bsam yas/ stag lung] gzhu kun dga' ra ba/ shangs rtsegadong] chu mig /ston mo lung sogs dgon sna tshogs su chos gsungs/zhe gcig gi dus dben dmar gyi gdan sa dbon 4 rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gtad/ dmu ru sham bhar btab/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ rgyud 'bum dang 'dul ba bzhengs/ sems can mang po'i don mdzad/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhakhrungs ma thag par dbang bskur te/nyid kyi re lnga bzhes dus shing yos la gshegs/ slob ma shin tu mang ste/ti shri kun blo/ lo ts+tsha ba yar klungs pa/thar lo/ dpang lo se gas mang du byon/ rga lo'i sras gsum pas yul bskyangs/ rga lo'i sras bzhi pa a ka ra sirnyis dus pa'or lugs gnyis dngan rwa lugs dpyal lugs kyi gshed skor dngadsa skya'i chos skor gsan/de'i sras rdo rje rgyal mtshan ni chu lug la 'khungs/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyaladang/ slobadasan sher rgyal la mkhan 4 zhus te rab tu byung) lo bcu drug pa ladabenadamar gyi gdan sa bzung] dus 'khor gyi bshad pa bskyangs/ mkhan po dka' bzhi pa dang] zhe la pa la bsnyen par rdzogs/ thar lo la ka tsan dang mngon pa/ sher seng la dus gshor dang gshed skor gyi dbang dang man ngag /zhe lnga par 'dul mdzod/ sangs rgyas sgom par rga lo nas brgyud pa'i rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang] gsang 'dus/ jo lugs kyi bde mchog /lam 'bras sogs gsan/ sle'u chung ba blo ldan shes rab la gsang 'dus/ yo ga gsang ldan gdan bzhi sogs dang/ dus gshor dka' gnas la zhu yig phul nas gtan la phabs/ sher seng gshegs nas dpen dmar dang / sham lhar gnyis ka bzung lte bshad pa yun ring mdzad/ snyan pa rgyas pas gong ma rgyal pos spyan drangs te/ khyi lor gong du byon/ rgyal blon ma lus pa dad par mdzad/ bzhi bcu rtsagasum pa shing glang lor gshegs/ de la da'on po bsod nams lhun grub kyis gsan/ de la rje rin po ches dpa' 148
rwa lugasadar tshugcig gsan par srad rgyud bla ma gong ma dag gsungs sem/ /lta rong ba sher seng la bla ma ye shes dpal pas gsan te/ de yang mdo stod du 'khrangs/gzhon nu nas rab tu byung / gzhung lugs du ma la sbyangs/ gsan rgya dang mkhyen rgya bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa dang mnyam pa 34gas dang / khyad par bla ma shes rab seng ge la/ gshin rje dgra nag /rdo rje 'jigs byed/ gdong drug sogs gshed skor gyi dbang gdams pa ma lus pa pa// gh+nā sna /sna lha sna ༵ spri( miX]/ ༷ shārjosnahā ḍi r+yaṃ bsnyen sgrub mdzad pas grub pa'i mtshan ༈de la chos rje don grub rin chen gyis gsan te/ chos rje de mdo smad du zhakhrungs/ gzhon nu nas rab tu byung lte/ dbus su bde ba can du snye thang pa bkra shis seng ge serdzogs la phar phyin dang byams chos sde lngar sbyangs pas mkhas par gyug de nas gtsang gi snar thang du byon/ bcom ldan rigs ral gyi bu chen bcom ldan pa rang gi gdan sa pa ldong ston rigs pa'i seng ge la/pa/ traṃ /sna /sna ༵༵ rdzu sbyo ༵/ /sa/ kau ṇā ñtsā 3sna shā dzo/ rnyi sna bh+yo// dzodhi rlo rtswa rmo/ btab cing/ zhabs la khrag rdol gyi bar du nyin mtshan du skor ba mdzad pas blo gros kyi pad+ma kha phye bar bzhad pas rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par gyur nas/ rtsod pa'i khyu mchog tu rgyud mthun rkyen dkon kyang snar thang gi skyo tshul la'ang brten nas legs par sbyangs/ de rjes zhwa lur grwa skor la byone nas gangs can kun gyi kun mkhyen chen po bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa lu'i gdan sar phebs nas 'dug pa la'ang tshogs su bzo gleng mdzad par khas blangs legs par zin/ mkhas pa'i grags pa rgyas/ de nas rong du byon te/ rong gi bla ma ye shes dpal pa'i drung du gshin rje gshed skor spyi dang] khyad par 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang] rgyud 'grel bshad pa man ngag thams 149
'jigs byed chos 'byung /cad legs par gsan nas zugs su chud/ slar mdo smad du byon/shing kun lde gsar gyi mkhan po mdzad de/ chos mdo sngags du ma gsungs/ skabs gcig tu snye thang bde ba can gyi gdan sar 'byon par zhu ba'i gdan 'dren byung bas dbus su phebs/ 'on kyang gdan sa'i stabs ma 'phrod/yo byad mang du bsnams byone pa rnams kyis bde ba canadang/snar thang sogs su gtsug lag khang dang]dge 'dun gyi zhabs rtog rgya chen po bsgrubs nas/yab chos sdings su/ skyes mchog rtog /spra k+ṣiṃ /khri /sgyu ༷ ṭ+wāṃ spri /9 ga k+ti tram̐ ny+pha/ ༷/ 3 ༷ ༷ smaṃ ༷༷ spya/ ṣ+ṭaṃ ༷༷ spri/ dgonadang sha sbrangadagon gnyis btab/ lo sbrel gyi bar du phar tshad kyis thog drangs/ byams chos rnamasadang/ brtagaganyis spyod 'jug sogs bshad kyang bzhed pa ltar gyi phan thogs cher ma byung bas zugs skyo bar gyur te/sha sbrang du dbon 4 shākya bzang ṭo gdan sar bskos/ khong rang gis bya khyung du yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed la sgrub pa rtsegacig tu mdzad pas/ lhag pa'i lhas yang yang byin gyis brlabs shing / mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa chen 4 yin te/ yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed rmi lam du yang zhal gzigs pas mngon sum du ma'ong bar gsol ba btab pas/cis kyang mngon sum du mthong ba dgos na/ sang phod lung pa 'di'i mda' ru 'ong zhes re zhig la mdzub mo btsugs nas gsungs so/ /rnal sad pa dang slar brtag pas/ klu 'bum dge dang shing za a chos gnyis la yi dam gyi sprul pa'i sku zhig byung bar dgongs nas/ de nas yab yum gnyis la bdud miril bu/'jamadabyangs ril bu/ srung mdud byin rlabs can rnams bskuranas/ khye'u khyed par can zhig 'byung bar 'dug pas/ skyes pa'i tshe ril bu 'di rnams 'o ma dang sbyar nas khye'u la phul/srung mdud 'de thogs/gribadang mi gtsang ba la la)ma/ bkur nyidang rim spo cher gyis gsungs 150
ra lugs dar tshul/nas/ bka' shog gnad sbyon dang bcas pa gnangaka zhakhrungs nas kyang khrus chu dang bsrung ba yang yang gnang) lo gsum lon pa'i tshe yab yum gnyis kyis gdan 'dren zhus pas byon te/ yab la rta dang lug la sogs pa dang] gos dar sogs zang zing gi gnang sbyinadapag med mdzad nas/khyod kyi bu 'ding la phul cig bka' gnang nas/ yab yum gnyis kyis kyangadaga' sprodang bcas phul te/ phyag phyir khrid ces lha'on rin 4 ches kyang gsungs te rnam thar zur 'debs sogs las kyang ngo) /thun mongadang thun mong masan pa'i mngon par shes pa mnga' bas lkog tu gyur pa'i yul mngon sum du gzigs te/ de yang snar thang dang bde ba can du ja skol dang 'bul ba mang du btang/ de dus ston ser zhig chos grangasadang dus nges b.rasad la zungs shig/de ring snar thang na rang re'i 'bul ba dang rdza skol byed kyin 'dug gsungs/ de dus rje rin 4 ches thugs la dus tshigadang nyin zhag bzhag ste/ phyis 'bul skyel rnams mar sleb dus legs par dris pas ja skol byas pa'i nyi ma de nyid rang du 'dug gsung/ yab tu rtogs ldan pa gshegs nas/ byang sems pa gdan sar bskos/ khong gi gsung yig 'bul skal dang bcas pa bskur byung bas/ rtogs ldan pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi smon lam rlabs chen mdzad/ yig lan gnang dus gsung shog dang lan thams cad gu ru dkon gzhon la mdzad pas/ sngar rang re la byang sems pas bskur pas de la mdzad pa drag zhus kyang ma gsan par de gas 'thus gsung / yar sleb dus byang sems pa yang 'das nas gu ru dkon gzhon pa yab kyi gdan sar bskos tshar 'dug gsung / de lta bu la sogs pa'i mngon shes thogs med mnga' ba'i lo rgyus 'os/ gang ltar mchims blo bzang grags pas kyang tshos rje don grub rin chen pa la khyod mdo khams su song dang slob ma khyad par can gcig yod/ de la nga'i ming 'de thogs dang bstan pa la phan 'ogs khyad par can zhig 'ong zhes lung bstan par bdag gi bla ma 'jam mgon blo spos rgya mtshos gsungs pa 'di sprul pa'i 151
