'jigs byedachos 'byung /sku'i rnam par 'phrul padapag tu med pa ji ltaranam mkha'i lam las/ zla ba'idakyil dngor gcig nyid kyis sa'i steng du chu snod tha dad pa sna tshogs pa zhig gi nang du cig car rang gi gzugs brnyan ston pa de bzhin du 'bad rtsol med par nye bar bstan pa las/ bdag cag rnams la ni/ 'u bu cag rang dang las ba ris mthun par skye ba bzhes pa'idage ba'i bshes gnyen nyid kyi rnam par bstan pas don mdzad do/ /zhes bya bar khong du chud par bya ba yin pa gor ma chag ste/ 'di la bdag nyid yid ches par bya ba'i lo rgyus kyi gtan tshigs gtam du gling pa'ang thos so/ /zhes gsungs pa ni rdo rje'i gsung mi 'gyur ba lte/ sangs rgyas byang sems grub chen du mas sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul par lung bstan gyi lung dngan mkhyen ba6nus gsum rigs gsum mgon 4 ltar grub pa'i gtan tshigs dang/ gabrungs sar byang chub kyi shing skyes pa'i gtan tshigs sogs kyis grub pas sdu / /lung ni/ phal cher grags che ba mang la grub zin pas mi 'bri zhing / gtso 'o ni 'jamadapal rtsargyud las/ dus kyi tha mde lani/ /sems can kun la mchog sbyin byed/ /'jig rten nga ni mya ngan 'das/ /sa yi steng 'di stongs pa na/ /khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyug /de tshedagon chen rab dga' ba/ /kha ba can nang yod pa yin/ /chu 4 gser dang ldan 'gram du/ /nga ni mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di 'jam dbyangs la gsungs pas 'jam dbyangs tha mal gyi tshul bzung ba'i lung dang / 'di'i tshigs bcad sgyi ma'idang 4 gnyis kyis 'odadang rje bdag nyid chen po 'di las gzhan la mi 'grig cing]de dang mthun par mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsang ba'i rnam thar pu dpal ldan zla bas rig pa'i khu byug che bar lung bstan tshul/ gsang ba'i rnam thar de nyid las/ yang lan gcig dpal ldan zla ba grags pas ma 'ongs pa'i dus su/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dge slong gi tshul du bsam bzhin du mtha' dgob tu sku skye ba bzhes par 'dug pas/ khyod kyang der skye ba 'o(ngas la/154
rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshugde'i bka' bsgrub pa dang] bstan pa rgyas par gyis/ zhes dang] de bzhin du 'phags pa lta zhi ba lha sangs rgyas bskyangs gsum gas lung bstan pa dang/ yang rnam thar de nyid las/ yang sku skye snga ma zhig la rje btsun 'jam dbyangs byonanas mtha' dngob kyi sems can rmongs pa blang dor gyi gnas mi shes pa tsho snying re rje/ lha'or bar 'khyams pa ma rig pas lan pa sa lam log par song ba yin te/ kho bos de dag rnams thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i phyir du slodaman pa'i bsam padang bstunanasadage slong gi tshul du 'ong gi khyod kyanganga'i gdul bya yin pasader 'ong bar gyis/ zhes gsungs so/ /'di la rigs pas brtagan/ rje glam rje btsun lan+dam dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul du yid ches par gyis shig /ces dang / de dang mthun par ma cig lab sgron gyi lung bstan las/ de'i dus su bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyi sras phyogs bcu'i sangs n+dha rnyi ༵ ༵ shān+dha tshoX pa~X paX kū gā snraX dh+ri ༵ pa/r+shaspri/dri dri ༵ ༵ pa shā shāt+ta ༵ spra spya) la nyi ma shar ba lta bu mdzad nas/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa mtha' nas rgyas par mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi dang 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin tshul ni/ mkhan chen phyag rdor bas gsang bdag la zhus bas/gsang bdag gi zhal nas/ gsang 'dzin las kyi rdo rje la/ /〈snan nas nye bar 'brel ba yi/ /blo bzang grags pa 'di nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa ste/ /zhes pa nas/ de ni sa bcu mthar phyin to/ /zhes dang] de dang mthun par grub chen phyag rdor ba nyid kyi gsang ba'i rnam thar las kyang] chos rje blo bzang grags pa khyed sngar yang skye ba gzhan gyis bar ma chad du paṇ+ḍi ta rkyang gi skye ba brgya bzhes/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mang 4 dang mjal gyin yod/ de rnams la bar chad kyi mtshan ma yin nam mi shes dgongs pa mi mdzad par zhu/ sangs rgyasadang byang chub sems dpa' 155
'jigs byed chos 'byung /rang byon nas zhal ltagasung bsgrags pa lags/ zhes dang] de bzhin du rtogs ldan pa la/ rgyal ba dbang po'i tog gi dus sangs rgyas kun dang byang sems kyis rje 'di byin gyis rlabs tshul sogs dang / de bzhin du ma bcos pa'i slob dpon pad+ma'i gter du mar yang lung bstan tshul/chos rje mgon rin gyi gter yig las/ 'jam dbyangs sprul ba blo bzang zhes/ /bstan pa rgyas byedango mtshar can/ /zhes dang] pad+ma bka' chems las/ 'jam dbyangs sprul pa gdul bya bstan pa'i bdag/mdo sngags bstan 'dzin blo bzang grags pa 'byung] /zhing 'di 'dasanas byams pa'i drung du 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu mang / 'jam dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung ba dngaka 'jam 〉〉pa shā k+ṣiṃ ṭ+wāṃ dri gal pasna ṭ+wāṃ rdzu sra po/ m+p+raṃ ñtsha tri sna / /rtswa nā ༵ dzā tā (pa /pa gh+nā pa)rnyi shā brten pa'idakyil 'khor mi shes pa'ingo tsha la yon tan du ma sems shig/yon tanadapag tu med tshul/ grub chen las kyi rdo rjes zhus lan las/gsang bdag gis kho 4 lagan rdo khus kyang 'di yigegyon tanadapag par mi nus shing/ lhag pa'i ltamang pos rjes su bzung/ rigs gsum mgon shos kyang rjes su bzung lte lhag pa'i lha yin/ sangs nam rgya ngas mi ston/ lan+dam dbyangs dang /spyan ras gzigs kyis lung ston par 'gyur ro/ /ma'ong thos reg gsum gyis phan yon 'job nges pa'i gang zag yin pas/ khong gi rgyud tshod gzhan gyis dpag par mi nus se / /zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba rgya mtsho dang ldan pa'i rje 'di'i rnam thar la sngon byung gi rnam thar rags rim tsam dang/ da ltar gyi gzungs tshul sogs kyi rnam thar go rim gyi sgo nas mdzad pa ngo mtshar can gyi tho bye brag tu bshad pa dang] ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi mdzad 'phrin du ma ston tshul gsum/ dang po ni/ rje bdag nyid chen po 'di/ bskal pa bye ba stong phrag dpag 6med pa'i sngon rolanas rje btsun lan+damadabyangs kyis yangadang yang du zeg pa chen po'i 156
rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshugdge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzadade/rig pa'i gnas mtha'adag skyaba'i spobs pa thogs pa med cing/mngon shes lnga brnyes pa/ bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i zugs stobs bsam gyis mi khyab cinganzab mo'i lta ba dang gsang sngags skya thabs la mnga' brnyes shing / rgyal ba dbang po'i tog dang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyis de dus nas byin gyis brlabs shing / 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas par zab mo'i ltab dang gsang sngags kyi chos tshul spel par mdzad pa yin te/rgyal ba dbang po'i tog de ni/ bskal pa chen 4 bye ba stong phrag dpag med kyi sngon pu 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir 'jig rten gyi khams dang ba'i 'od ces bya ba la/ rgyal ba dbang po'irtog gshor sku tshe mdzad pa mtha' yas pa can byon par yab sras mjal ba dang mdo kun btus las bshad pa/ de dus nas yon tan de lta bu dang mdzad pa de lta bu 'jika rten gyi khams mtha' yas par da lta'i bar du bstan par rje btsun laram dbyangs kyis gsungs pa'i phyig shar ba rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis rtogs ldan rin po cher zhus pa'i dris lan rje btsun langam dbyangs kyis gsungs pa las/ snying stobs phul du byung ba'i sems dpa' chen 4 'di nyid/ sngon tshe rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis yang dang yang du dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad/ phyi nang gi rig pa'i gnas rnams la zogs med du smra ba'i spobs pa'ang thob/ mngon par shes pa lnga la mnga' brnyes/ de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog gi drung du rje btsun dang mngor mang po dang bcas te byon/de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog gis lus 〈snag la mi lta bar lta ba rnam dag dang 'brel ba'i sngags mdag pa'i zhing rnams su rgyas par byed pa ni/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes sogs kyis bsngags pa mang du brjod/ de'i tshe sems dpa' chen 4 lade nyid kyis gshor rgya mtsho chen po lta bu'idabus nas bzhengs lte/ ma dag pa'i zhing rnams su ltab rnamadag dang 'brel ba'i sngags lus srog la mi lta bar bdag gis rgyas par byed nus par gyur 157
'jigs byed chos 'byung /cig/ces smon lam btab/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'dini snying stobs phul du phyin pa'o/ /zhes mgrin gcig tu brjod de'i mod la de bzhin gshegs padabang po'i tog dang gangor byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang smon lam gnang / de bzhin gshegs pa de'i mthus phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyis kyang smon lam gnang / zugs kyis dgongs te sngar bzhin mdzad/ de'i tshe snying stobs phul du phyin pa'i sems dpa' chen po 'di nyid ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dpag tu med pa 'das pa'i byang shar gyi mtshams su/ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bkod pa sna tshogs pas mdzes pa zhes bya ba'i zhing du de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'ing ro zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes lung bstan/ de nas bzung ste/ ma dag pa'i zhing rnams su/ sngags rgya cher spel ba bkod pa stsa tshogs kyi sgonas bgrang ba las 'das pa thabs mkhas kyis mdzad/ da dung yang zhing khams mtha' yas pa rnams su skad cig gcig gis de nyid mang du rgyas par mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs la/ de'i tshe rje 7do'i bshes gnyen 'jam dbyangs dang / rje rang nyid yon tan dang ldan tshul/ rnam dag gangs ri ma las/ khyod ni sku tshe du ma'i snga rol tu/ /rje btsun 'angam dbyangs sras kyi shu sor rgyud /gzungs slobs mngon shes ting 'odzin du ma la/ /dbang 'byor chos kun rnam dpyod spyan gyis gzigs/ /nam zhig de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog /rnam mang gagor gyi dbus na theg pa mchog/ston mdzad mdun sa che der 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas te gshegs/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas des zab mo dang gsang sngags spel ba'i dam bca' la bsngags tshul/ de nyid las/ de tshe rgyal ba de yis tshangs dbyangs kyis/ /rgyal sras dpa' 4 lus dang srog la yang / /stos pa med par ma dag zhing rnams su/ /rdo rje zeg pa'i lam bzang 'dab brgya pa/ /stong nyid gtam gyi dri bzang rdzogs pa yis/ /yongs su 'gengs la zhugs pa gang yin pa/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod kun gyi/ /rabadang phul zhes rgya cher 158
rje bla mayab sras nas brgyud tshul/bsngags ba las/ /zhes gsungs/ de dus lhag bsam bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khrungs tshul/ rgyal ba de'i gshor gnam gyi skar ma lta bu dang / gzi bajid nyi ma ltar 'bar ba'i rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ snying stobs rmad byung gis 'gro ba dbugs dbyung ba'i 'jigs med seng ge'i sgra dbyangs kyis smon lam mdzad tshul ni/ de nyid las/ bdag nyid che khyod snying stobs 'o ma'i mtsho/ /ches cher bskyod pa'i rlabs phreng g.yos pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i lhangor mang dbus nas myur bar langs/ /ma zhum shin tu mtho ba'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /bdag ni grangs med ma dag zhing rnams su/ /stong nyid ltadang nyer 'brel sngags kyi lam/ /lus dang 〈snag la mi lta 'doms pa yis/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang rgyas bya zhes/ /dam bcas smon lam btab pa'i mod nyid la/ zhes dag de'i tshe rgyal ba de'i zugs rje'i 'od zer gyis bskul te/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyis de dus nas byin gyis rlabs tshul ni de nyid las/ rgyal ba dbang po'i tog dang phyogs bcu yi/ /rgyal ba ma lus dbyangs dang mgrin gcig tu/ /legs so khyod ni snying stobs chen po zhes/ /ches cher bsngags shing ngo mtshar ltas mang bstan/ /de nas brtsams te sangs rgyas zhing kun tu/ /'di yi mtshan ni snying stobs chen 4 zhes/ /rgyal ba sras bcas kun la mthun par grags/ /zhes gsungs sdurdzo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i rtog byung dus bskal pa mtha' yas pa'i sngon yin tshul dang / zhing khams kyi khyad par 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i spung gi bye ma'i grangs mnyam gyi 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig tu gyur pa dang / gshor dang gdul bya'i khyad par bde ba khyad par can lnga la skyod kyang zhen chags med pa sogs yon tan dpag yas dang ldan pa dang / sangs rgyas de yang bdag cag gi ston pa dang rgyud gcig yin pa dang] der ma zad da dung ston pa lan nyid kyis gsar du sems bskyed pa dang latsang rgya tshul dngor ba ma stong bar du ston par bshad pa'i phyig khyad par dang po bzhi ston par yab sras mjal ba'i 159
'jigs byed chos 'byung /(spra pashā) spra ny+pha gh+nā ༵ sprad sbyi pad+mo hūm̐ shā&pa pa pasdum/ ṭā sbyong (pa spyanam k+ṣiṃ dī ༵ rdzu lha hūm̐ gzhal du med pa/ brjod du med pa 'das pa de'i tshe de'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dbang po'i tog ces bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig tu gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na 'khod pa'i sems can rnams kyang bde ba lnga thob par gyur te/ 'de ltar la la ni 'dod pa'i bde ba dang ldan par gyur to/ /la la ni khyim nas 'byung ba'i bde ba dang ldan par gyur to/ /la la ni bsam gtan gyi bde bdang ldan par gyurato/ /la lani snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde bdang ldan par gyur to/ /la lani bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bde ba dang ldan par gyur te/dedag bde bde la yang spyod la/ de dag la mngon par zhen pa med par gyur to/ /'de lta ste/ dper na bung ba me tog gi khu bas nye bar 'tsho yang de la mngon par zhen pa med do/ /de bzhin du sems can de dag kyang bde ba de la yongs su spyod kyang de la mngon par zhen pa med do/ /'di lta lte/ dper na bar snang la rgyu ba'i bya ni/ bar snang la yang rgyu la de la mngon par chags pa yang med do/ /de bzhin du sems can de dag kyang bde ba de la yongs su gyod kyang] de la mngon par zhen pa med do/ /'jamadapal gyis gsol pa/de'i tshe de'i dus na de bzhin gshegs padabang po'i tog ces bgyi bar gyur padeni bcom ldan lanas nyidade'i tshede'i dusan/de bzhin gshegs padabang po'i tog ces bgyi bar 'tshal to/ /zhes gsungs se / /khyad par lnga pa yin te/ yab sras mjal ba las/ bye ba brgyad cur rgyal ba nyid/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bstan gyur kyang] /da dung chog pa'i 'du shes bsal/ /byang chub mchog tu zugs kyang 'jug /stong gsum drug cu rtsagacig gi /sangs 160
rje bla mngab༄sa nas brgyud tshul/rgyas zhing rnams dag gyur pas/ /ji ltar thub pa thabs mkhas pa/ /rgyal ba khyod ni kun gyis latsal/ /da dung dang 4 zugs bskyed pad /de dang der ni yongs bstan te/ /da dung dulang 'drin pa khyod/ /sangs rgyas mngon par ston par mdzad/ /ces dang] dam chos pad dkar las kyang /bskal pa bye stong bsam gyis mi khyab pad /de yi tshad ninamakhang med panas/ /byang chub mchog rab de ni ngas thob ste/ /nga ni rtag tu chos kyang rab 'chad do/ /zhes gsungs shing / 'di ldem dgongs ma yin par sgra ji bzhin yin pag mdo kun btus su khyad par bzhi ba'i bshad pasan no/ /de nas bzung ste bshad zin 9ltag zhing khams mtha' yas par mdo sngags kyi zab chos spel zhing/ ston pa sangs rgyas rdo rje gdan du byon pa'i dus/gzhon nunas mjal zhing sems bskyed/rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ lung bstan lte byin gyis rlabs pa yin te/ de'i tshe bram ze'i khye'u zhig tu 'khrungs/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul padage slong mos pa'i blo gros zhes bya bas khrid de/ston pa'i zhabs drung du shel zeng phul/ mdo sngags kyi zab mo'i lta ba dri ma med par rang bzhin gyis rtogs par smon lam btab pas/da garje rang nyid kyi slob brgyud kyi tshogs mtha'alpus pas dbu ma'i lta ba dang] sngags kyi skal ldan du gyur pa'i rgyu rkyen phul du byung tshulani/ yangadag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa myangan las 'das pa'i dus su/ 'phags pa 'od srung dang/kun dga' 'o la sogs pa'i lha'or rnams la mdo sde gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i rgyal 4 bka' stsal to/ /mdo 'di bod du ma 'gyur yang] 'de'i nang nas bstan pa dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i le'u phyung ste/ 'od du bsgyur ba'i nang du bka' phyag gi dam pa mang po dang gtso sar rje 'di lung bstan tshul ni/ dpe rnying mthong ba las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kunadaga' ṭo/ bstan pa gso ba'i gang zag 'di ltar 'byung / da ltar nga la shel dkar gyi/ /zeng ba phul nas sems bskyed spru//ma 'ongs dus kyi snyigs ma la//'bridang ldan gyi sa mtshams su//dga' zhes bya ba'idagon pa 'debs//blo 161
'jigs byed chos 'byung /lhar+sha snrosna spra'i /lha dzo /sprir+sha /nga/ tsho r+sha ni kau ༵ ṭ+wāṃ /rdzu lha/ gh+nā ༵ lhanyi/ sa/dzī / t+pū ba shān yi tsho shā zhing mchod pa byed/ /ston pa'i mdo bzhin gsung slogs shing / /nga la gsol ba rab btab nas/ /bstan pa lo stong bar du gnas/ /de nas 'phos nas shar phyogs su/ /rmad byung bkod mdzes zhing khams su/ /seṅge'i nga ro zhes bya ba'i/ /rgyal ba de bzhin gshegs par 'gyug /de la dad byed zhing der skye/ /zhing mchog de ni khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs la/ mkhar nag chos 'byung du drangs pa las/ /kun dga' bo/ da lta nga la shel dkar gyi/ /phreng ba phul ba'i khye'u 'di/ /nga yi bstan pa gso byed la/ /zhes sogs kyis khye'ur bshad cing / de dang mthun par rje btsun gyis bla ma dbu ma pa la gsungs tshul/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i gsung ba'i rnam tharadangos grub snye ma las/ bla ma dbu ma pas rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la/ rje rin 4 che 'di'i sku skye snga sgyi sogs kyi zhu ba mdzad pas/ sngon sangs rgyas 'jig rten na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ bla ma 'di rgya gar du bram ze'i khye'u zhig tu 'khrangs/ de'i tshe dge slong gi cha lugs 'dzin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mos pa'i blo gros zhes bya ba dang mjal nas/ de nyid mnyes par byas shing zhabs 'bring du 'brangs/ chos mang du gsan/ des khrid de/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i zhabs drung du mjal zhing sems bskyed/ de'i tshe ston pa la shel dkar po dri ma med pa brgya rtsa'i phreng ba zhigadad pas phul nas smon lam btab pas/ stong pa nyid kyi lta ba phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i sa 'on bzhag pa yin/ zhes dang / de bzhin du rje legs bzang bas mdzad pa'i gsang ba'i rnam thar rab gsang rmad byung dga' ston byin rlabs kyi char rgyun dngos grub kyi gter 'byed rin 4 che'i rlung pa las/ bla ma dbu ma pas rje btsun gyi drung du/ rje rin ṭo che'i sku skye snga phyi sogs zhus pas/ ston pa 'jig rten na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rgya gar du bram ze'i khye'u gcig tu 'khrungs/162
rje bla mayabasras nas brgyud tshugde'i tshe dge slong gi cha lugs 'dzin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mos pa'i blo zos zhes bya ba mnyes par byas shang / zhabs drung du 'brangs/ chos mang du gsan/ des khrid de/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i drung du shel dkar po'i phreng ba brgya rtsagacig dad pas phul nas sems bskyed de zhon lam btab pas/ stong pa nyid kyi lta ba phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i sa 'on bzhag pasan/ zhes dang / yang de bzhin du mkhas grub chen 4 kun dga' bde legs kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs las/ bla ma dbu ma pas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la rje 'de'i sku skye snga phyi glerdzogs kyi zhu ba mdzad pas/ sngon sangs rgyas 'jig rten na bzhugs pa'i dus su bla ma 'di rgya gar du bram ze'i khye'u zhig tu zhakhrungs/ de'i tshe dge slong byang chub sems dpa' mos pa'i blo gros zhes bya ba dang mjal nas de mnyes par byas te/ des khrid de/ ston pa shākya chub pa'i zhabs drung du mjal zhing sems bskyed/ de'i tshe ston pa la shel dkar po dri ma med pa brgya rtsa'i phreng ba zhig dad pas phul nas smon lam btab pas stong pa nyid kyi lta ba phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i sa 'on bzhag pa yin/ zhes dang / de bzhin du rje'i rtogs brjod 'dun legs ma'i ṭīk+ka legs bshad sgron me las/ rje btsun gyi drung du bla ma dbu ma pas/ bdag nyid chen 4 'de'i sku tshe snga phyi sogs ji ltar lags zhus pas/ ston pa 'jig rten na byon pa'i dus/ rgya gar du bram ze'i khye'u zhig tu 'khrungs/ de'i tshe dge slong gi cha lugs 'dzin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mos pa'i blo gros zhes bya ba mnyes par byas shing chos kyang mang du gsan/ des khrid de/ ston pa shākya thusapa'i drung du shel dkar bo'i phreng ba brgya rtsagacig phul nas sems bskyed cing smon lam btab pas/stong pa nyid kyi lta ba phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i sa bon bzhag pa yin/ zhes dang / 'jam dbyangs chos rjes gsang ba'i rnam thar las/ sngon tshe rdo rje gdan du rgyal ba la/ /rin chen shel gyi phreng ba brgya rtsagacig/legs par phul te byang chub sems bskyedanas/ /yang dag lta ba rtogs 163
'jigs byed chos 'byung /pa'i skal ldan rgyud /ces dang] de bzhin du bstod pa brgyad cu ba las/ sngon tshe bram ze'i khye'ur zhabrungs pa'i dus/ /rang gi ston pa shākya zub pa la/ /shel dkar phreng ba dri med phul byas te/ /dang por thugs bskyed mdzad pa'i tsong kha ba/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltabu'i khye'u de rab tu byungaka bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mtshan dge slong pad+ma'i ngad ldan zhes bya ba yin te/ ston pa mtsho ma dros pa'i 'gram du dbyar gnas dus klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas dung phul ba dbyar dus de dang bya rgod phung po'i ri sogs su chos dung byas/ ston pas mo'u 'gal gyi bu la da lta'i dge slong pad+ma'i ngad ldan 'dis ma 'ongs pa na gangs can du nga'i bstan pa rgyas par byed pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs dud byed mara'agyur bas khyod rdzu 'phrul gyis song la 'od gdong dmar yul gyi 'gog pa rir gter du spos la gter bdag tshogs bdag sbre'us byas te bsrung du chug ces bka' stsal cing de ltar byas pa yin lte/ lang gshegs rgya nag 'gyur las/ ston pa gsor bcas mtsho ma pham pa'i 'gram du dbyar gnas par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i me+e/ klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas dung phul bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mo'u 'gal gyi bu la khyod rdzu 'phrul gyis song la/ dung 'de 'od gdong dmar can gyi yul du spos shig/ma 'ongs pa'i dus na lugar lana'i nang nas dge slong pad+ma'i ngad ldan gyis nga'i bstan pa rgyas par byed ba'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs dung byed kyi/ de'i gter bdag tu tshogs bdag spre'u'i gzugs su byas te bsrung du chug ces gsungs par bshad pa dang / lung bstan gsang ba'i me long las/ bya rgod phung bo'i rir ston pa sangs rgyas la klu'i rgyal 4 ma dros pas dung phul ba re zhig chos dung mdzad/de rjes ston pa dngor bcas kha cher phebs dusad lta'i slob mdage slong pad+ma'i ngad ldan 'di 'od gdong dmar can gyi yul du blo bzang grags pa zhes bya ba'i dge slong du gyur nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i bstan pa rgyas par byed pa 'ong gsungs te/ kun dga' 'o la bka' stsal nas/ kun dga' 'os dung 164
rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshugbsnams nas rdzu 'phrul gyis byon/ 'brog ri 4 cher gter du smras/ gter bdag tshogs bdag la bcol ba spre'u'i gzugs su yod ces gsungs pa gnyis phal cher mthun par yod la/ de'i rjes su bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa du ma lung bstan pa'i tshul slo bzang bka' 'bum ltar yin no/ /des na rje 'dis ston pa'i drung du mjal ba nas da lta yan la dus mnyam gyi sprul ba ma rtsis par 'khrangs rabs ris brgyud la sku'i skye ba btsubadun bzhes bsanate/ gramadabu ma bas rje btsun la zhus pa'i lan las/ rje 'dis ston pa'i drung du mjal ba nas da lngayan la sku'i skye ba bcu bdun song la/ rgya gar yul du paṇ+ḍi ta che ba gsum dang chung ba gnyis/ 'od du 'di ma gtogs pa'i bshes gnyen gyi sku'i skye ba gsum blangs pa'i gcigani paṇ+ḍitar bgrang du rung zhinganbstan pa la phan shin tu che ba zhig tu 'khrungs mtshan ci zer ba lags zhus pas/ khyedang rgyal skye 'ongs pas da res mi 'chad ces gsungs/de 'dra'i sku'i skye ba snga phyi ni/ grub chen phyag rdor bas two ༵ dī bai nā rnyi k+ṣiṃ dī r+sha smi shā gh+nā spya sdu sdusalta ༵ hūm̐ gā gh+nā/ ma|pa dz+nyo ñdzadīX (( /hā/ pa'i gsang ba'i rnam thar sogs las shes par bya zhing/ de ltar rje 'di nyid kyi dus kyi bstan pa 'edzin skyong spel pa'i dngos slob sbyin bdag rnams ni/ rje'i skye ba gong ma dang bcas nas smon lam lhan gcig sngonanas grub lte/ paṇa chen don yod rdo rjedang/ khyad par du kha che r+ṇi stan du paṇa chen ma ti bha tra shrīr 'khrangs dus thams cad kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang rigs gsum mgon 4 sogs la shub bstan spel ba'i byin rlabs dang dris lan zhu ba mdzad cingad byams pa dang mgon 4 tshedabag med kyis 'amadon du bskul ba'i rgyu mtshan gyisayinate/mkhan chen las kyi rdo rjes gsang bdag la zhus pa/ blo bzang grags pa 'di'i skye ba snga ma gang du zhakhrungs/ pyi ma gang du zhabrungs/ dgung lo'i tshad ci tsam shub/ 'grodon gang du 'phel/ slob ma 165
'jigs byed chos 'byung /ji lta bu zhig 'byung] yi dam gang dang 'brel/ 'tshang nam rgya/ rgyud tshod ji lta bu yin zhus pas/gsang bdag gi zhal nas/ 'di'i skye ba snga ma kha che khri stan du paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti bha tra shrī zhes bya bar zhabrungs/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dngor lnga brgya 'dus/ zhes dang] ma cig la yang bsod nams rgyan mas zhus pa las/ ma cig lags/de 'dra ba 'byung ba da lta'adinas lo ci tsam yod/ snyigs ma de'i dus su rgyal khrims dang chos khrims nyams la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa smag tu slog lurgyug pa tsam de ma cig rang gi zugs rje yin nam/ ci 'dra yin/ rgyu ci las 'byung ba yin/ de dus kyi snyigs ma 'byung ba la rtags ci 'dra ba 〈snad lags/ zhes zhus pa la/ ma cig gi zhal nas/bu mo bzhi legs par nyon la yid la zungs shig dang ngas bshad do/ /snyigs ma 'de nas bzung ste lo brgya phrag las 'das pa na dkyil du phyin no/ /snyigs ma de'i dus bstan pa de gsal bar byed pa de nga ni ma yin no/ /bstan pa de gsal bar byed pa'i skyes bu de ni da lta rgya gar sgya po ta ri'i shar lho mtshams su bzhugs shing sems can gyi don la dka' ba mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de ni cher dran pa dang ldan pa/ khyad par shes rab dang ldan pa/ khyad par snying stobs dang ldan pa gcig yin pa des/ res 'ga' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po la chos zhu/ res mgon po byams pa la chos zhu/ res mgon 4 tshe dpag med la chos zhu/ res mgon po 'jam dpal la chos zhu ba/ res ku ku ri ba rnams la chos zhu bar nus pa'i sems can gyi don la zugs bskyed shin tu che ba/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug shin tu khros pa'i nag po phyag drug pa mdon 4 chen po la sogs pa'i ma mgon rnams bran bzhin nyan nas bstan pa bsrung bar byang chub sems dpa' de/ snyigs ma de'i dus su 'dir byon nas dge slong gi chas su zhugs nas/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gsal bar byed pa yin/ de'ang thub pa nyid kyi lung bstan thob pa dang]mgon po tshedapag medadang byams pa la sogs kyis mngags pa yin gyi/ rgyu rkyen yang de ltar 166
rje bla mayabasras nas brgyudatshugyin no/ /zhes gsungs dred/ /gnyis pa da ltar gyi zhabrungs tshul rnam thar ho rim gyi sgo nas mdzad pango mtshar can gyi zo bye brag tu 'god pa ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras po de nyid/ lcags sbrel la sku bltams/ lo nyir dgu bzhes dus rab tu byung nas lo drug dka' ba spyad de/ so lnga pa shing pho rta yi sa ga zla ba'i dpyid zla tha chung gi tshes bco lnga la sangs rgyas/ lo de'i hor zla drug pa'i zhag chad brtsis na tshes drug dang ma brtsis pa'i tshes lnga la chos lubor bskog sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i dbu rnyed nas lo stong phrag gcig dang dgu brgya dang bdun 'das pa na me mkha' rgya mtsho'i 'das lo'i rjes kyi rab byung gi thog ma shad de nas sum brgyadang bco brgyad 'das pa'i rab byung drug pa'i lteng nas lo bco brgyad 'das pa'i me mo bya'i lo la mdo khams smad kyi sa'i thig le tsong khad mal gyi rigs/ yab klu 'bum dge dang] yum shing bza' a chos zhes bya ba dad sogs snying stobs yon tan gyis smyug pa'i yab yum sgya sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te lubrungs so/ /'di la rje rin 4 che dgung lo nga gsum pa'i sa glang lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i yar tshes gsum par mnal lam gyi tshul du/ zab rgyas kyi bum chu byin tshul brda' tshig gnang ba las/ kā la sha bkang ster rtsis byed/ /phul byung nas ni sum brgya bcu/ /song zer yab gcig dkyil 'khor gtso/ /zhes pa'i gsang ba'i rnam thar las/ jo 4 nas de'i bar la sum brgya dang bcu song bar bshad pa la/ kha cig jo ṭo shing rtar gshegs panas/ rje'i sa glang gi bar la 'dod pa shin tu mi 'thad de/ dzo 'o gshegs pa'i shing rtanas/ rje'idagung long gsum pa'i sa glang yan chad la sum brgyadang lnga brtsartsalnga song ba'i phyir te/ dzo bo gshegs pa'i shing rta rab byung dang po'i shing rta dang / rje'i bum chu byin pa'i sa glang rab byung bdun ba'i lo skor gnyis pa'i sa glang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di ltar 'dod pa dag gis lung de'i nis lo'i thog mtha' gnyis ka 167
'jigs byedachos 'byung /nor ba dzo 'o gshegs lo nas rtsis phyin gtan nas mi 'grig par snga ma'i rigs pas dpyod ldan rnams kyis shes dgos la/ mtha'i lo sa glang la byed pa yang gsang ba'i rnam thar gnyis dang /gnas rnying ba'i rnam tharadangad gung ru'i 'dun legs ma'i ṭīk+ka las/ de'i bar du zhes yod pa'i 'das tsheg gi yi ge tsam yang ma bltas pa'i snying khams su rangango shes par mdzod la/ de'i bar dang/ da lta'i bar gyi zhes pa'i tsheg gnyis kyi khyad bar 'das pa dang da ltar la rgyur ba'ang shes bar gyis/ yang kha cig gis jo 'ogashegs pa'i shing rtanas rje zhakhrungs lo me bya'i snga lo la bh+yor nalang mi godade/ 'do snga ma las cungadaga'akhang jo 4 gshegs pa'i dus kyi rab byungadang 4 shing rta nas rab byung drug pa'i me bya'i bar la 'dzi sum brgya dang bzhi las ma song ba'i sgyid lo drug gis nyungs rtso/ /'dis rtsis gzhi'i thog ma ngo bo'i 'das lo la skyar bas nongs te/ phul byung nasani zhes pa'idon ma go bar zadado/ /yang kha cig jo 4 chu pho rtar 'das par ladodanas me bya'i bar la sbyaran ches mi 'phrig ste/ sbyor lam yigadangadage bshes ston pa'idagung lodang rwa sgreng sogs dang 'gal la/de'i bar la lo sum brgya dang bcu drugatsangad pas lo drug gis mnges pa'i pyir ro/ /yang kha cig chu rta nas sa glang gi bar sbyar ba'ang ches mi 'grig lte/ chu rta la jo 4 zhakhrungs bar byasan shing rtalas kyang lo bco brgyad kyis mang skyon sogs 'ong/ yang mkhas grub chen 4 nor bzang rgya mtshos de'i rtsis lo brgya nyer gcig gi mjug gi rab byung nas lo drug 'das pa'i chu bya la jo 4 zhakhrungs/ dgung lo bdun cu pa chu rta la gshegs pa'i de nas rje'i nga gsum pa sa glang gi bar sum brgyadang brgyad song kyang rags jig kyis sum brgyadang bsabyas gsungs pasang mi 4dade/jo bo'idagung snying rta losan padang/ rtalo la gshegs par jo bo'i dngos slob 'brom rin 4 che/ nag tsho lo chenadang]ka bdang sgom pa rdzothos mtha' yas sogs kyi yi ge dang 'gal zhingaka rtsis lo nyis brgya nyer gcig pa'i mjug gi rab byung nang gi drug pa 168
rje bla maphubasras nas brgyudatshugchu bya nas brtsis pa'i bdun cu pa chu rta la gshegs pa yin na jo 4 ma gshegs pa'i gong du 'gyom/ rnal 'phyor pa/ dgon pa ba rnams kyang 'das par 'gyuradagos pa la/ dge bshes ston pa lo nga gcig par jo bo gshegs/ nga bzhi pa me byar rwa sgreng btab par bla rabs kyi rnam thar las thon pa dngan rje rab byung drug par zhakhrungs pas so/ /der ma zad bdun cu par gshegs pa yang mi 'thad de/ jo 'os rang bzhin gyi rnal 'gyor mar lung bstan zhus dus 'od du ma byon na dgung lo go gnyis dang / 'od du byon na don gsum las mi chub par bshad pa dang] bstod ba sogs dang lagal pa'i pyir te/ bka' gdams chos 'byung las kyang] tshe ni 'od du byon na thung bar 'dug gsung] ji tsam gyis zung zhus pas/ sad du ma byon na dgung lo go gnyis thub/ phyin na bdun cu gagasum las mi thub gsung / don la nyi shu tham pas zung du song ba yin skad/ de'i tshe jo bo'i zugs dgongs la 'od la phan thogs na thung na yang thung ste/ tshe la mi lta snyam pa'i zugs stobs chen 4 skyes/ rang bas gzhan gces bya ba de lta bu zhig yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i )ga des na yang nag tsho nas brgyud pa'i rnam thar gyi yi ge las/ sangs rgyas shing 'o sbrel la mya ngan las 'dasanas lo sum stong bzhi bcu rtsabadun 'das pa'i rab myos zhes pa lcags pho ltare lo la jo 'o 'khrungs/ nga bdun pa zad pa zhes pa me stag la rgya gar nas gdan bteg pa sogs bshad pa yang mi 'thad de/ lam yig gsang 'khor ma las/ drug cu'i bar du rgya gar chos kyis bskyangs/ /chu pho rta la kha ba can du byon/ /zhes gsungs pa dang dngos su lagal zhing] rang de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i phyir ro/ /desan jo bo'i bstod pa sogs dang 'gal ba'i phyir te/ jo 4 chu rta la 'khrungs/ nga dgu pa dpa' 'o zhes pa lcags 'brug la gdan bteg /lcags sbrul la bal por phebs/ chu rta la mnga' ris su byon/ re drug par bsam yas dang de'i mdzug tu snye thang du bum chu byin/ jo 4 don gsum bzhes pa'i rgyal ba zhes pa shing rta)dbyug gu zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad la 169
'jigs byed chos 'byung /gshegs pa yin te/ dedag gi shes byed ni glegs bam rin 4 che dang] lam yig gsang lhagar mdang/shar ba'i lam rim brjed byang rnams kyi dgongs pa yin zhing] rje rin 4 che dang/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i yangadagongs pasan tshul/ dus lubor ṭīka chen las/ ngo 'os lcags mo yos la 'od du bsnyan rtsis mdzad par bshad pas/ dzo bo chu rta la zhakhrungs par bzhed par grub cing / lam rim chen mo las/ deyang mnga' ris su lo gsum/ snye thang du lo dgu/dbus gtsang gzhan du lo lnga'i bar du skal bdang ldan pa rnams la mdo sngags kyi gzhung gdams ngag ma lus pa bstan nas/ zhes gsungs/ bstod pa las kyang] khyod sngon so ma bu ri na/ /rtog ge 'bar ba gsungs pa'i tshe/ /da ni lo ni nyi shu na/ /tshe yi 'du byed gtong 'gyur gsung] /de nas lo gnyis lon pa na/ /'od du 'byon pa'i dus su ni/ /bi kra ma la shī lar ni/ /da ni lo ni bco brgyad na/ /tshe yi 'du byed btang nas ni/ /lus 'di 'od du 'jog go gsungan /zhes gsungs so/ /des na lam yig kha cig dang / lam rim kha cig las bod du lo dgu zer ba dang / bcu gnyis sogs zer ba'ang khegs so/ /des na chos 'byung yid kyi mdzes rgyan dang / gzhin rje gshed kyi chos 'byung las kyang jo 4 lcags rta la 'khungs pa'i re drug pa me phag nas sa glang gi bar gyi brtsi tshul gnyis pa yang gzhanangor bstun pa tsamasan gyi/rang lugs snying 4 chu rtar bzhed par bshad pas rtso/ /des na gsang dngor ma'i dpe kha cig las/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa ni/ /me pho rta la rgya gar yul du 'khrungs/ /drug cu'i bar du rgya gar chos kyis bskyangs/ /chu pho rta la kha ba can du byon/ /zhes padape mdag payin te/ me rtar zhabrungs padang/ drug cu'i bar chu rtayongs pa lagal bas rkang pa gnyis pa ma dag cing] gsum pa yang rags rtsis su mngon/ de ltar mtha' gzhan du dogs pa'i spros pa lung rigs rnam par dag pas bsal lte/ rnam par dag pa'i rang lugs 'de ltarasan te/ jo 'o chu rdzal 'khrungs pa'i dgung lo re drug pa me phag gi lo mjug snye thang du phebs 170
rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshugpar byams 'jam dbyangs gnyis kyis mos kyi 'gro ba mdzad pa zhal gzigs/ de nas rje tsong kha ba chen sa zhakhrungs pa'i me mo bya'i bar du lo sum brgyadang bcasong bani/ brna tshig las/phul byung nas ni sum brgya brga /zhes pa'i don mi zhakhrul ba yin te/ jo 'o zhakhrungs lo dang gshegs lo'i mtha' gzhan sngar ltar khegs shing / 'di'i sum brgya dang bcu'i thog ma/ dzo 'o la byams 'jam dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa nas 'dzin pa ni/ brda tshig las/ byā lha'i gong gi tsan+t+ra ni/ /mig dang zla ba'i grangs gsum la/ /bzo ba mdzad pa'i chu 'dres chus/ /kā la sha bkang nyer rtsis byed/ /phul byung nas ni sum brgya bcu/ /song zer yab gcig dkyil gshor gtso/ /bgro ba mdzad pa gnyis kyang snang / /zhes dang / de'i don gsang ba'i rnam thar rin 4 che'i snye ma las/gsum la zhes bya ba ni/ zla ba de'i tshes gsum gyi mtshan mo'o/ /de'i tshe rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig rje btsun lan+dam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil lubor yongs su rdzogs par snang zhing /dkyil lubor gyi gtso bos/ rgyan bzang 4 sna tshogs pas spras pa'i rin 4 che'i bum pa chus bkang pa zhig rje nyid la nyer rtsis byed cing kā la sha ni bum pa'i brda yinalhar+sha/ /bum pa'i chu 'do jo bo chen 4 dpal ldan a ti sha snye thang gi skyi chu'i 'gram na bzhugs dus/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang rje btsun byams pa gnyis/ sku gsum dang gcig gang yin la chos kyi bzo ba mdzad pa'i chu 'dris pa'i chu yin/ 'di jo 'o chen 4 nas bzung ste/ da bar la lo sum brgya dang bcu song / de'i bar du ster sa ma rnyed/ ces gsungs pa 'dis/ jo 'o chen 4 nas bzung ste/ zhes pas jo 'o bzhugs dus yin par bstan pa dang / snye thang gi skyi chu'i 'gram na bzhugs dus sogs kyis byams 'jam dbyangs kyis bzo ba mdzad pa'i bum chu thob pa nas bzung ste/ rje lubrungs pa'i me bya de'i bar la lo sum brgya dang bcu song / zhes gsungs shing / lo sum brgya dang bcu bo de'i bar du zab rgyas yongs rdzogs dang] gsang 'dus kyi gnad yongs su rdzogs pa'i bum chu 'di 171
'jigasabyedachos 'byung /ster ba'i yul tsam yang ma rnyed pa ni/ brda tshig gi gsang ba'i rnam thar las/ ster sa ma rnyed ces gsungs pa/ rje zhakhrungs pa nas yongs rdzogs kyi bum chu de ster ba'i snod rung byung yang) da ster ba'i skabs su babs pa yin pas/ khyod la ster ba yin no/ /zhes pa'i gsung gis rje rin 4 che ladabugasadabyung bar mdzad tshul ni/ brda tshig gidon gsang ba'i rnam thar las/ da khyod la ster bsanalhas zhes zer zhes gsungs la/ de bzhin du gnas rnying kun dga' bde legs kyis mdzad pa'i rje'i rnam thar las kyang/ bum pa'i chu 'di jo 'o chen po dpal ldan a ti sha snye thang gi sgyi chu'i 'gram du bzhugs dus/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang rje btsun byams pa gnyis sku gsum dang gcig gangasan la chos kyi bkro ba mdzad pa'i chu 'dris pa'i chu yin/ 'di jo so chen ponas bzung ste da'i bar la lo sum brgya dang bcu song / da bar du ster sa ma rnyed/ da khyod la ster ba yin no/ /zhes zer zhing / de'i tshe chos kyi bgro ba mdzad pa 'o rje btsun 'jam dpal dang rje btsun byams pa gnyis snang ngo] /zhes dang] gung ru rgyan bzang gis mdzad pa'i rje'i 'dun legs ma'i ṭīk+ka las kyang bum pa'i chu 'di jo 'o snye thang du sgyi chu'i 'gram du bzhugs dus rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang rje btsun byams mgon gnyis sku gsum dang gcig gang yin la chos kyi bgro ba mdzad pa'i chu 'dris pa'i chu yin/ gdo jo bonas bzung ste da'i bar la lo sum brgyadang bcu song/da bar du ster sa ma rnyed/ da khyod la ster ba yin zhes zeg de'i tshe chos kyi bgro ba mdzad pa 'o gnyis kyang snang ngo / /zhes gsungs so/ /de yang rje 'di nyid 3khungs pa'i tshe/ yul gyi skye 4 rnams dngaka yab yum gnyis dang] chos kyi rje don grub rin chen sogs la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas sna tshogs dang bcas te/ sbrel lor yab kyi mnal lam du/ 'jam dpal rgya ban glegs bam can gyi rnam pas mchod khang du phebs pa rmis pas bu shes rab can zhig yong ngam snyam pa dang / lcang lo can nas phyag rdor gyis rdo rje 'phangs pa yum la thim pa rmis pas bu stobs ldan zhig skye ba 172
rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshul/yin nam snyam pa dang/ yum gyis me tog gi thang gcig tu/ skye 'o mang 4 dang lhan tu lta'od pagshar nas shel gyi khye'u dngaka nub kyi mkha' las mas/ 'di'i khrod nas su 'os dris nas yum la khus byas ba dang / khyim mtshes gzhan gyis jo 'o rin 4 che gdan drangs pa dang / nyi zla skar gsum cig car shar ba rmis pa dang]nyin par yang me tog gi char dang/ nam mkha' nas rol mo grags pa dang] sa g.yo ba sogs dang / chos rje don grub rin ṭo che'i rmi lam du/ rdo rje 'dzigs byed la zhal dngos su mthong ba dgos zhes gsol ba btab bas/ tsong kha ngos bstan nas/ sang phodad tsam lung ba lana'i mda' ru yong] de bar du bde bar gyis gsungs pas rje 'der zhabrungs par mkhyen/ bya lor yum gyi rmi lam sa spyan ras gzigs bsu zhes skye ṭo thams cad kyis rnga rol mchod rdzas sna tshogs khyer nas 'akro bar bltas pas/ nam mkhar gser sku ri 'o tsam 'od zer nyi ma ltar 'phro ba/ chos kyi sgra dbyangasadang bcas pa lha'i bu bu mo cha lugs phun sum tshogs pa du mas bskor ba zhig mar mar babs te lus la thim pas/ rang la phyag skor dang mtshod pa dang bkra shis brjod pa sogs rmis/ bya lo'i mjug yum gyi zugs ga'i shel sgo phye zhing / mkha' 'gros khus gsol ba rmis rjes zo rangs zhabrungs/ chos rjedon rin pas lan+dam dbyangs kyi ril bu sogs kyang de dus gnang / zhabrungs sa der tsan+da na dkar 4 lta bu'i sdong 'o skyes pa'i lo ma rnams la sku mi 'dra ba du ma dang/ a ra pa tsa na'i yi ge rtsogs byon cing] de'i mdun du de'i rtsab brgyugs pa'i ldong 'o gnyis pa zhig byung b.radaga' ldan gsar mar grags so/ /dgung lo gsum par rol ba'i rdo rjes dge bsnyen mdzad/ dbus su phebs na sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bur 'ong zhes lung bstan par chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston las bshad/ bdun par chos rje don rin pa'i zhabs bsten/ brgyad par dge tshul dang] bde dkyes gshin rje gshed dmar nag dang/ rdo rje 'dzigs byed kyi dbang / phyag rdor gshor chen gyi dbang sogs dang / bsnyen sgrub du ma dang /173
'jigasabyed chos 'byung /byams chos phal cher gsan cing bshad gsar yang mdzad de/ brgyad cu las/ bcu drug par du pa// (sna ༈ spya /snad/ pa/ pa/'a/ sna kū shārnyi /sprihā lha/spra (pa kā pas/ ṭ+wāṃ dhi /su/ts+tsha/nā /shā lam du phyag rdor dang jo bo rje yang yang phebs/ brgyad cu las/ rab tu byung nas yang yang mnal lam pu /mthu stobs dbang rgyug gsang bdag gtum 4 dang] /rgyal ba gnyis pa jo 'o a ti sha /stu bstan byin gyis brlabs pa'i tsong kha pa/ /zhes dngad gsang ba'i rnam thar las/ dgung lo bdun nas rje btsun gsang bdag dang] /shing rta chen po dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ /mngon sum gzigs shing rgyun du rjes bzung bas/ /sngags dang pha rol phyin gzhung gdams par shag /zhes gsungs/ de dus su ljags bsnyen sogs kyang mdzad nas dgung lo bcu drug par dbus su phebs/ lam du chab mdor zhag bzhugs mdzad skabs gnas brtan bcu drug dngan mgon khang gi sar mgon po zhal gzigs nas lung bstan par yang grags che/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa'i dus 'bri gung du phebs/ spyan snga chos kyi rgyal 'od rdo rje phreng ba/ nā ro chos drug /phyag chen lnga ldan sogs zab khrid mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas gung thang du rgyud 'jug ltar rgyal sras kyingang tshul rig gnas mtha'adag slob pa mtshon par tshal ba'i lngarje dkon mchog skyabs la smanadapyad yan lag brgyad pa gsan pas lhag ma med par shugs su chud de gso rig ma mdzad kyang/ gso rig smra ba thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur tshul phyis kyi sman pa thams cad kyis gsesnal sman 'bul dus zhal bkod zhu bar grag /snye thang du bkra shis seng ge dang gdan sa dge skyos gnyis la chos gsan/ bde ba can du bla ma yon dbu gnyis la phar phyin shing rta'i srol bzhir grags pa sogs gsan/ 'jam rin la byams chos kun gsan/ dngul chu chos rdzong du 'jam dbyangs bdun pa bla mdam pa brtsodanams rgyal mtshan la/ a ra pa tsa na/ dril bu lusadakyil 174
rje bla ma yab sras nas brgyud tshul/gyi dbang dang / gur mgon gyi rjes gnang dang] dbu'i paṇa zhwa gnang nas bu lugs kyi bstan pa gtad/ bcu dgu'i dus gsang phur grwa skor mdzad pas zla bral gyi snyan pa che/ de nas bde ba can du grwa skor mdzad pas de bas kyang snyan pa cher rgyas/ gtsang du mkhar kha la brgyud de zhwa lur lo chen rin rnam la/ bde mchog mai tri bcu gsum ma gsan/ de nas snar thang dang sa bzang du/ ma ti paṇa chen gyi drung du chos mang du gsan/ sa skyar phebasanas grwa skor mdzad/ mkhas kun dbus su 'jigs med gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs che/ brgyad cu las/ bde ba can dang dpal ldan sa skya sogs/ /bshad grwa 'ga' ru legs par thugs skyangs nas/ /dbus gtsang gnyis su dka' bzhi'i grwa skor mdzad/ /zla med mkhas par grags pa'i tsong kha pa/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du bzang ldan du phar phyin gyi grwa skor mdzad/ laga' rong dang ngam ring du grwa skor mdzad/ mar lam jo nang du mkhas pa phyogs las bar dus dngor sbyi1ra drug gi khrid sogs gsan/ sgyi lhas rin po che la bka' gdams lam rim dang] tshos rje rgyan bzang bas glegs bam gsan gsungs/ er grwa skor mdzad/ snar thang du lo chen don bzang la mdzod tshad ma sogs gsan/ gnas rnying du grwa skor dang / nya dngon kun dga' dpal la phar phyin gsan/ zugs tshim/ rtsechen du rje btsun red mda' ba la mdzod mdzub khrid gsan/ phan tshun thugs legs bshad kyi pad+ma dkar pos 'brel bar rgyud nyang stod bsam gling pu rje btsun red mda' bar 'jug pa rtsa'agrel gsan/ po ta lar lesna chen byang 〉phebs par chos 'grel gsan/ skyongar lung du mkhan chen blo gsal la rgya cher 'grel gsan/ bshad srol lhagadang bcas pa rtogs shing /shog gu bcu bdun re rgyun du bzungadtshogs su zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i mnyam bzhag gi ting nge 'odzin brtan 4 byung /brgyad cu las/ 'dul ba'i gzhung lugs gsan me+e 'grel chen gyi bcu bdun tsam re 'chag med 'dzin pa dang skabs su mdo yi zhal 'don mdzad pa'i tshe/ /ting 'dzin rtsol med zhakhrungs pa'i 175
'jigs byed chos 'byung /tsong kha pa/ /zhes gsungs/de dus sku stod bsnyung bag stod lung du khu rgyan bsnyen sgrub la mkhas pa zhig la man ngag gsan kyang ma phan/ dpon slob 'ga' zhig dang bcas ngur smrig gi phu'i la nas gnas rnying la byon/ gnas rnying pa mang pho dang zhabs sgyi rnams kyis gsol ba btab pas mngon pa kun btus kyi chos dngor zog mar bskog dpyid snar thang la brgyud sa skyar byon/ rje btsun red mda' par kun btus gsan/ rnam 'grel la gtso khor sbyangs/ de bzhin du dbu ma 'jug pa dang 'dul ba lung sogs kyi bshad pa gsan/ bla ma rdo rin pa'i drung du brtag gnyis sa lugs kyi bshad pa gsan/ sa skya'i bla brang shar ba'i sngags kyi dge bshes gcig la man ngag blangs te/ bla brang rin chen sgang gi rgyab rir ma nang gi ha 'don pa lan laga' mdzad pas sku stod kyi bsnyung dwangs/ de nas dasan slob rnams kyis la stod byang gi ngam ring du dpyid dang dbyar bzhugs shing red mda' bas kun btus ṭīka chen brtsams/ rnam 'grel rang 'grel yang gsan/ston dus zhakhrungs yul nas 'bul ba bskur ba bzhes/ mal hro lha lung du bla ma bse da grags la sngags kyi thugs sprungad gnangad mtshams bsnams/ rnam 'grel rigs mdzod la gzigs rtog mdzad cing] spyan chabadang ba sbru ldang ba rgyun du byung] dgun bde ba can du bzhugs te po ti mang bo'i gzigs rtog mdzad/ gtsang la byon/ snar thang du phebs/ lo chen don bzang bas mdzad pa'i tshad ṭīka gsan/dbyar chos la snar thang purnam 'grel mngon pa gong 'og 'dul ba mdo rtsabazhi'i grwa skor mdzad/ snar thang du gzhung bsgyur ba'i thog ma'ang de dus byungaka 'o dong du bla ma rje btsun phebs paradabu tshadadang phar pyin 'dul ba'i bshad pa rigs tshogs kyi lung rnams dang/ lo ts+tsha banam bzang la snyanangag sa ris sgra sogs gsan/ 'de nasadabyangs can ma bsgrubs/ rje btsun dang lhan du sa skyar phebs/ poti bcu 〈snags mkhyen kyang rnam 'grel mngon pa gnyis mdo rtsabazhi'i grwa skor mdzad/ dam pa thams cad kyi zugs phrogs/ de 'phral dbus su byon/ sos gung thang du 176
rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshul/bzhugs/ gsang phur dbyangs can ma'i bsnyen pa bye ba lnga song skabs dbyangs can ma'i zhal gzigs/ de nas gsang phur dka' chen bzhi'i grwa skor mdzad pas mkhas pa'i mkhas pa thams cad kyi thugs phrogs/ legs bshad kyi 'od stong spros pas rgol ba'i tshogs nyin byed mdun gyi me khyer lta bur byas/ rtses thang du dka' chen bzhi'i grwa skor mdzad/ legs bshad gdong lnga'i nga ros mkhas mang ri dwags ma lus 'dzigs pa dang ngo mtshar rmad byung du bkod/ snyan pa'i ba dan sa gsum du mi zugang ba tsam mdzad/ brgyad cu las/ rgya 'od mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs thams cad la/ /phyogs ris med par rgyun du sbyangs pa yis/ /rang gzhan grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i mthar sdugan nas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa mdzad pa'i tsong kha pa/ zhes gsungs/ yar klungs su tshogs pa'i mkhan 4 dka' bzhi ba tshul rin pas mkhan 4 dngad byi rdzing mkhan po sher mdon gyis las slob dang/byi rdzing dbu mdzad bsod nams rdo rjes gsang ston mdzad nas dge 'dun nyi shu'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes te lhar bcas 'ju ba'i gtsug rgyan du rgyud gdan se thal du spyan snga grags byang dang mjal/ legs bshad kyi skyes phul zhing bka' mchid mdzad pas/ skun gzhon nu'i dus nas gsung rab thams cad kyi pha mthar phyin pa'i thugs rab la spyan snga rin 4 che ngo mtshar ba dang rmad du byung ba'i zugs dad dang spyan chab chu mig ltar g.yos shing/ de bzhin du rje rin 4 che 'di'i gzhon nu'i dus kyi rnam dpyod kyis dus mnyam gyi mkhas ba mtha' dag khengs pa zum par phyis 'byung gi gzur gnas dpyod ldan thams cad la de ltar 'byung ba'i phyig stag tshang bas kyangan khyod zlo nyi mas gzhon nu'i dus kyi me+e/ /mdo dang rgyan gyi pad tshal rgyas ma'ong nas/ /bdag yid khengs pa'i ku mud lhag par zum/ /zab yangs mkhyen pa'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /lta bur 'o dong 'jigs bral dang / sa bzang lo ts+tsha ba dang / rkarma mi bskyod rdo rje sogs du mas gsungs pa'i sgyid spyan snga rin 4 che la nā ro chos drug/phag gru pa'i bka' 'bum 177
'jigs byed chos 'byung /sesnags dang lam 'bras gsan/ lo chen nam bzang la sgra'i sa ris phal cher gsan/ lha khang ke rur tsha kho dpon 4 sogs lde snod 'dzin pa mang po la phar tshad dbu ma sogs kyi chos gsungs/sgyid shod du phebs/ tshal du bka' bstan bcos bod du 'gyur ro cog la gzigs rtog mdzad/gsung rab mtha' dag la dpyod pa'i go mtha' yas pa zugs la gabrungs/ mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa'grel gyi rnam bshad rgya 'od mtha' dag gi legs bshad kyi 'byung gnas legs bshad gser gyi phreng ba brtsams/ de'i tshe ldongs lenar 'dzin bzang bar grags pa gling mtshungs med dang] mdo smad pa 'jam dpal bkra shis dang / shākya grub gsum dang rje 'dis zugs 'dzin gyi khyad par nyams sad mdzad pas/ tshal dbus gling gi tog gi rtsel nyi ma shar dus rje rin 4 che 'dis sngon ma gzigs pa'i mda' tshad phreng dgu ma'i shog ldeb bzhi shin tu dag pa dang byang bar zin/ gling gis gsum h+pho re ba dang / gzhan gnyis kyis re re zin/ lha sar jo 'o zugs rje chen 4 rang byon lnga ldan gyi mdun du bsnyung gnas mang sodang mnal lam brtags/ dgun tshos bde ba can du byon te sde smod mang du gsungs/ dpyid chos la dbus stod bya yul du phebs/ dge bshes bdun cu glengags la phar tshad 'jug gsum kun btus bzhi gsungs/ slar yang tshal du byon/ legs bshad gser phreng gi 'phyo nas mdzad/ bde ba can du legs bshad gser phreng gi mjug rdzogs par mdzad/ skyor lung du tshal ba mkhas mtshog rtogs ldan ye shes rgyal mtshan la dus gshor gsung bar zhus te/ spyan drangasanas dus lubor 'grel chen gyi bshad padang ri mo sogs la zhib par sbyangs/ der sde snod 'edzin pa mang 4 la gzhung che chung mang po'i bshad pagang gsungs/ de'i pyi lodabyar chos bde ba can du blo gsal rgya mtsho'i tshogs la sde snod kyi bshad pa mang du gnangande nas dgun stod lung mtsho smad du dus gshor la sbyangs shing] bshes gnyen mang po la sde snod kyang gsungs/ ngang dkar du yang dus gshor la sbyangs shing blo gsal mang 4 la sde snod kyang mang 178
rje bla ma yab sras nas brgyud tshugdu gsungs/ de nas rdzong phyi grags rin pas spyan drangs/ srin yor ri phebs/ de dus gong spur sgom pa chos rgyal gyis zhus te/ serdzos rigs lnga lha khang du sde snod 'dzin pa bdun cu lhag tsam la phar tshad mngon pa gong 'og 'dul ba mdo rtsa'ajug pa sogs gsungs/ yar lung smon mkhar du sde snod mang du gsungs/ dbang rjes gnang dang man ngag kyang ci rigs 'di dus bshad/ de nas mon mkhar bkra shis gdong du sde snod 'dzin pa brgya sogs la po ti bcu bdun chos thog gcig la bshad pas thun mong gi rnam thar la ches cher mkhas pa rnams kyis gling ba don la gnas sesna/ /de'i dbyar yar lung tshesna spur brag tu bde mtshog la mtshams bsnams/ bzlas sgom dang bdag 'jug mdzad/ ni gu chos drug dang rlung rgyur brgyad brgya re thun re la mdzad cing nyams myong bzang 4 zhakhrungs/ de'i ston skyid shod po ta lar chos kyi bgro ba mang yo dang/ gdul bya rnams la legs bshad gnang / de'i dgun skyor lung brag tu sde snod 'dzin pa du ma la dus gsor dang phar tshad sogs mang du gsungs/ de'i dpyid rte) pho la rgyud lde chen po rnams gsan bzhed nas paXr+sha spri shāX gh+nā (lha dwo r+shaX ༈ bli ṭ+wāṃ rnyi ༈ s+t+ra tsho ga ༵ hūm̐ ༵ /shā shā ༵༵ sna pashā (pa āX zhus shing khong la 'jam dbyangs kyi snang ba yod pa la dpyad dgos gsungs nas/ rje rin po ches lajam dbyangs la dri ba'i lo ts+tsha dbu ma pas byas nas dri gtugs dang / dbyad pa mang du mdzad pas shugs yid ches nges skyes/ ze tshom mi dgos par 'dug /kho bos kyang slad nas 'jam dbyangs chos skor zhu dgos zhes snyan gsan phabs/ brgyad cu las/ dbu ma pa yis par du mtshams sbyar te/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la dri ba zhus pa yis/ /shin tu rtogs dka'i zab pa'i gnad rnams kyi/ /ze tshom dra ba chod pa'i tsong kha pa/ /zhes gsungs/ de nas stag tshang rdzong khor byon/ lo chen skyabs mtshog gis sbyin bdag mdzad nas lo chen grags rgyan dang] rje btsun dang/179
'jigs byedachos 'byung /lo chen don bzang dang] rje 'di ba bzhi rjes 'brang dang bcas pas lhan cig bshad pa dang bka' mchid kyis dus mda' bar mdzad de/ de'i tshe grags rgyan gyis phar phyin dang / skyabs mchog gis brtag gnyis/ rje btsun gyis rnam 'grel 'grel bshad rang gis mdzad pa rje 'di la gsungs/'ba'u 'ba' gnyer du/ rje btsun red mda' bar rje 'dis gsang 'dus rtsargyud kyi bshad pa gsan/ de dus gong gsum bde chen pas bu ston la 'grel chen tshar bcu bdun nyan pa'i lung bstan rmis shing phyis mthun/ de nas rje 'di rong chos lung du byon/ rje 'dis dris/ bla ma dbu ma pas lo ts+tsha mdzad nas rje btsun 'jam dbyangs chos skor gsan/ chos kyi dri ba mang du zhus/ nyang stong du 'grel chen bu ston rin 4 che la tshar bcu bdun gsan pa'i rin 4 che bde chen pa'i drung du mjal/ phyag phyis dar ser 4 zhig phul/ sang nyin ja zhal dang gos yug ljang khu gcig phul/'grel chen rdzogs pa gcig zhus pas rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa dang phyag len mdzub khrid dang bh+yor drug gi nyams khrid rdzogs par gsan/ de nas nyang stod smad kyi mtshams nyakhris mkhang du/yog pa mgon bzang las/ rje 'dis gar dang dbyangs dang thig sogs mkhas par sbyangs/ de dus nub gcig khyung lhas pas rin 4 che'i dbu rgyan dang / rdo dril bzung ba'i gar gyis rje la bskor ba mdzad nas/ rdo dril dbur bzhag nas rkarma badz+ra gsungs pa 'is/ dpyid mjug nyang stod sde chen du/ rin 4 che chos dpal la rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang dang lung mdzub khrid dang / bshad pa gar thig dbyangs gsum se gas kyi sgo nas phreng ba skor gsum la mkhas par byas/ lha'or chen gyidabang dang lung man ngag sesnags zab rgyas mang du gsan/ zhwa lur khri chen 4 zhig gi steng nas bla ma bsgras po'i thugs dar sngags zeng pyi nang mang po yod pa rmis/ ston dgun zhwa lur/rin 4 che khung lhas par yo ga'i dkyil gsor bcu gnyis sogs dang / bde gsang bya spyod kyi dbang bka' mtha' dag gsan cing 'bul ba tshogs gshor gyis mnyes par byas/ pa nam phag 180
rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyudatshugrig rin 4 che chos dpal la byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa skor gsum/ bu'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs dang] yo ga pa rgyal mtshan grags pa la yo ga'i garadabyangs sogasadang] yo ga'i rgyud dang 'grel pa kun gsan/ 'jag chen byams pa dpal la mgon 4 shangs lugs kyi skor kun gsan pa zungags mdo sngags mtha' dag gsan pa yin te/ brgyad cu las/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma du ma la/ /yongs su dag pa'i brgyud pa thams cad kyi/ /dbang lung gzhung bshad man ngag phal mo che/ /zung zugar gtugs nas gsan pa'i tsong kha pa/ /zhes gsungs dren/ /sprel lo'i ston bla ma dbu ma pa dang lhan cigadabus kyidaga' ba gdong du phebs/ ltasar ngo 4 la ga〈snal ba btab/dpon slob gnyis gas mtshams bcad/ gzims khang so sor byas/ gsol ja lhan tu bzhes/ bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med la gsol ba btab/nyin gcig baishār+ya'i mdog zlum po'i mtha' 'ja' tshon sna lngas sbrel ba'i dbus na rje btsun 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na blta bas tshog mi shes pa mthongaka 'di nas brtsams gsol ba btab res kyis dngos su mjal/ de nas rje 'dis rje btsun ḍā rnyi tshormo deX /r+sha dṛ zloshā (pa rnyi( shāshā 〉pa hāshālañtsha/ nga hāshā /3sna r+shasdu/ /dīpa /pa/ dngos su bstan te/ dbu ma bas lo ts+tsha mdzad cing / rje btsun rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur nas chos skyong la bka' gnang bas/ chos skyong gis kyang bka' sdod gnang ba gzigs/ 'dinas rje btsun gyi bka' bzhin 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad dang lhan cig ri khrod du phebs par thag bcad/dbu ma ba lha sar bskyal/ lha sa'i thog steng ma'i lho'i rgya phibs kyi 'og tu mchod nas gsol ba gh+nā /lha ༵/nga dzā spri (dri dris ༵༵ smi ga m+p+raṃ paX/ pa|pa /ga(༷ hā spra ༵ r+sha dzo /lha par spya sa'i/lha khang steng du rje 'dis bla ma dbu ma pa la gsang 'dus kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs par gnang / ston 181
'jigasabyed chos 'byung /mjug skyor lung du chos mang du gsungs/ dgun sbrel lo sum cu rtsadrug pa'i zla ba bcu bar skyor lung du lhargaradag pa rnam brgyadadangadagus gzhung zho mdzad nas 'ol khar bya bral la byon/dgun dpyidadapon slob thams cad kyis sangs rgyas rtso lnga'i sgo nas bsag sbyangs la 'bad res kyis/rje 'dis sangs rgyas so lnga'i zhal yang yang gzigs/ rje btsun byams pa rin po che'i rgyan dang chos 'chad me rtog gi sdong bu bsnams pa/ rin po che'i khri la skyil krung can shin tu che ba/ sman bla bla gos ser po can dang / byams pa rab byung cha byad snam sbyar gsol ba klu shing sdong 4 ril ba sgyi blugs kyis mtshan pa 'odzin pa dang/ tshe dpag med rnams yang yang gzigs/ de dus gnas der bsag sbyang dang sangs rgyas phal po che'i nang gi rgyal ba sras bcas kyi spyod pa thams cad la myong ba rnam dag glang chen pad mtshor sbyo ba lta bu skyes kyi bar du spyangs/ de dus kyang 'angam dbyangs/ sangs rgyas so lnga/ byams pa/ sman bla/ tshe dpag med rnams gzigs/ de dus bshad na snyam du dgongs pa la rje btsun gyis/ dmu rgod 'duladaka'i sems can 'di rnams la/ /bshad pas phan thogs chen 4 ga la zhig /de bas dbe+en pa bsten nas rtsegacig sgrubs/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'tsheng ba'i lam rnyed snyam///zhes gsungs/de nas so bdun pa'i dbyar rdzing phyi'i byams pa dang mjal/ mchod pa dang smon lam rlabs chen mdzad/de nas dgun dwags po sman lungaka rgya sog phur phebs/ thugs dam 'phel skabs/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog can nyi ma bye ba las gzi bajid che ba gcig la sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med kyis mtha' ba〈snar ba nam mkha'i khams khyab pa gzigs/ yang rje btsun la 'phags pa yab sras lnga/zogs med sku mched/ phyogs glang/ chos grags/ mchog gnyis/ lha dbang blo/ rgyan mkhan po/ka ma la shī la/ a lhal zungags paṇ+ḍi ta du mdang/ in+d+ra bodhi/ sa ra ha/ lū dril nag gsum zugags grub chen brgyad cus bskor ba'i snang ba byung / 'di dag gi gzhung la brten nas phan pa rgya chen 182
rje bla mayab sras nas brgyud tshug'byung ba'i rten 'brel 'grig/brgyad cu las/ rgya sog phu ru rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang / /grub chen du mas bskor ba gzigs pa yis/ /legs tshogs rten 'brel 'grig pa'i tsong kha pa//zhes sesna/ /denasalang gnasader bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs bskal ba'i me 'bar ba ltabu'i gzi brdzid bzod par dka' ba gcig gzigs te 'od du zhu nas thim tshul gcig byung / 'di ni byin rlabs nye brgyud lha'i dbang bskur mchog gi de 'dra la mkhas pa rnams bzhedado/ /denas 'jigs byed bdag 'jug ma chag par gnang] 'di la lung bstan sogs kyang yod/ brgyad cu las/ gnas der bzod par dka' ba'i gzi bajid can/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag rdzogs pa'i sku/ /zhal gzigs phyin chad nam yang 'chag med du/ /lam dus dbang bzhi nod pa'i tsong kha pa/ /zhes so/ /gnas der rdo bcal du sgyin sreg mdzad pa gangs chen 4 babs kyang nye gangor du cung zad kyang ma babs pa kun gyis mthong/ yang gnasaderade rjes su rje btsun gyi sku sngar ltabu la sangs rgyas byang sems paṇa grub mkha' khyab kyis bskor ba'i rje btsun gyi zugs ka nas ral gri'i yu lha s+tha zlo rgyu/ ṇā shā shā paspra ༵༷ shāX ༷༷ ༵ dhī r+shasprid m+p+raṃ shā pa/ ṭā /lha ṭ+wāṃ stasgyu ༵༵ ༵ (rdzu pa rgyas/ de dus ngo mkhyen mi mkhyen mtha' yas pa zhig kha gdangs pa'i khar mang du 'gro ba dang/cung zad 'gro ba mang 4 dang/ mi 'gro ba yang gzigs pas/ rje'i gsung las/ ka ta ras krong khyer du/ /skyed mo'i tshal ni rnam par rgyas/ /bung ba mang po de la rol/ /bdud rtsimachog kyang 'thung bar snang] /zhes brda tsam lung bstan du mdzadado/ /desan mang po zhes gsungs pas lam bskyed rdzogs dang] bde stong gi ting nge 'odzin rnyed pa bzhugs dus dang / phyis kyi mang 4 'byung ba dang]mchog kyang 'thung zhes pas mtshog gi dngos grub brnyes pa yang re mang 'ong ba'i gsungadangam kha 183
'jigs byed chos 'byung/gdangs pa ni lam rim gnyis dang bde stong la brtson pa dang/ ma thob padag kyang rmad byung bkod par thob ba'i rten 'brel gyi lung bstan yin tshul/ mkhas grub kyi rnam thar gzigs pa lnga ldan las/ mdo sngags kyi lam rim la 'bad pa dang smon lam rtsegacig byas pa der skye bar bshad pa lta bu ches mang ba go ba gal che lte/tsong kha brgyad cu las/de dus mkhyen dang mi mkhyen skye dgu'i tshogs/ /bdud rtsi 'dod pa dpag med snang ba las/ 'ga' yis ma thob la las cung zhig myong / /phal cher tshim par gzigs pa'i tsong kha pa/ /zhes gsungs pa'i skye dgu'i tshogs dang dpag med snang ba zhes pas shin tu mang bar bstan cing] phal cher tshim par zhes pas mang bos dngos grub 'ogab par bshad pa yin te/ gsang ba'i bdag pos/ dga' ldan la bsnyad pa'i ming thogs/ khyed rang bzhugs padang 'dra ba'i rten 'grelaskumad/de'idon gyis khyed rang gi gdul bya'i zhing du 'gyur ba dang / gron gyi smon lam gyi 'phen pa yod pa rnams la/ mdo sngags kyi gnad ma 'chug par go nas grol ba thob pa'i dgos pa khag che lags/ zhes dang / lab sgron lung bstan las/dge slong de dang thug pa'i sems can gangadagadamu rgod bod du bstan mthar skyes kyang don chen 'grub pa yin no/ /zhes dang / mdo sde gdams ngag 'a'ogs pa las/ de la dad byed zhing der skye/ /zhing mchog de ni khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dang / 'jamadapal rtsargyud las/ dang sar yi ger grags pa/ /nas/ srid pa gsum gyi mthar yang byed/ /sngags dang rgyud la mngon brtson pa'i/ /grags pa 'dzin par shes par sga /zhes dang / lab sgron gyi lung bstan las/ khyad par bstan pa gsal byed dge slong mchog/mtha' yas rgyud sde'i tshogs la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa'i bcud phyung nas/ /dri med gsung gi 'od zer rab tu rgyas pa yis/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rmongs pa'i mun pa sel bar byed/ /bslab gsum sde snod gsum sogs gzhung lugs rnams//lhag par gsal bar byed cingadon rnams mngon gyur nas/ /gdul 184
rje tham yab sras nasabargyud tshul/byar gyur pa'i skal ba ldan rnams tshim par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltabu shin tu mang ngos /kha cig de ltar ma shes par lubrul ba'i lam du nyakhyams pa smras so/ /gnas der de 'dra'i gzigs snang dang mngon par rtogs pa dpag med zhakhrungs/ yang gnas der tsho 'phrul gyi zhag bco lnga'i ring mchod pa rgya chen bo bshams te/ mchod yul spyan 'dren pa'i 'dun pa shugs drag mdzad pa'i tshe/shar phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam snang gi rnam pas til gyi gang bu ltar gang bar gzigs/ de bzhin du lto phyogs rin 'byung / nub phyogs 'od dpag med/ byang phyogasadon grub/ dbus kyi steng du mi bskyod pas sngar ltar gang bar gzigs nas mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul/ zhag bco lnga'i ring spyod lam dus su'ang gzigs par gyur to/ /dpyid 'ol kha rdzing phyir phebs/ rje btsun gyis zhig gsos kyis gsung] dpon slob bcu gnyis kyi phyag rdzas gtor cha sesnags gang 〈snad la rin btab pas zho bcu gnyis las ma byung / rnam sras la 'phrin las bcol bar dgongs kyang mar med pas/ btsun pa zhig gis mar zod pa gang phul/ sang nyid 'gyog pas mar thud mang 4 phul cingaka de nas 'bul ba mang du byung1 skabs gzhan gyi tshe yang 'phrin las brtsol bas de 'dra sha ltag byung / rtsig zhal grub 'phral 'jam dbyangs zhing bkod kyi skya ris btab pag rab gnas mdzad pas ye shes pa thim pa'i snang ba byungasga mar me chung ngu zhig phul/nyin zhag phyed gsum bzung/ thams cad grubanas 'jamadapal gsang ldan gyidakyil pongor bzhengs/ rab gnas rgyas pa'i sgo nas slob ma bcu lhag ladabang yang gnang/rten rnams la gos dar gyi na bza' snyan shal/ logs bris zhal khebs/ rab ston dang bcas rgyas par mdzad pa'i dngos gzhi'i nyin nyi ma tshad las lhag par thams cad gling/ yang sangs rgyas so lnga'i sku 'bri bar brtsams pas/ sku mdog sogs lha bzos ma shes par zhus pas/ rje rang gis gsol ba btab pas/ zhal gzigs gnang rim bzhin 'de 'dra'i sku mdog gyis zhes bkod nas bris/ de'i tshe 185
'jigasabyed chos 'byung /grub chen phyag rdor gyis sangs rgyas rtso lnga phebs pa/ gar 'gyon zhus pas/ rdzing phyi'i rab gnas la 'byon gsungs pa'i tshes grangs kyang mthun par 'dug/kha cig gis mkha' 'phyos ri mo byed pa 'i lam du mthong] de dus rje btsun byams pa'i bstod pa rin chen sgron me zhes bya ba byams par phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyisadabang bskur tshul gyi bstod pa dang] bde smon dang/ rang nyid kyi ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di 'dra 'grub pa'i smon lam gyis gsungs nas/ de gsum brtsams/ mkhan chen phyag rdor pa la phyag na rdo rjes lung bstan pa bzhin rje spyan 'dren gyi chab shog gis mtshams sbyar nas lho brag tu phebs par mdzad/ bra'o dgon par phyag phebs/ der mkhan chen phyag rdor ba yang bsu ba la byon pas/ rjes gsang bdag gtum po 'jigs pa gcig tu gzigs/ mkhan chen gyis rje 'de ba 'od kyi dra bas mdzes pa'i 'jam dbyangs gcig bzhengs nas phebs par gzigs shing / me tog gi char dang lan+da' 'od kyi gur phyogs kun khyab par gyugde nub mkhan chen pa la bla ma'i rnal 'byor gcig gsan pas phyag rdor rje la thim par gnyis das gzigs/ h+pho rangs gsang bdag gis mkhan chen la/ byams pa la bslab btus zhus gsung / rje la bslab btus gsung dgos zhus pas/ gsang bdag gsung ngam gsungs nas mkhan chen dang dge 'dun thams cad la gsungs/ rin po che la grwa lnga'i dbang rjes gnang sogs dang / rje nyid kyis mkhan chen la lam rim bka' babs gnyis kyi khrid dang / phyag rdor khyung lnga/gshor chen sogs snyan brgyud kyi dbang gsan nas dngos su de dag gzigs shing byin gyis brlabs pasadagung lo zhe lnga'i sku gegs chen 4 yod pa dngor chen gyi sgonas bzlog par mdzad pa serdzogs sku drin cha gsung / rgya gar du mi tra rtswa gi mjal bar phebs par dgongs pas/ mkhan chen la phyag rdor gyis rje phebs na ngo mtshar kyang dngor la gnod pa dang / de bas rdzing phyi'i rje btsun byams par rab byung gi rtags tshang ma dang bstod pa tshangs pa'i cod pan zhes pa phul na 186
rjebla ma yab sras nas brgyud tshul/rten 'brel yod gsungs tshul dang / rje la rje btsun gyis de ltar byas na dus phyis rab byung gi sde rnam par dag pa tshugs pa'i rten 'brel yod pas phul/ rgya gar la pyin na bgegs sngar ltar gsungs pas/ chos gos gsum/ gsil byed/ lhung bzed/ gding ba/ chu tshags sogs dngakabstod pa tshangs pa'i cod pan ma rdzing phyi'i byams par bskur te gnyal du byon/ de nas gnyal lo ror zla ba lngar bzhugs/ dge bshes zo lung ba'i bsnyan rim chen mo spyan drangs te/ bsu ba mdzad/ mchod pa phul te gzigs pas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo sngags yod do cog gang zag gcig gi lam du da lta so skye'i dus nas nyams su len tshul dang / lam gyi ngo 'o grangs nges go rim rnams shing rta chen po gnyis ltar thugs nges cher nyakhungs/ der bstan rim tshar gcig gsungs/ gnyal bra gor du mkhan chen chos skyabs bzang 4 la 'dul mngon dbu ma sogs lung dang] shar ba'i lam rim/ be+e bum sngon po rtsa'agrel/ spyod 'jug blo spyong sogs bka' gdams gzhung pa'i mdo sngags kyi gdams ngag mang 4 rdzogs par gsan/ gnyal smad gsal rje gangs kyi yar 'dren du dbyar gcig rje btsun gyi zhal gzigs/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta gcig gi gzhung la brten nas dbu ma'i lta ba rtogs par lung bstan/ rgyal chen rnam sras zhal gzigs par yang bshad do/ /de nas dpon slob sum cu tsa ri ma chen la byon/ ri khrod gzigs shing / bde mchog gi bdag 'jug sogs mdzad/ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung/ tsa ri nas gnyal du byon pa'i mo la'i la rtsar zhag bzhugs dus/ rje btsun byams mgon gyi sku shin tu che ba lhun po ltar bajid cing 'bar ba zhig gis/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis sangs rgyas 'dzig rten du byon pa 'dra ba zhig 'ong bar shes par byos shag ces seṅge'i sgras dbugs dbyung ba ni/ gsang bdag gis mkhan chen la sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa 'dra ba'i ring lugs 'ong / zhes dang / lab sgron gyis/ sangs rgyas wa ra ñtsha sir phebs nas chos ga'or bskor ba lta bu 'ong par gsungs pa rnams mthun zhing /187
'jigs byed chos 'byung /de ni rang bzhin brjod pa kho nar byung / gnyal smad seng ge'i rdzong du rgyun du bh+yor drug sogs la dbyad pas mi zhakhrul ba'inges pa rnyed cing rdo rje'i tshig sbram mdzad/ dus lubor dpa' cig gser gyi mdog can gyi gzigs snang nang mar byung zhing/ nub gcig mnal lam pu khyod kyis dus skya lubor lo 'di la rgyal po zla ba bzang 4 'dra ba gcig 'ong ba yod do/ /zhes gsungs dren/ /gnyal smad du bzhugs dus dbyangs can ma'i gsung gis/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsabadun thub/ de bar rang gzhan gyidon dpag med 'grub gsung bad rjes rnam par rgyal ma sogs la bsnyen pas de las ring mi zub bam zhus pas/ de thams cad sngon gyi smon lam gyi shugs dang] shes rab la 'dun pas sku tshe la de tsam ma phan gsung / rtogs ldan pas 'jam dbyangs la dris pas/ da phan chad bar chad bzlog thabs dang sku che'i rten 'brel bsgrig na dka' se ba la zlog nus gsung ngo] /gnyal smad seng ge rdzong der bzhugs dus rje btsun gyi zhal gzigs khyad par can byung nas lam gyi ngo bo grangs nges/ khyad par zhi lhag gi gnad rnams zhus pas/ da nged la yang yang 'dri mi dgos/ gzhung chen 4 rnams la zhib par dpyod/ nged kyi bstan pa dang mthun pa sha stag 'ongakami mthun pa re tsam byung na 'dor spus gdams ngag tu 'dod pa rnams la 'bab kyi gzhung chen 4 rnams 'dor du mi rung ngo /zhes gsungs/ da phyin chad sgo gsum gyi mdzad pa thams cad gzhan don kho nar gyis gsungs nasade bzhin mdzad/ de nas gnyal smad gser phye 'bum pa la mchod pa rgya chen po phul/ rje btsun gyis gsungs nas rab byung gi rtags yongs rdzogs rung chu 'debs pa yan chad/ phyag len phra mo rnams nas kyis gsung / rjes dus kyi dbang gis bsgrub pa dkaggzhan gyi bloror mi ldan pa'i rgyu mtshan nan cher zhus na'ang] rje btsun gyis mi gsan par gyis gsungs nas/ dpon slob thams cad kyis chos gos gsum gding ba sogs dras drub dang lhung bzed sogs 'chang ba mdzad pas/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i snyan pas sa kun khyab cing] denas bzung 188
rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshul/ste cha lugs phun sum tshogs pas sa thams cad gang bar gyur to/ /de nas dpyid gnyal gyi spang chung du bzhugs/ dge 'dun mang por chos sna tshogasadang/ grong pa'i skye 'odapag med skyabs 'go /sna /ba/sna dwo /lha dz+nyo /sdu t+na nalha r+shar+sha zloshā dī ༵ ((dri pa( /pa pa( pa~X ༵ shu bo rigs ldan pad dkar gyi rnam 'phrul rgyal tshab rin po ches de dus mjal/ rnam 'grel gyi lam bsgrigs dngor la gsungs pa gsan pas zugasadad cher 'khrungs/ zhal bzhugs kyi bar du mi 'bral bar zhabs sgyi sar blangs chog par phyag byas te bshum nas zhus pas gnang ba byin/de nas gnyal sde bzhi 'dus pa'i chos gsar gnyal lung ra chen por grags pa btsugs shing /phyis kyang bsgrub par gnang bas deng sang bar du dar bar yod/ de ltar gnyal phyogs kyi bstan don mdzad nas/'ode gung rgyal gyi lngazhol dwags po masdings su bzhugs/ chos mang du gsungs/gram dang yidam dbyer med la ga〈snal ba drag tu btab pas nub cig/'phags pa yab sras lngas rang bzhin 'dzid med la bgro ba mdzad pa'i nang nas sangs rgyas bskyangs yin zer ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta gro bsangs sku bong che ba gcig dbu sngas la byon nas rgya dpe zhig phyag na bzung nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma 'is/ phyi nyin bud+dha pa li ta gzigs pas thal rang gi dgag bya'i khyad rtsogs langes pa rnyed/ mtshan 'dzin gyi dmigs gtad thams cad zhig cing ston pa la shes nas dad pa zob pa'i shugs kyis rten 'brel bstod pa mdzad/ phyin chad rjes 'jug dag gis kyang 'grel pa der gzigs na rten 'brel yod gsung ngo / /de nas ston 'ol kha'i 'gar phug tu byon/'ol kha'i dge 'dun rnams la chos gsungs/ de nas g.ye'i te'u rar byon/ dbyar bzhugs/g.ye'idage 'dun rnams la chos mang du gsungs/ denas 'ol kha'i brag gdong dudagun bzhugs/de nas rdzing phyi'i jo 4 la cho 'phrul gyi dus mchod la dgongs nas zhag bco lnga'i ring mchod pa 189

rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshugpar can myur du zhakhrungs shing/ slob ma skal ldan bdun la yang lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par can re skye bar 'gyur gsungs/ rjes nged khams ma snyoms pas rtogs ldan pa la dris gsungasanas dris pas/rtogs ldan pas rje'i zugs rgyud la bde stong gi ye shes zhabrungs tshag phyi'i rkyen zhing skyes kyi pho nya rnams kyis kyang grogs mdzad/ lhag pa'i lhas kyang byin gyis slobs pa'i rgyu tshogs rnams tshang zhing / lam de myur du zhakhrungs zhes rje btsun gyis gsungs/ de'i tshul yang rtogs ldan pas mnal lam pu rje'i mchod rten yin zer ba'i dkar yol gyi mdog ltabu phyag tshad shin tu rdzogs pa nor bu rin po che'itog can/ rtsosprin gseb mthon por sleb pa la mkha' 'gro ma mang 4 rin 4 che'i dbu rgyan can rnams kyis/ rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsidakar pos bkang ba dpag med kyis khras gsol ba dang] de'i mthar 'bum pa mang 4 'dug cing / byang na mchod rten de'i seng khri dang mnyam pa bdun la khus gsol ba dang / mchod rten gcig gi go sa 'dug par bdud migasol zer bar da lta ma byung ba zeg 'bum pa rnams gsol zer bad da dung mi gsol/'di dag 'chos dgos pas bcos nas gsol zer ba rmis/ rje btsun la rmi lam 'di zhus pas sngar ltar gsungs so/ /sgrub mchod sogs 'du khang du byas na dbang ma zob pas dkyil na'or mthong ba'i dgag bya che bas sngags kyi sgrub khang lagolang gcig dgos gsungs nas/ lug lor yangs pa can gyi rmang btings/ khyams gtsang khang dang bcas par ka ba don gnyis ma'i gtsang khang du/ ston pa'i sku dzo bo'i tshad las che ba thub pa tshul khrims mar grags pa'i byin rlabs can dang] gzhan yang byams tshe 'jigs 'jam bzhi'i gser sku dang / rgyu dar 'dag gi 'jigs byed mtho bcu bdun pa bzhengs pa'i mazhal rang byon dang / thugs dar drod lcog sgong tsam pa dang /steng gi gtsang khang du/ dpal gsang 'dus lha so gnyis kyi blos bslangs/ gshor lo bde mchog lū i pa drug cu re gnyis kyi blos bslangs/ dpal rdor dbyings kyi dkyil gsor chen po'i blos 203
