rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshul/ngag rgyun du grags che ba da lta'i bar du yod pa bden par mngon/ 7do'i don gyi nyams len cher ma byung yang phyag len ma nyams par byas pa byin rlabs shin tu myur ba de yin te/ sngon smon lam gnang dus sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab par bshad pas so/ /gtsug lag khang rten bcas bya lor grub nas bya lo'i nang du rgyud sde dang mthun par rab gnas rgyas par mdzad pa'i nyin/ nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dkyil nas sgra chen po 'brug tsam zhig mchod khang du thim pa kun gyis zos shing / de dus bde gsang gi rim lnga'i rnal 'gyor pa 'ga' zhig gis/ rdo rje 'dzigs byed nam mkha' gang ba tsam phyogs bzhi nas byung nas lder sku la thim pa gzigs gsungs/de'i don gyis yul kun tu bkra shis par gyur to/ /khyi'i lo la sde snod 'dzin pa brgya phrag du ma phyogs tha dad nas byon pa dang gnyug ma'i dge 'dun dang bcas paradaga' ldan nyid ma chos kyi dngor lo rgyun mi 'chad par bskor zhing gsang 'dus 'grel pa bzhi sbragasadang/ bshad rgyud 'ga' zhig dang / rim lnga'i khrid rgyas pa/ dus lubor sbyongar drug gi khrid rgyas pa/ dus 'khor 'grel chen gyi bshad pa zhib mo dang / gzhan yang dbu tshad/ bde mchog lam rim sogs gsungs/ de'i dbyar dang ston la yangs pa can gyi khyams kyi logs bris kyang grub/ 'jug pa'i rnam bshad brtsams shing gsungs/ brgyad cu las/ stobs ldan phyag drug pa dang phyag bzhi pa/ /gur gyi mgon 4 rnam thos sras la setshags/ /bstan srung du mas rang rang gzugs bstan nas/ /'phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pa'i tsong kha pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khyi lo'i dgun nam re gnyis pa'i dgun smad cig /chos skyong 'di rnams la'ang gtor ma 'bul dus dbyangs kyi nga ro dang bcas na shin tu dgyes par 'dug pas 'di bzhin byed pa yin gsungs nas/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal 4 spyan 'drin dngad bstod cing bskul ba sogs kyi dbyangs bzhi mdzad/ de dus nub gcig 'ga' zhig gi mnal lam du/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i sku bajid cing che ba zhig pha tshad nas byon nas 205
'jigs byed chos 'byung /bstod pa'i dbyangs 'di ltar gyis la then cig gsungs nas/ kho rang gis 'phen gyin 'dug pas sa dang ri bo thams cad bar re re 'ong pa gcig rmis 'dug/gzhan yang de 'dra'i rmis ltas laga' re la byung / des na bstod pa'i dbyangs 'di la gshin rje'i ngar dbyangs sam gshan rje'i then dbyangs zer ba'ang don 'di 'dra yin snyam/ de nas dbyangs slob pa rnams la gtor ma ma bshams bar du dbyangs bya mi rung par 'dug pas ma byed gsungs/ skabs shig de'i rgyu mtshan ci zhig mchis zhus pas/ legs bzang bas mdzad pa'i gsang pa'i rnam thar las/ de'i rgyu mtshan ṭ+wāṃ k+ṣiṃ lhan: rnyi dā ṇ+ḍa/ go/ ༷ ༵ ༵ rnyilha spra ((nā ñtsā spyana~X tāchi kau ṭ+wāṃ ༵ /spri pa/ pa/ nas gus pa rnams la lhag par 'go/rje la zhabs drung na zhakhod pa gang rung re'i gzugs su sprul nas snyan drung du shib shib kyi zhal ta zhus pa'i rnam pa mang 4 'ongs/ gzims khang du phar 'gro tshur 'gro dang sku mdun sogs su bya byed mang po byed pa gzims khang na 'khod pa gzhan gyis /mi shāt+ta~X dzhai/da /hā / pa ༵ /pa lha sh+lau zhi r+sha k+to r+sha dī sngu kāXn r+sha ga~X shā lha/nga za~X kying ro byas pa'i me+e dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur sogs ston gyin 'dug gsung ngo / /zhes dang/ brgyad cu las kyang/ khyad par du yang las kyi gshin rje yis/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyis du ma'i gtam sbyoX k+ṇi dī / shā/ sa ga〉nga ji( rno :sna pa~X dā sbyo/ )pa kau da/ tsho/ ṭ+wāṃ /sna ༵/ sna ga peṃ ( rdzu (shā gsang 'dus rtsargyud dang] 'grel ba sgron gsal par du brkos grub/ phag lo la dbus gtsang gi sde snod 'odzin pa che dgu mtha' yas 'dus/ dpyid dang dbyar du gshor lo bde mtshog gi rgyud sogs chos gagar bskor zhing/ bde mchog rtsargyud kyi ṭīk+ka mdzad/ kun la gsungs shing 'dzin 206
rje bla ma yab sras nas brgyud tshul/chos kyang ṭīk+ka mda' tshad zeng dgu pa re btang ba'i skyor dpon lajam dbyangs chos rjes mdzad cingad byams chen chos rje'ang ngo mtshar bar gsungs/ phag lo'i ston stod lung gi chu tshan sku la 'phyod par 'ga' zhig gis zhus pa'i rkyen dngad gtso 'or jo 'o rin po che'i drung du sku de'i phyag tha ma dang] sku dedangos kyi gdul bya'i skye ṭo mang po zhig gidon mdzad par dgongs pa dang/ sngar nas smin par mdzad pa'i gdul bya mtha' yas pa rnams la legs par bshad pa'i gsung gi tha ma stsol par bzhed pas dga' ldan nas phyag bteg /lha sar jo 'o la mchod pa dang smon lam mtha' yas mdzad cing stod lung du phebs/ de'i tshe nang pa so sos gdan drangs pa phal cher la phebs shing chab tshan khar phebs te zhabs la cung zad bdug par mdzad/ stod lung phu mda'i skye bo'i tshogs mtha' yas pa dag la chos dang byin rlabs kyi skyes gnangaka ngag rgyun ltar na chu mig lung gi chos grwa la gsang 'dus kyi lhatshogs thim pa gzigs nas rgyud grwa 'byung bar lung bstan par grags pa yang bden par mngon/ thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur ba dngaka gsung thos pa dang]zhal mthong ba tsam gyis kyang don dang ldan par mdzad do/ /tshur phebs dus 'do li la bzhugs nas 'bras spungs su phebs pa'i tshe/ 'do li'i sna la 'ja' kha dog sna lnga thal byung du zug/gnas rnying pa'i rnam thar pu 'bras snangs sngags khang gi rten rnams la rab gnas mdzad pas ye shes pa spyan 'drin gyi dus su sa g.yos shing 'ur tshom gyi sgra chen po thams cad kyis mngon sum du rig pa'i zil chen podang bcas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mgon bo phyag drug pa dgor bcas/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po yab yum nyakhor bcas kyi ye shes pa rnams dngos su bcug par mdzad cingad brtan bzhugs rgyas pa/ yon bdag bsgo ba/ gser gyi gta' gtor 'ga' ba/ zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg tshar mang po dang bcas pa mdzad ces gsungs pa/ rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar rgyal ba gong mas mdzad pa ltar na 'dzigs byed 'dag par ljags 207
'jigs byed chos 'byung /chab dang bcas bzhengs par yang mdzad par gsungs pa ltar yin la/ rwa lo'i gdung yod par 'jigs byed chos 'byung las bshad do/ /'bras spungs su bshes gnyen sde snod 'dzin pa nyis stong tsam la lam rim gyi khrid/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ ṭ+wā ro chos drug /gsang 'dus rgyud sogs gsungs shing/ de'i dus su chos grwa'i dbus su/ 'ja' kha dog sna lnga thal byung du yang yang zug pa dngaka nam mkha'i dbyings mthon po nas lha'i pho nya lta bu'i sprin dga' ldan du yang yang babs so/ /de'i tshe nyin gcig dga' ldan phyogs la gzigs pa gcig mdzad/ gsang 'dus le'u dgu pa'i skabs la chos mtshams mdzad/ thams cad kyis rgyud dang lam rim gyi tha na lung tsam zhus kyang ma gsan par kha sang nas 'phen pa song zin/ da lan myur du bteg na thams cad la dga' bas 'degs gsungs te/ da dung sngags dang mtshan nyid kyi bshad rgyun rdzogs pa med par ring du gnas pa'i rten 'brel du mdzad do/ /lha sar phebs/ dzo 'o rin po che'i drung du phyag mchod smon lam rgya cher mdzad de/bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i rten 'brel mdzad/de nas se rar byams chen chos rjes spyan drangs te se ra chos sdings su sngags kyi rgyud sde la 'chad nyam rnam par dag pa 'od 'der cher ma dar la/ rje rang gis bshad pa rnam par dag pa mdzad pa'i bdud rtsimyangs pa yod kyang rgyud kyi 'chad nyan rkang tshugs pa'i grwa sa things pa med par dgongs nas rgyud kyi 'chad nyan rnam par dag pa gcig tshugs na ci ma rung snyam pas/ byams chen chos rje la zhal ta gnang nas chos rjes de'i mthun rkyen kyi gas so sor gnang zhing/ gzhi 'dul ba'i bslab khrims rnam dag la brten nas dpal gsang 'dusadang bde mchog ②rgyud kyi 'chad nyad tshugs pa'i rten 'brel du se ra chos sdings su gso lhong mdzad/ rgyud kyi rgyal 4 gnyis kyidabu nas chos thun re gsungs shing]de'i tshe chos grwa'i bu slob gser gyi lhun poltabu mang 4 'dus pa'i 'dus tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus na rje rin po ches rgyud kyi bshad srol 'dzin nus pa yod dam zhes bka' 208
rje bla ma yab sras nas brgyudatshuglan gcig gnyis su phebs par mkhas pa sus kyang ldang ma nus/ rje sher seng gis phyag byas te/ de kho bos bya zhes bka' sbyi bos blangs shing rje mchog tu dgyes nas gsang 'dus kyi gser sku khyad par can/ 'grel pa bzhi sbrags/ rgyud kyi rnam bshad gnyis/ bskyed rdzogs/ chos rgyal gyi zhal 'bags/ 'cham gos/ dbyug zhags rnams gnang lte/ der btsugs pa'i rgyud pa'i grwa tshang de dus yin la/ sher seng gis rgyud pa de las rgyud grwa gsum btsugs gsungs so/ /de nas ba lam rtser brag dkar rdzong dpon yab yum la sngags kyi grwa sa gcig bka' gnang] rdzong dpon pas kyang khas blangs te/ gnas de nyid la rab gnas zhus pas/ da lan min pa mi 'ong gsungs nas rab gnas rgyas par byas/ gtsug lag khang gi ming gsang sngags mkhar du btags/ de nas brag dkar du byon/ gru bzhir gdan drangs pas kyang phebs/ de'i nub nam mkha' nas gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra chen 4 gsang mtho ba mis brdung ba min par nges par byungaka 'bras spungs nas phebs dus su slo bur du sa yang yang g.yo ba/ 'ja' kha dog sna lnga 'do lir zug pa byung/ de nas gru bzhi nas dga' ldan du phebs/thog mar yangs pa can du mchod gtor rgya cher bshams nas/ ston pa'i sku dang / gzhal yas khang rnams dang / yi dam gyi drung du/ smon lam dang 'phrin bcol rgya cher mdzad/ de nas 'du khang du mang rdza la gdan drangs pas tshogs dbur phebs te bgro ba rgyas par mdzad pa'i mjug tu zhu ba po su'ang med par bde smon gyi bsdo ba rgyas par mdzad cingan dge 'dun tshogs pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su shis brjod rgyas par gnang ba'i gyis kyi stan 'brel che bar dgongs/ de nas gzims khang la phebs/ bsnyung tshul bstan/ sang nyin 'dul 'dzin rgyal tshab sogs yod dus rgyal tshab kyis zhal ta 'dra bdag tshor gnang bar zhus pas/paṇa zhwa leb lasdog dbur bzhag spru rgyal tshab kyi sku pang du 'phangs shingad gos zer gcig gtad nas don 'de go bar gyis la byang chub kyi sems spyod gsungs shingaka gdan saralang don gyis 209
'jigasabyed chos 'byung /bskos par mdzad do/ /de nas bde mchog gi tshogs gshor byas/ nang mchod lan so gnyis myangs te rdor bzlas mdzad cingan sang nyer lnga'i snga dro dang por zhabs skyil krung phyag mnyam bzhag mdzad nas 'od gsal chos sku mngon du mdzadade/ bar do longs spyod rdzogs skur sangs rgya tshul bstan te/ sku gzhon nu'i lus can la 'ja' 'od 'phyo ba can dang] nam mkha' nas me tog gi char dang ro' 'od sogs zhag mang po'i bar du byung ngo / /gsum pa ni/ dpa' 'o mkha' 'gro grangs med pas spyan drangs te/ bar do longs sku las rmad byung bkod pa sogs su sprul sku'i mdzad pa bstan pa yin te/ dpal gsang 'dus lha so gnyis kyi rten brten pa sogs su mchog gi sprul skur mdzad la/ gdams ngag 'bogs pa las/de nas 'phos nas shar phyogs su/ /rmad byung bkod mdzes zhing khams su/ seṅge'i nga ro zhes bya ba'i/ /rgyal ba de bzhin gshegs par 'gyug /zhes gsungs shing] de bzhin du bde ba can du rgyal sras kyi tshul dang / dga' ldan du rje btsun byams mgon gyi mdun du pad+ma las rgyal sras lan+dam dpal snying bor gakhungs shing chos gsan pa sogs sprul ba pye ba phrag brgyas 'jig rten gyi khams 'di la sogs par la lar bla mdang] la lar yul gyi rgyal 4 dang/ gtso 'odang/ bram ze la 〈snags pa'i tshul dang / zhing khams la lar sangs rgyas pa'i tshul serdzogs mtha' yas pas 'gro ba gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul ba'i bkod pa mtha' yas pas 'gro ba drangs par mdzad/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs dang dus kun tu rgyas par mdzad pa yin te/ bstan pa nam gnas bar du sprul ba sna tshogs pa dge slong dang] rgyal 'o dang] lha ri dwags/'od zeg yi ge sogs su ston pas rang gi grogs dang sa bzhi grwa nas tha ma stong phrag gsum sogs 'ongs shing] dgon so sor tshur 'du ba phyir la bstanadon du phebs pa rgya mtsho la chu 4 'du bdang g.yo ba ltabuyin zhes ston pa ni/ glegs bam rin 4 che las/ mar me mdzad kyang gnas mtshog 'ded /sgrol mar bcas te 210
rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshugsprul stong 'gyed/ /ces dang/ khyad paradaga' ldan gyi gnas sogs lung bstan tshul yang/ glegs bam rin po che las/ byang ri lhun 'o brtan pa'i rtseg /zhes panas/de ni rdo rje gdanadang mtshungs/lha dang klu dang gnod sgyin dang / /mi dang dri za dag gis mchod/ gang nas bltas kyang lham mer gsal/ /bdag gi sprul pa dam pa zhig /res 'ga' dge slong nyid du sprul/ /de ni gnas de skyong bar byed/ /res 'ga' gyis pa'i gzugs su 'ong / res 'ga' dbul phongs sbrang po'i gzugs/ /res 'ga' byol song bya khyi'i gzugs/ /res 'ga' gserdzol 'debs dbyangs kyi gzugs/ /res 'ga' yi ge 'bru yi gzugs/ /grags pa can gyi dge slong lnga1 /bstan gnas bar du yang yang 'ong] /zhes gsungs shingaka 'de khri rin 4 che 'od zer pa'i chos 'byung las rje la sbyad bsod grags kyi chos 'byung du snar thang byang chen la sbyar yang/ phyi ma 'di snar thang byang chen kho nar sbyar ba mi 'thad de/ de yang] glegs bam rin ṭo che'i lung bstan le'u las/ la la bsres pa nyid du bstan/ /zhes gsungs/ bsres pa tsam la tshig re gnyis kyis tshog kyang / 'dir bshad pa'i khyad chos kun de la ma tshang pa'i phyir dang/ khyad par du rdo rje gdan zhes bdud 'dul ba'i gnas dang / sangs rgyas pa'i bshad pa de la ma grags pa'i phyir/ des na byang ri lhun po sogs kyis gnas kyi dbyibs dang / sku gdung mthar gnas tshul dang rje rin po ches phyis kyi gdul bya'i lam gyi gegs bdud rigs rnams 〈snan ston pas 'dul ba ltar bcom pas rgyal ba gnyis par grags pa ltar gnas kyang rdo rje gdan gnyis pa yin par lung bstan cing / lha dang 〈snags kyis de la lha klu mi dri za dredags kyis malngasnad cing] phyogs kun nas gnas de gsal ba ༵]sa pad g+na trā t+t+waṃ ༵ rnyi/]rnyi/ spraX pasna r+sha shārnyi pa zloshā ༵ :sna k+ṣiṃ pa/ snar+shar+sha (dī (pa/ du yang yang 'ong] /zhes pas lo stong yang bshad mod/ mdor na lab sgron gyi gsung ltad bstan 211
'jigs byed chos 'byung /༵ pa/pa hūm̐ (( ñtsha /sna ci dī spyazlo pa/ spri lha r+yaṃ lha dwo 'o/ji /shā ༷sdu hūm̐~X ༵ ༵la sprad ṭ+wāṃ /dī sdi pa nyidadang mtshungs/ /khrims ldanades spyan rlabs kyis/ /skyes bu gsumanimasan gnyer ba'i/ /bya ba nyung ba brgya phrag tsam/ /gnas der bsam gtan sgom par byed/ /ces gsungs pa dga' ldan du rje bzhugs dus lam rim sgom mkhan stong phrag long nges yod par ma zad/ rgyal tshab rin so che'i dus su'ang rang gis gtso byas de ltar yod par dga' ldan gyi gdan rabs mkhas pa'i dbang po stag lung brag padapon slob kyis gzims khang du bris pa de las kyang bshad cing/ khyad par mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i dus de'i steng du mtshan nyid kyi grwa tshang bzhi btsugs par yang lamarim bshad srold lta'i bar dugengad mod/ de la las smon log pa'i ltagrubangan pas bar bar cung zad gnod cing 'dod yon gyis g.yeng ba byed pa dang/ de'i tshe phan tshun bsam gtan pa phan gnod sgom bzlas byed pa'i chags snang gidabang du 'chor zhing rtsod kyang rje'i sprul pa du ma'i byin rlabs kyis skyon med cing zhi nas lhar bcas 'gro ba'i mchod gnas su 'gyur tshul ni/ de nyid las/ de la'ang ltabs cung zad gnod/ 'dod yon bdud kyi g.yab mo 'byung] /bsam gtan pa~X snashā /(1 spri 〉pazlo/ ༵ lhalha sazhe dzī /(dri pa~X/ pyā/ dz+nyo ( /pa pa/ /mitshu hā lung bstan sogs yod la/ de ltar ma byas par byang chen la sbyar na sgom mkhan de tsam dang lhar bcas kyis mchod par 'jig rten na ma grags pas yod kyang snang rung mi dmigs pa'i lung bstan mi bya'o/ /der ma zad/ lungade nyid las/ mdor na gnas mtshog de dag tu/ /dang ṭo bzhi grwa nas bzung ste/ /tha ma stong phrag phyed dang gsum/ /bslab pa gsum ldan shākya'i sras/ /'gro ba kun gyi mgon du 'gyug /gnas der phyogs dang phyogs mtshams nas/ /'dun ldan dpag med 212
rje bla ma yabasras nasabargyudatshug'du bar 'gyug /pyir yang las can phyogs bcur 'gro/ /phyi yi rgya mtsho dag dang mtshungs/ /chu 'o brgya yis gang mi nus/ /de tsam zhig gis bri mi nus/ /zhes gsungs palangadaga' ldan gyis rje'i bu chen de dag se 'bras dge gsum bkra shis lhun po sogs gnas so sor phyogs so so nāpa sna gā sbyishā dīpa snro slopa (pa k+ṣiṃ spyu ( bu/ ( pa// ༈ dz+nyo / lha(5 pañtsha/ r+shar+sha /ze( bas gcig yin pa khegs/ 'dun ldan dpag med phar 'gro tshur 'ong lta bu ni/ snar thang la'ang tshogs che yang 'du 'god phyogs mtha' dag nas med cing / rje'i bstan pa'i dus kyi 'phel rgyas lta bu 'phags yul na'ang med par grags shing / lung bstan yang mang ba drangs zin cing mngon sum du grub pa 'di lags so/ /sku sgyi ma la dga' ldan du skye ba bzhes par gsungs padangaka rmad byung bkod par gshegs par gsungs pa sogs mang yang mi 'gal te/ sngar bshad pa ltar sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul par bshad pa dang / sprul pa mtha' yas pa rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs ltar yin te/ de yang dga' ldan du mtshan 'angam dpal snying po zhes bya bar gabrungs pa ni/grub chen la phyag rdor gyis/ blo bzang grags pa 'gran zla kun dang bral/ /shākya'i rgyal po'i drung du zugs mchog bskyed/ /zhing 'dir mdo dang sngags kyi gzhung lugs spel/ /'di nas 'phos nas dga' ldan gnas su 'gro//'jam dpal snying 4 byams pa'i sras mtshogade/ /myur du sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs par 'gyug /zhes dang / rdo rje gling pa'i gter ma las/ mdo sngags bstan 'dzin blo bzang grags pa 'byung] /mi rabs brgyad du gsang sngags sdedagon 'byung] /zhing benar 'das nas byams pa'i drung du 'ju/ /de yi rgyud 'dzin tshe gcig sangs rgyas yin/ /zhes dang]pad+ma bka' chems las/ 'jam dbyangs sprul pa gdul bya bstan pa'i bdag /mdo sngags bstan 'dzin blo bzang grags pa 'byungaka /zhing lenar 'das nas byams pa'i drung du 'gro/ /zhes gsungs 213
'jigasabyed chos 'byung /pa sogs gter rnal mar lung bstan gang legs kho na las med pas/ snang rtsib 〈snags kyis lung bstan ngan pa byas pa rang rdzun ma yin par ston byed gsal ba yin la/ yang 'di nas gshegs nas rmad byung bkod par skye ba yang / mdo lde gdams ngag 'a'ogs pa las nga la gaglenal ba rab btab nas/ /bstan pa 'o( stong bar du gnas/ /de nas shar phyogs 'o(gas su 'ju/ /rmad byung bkod pa'i 'jig rten du/ /seng ge'i nga ro zhes byar 'gyug /de la dad byed zhing der skye/ /zhing mchog de ni khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dang / bka' gter yang mang mod/ gsal bar slob dpon gyis mdzad pa'i bskul byang las/ 'de ltar nyon cig rgyal yodad pa can/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten byon dus nye bar dngog /mya ngan 'das tshe u pa gup+ta zhes/ /grong khyer 'ga' ru bha ba lha drar grags/ /shar phyogs rgya nag yul dang nye ba'i chad /shākya'i dge slong slo bzang zhes bya 'byung / /rgyal ba'i sras 4 grags pa'i mtha' can des/ /shākya'i rgyal pho 'o(ngas sprengad rdzogs skur bsgyud /pha rgyud zab gnad phra mo'i rnal 'phyor dang] /mthar bzhi spros bral rtogs pa'i lta ba /rdzu///dzo/ ༵༵ dā gh+nā 〉pa tshozlo ༵ ā lha rnyi sna pyi//rgya/paX ༷shā dzo pa~X twi r+sha tshipa (sdu/ yi phyag gi rin chen mchod sdong las/ /'od zer bye ba'i phung yo rab tu 'gyed/ /ces gsungs pa shan tu gsal zhing rnam dag gangs ri ma dang yang mthun la/ der ma zad sngon gyi rang gzhan gyi dam pa thams cad de ltar du ze tshom med cing mngon par mkhyen tshul mang zhing / rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis rtogs ldan pa la gsungs pa las/ de'i tshe snying stobs phul du phyin pa'i sems dpa' chen po 'de nyid ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dpag tu med pa 'das pa'i byang shar mtshams su ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bkod pa sna tshogs pas mdzes pa zhes bya ba'i zhing du de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'ing ro zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhesadang rtogs ldan pa'i gsung las kyang/214
rje blam yabasras nas brgyud tshul/'dun pa shugs drag sa mang du byas pa'i mtshams shig tu/ de bzhin gshegs pa de'i sku'i rnam pa mi 'ong gnyis las che tsam sprul sku'i cha lugs shin tu rgyas pa sngar bshad pa ltar gyur te zhag bco lnga'i bar du gsal bo byung / zhes dang / rje rin po che des da ltar sprul sku dpag med ston pa dang / sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan mang ba yang / rtogs ldan pa'i gsung las/ rje de da ltar sprul ba dpag tu med pas 'jig rten du rol pa yin/ sangs rgyas pa na sangs rgyas ye shes dbang 4/zhes pa gcig tu 'gyur ba yin par snang / zhes dang / bka' gdams chos 'byung las kyang /sangs rgyas re re la'ang zhing dang mtshan mang bas rje sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan yang mang bar snang ngo] /zhes rtso/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i gnas tshul ni/ so skye ltaci 'phags pa mthon po rnams kyis kyang dpagadaka' la 'brel tshad 'drin nges pa gcig yin te/ lho brag grub chen la gsang bdag gi zhal nas/ blo bzang grags pa 'di tshogs gnyis rgya chen ṭo bsags pa mthong thos reg gsum gyis phan yon lenab pa'i gang zag yin/ so so'i skye bo'i snang ngor bh+yor lam par grags/ kho rgyo lag na rdo rjes kyang 'de'iphunan tan gyi mtha' rtogs par mi nus so/ /'tshang nam rgya ngas mi ston/ 'jam dpal dang spyan ras gzigs kyis lung ston par 'gyur ro/ /dri ba zhus pa rnams la kho rang rgyus che gsung gin 'dug /khyed kyi che ba'i yon tan nang du gsungs na'ang yi ger 'bri long ma byung zhing phyogs tsam bris pa 'di dag kyang gzhan gyi blor mi shong srid pas sred par zhu gsung/ de yang shun mong snang tshul gyi dbang du byas na 'de'i phyi ma la dga' ldan du lan+dam dpal snying 4 dang de'i nying mar 'dzam gling 'di'i gzhan gcig tu chos kyi rgyal po chen po lag don rlabs chen mdzad pa gcig dang] skye ba gsum pa la5ma gling 'de'i shar phyogs ri rtsazhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang du paṇ+ḍi ta dz+nyā na zhes bya ba lugar tshogs lam chen ṭo dang dang bh+yor lam yan chad la gnas pa sha stag gi gsor nyis stong 'du ba yin te/ gsang bdag 215
'jigasabyedachos 'byung /gi lung bstan las/ yang las kyi rdo rjes gsang bdag la zhus pa/ blo bzang grags pa 'di'i skye ba snga ma gang du zhakhrungs/ phyi ma gang du zhakhrungs/ dgung lo'i tshad ci tsam thub/ 'phro don gang du 'phel/ slob ma ji lta bu zhig yi dam gang dang 'brel/ 'tshang nam rgya/ rgyud tshod ji lta bu yin zhus pas/ gsang bdag gi zhal nas/ 'di'i skye ba snga ma kha che grib bstan du paṇ+ḍi ta ma ñtsā bha dra shrī zhes bya bar zhakhrungs/ phun sum tshogs pa'i langor lnga brgya 'dus/ sku skye ba rting ma dga' ldan du byang chub sems dpa' lan+damadapal snying po zhes bya bar skyede'i nying ma 'dzam gling gzhan du chos rgyal zhig tu skye ba bzhes nas 'grodon rlabs chen mdzad/ skye ba gsum pa 'dzam gling 'dir shar phyogs ri rtsazhes bya ba'i gtsug khang du paṇ+ḍita dzā na zhes bya bar skye ba bedzin/gshor nyis stong 'du zhing / 'khor thams cad kyang tshogs lam chen sho dang bh+yor lam la gnas pa sha stag go/zhes gsungs/ de yang shun mong ba'i dbang du byas na/ rje rin po che 'dis ston pa sangs rgyas la mjal ba nas sku 'do yan chad skye ba bcu bdun song lte/ bla ma dbu ma pa la 'jam dbyangs kyis gsungs pa las/ rje 'di ston pa'i drung du mjal ba nas da lta yan chad la sku'i skye ba bcu bdun song ba la/ rgya gar du paṇ+ḍi ta che ba gsumadang chung ba gnyis/'od du 'di ma gtogs pa'i bshes gnyen gyi sku skye gsum blangs pa la gcig ni paṇ+ḍi tar bgrang du rung zhing] bstan pa la phan shin nyuche ba zhig nyuzhakhrungs gsungs pa'i mtshan ci zer lags zhus pas/ khyedang rgyal skyes 'ong bas da res la mi 'chad ces gsungs/ gyis grub chen phyag rdor pa dang / dpal mo rab bzang gi nyams la rngog lo chen poyin zedalha'i skye ba gcigadang phal pa gnyis blangs so//legs bshad kyi rtsom pa yang/ byang chub lam gyi rim ba'i bstan bcos che chung gnyis/ tshul khrims le'u'i rnam bshad byang chub gzhung lam/dranganges rnam par 'byod pa legs bshad snying po/ rtsashe'i rnam bshad rigs pa'i rgya mtsho/ 'jug pa'i rnam bshadadagongs pa rab gsal/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 216
rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshul/'grel pa dang bcas pa'i legs par bshad pa gser gyi 'phreng ba la sogs pa mdo phyogs kyi skor dang/ sngags phyogs la/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i rnam bshad/ ②lhung rnam bshad/ rnam bzhag rim dī phru sdi /sh+lau rmo ji hūm̐ spya ༵ pam ṭhaṃ dz+nyo rnyi/k+ṣiṃ tsho/pa ñtsā nā ñtsā sgrupa ༵༵༵ ṭ+wāṃ hā shārnyi traṃ pa'i mngon rtogs dkyil tshog dang bcas pa/ bshad rgyud lha mo bzhis zhus dang] ye shes rdo rje kun las btus gnyis kyi rgya cher bshad pa/ rim lnga gdan rdzogs dang / de'i ngo sprod rim lnga ༵༵ padro smyo /ma/ñtsha ( dzo / pashā rmo r+shasko/ pa ༵ ṭ+wāṃ sbyodapa (sbyi ( rnyi r+shadī brnyi gh+nā spridīr+sha lha 'dod pa lasdo ba/ tshes bcu'i lag mchod/ rdzogs rim rnal 'byor bzhi ldan gyi khrid yig che chung/dril bu lusadakyil gyi mngonadakyil/dril bu rim lnga'i ṭīka rtsargyud ṭīka chen sogasadang] gzhan yang 'pho khrid gser gyi sgo 'byed/ na ro chos drug gi khrid yig yid ches gsum ldan/ bka' 'bum thor bu ba nas 'byung ba rnams dngan mdo sngags kyi dka' ba'i gnad kyi zin bris la yang/bskyed rim gyi zin bris/ rdo rje bzlas pa/ sgyu lus kyi zin bris/ mngon par byang chub pa'i zin bris/ zung 'jug gi zin bris/ sgrub thabs kyi zin bris/ 'jam rdor gyi zin bris/ de'i dkyil tshog /dus 'khor le'u so so'i zin bris/ 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma'i zin bris/ rnal 'byor bzhi rim gyi zin bris/ zhag gsum gyi zin bris/ dge 'dun nyi shu'i zin bris/ bsam gzugs zin bris gnyis dang] dbu ma rgyan gyi zin bris/ dbu ma bden gnyis kyi zin bris/ spyod 'jug shes rab le'u'i zin bris/ thal 'gyur pa'i shun mong ma yin pa'i khyad tshos brgyad kyi rin bris sogs yod/ bla ma snga ma du mas gsung 'bum bsgrigs par poti nyer lnga canadang/ sum cu can yang yod/de lta bu'i gsung gi bdud rtsimyangs pa'i sras bslab pa gsum bsrung ba/ mkhas zhing grub pa 217
'jigs byed chos 'byung/brnyes pa/ sde snod gsumadang rgyud sde bzhi'i rnga bo che sa gsum du sgrogs pa gnam gyi skar tshogs lta bu'am/ lha'i yongs 'du'i ldon pa 'bras bu'i khur gyis bajid pa'am/ ma dros pa'i mtsho la pad+ma dang me tog gis brgyan pa lta bu bsam las 'das pa zhig nub dzā lan+ta ra nas/ shar phyogs rgya mtsho chen so la thug gi bar thams cad khyab par byon nas/ rgya gar rgya nag bal po bod gangs can gyi ldongs ma lus pa dge 'dun gyi sde dang] mdo sngags kyi bshad sgrub kyis khyab par mdzad pa'i slob ma'i grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bdag 'dras brjod par ga la nus/ gtso 'or gyur pa rags rim nge mtshar ba rna bar thos pa 'ga' tsam brjod par bya ste/ bla ma chos gsan pa bzhi lte/ dbu ma pa/ lho brag phyag rdor pa/ bra gor mkhan 4 chos skyabs bzang 4/ rje btsun red mda' ba dang bzhi'o/ /sras kyi thu 'o gsum ni/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen dang / 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan/ nang shugs kyi sras rigs ldan rnam 'phrul mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa dge legs dpal bzang / de gsum ni gsang bdag gis lung bstan pa'i slob ma gsum zhes rje btsun chos rgyan gsung ste legs so/ /bdud sde'i gnyen 4 sras bar tshar gyi lubor dag pa rnam brgyad ni/ rtogs ldan 'jam dkar pa/ gnas brtan byang seng pa/ shar pa rin rgya shu ba/ gnas brtan bzang skyong ba ste dbus pa bzhi/ rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ dge bshes shes rab grags pa/ dge bshes 'jam dpal bkra shis/ dge bshes dpal skyongs pa ste mdo smad pa bzhi ste/ 'di dag kyang lung rtogs kyi yon tan dpag par dka' zhing / rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin brtan po mnga' ba/ yi dam gyi lha du mas rjes su bzung ba sha stag go/tsha kho dbon po ngag dbang grags pa/ mdo smad pa grags pa blo gros/ ldong ston dz+nyā na shrī/ dge bshes sha ston te/ bya bral la ma zegs gong gi sras snga tshar bzhi/ zhwa lu legs pa rgyal mtshan/ rje blo spos chos skyong] ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan gsum ni/ 'jam dbyangs snyan rgyud chu bo'i mgo 'odzin pa'i chos rje gser 218
rjebla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshul/r+ṇi ba gsum/ hor ston nam mkha' dpal/ shar pa rin rgyal ba gnyis ni 6shar gyi bstan pa'i gsal byed gnyis/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan/ mtshungs med chos rje rgyal mtshan bzang pho/ rje btsun sher rab seng ge /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/ tsha kho dbon po ngag dbang grags pa/ stod sher seng] smad sher seng dang bdun ni 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sras chen bdun/ chos rje dkon mchog tshul khrims/ mkhas pa rgyal dbang kha che/gnyal rgod rin bsam/ mkhyed rab grags bzangaka gnyal chen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dpal seng / snar thang rab mchog dang bdun ni dbus gtsang bstan pa'i sgron me bdun/ byang sems shākya bsod nams/ byang sems kun dga' bzang po/ byang sems blo gros rgyal mtshan/byang sems tshul khrims dpal bzang / byang sems gzhon nu rgyal mchog /byang sems rgyal mtshan grags bzang / byang sems rgyal sras bde 'byung ba dang bdun ni gzhan don lhun gyis grub pa'i sems dpa' bdun/ byams chen shākya yi shes/ byang dar ma/ mdo smad pa legs bzang gsum ni mi dbang gtsug na mdzes pa'i tī shri gsum/ ma cig dbon po nam mkha' dpal/ yar rgyab dbon po bsod nams rnam rgyal/ zhwa lu pa bkra shis rgya mtsho/ mus srad pa blo gros rin chen dang bzhi ni mang thos mkhas pa bzhi/ zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa/ gu ge ngag dbang grags pa/lho pa rgyal mtshan seng ge/ bla mdapal ldan pa/ ldan ma yon tan dpal/ mdo smad pa bsod nams shes rab/ rong po lce nag /mdo smad pa 'od zer dang brgyad ni bstan pa phyogs mthar skyong ba'i dar chen brgyad/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal/ stag lung lo ts+tsha ba ste lo chen gnyis/ rin 4 che dpal ldan pa/ rin po che bsod nams bzang 4/ rin 4 che byang chub rdo rje/ rin po che bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'bri khung rin 4 che don grub rgyal po/ ltag lung rin ṭo che bkra shis dpal 'od dang drug ni sa skyong chos rje drug /chos rje sher 'byung ba/ rgyal ba rin bsam pa/ byang gling 219
'jigs byed chos 'byung/grags rin pa/ mnga' ris bsod nams rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal/ gu ge sangs rgyan/'jam dbyangs rin grags/ dmar khams grags bzang] slob dpon brtson grags/ slob dpon legs ldan pa/ bla ma stag leb byang rgyal pa/ bla ma byang dpal pa ste bcu gnyis ni mang du mkhyen pa'i bstan 'dzin bcu gnyis/ sbre zhing rin po che byang dpal pa dang / rin chen dpal gnyis ni mkha' rgyud grub pa'i gdung rabs gnyis/ skyes mchog smon lam pa dang]ri mi 'babs pa bsod nams rin chen gnyisani skyes bungo mtshar can gnyis/ spyan snga kun slo/ spyan snga gzhon 'od/ spyan snga blo rgyan/ spyan snga dpal bzang] spyan snga nam rgyal/ spyan snga bsod lhun/ spyan snga rin rgyal/ spyan snga rin chen 'pheladang brgyadani skyedagu'i bla ma spyan snga brgyad/ gung thang chos rje mdzes pa dpal/bla chen nyan shag/stag lung gu shri dpaladon pa/te'u rwa pa ye shesadapal/ mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang] mkhan chen rgyal bzang / mkhan chen kun rdog mkhan chen byang dpal te bla chen brgyad/ chen 4 grags bzang/ chen 4 dwags 4/ chen 4 slo 'phel/ chen 4 kun rgyal/ chen po bkras rgyan/ chen po 'jam dbyangs kha che/ chas sgo pa bkra shis rin chen te chen 4 bdun/ dka' bcudar bzang] 'bal ser dka' bcu/tso tsha dka' bcu yon tan rgyal mtshan/ lhu ladaka' brgamthil chungadaka' bcu padon yod/ bragadagon dka' bzhi pa rin chenadapal/ rgyal ba dka' bzhi pa rin chen chos rgyal/ gye re dka' bzhi pa sangs rgyas dbang phyug/stag phu dka' bzhi pa sangs rgyas bzang 4/ g.yag sde dka' bzhi spru bsemad nams bzang 4/ gros dka' bzhi pa/ 'tshur phu dka' bzhi pa/ dka' bzhi pa chos sengan dka' bzhi pa grags pa rgyal mtshan te gzhung lugs smra ba'i dka' chen bcu bzhi/ jo gdan zla ba blo gros/ jo gdan bsod nams lhun grub/ dzo gdan legs rin pa/ kong pho jo gdan dang bzhi ni skyangs pa'i yon tan brtul zhugs 'odzin pa'i jo 4 stan gcig pa bzhi/ gnas brtan chos bzang ba/gnas brtan rgyal steng bdon grubadapal/gnas 220
rje bla ma yab sras nas brgyud tshugbrtan rgya ma bdage 'dun rgyal ba/ gnas brtan 'od zer bkra shis/ gnas brtan gzhon nu sangs rgyas/ gnas brtan kun 'bum ste tshul khrims rnam paradag pa'i gnas brtarna drug ku cor rtogs ldan pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang /rtogs ldan nam mkha' 〈sna re/ rgod phrug grags pa 'byung gnas/rtags ldan ral zhig pa/ bu le nam rgyal te zab mo'i rtogs ldan lnga/ lha gzigs grags pa rgya mtsho/ rgya ston blo bzang grags pa/ drung gzhon nu dpal pa/ mkhan 4 bsam rgyal/ bla ma gser thub pa/ yangs steng rin 4 che/ zhi blo da'on 4/ drung nam mkha' pa/ bla ma mgon po byang chub/ bla ma bsod rin pa/ drung chos 'phags pa/ bla ma shāka rin pa/ bla ma zla ba bzang po/ bla ma chos rgyal mtshan/ rgya ra sangs rgyas ye shes sogs mtha' yas pa zhig byon te/ mdor na gas/nga bde gung gsum/ dga' skyor zul gsum/ lo bya yul rin chen sgang gsum/ rgyal glang thang gro sa gsum/rwa sgreng 'chad kha sgyil bu gsum/ 'bri stag tshal gsum/ e gnyal dwags gsum gyi chos dpon/thang 'o che sogs g.yor phyogs kyi tshosadapon rnams kyis de dus/ rje rin po che'i zhabs drung du ma btud pa mi snang ste/ ye bzang 〉ba chen po'i zhal nas/ de dus sa chen 4 'di/ rje btsun tsong kha pa'i gdugs dkar po gcig gis khyab bar byas nas yod pa yin/ zhes gsungs so/ /de yang lha pa zhabs drung gisadage lugs kyi bla ma yin na/rdo rje 'dzigs byed kyi bskyed rim gcig mdzad pas khyab gsungs pa ltar/ da lta'i bar du bla mar ma zad btsun chung tsho yan chad kyis la)gas byed 'don pas dgon kun na ja mchod kyang 'drin pa mnyam med ma ltag rang lus lha sku'i ngo bo nyid/ ces pa'i gsung don la gnas pas dge lugs rdo rje la)gas byed kyi chos dar tshul ni/ dge lugs kyidagon pa bzhin sa chen 4 'di'i rgya mtsho'i mtha' tshun chad la khyab par mngon sum du grub pa gnasan pas de kun su zhig gis brjod nus/'on kyang rdo rje la)gas pyed kyi dbang rgyud gdams ngag nyams khrid ma lus zugs kyi sras mchog mkhas grub thams cad 221
'jigs byed chos 'byung /mkhyen pa la rdzogs par gnang zhing / yang bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams khrid khyad par can bu chen thams cad la gnang bar mdzad snang zhing/ de dag gis kyang rang rang la gang gnang ba de la thams cad kyis zin bris mdzad pa ches mang ba mthong ngon /༈ des na sras snga tshar gyi rim pas bkod na/ tsha kho dbon 4 ngag dbang grags pa ni/ tsha kho rgyal po'i rigs su 'khrangs shing / dbus gtsang du gsung rab la sbyangs pas mkhas grags shin tu che/ bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin brtan po mnga' zhing/ lta ba log pa dum dus re la'ang tshar bcad pa ste/nyid kyi gsang gi yig chung las/ brgya phyed mkha' spre da gnas su badz+ra muḥzhes gsungs nas/ dgon mdo smad kyi phyogs na che ba'i dgon lde mang du btsugs te ja phu stod du da tshang lhun grub gling zer ba'i dgon nga dang / ja phu'i sked na ba mgo dgon pa dang gnyis da lta'ang rgyas shing / ja phu'i smad na sum mdo dgon btab pa deng sang mi snang / dpu dge'i khog na dmu dge dgon yang btab par grags la chung du mang skad/ de ltar bstan pa rgyas par mdzad pas gdams ngag gi rgyun dbus gtsang kun na bzhugs shing] bdag gis kyang ci rigs gcig thob bo/ /dgon sde rnams kyang da lta'i bar du rgyas so/ /de la rje rin 4 che yang shin tu dgyes pa zhig ste/ kho bos smras pa'i rjes su zhugs shig dang / /tshe rabs kun tu rgyud dang smon lam kun/ /mtshungs par spre da de nam zhig sangs rgyas tshe/ /bdud rtsi'i bgo bsha' thog mar 'gyed par s+pha /zhes gsungs la/ de yang 'phags yul gyi dpal 'bras rdo rje dang / rdo rje dril bu ba sogs dang rgyud gcig cing / sku'i skye ba sgyi ma la kun mkhyen legs pa don grub dang / de'i pyi ma la dga' ldan mkha' rgyud du sangs rgyas par gsungs so/ /de'i dbon 4 chos grags kyis kyang mkhas grub rin po cher gdams pa rdzogs par gnang/ khyad par zhakhrul lubor man ngag mar me'i yig chung sogasadang / ling ka sngags med kyi gnad yig 'god tshuladang/ sngags can la mi 'dra 222
rje bla rma yab sus nas brgyud tshugba gnyis sogs gnang ba dar rgyas che zhing rnam thar mdzad pa gong ma'i rjes su 'gro ba byung /mgon po'i phyag len dngor lo sogs bslabs nas da lta'i bar du dar ro/ /yang de phyogs kyi girti dgon ni drung ba ljags nag gis btab ste/ 'di ni bstan pa phyogs mthar skyong ba'idar chen bdun gyi nang tshan mkhas pa rong 4 ljags nag tu grags pa de lags so/ /mdo stod pa grags pa blo gros ni/ rje rin po che'i bu chen dang / snyo brag grub chen gyi sras brgyad dam bcu gsum gyi gcig yin/ gsang bdag gis/ grags pa blo gros yon tan rmad du byung / /rang rgyud smin grol theg chen sa ru 'dzeg/ces lung bstan la sa thob par bshad pa'i bdag nyid chen po gcig yin no/ /dge bshes sha ston dang / ldong ston dge bshes chen yo yin pas/ rje la dus gcig tu po hi mang po gsung bar zhu mkhan se gas yin/ bya bral la phebs dus kyi sras rnams las 'jamadakar pa dpal ldan bzang po ni/ dang rdzo skyor lung gi dge bshes 'dul 'dzin zhig yin kyang / bya bral gyi phyag phyir byon nas sngags kyi gdams pa thugs nyams su bzhes shing] rje'i bu chen phal cher gyi bla ma dang bslab bya ston par mdzad pas/ 'de'i gsung dge slong gi bslab bya'i zin bris gnas brtan bzang skyong pas mdzad pa gcig kyang yod/ dge ldan 'debs pa'i snga rol tsam der rgyal sde rje dkar gyi ri khrod du mya ngan las 'das par grags/ de'i skyes rabs de mo sprul sku rim byon rnams yin te/ phyis su bshad par bya'o/ /rje bzang skyong pa ni/ 'khrangs yul mal gro pa/ rje rin 4 che 'das nas 'ol khar nyi ma gling btab ste/ rdzing phyi'i gdan sa dang sbrags nas e phyogs su'ang 'gro don mdzad cing / zin bris dang rtsom pa'ang ci rigs snang / slob ma'ang chos rje nam mkha' blo gros/ mkhas pa chos grags/ dpon po lhun grub rgya mtsho sogs sde snod 'dzin pa'i mkhas pa chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / nam blos rtses thang khramo'i gzim sbyil bzungs nas mdzod 'dul sogs mdo sngags kyi chos thams cad gsungs/ lhun rgyam pas/ pad dkar 223
'jigs byed chos 'byung /zhal lung gi yig cha khyad 'phags 'di brtsams pas da lta'i bar du phug lugs zhes legs bshad du grags/ rje rin chen rgyal mtshan ni/ stod lung ba/ lung rtogs kyi yon tan du ma mnga' zhing / bskyed rdzogs kyi rtogs pa skyes pa'i bstod pa'ang yod cing / 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen yo zhig lte shar gyi gdan sa'i thog ma yin/ gzigs khang shar du bzhugs pas shar pa rin 4 cher grags shing / rje bzhugs dus nas dngos slob ches che ba du mas kyang chos gsan te/mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa zugags kyis kyang gsan no/ /dpon 4 nyi grags zla grags sogasadapon rgyud kyang bzang bar byung]rtogs ldan pani/tsong kha'i yul du me pho spre'u la 'khrungs/rje las lo gcig gis rgan/ dgung 〈sna bco brgyad tsam la dbus su phebs/ gzhon nu nas chos kyi bag chags sad pas zla ba sgron me'i mdo sogs zugs 'edzin dang rgyun du zhal 'don mdzad la/ chos rje zho lung mtsho kha ba'i drung du bh+yor drug gsan/ de dus mdo thugs la yod pas khong gi grub mtha' dang mdo bstun nas zhu gnyugs mdzad/ de nas rje rin 4 ches bde ba can du rgyud bla ma gsung gin 'dug pa gsan du byon pas legs par go ba byung gsungs/ de dus na khrid skyong medod kyang rje'i zhal ta la tshad ma nyon gsungs pas/ slob dpon dkon seng la tshad ma bslabs/grwa skor gyi gzhung ṭika thadagon du sbrel/ stag lung lo ts+tsha ba la gshor chen gyidabang sogs kha yar gsan/ spyan snga dpal ba'i drung du bu ston chos 'byung sogs gsan/ de dus nas mthun 'jug bsgyungs te chig tshugs 'ba' zhig mdzad/ de nas brag tshab mkhan yodage 'dun rin chen pa la bam 'o lnga bcu ba dang mdo rtsagasan/ rje'i zhal sngar yang gsan te phyag len dang bcas pa zhib par mdzad/ phar pyin gtsang nya dpon pa'i grwa ba sa skya'i bla ma kunadaga'i gdan sa pa gcig la nyan gsungs/denasadapal ldan bla ma'i slob ma yonahan bzang po'i drung du lam 'bras sogs gsan/bla ma 'dide dus rtsarlung la dbang thob pas rlung sor rtser 'jungs shing bskyed rdzogs la nus pa 224

rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshuggsum tsam gyis tshar bcad nas thams cad kyis kyang rigs gter nang 'gal gyi phung so yin par thag bcad do/ /de'i sang nyin sgyin bdag kyang yid rab tu ma bde nas slob dpon rnams bka' bkyon gyis tshar bcad/ da khyod rnams kyi nang na lan 'debs nus pa su yod dris pas khong rnams kyisadaka' bcu bdage legasadapal pa 'di slo gros thogs pa med pa zhig 'dug pas 'de rtsod du bcug na grag ces spos byas te/ de'i sang nyin sngar ltar stan bshams pa'i mdun sadmkhan chen pas rigs gter gyi dbu nas mthar chags la bkag /bdag nyid chen 4 'dis skyon spong rim pa bzhin du mdzad cing / khong rang nyid kyis grub mtha' bzhag pa rnams kyang rigs pa dri ma med pas sun byung ste/ lan med par mdzad pa'i tshe/ de mdo sde pa'i grub mtha'inang 'gal yin gsungs pa ma gtogs gzhan gsung rgyu ma byung / yang rje bla ma 'di nyid ngam ring gi dbyar chos shig gi dus chos rje g.yag pa dang ngam ring gi tshogs su rtsod pa mdzad pas rje bla ma 'des mkhas grub g.yag pa yang pham par mdzad 'dug lte parnyita chen po 'di nyid kyirang tshul yin pas ngo mtshar du ci zhig yod/ mdor na rje bla ma 'de nyid ni/ lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung zhing / skye ba mang por rig gnas la sbyangs pa'i stobs kyis mkhas par rlom pa sus kyang 'de'i mdun sar smra ba'i ma thogs pa min te/ des na che brjod las kyang/ khyod kyi rnamadapyod sgro ldan ni/ /rnon pos shes bya'i 'ben dag phug /smra ba'i seng ge mtha' dag gi /dregs pa'i ral ba ma lus bcad/ /kha la smra bcad rgya pyin pa/ /dbyangs can ngo mtshar gyur pa bzhin/ /zhes bsngags pa ni don gnas kho na'o/ /nyer gsum pa la rje rin po che'i snyan pas yid 'phyog ste/ se ra chos sdings su rje rin po che dang thog mar mjal bas tshe rabs du mar yab srasayin pas thugs dad chen yos mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes par mdzad/ rje'i zhal nas/ lam nas rmi lam 'dra byung ngam/ zhes gsung bar/ chu shul du sleb nub phyogs mtshams kun mun pas khyab pas gar 'gro gtol med par/235
'jigs byed chos 'byung /shar phyogs nas ral gri'i gshor lo rtsibs stong can gyi dbus su rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku shin tu mdzes pa bzhugs shing nibs re'i 〉la nyi ma'i dkyil gshor re yod pa zhig byung nas rim pas 'dzam gling 'od kyi khyab pa zhig nas zhus pas/ shin tu legs/nyid la 'phrin las legs po 'ong ba'i ltas yin/ khyod kyis bla ma 'jamadapal dngos su mthong ba'i gdul bya mchog yin pa'i rtags red/ don la nga 'jam dbyangs yin yang tha mal pa'i rnam par bstan pa yin gsungs shing] nga'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis yi dam rdo rje 'dzigs byed dang / laram dbyangs a ra pa tsan la byed dgos/ 'di la rten 'brel zhig yod gsungs/ phyag phul te 'di nas 'jigs byed gnang dgos zhus pas/ yong gsungs nas mkhas grub rje gcig pu kho nar rje rang gi phyag gis rdul tshon gyi dkyil gshor bzhengs nas dbang dang rjes gnang man ngag kun rdzogs par gnang]de bzhin du gsang sngags kyi skor kun la zhib par dogasadapyod zhus pas yig chung mang podeyin/ gsung ma lus pa bum pa gang byor gyur cing/ gsang bdag gis lung bstan pa'i rgyal tshab dngaka 'dul 'dzin dang / lan+dam dkar pa gsum la'ang chos mang du gsan/ slar gtsang la byon nas nyang stod lcang ra'i gdan sa mdzad pas lcang ra dka' bcu par grags/ de nas bdag po rab brtan pa dang mchod yon gnyis kyisadapal lubor bde chen gyi chos grwa chen sa btab ste nor bu dga' ldan pa/ brang mo che ba/ legs grub pa/ zhi gnas pa/ gser khang gong 'og gnyis dang]ltakhang pa sesnags dge lugs kyi grwa tshang mang po'i gzhi btsugs shingan sde snod 'dzin pa rnams me tog la sbrang mi'athung ba bzhin du gangor nas gtsang phyogs su rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i bstan pa'i snang byed mdzad pas ltamis smon pa'i skabs deg sngon tsam nas rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan pas sngon med pa'i rje yab sras kyi legs bshad la ma bzod nas rje rin po che la rtsod ga nas nus/mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa la'ang rtsod mi nus kyang lan cig rtsod pa byed do zhes pa'i tshig 236
rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshugtsam gyis sgra bsgragasanas sa skya'i bstan pa bzungango zhes pa'i snyan pa thob nyurenas/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa nyang stod na bzhugs dus kho 'o dang lhan cig rtsod pa byed do zhes 'phrin yang yang bskur ro/ /de dus sa skya na rje yab sras kyis sa skya'i grub mtha' bkag go /zhes 'chal gtam phyogs bcug nus ldan du rlom pa'i brun po snying khams can dag gis gtor mgong yang 'phangs snang / gzhan yang kun bzang pas kyang tshe 'di'i rnyed bkur dang 'dod pa cung zad ma grub pas rje rin 4 che la mdo sngags kyi lam rim/ṭīk+ka kun gsan kyang dam tshig dang sdom pa ②ltar dor nas rje yab sras la ngan smras dang dgag khul gyi yi ge mkhas grub rin 4 cher bskur ba'i lan smra ba ngan pa 'thag par byed pa'i gnam lcags kyi gshor lo zhes pa brtsams te/ de yang rang gi rtags sbyongar rnams kyi khyab pa re re nas gzhags pas gsar gsum ga dngos su khas len dgos pa byung bar sa skya'i grwa ba rtog dpyod can dag gis gtor gsum ngan na smras pas/ngor pa na re/ skyon med/ chos can mi gcig 'dug gsungs pas/ dngor gyis bzhad gad byas pa/ nged kyi ngor pa kun dga' bzang ṭo 'de/ /lcang ra chos mdzad padang brtsad pa'i tshe/ /dngor gsum brgya phrag dngos 'gal byas na yang] /chos can mi gcig gsungs la gsesnal ba 'debs/ /byas pa da lta'i bar sadage sogs thams cad kyis med mor smra bar snang/ yangadedag gi skabs shig bdag 4 rab brtan pas mkhyen bzhin du nā len+d+ra nas chos rje rong po gdan drangs/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa dang rtsod pa mdzad par dril bsgrags shing/ mkhas grub rin 4 ches kyang zhal gyis bzhes pa'i grags pas chos sde rnams nas mkhas pa mang 4 dpang por lhags par gyur cingaddpal 'khor bde chen gyi gtsug lag khang gi ka gdung g.yas g.yon la/ mkhas grub rje dang /chos rje rong po gnyis kyi bzhugs gdanalang grangs mnyam mdzad/ rtsodadapang gi mkhas pa rnams la'ang de mthun gyi gdan bshams te/ gsol ja sogs sbyar grub nas rtsod par thag bcad pa'i 237
'jigs byed chos 'byung /tshe/ chos rje rong chen pa yang shan tu 'tshab lte/ gzims khang na stod g.yogs kyang med pa zhig mdzadanas bskor ba drag khu mdzad cing/ rgyud lam khang par yangayang 'phyon par mdzad ces thos te/ kho 'o cag gis sgro btags pa ma yin gyi/ de'i dus kyi slob ma thun mong ba dag gling bar grags/de nas chos rje rong chen pas sngar rang nyid kyis rtsod pa byed do zhes sgra bsgrags pas mi rtsod ces kyang gsung ma nus la/ rtsod par bsams pa'i tshenayang rang nyid byams chos la sbyangs pa cher mdzad pa ma gtogs/ gzhung lugs mtha' dag la ma spyangs shing] mkhas grub chen 4 'de ni mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i don thogs med du smra nus par yang mkhyen nas shin tu mdzad dka' la gtad pa'i dus su rong ston chos rje'i zugs la 'do lta bu yang shar snyam mosna/ /mkhas grub 'dis ni byis pa'i tshe na yangad paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal pham par byas zhes cas na/ da ni 'di'i blo phros kyi khyon la su zhig gis brgal bar nus/ kho bo ni paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis tsheg med par byas pa yin no snyam du nges par thugs la shar snyam ste/ mdor na da ni g.yo sgyu bya ba'i dus la babs kyi rtsod par mi nus so snyam du dgongs nas/mkhas grub rje la ni 'phrin bskur ba/ ngas khyod kyi bla ma rgyal tshab pa pham par byas zin gyi/ da khyod dang mi rtsod do zhes gsungs/der mkhas grub rjes bla ma rgyal tshab pa pham par byas ma byas rtsod yig yod pas rang re phrad nas ltab yin/ nga'i bla ma khyod kyis pham par ma byas kyi/ khyod kyi bla ma g.yag pa ngam ring tshogs su kho 'os pham par byas pa brjed pa yin nam/ kho 'o thag ring na gnas pa'i tshe rtsod pa byedado zhesakhang yang 'phrin bskuranas/ da rtsod mi nus pa ci byung bayin/de bsan mkhas pa'i rkang ma 'drin pard ltanyid du rtsod pas ma lasdol cig ces gsungs so/ /de ltar rgol ba'i dkyil dngor bshams pa la mngon du phyogs te/ tshogs dung 'bud par brtsams pa'i tshe/ chos rjerong 'odangon slob rnamasatabatab tu gyur te thog mar slob ma gcig btang nas/238
je bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshul/shin tu blun pa des tshig rtsub kyi mtshon gyis rgol ba'i dkyil 'khor bshams pa dkrug ste/mkhas grub pa rong ston chos rje'i rtsod zlar mi 'os zhes smras te thabs du ma zhig gi sgo nas rtsod mi dgos pa'i thabs la 'bad 'dug/mkhas grub rjes slar yang 'phrin bskur te/ yang na kha sang nas rtsod zeradon yang med/ da gnas rnyingadang zhwa lu nas rtsod dpang gi mkhas pa rnams kyang spyan drangs/ tshogs chen po 'dir phebs/ than gtsug lag khang du gdan bshams pa sogs kyang grub ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ spra ṭ+wāṃ ṭā /gh+nā spraX spra rnyi mi ṭhaṃ spripa r+sha ṭ+wāṃ sprirmi ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ༵ lha dī (dīs/ spri yab brdzu/ lhalha ñtsā zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar gsungs kyang chos rje rong pos da khyod dang mi rtsod do zhes na med la bud pa'i gsung byon te/ sngar rtsod pa byed do zhes 'phrin yang yang bskur ba thams cad rdzun gyi tshig tu tshos rje rong po nyid kyi bsgrags so//denas gtsug lag khang gi gdan bshams pa sogs rmi dī sdi (/ ༵ snang lha ma/ /lha dh+ri /sdu sprapa k+ṣiṃ ༵༵༵ hā ༷rnyi sbyi shā1 na ༵ /la skad 'don pa :theg ma27ga rigs kyi nus pa mi dman tshogs gnyis rin chen khams las grub/ /rnam dpyod mgyogs 'gro'i rta ljang gis drangs shes bya'i mkha' la thogs med cing] /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gos can ma lus rigs pa'i zer gyis snang byed pa/ /sngon med nam mkha'i nor bu de dang me khyer lhan cig ji ltar bgrong / /'on kyang rong skyes shākya yi/ /bstan la snang ba'i yid ldan zhing] /gshen rab gzhung lugs rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /pyis pa mkhas par rlom pa gang / /ring na gnas tshe kho 'odang] /lhan cig brgal lan bya'o zhes/ /gya gyu'i yid ldan drang srong gi /dmod pa'i tshig bzhin yang yang bsgrags/ /de nas nam zhig 'dir phyin tshe/ /zhum pa bzhin dang skrags pa bzhin/ /nongs pa bzhin dang 'grod pa bzhin/ /skyabs med bzhin du skyabs tshol byed/ /dpal 239
'jigs byed chos 'byung /ldan zla ba'i 'od dkar la/ /glag 'tshol 'dod pa'i mun can de/ /kho bo'i rigs tshul rdo rje yis/ /gzhom par bya zhes mngon du smras/ /bla ma'i legs bshad nyid byed zed /sgrib byed phrag dog rkang 'thung rgyas/ /nyes bshadanags tshal zhakhrigs pa khyod/ /da ltathal bar bya zhes smras/ /de tshe skrags pa'i yid ldan des/ /de dag bdag gis ma bkag ces/ /gtol med gyur ba'i tshig smra zhing] /rjun gyi khung bur yang yang bros/ /khrel yod ngo tsha'i gos dang bral/ /sdom pa'i ska rags lhod pa can/ /blun rmongs slob ma'i tshig ngan gyi/ /yol bas sgrib pa'i phag tu 'chel/ /phyogs 'dir mkhas pa'i bka' mchid dag/bya bar 'os pa min zhes pa'i/ /sbyin bdag tshig la skyabs bcas nas/ /bdag la bka' drin che zhes smras/ /lung rigs rlabs phreng rol pa can/ /sde chen rgya mtsho so so nas/ /mkhas pa gdengs can du ma dag /gnas 'dir dbang por lhags pa yangan /desas gang la mgon bcas pa/ /de nyid tshig gis rang rang gi /chu gter gnas su bskrad byas nas/ /rgol ba'i dkyil dngor rdzogs ma rgyud /'di ltar mngon du ma nus pa'i/ /zhum tshig smras pa dran byos ga/phyinas mkhas pa'i legs bshad la//lkog tungan smras ma byed ces//bdag gis gdams shing tshar bcad nas/ /bden min spru ba lhur len cing/ /ngo tshas gtol med gyur de dag/lug 'ong bzhin du mkhas rnams sgrogs/ /bder gshegs bstan pa gangs ri'i sul na gnas/ /gzhung lugs 'bum phrag ral ba'i khur gyis bajid/ /rigs pa'i mche lder mi bzad stobs ldan pa/ /mkhas mchog gdong lnga'i dbang 4 kho 'o tsam/ /dri med rigs pa'i gad rgyangs gcig gis kyang] /dregs ldan phas rgol glang 4 stong gi snying] /lkog mar phyin pa'i 'dzigs lter dge legs dpal/ /bzang 4 las gzhan smra ba'i seng ge gang / /zhes pa'i yi ge rgya sgo la sbyar zhing/rong stonadapon slob thal skad gcig pus kyangadapa' zhum zhing snang mdzadadang mi skyong palang shor ba ltar byas la/ 'jigs med grags pa rin po che'i bstod pa las/ rigs tshul gad rgyangs 240
rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshuggcig bsgrags pas/ /pha rol dud mo'i sa la brten/ /zhes dang / rtog gi rno ldan myur smra rnams/ /khrungad kyi mdun sar brgal lan gyi/ /gtam la zhugs tshe mgrin pa nas/ /rang dre(ga gis 'gag mi smra thob/ /ces so/ /de ltar na rgyang 〉sde pa ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'de gzhon nu'i dus nas mkhyen pa dang zugs rje nus mthu gang la'ang dpag par dka' ba'i rin 4 che dbang gi rgyal 4dang] phal pa'i mching bu'i khyad par mi shes pa'i brun po skal chad zhig ko snyam du dgongasanas/rtogs brjod las/ sangs rgyas las kyang dkon pa'i gdams pa mchog /ces pa nas/ mkhas pa bdag ni re ba lhur mi byed/ /ces gsungs nas/ dpen gnas ri 'o mdangs can du byon/thugs dam rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo sngags ma lus pa nyin re dang thun re bzhin du gdan 'og gcig tu nyams su bzhes par mdzad cing / sde snod 'dzin pa mtha' klas pa zhig lam de 'dra la gshod par mdzad/ mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba yongs la'ang de 'dra'i bdud mi'agyed pa'i thugs rje'i gdengs can dbang po'i zhal rlangs kyis khyab par mdzad pas dgongs pa ltar 'gro don dpag med lhun grub tu 'byung ba chos kyi ngang tshul g.yo bar mi 'gyur ro/ /mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos yang mang du rtsom par mdzad/ de'i tshe rgyang 〉pas bla ma 'di phyogs gzhan du thegs dogs nas nye gnas la lkog rngan gyi gser sogs mang du phul nas/ yar phebs su re ba rje 'dis mkhyen nas/ mche ba mi bzad sbar mo'i shugs 'chang ba/ /gangs ri 'dzin pa'i gdong lnga'i dbang yo de/ /lcags kyis bcings nas btsog chus 'tsho ba yi/ /sgo khyir 'dod pa mkhas pa'i bzhad gad yin/ /zhes gsungs nas ma phebs/ lcags phag gi 'tshar rgyal tshab rin 4 che/ gnas rnying du phebs par mjal du byon nas gser khrir phebs dgos pa'i zhal ta gnanganas phyag phyir ladzam gling gi snang byed mkhas pa'i nyi ma mched gnyis lhan dudakhus su phebs ban/ chos rgyal dudapen sha sku mched kyis/ rje yab sras gnyis la ji ltar gus 'dud mdzad pa bzhin du thub bstan ma 241
'jigs byed chos 'byung /lus pa'i bdag 4 dang bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog 'di yin no snyam du dad pa dang mos pas zhabs kyi pad+mo spyi gtsug gi rgyan du bkod pas skye dgu'i phan bde'i sgo brgya phye bar gyug de nas sngon sangs rgyas kyi dus nas da lta'i bar du 'dzam gling 'di la chos kyi sde chen 4 'de las bzang dang 'di lta bu dkon pa'i rgyan drug lta bu'i mkhas mang bye ba'i rol gnas dpal ldan 'bras spungs phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i glingadang/ dpal se ra theg chen gling gnyis su phebs pa'i tshe yang so sos ser sbreng dang tshogs pa zung gis chos 'brel zhus shing / rgya bod kyi gzhung bzang rtsa'agrel chen po brgya dang bdun cu'i zugs bshad mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs chos rjer grags pa bkra shis dpal ldan gyis gus pa'i phyag dang / rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' dang gzhung lugs rgya mtsho tsam gyi 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum mdzad cing zab mo'i ltab mnga' ba'i mtshungs med chos rje rgyan bzang pas sa gsum ma'i lung gi 'brel ba zhus/ de bzhin du gangs can gyi rdo rje gdan chen so/ sangs rgyas kyis mdo rgyud du ma nas lung bstan cing) srong btsan sgam 4 dang mkhas grub du mas byin gyis brlabs pa/ sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam chos skyong du ma'i sku brnyan rang byon gyis phyur bur gang ba'i gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du phebs pa'i tshe yang ser sbreng du ma zad/ shar nas 'phags pa'i gnas brtan rin chen rgyal mtshan zhes sngar bshad pa ltabu'iwenanatan gyis bod 'dir rgan pa chen podenang la 'phrang lhags su byon nas dar yug chen gcig rten du mdzad de phyag phul/ hor ston rin 4 ches dgon pa'i dkyil tsam du phebs nas phyag phul/ dge 'dun thams cad kyis kyang gtsang la myur du phebs dogs dbang lung rjes gnang mnangag sogs zhusanas zhal slob tu gyug lode la mos kyis mngon par mtho ba'i gser khri chen 4 la phebs te/ zhwa gser mdog sprungan pa'i rab byung bye ba phrag brgya sogs gling 'di'i mkhas grub ma lus pa'i gtsug rgyan du mdzes pa na/ rje bla ma'i gsung rab shing 242
rje bla ma yab sras nasabargyud chu la/rta chen 4 ma lus pa'i legs bshad kyi lha'i rnga 4 che'i sgra chen po sa gsum dang 'og min gyi bar du bsgrags pas dkar po'i sne rigs thams cad dar chen 'phyar cing / nag phyogs rnams ming gi lhag ma tsam du gyur pa'i snyan pas sa gsum khyab pa 'di las dang] spyir yang rin po che 'di'i rnam thar dran pas bdag ṭo rgyang rtsepa thugs 'gyod kyi bsreg za chen pos dus ring por gdung ba mi bzad pa byas pa yin snang] lar ni bdag 4 'di yang / 'od kyi blun 4 snying khams can ltar cang mi shes pa ni/ mkhas grub rje la rdo rwa gur dang 'grel na gur du mi 'gyur ram dris shing/ de ltar blun yang dus lha'or gyi cho ga 'ga' brtsams skad/ sngags shes pa la ji 'dra dgos mi shes par 'dug /'di 'dra 'od na mang] de la smras pa/ sa bdag mkhyen yangs grags kyang tshul 'di 'dras/ /nogadang lkog shal rwa rnams mi ldan kyang/ /dud nas mi 'gro ya so ldan pa'i phyugs/ /yin par rnam dpyod ldan rnams mthun par gling] /zhes bya'o/ /der ma zad da lta'i bar du rtsam pa chus brdzis pa/ lcags zhos 'gyogs pa dang / dge 'dun la grangs lhag pa byung na chad pa gcod pa sogs rten 'brel ma legs pa dang / bkren rtags de 'dra mang 4 btsugs pa de legs shos su rlom par snang la/ thos bsam gyi skad cha sgra mi grags pa byas 'dug pas blun pa la ang snyam pa mkhas par 'char te mang yang phyugs bro bas de tsam gyis/ de yang sku che ba'i yon tan phyogs tsam smras na/ bka' bstan chos kyi 'byams bshad mdzad pa'i dbang du byas na/ shing rta chen ṭo 'ogs med dang sangs rgyas gnyis pa kun mkhyenadabyig gnyen chos mngon pa 'chad pa la zhugs pa lta bu ste/ kha ba ri ba mtha' dag gis 'gran du med pa'i smra ba'i khyu mchog bla na med par gyur pa/mang thos 'tshogs pa'i mdun sar rtsod pa mdzad pa'i dbang du byas na/ phyogs glang chos grags mu stegs kyi ston pa 'groms pa la zhugs pa lta bu ste/ gzhon nu nas paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal dang / mkhan chen g.yag pa dang / thal skad tsam gyis kun mkhyen rong po sogs dngos 243

rje bla mayab sras nas brgyud tshul/mang du btab ste/ mdog chu'i lhor spangs yul chos sde dang/ chu de'i byang du gsang sngags pho brang btab cing / mus su chos sde btab pa'i chos lung shar ni/ lung dga' ldan par 'gril lo/ /nang rtsadang rlung gi rten 'brel gyis phyi'i rgya 'od ñtsha yul thams cad gzigs pa dang / rang gzhan gyi tshe rabs du ma dran pa dang / yum gshegs par mkhyen nas gangs bu le nas mnga' ris stod mang yul la snga dro phyed kyis sleb nas yum la chos gsungs shing / mang yul 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi nye gshor deg gsang 'dus dmar khrid/ dkyil chog /sgrub thabs/ dbang gi bshad pa sogs dang / rdo rje lajegs byed kyi bskyed rim phul du byung ba dang / rnal 'byor bzhi'i zin brisadang] rtsagasum bsrung ba'i gdams pa khyad 'phags sogs du ma mdzad pa deng dus kyang yig cha phyogs kun tu dar zhing / mkhas grub rje'i skye ba snga ma phal cher yang 'dis mngon shes kyis gzigs shing / mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i zugs rjes gzigs pa'i slob mar snang lte/ 'di'i mkhas grub rje'i gsang ba'i rnam thar gyi lung rkarma zhwa dmar ba sogs kyis kyang tshad grub mdzad pa dang lung wen mdzad cing] de bzhin du rang phyogs rje btsun pa dang bsod grags pa sogs dang / phyis kyi mkhar nag dang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen 4 sogs snga sgyi du mas kyang byed/ mgon po'i chos skor ci rigs mdzad pa sogs yod/( bla ma don grub dpal par/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas dgon pa thob ces rang nyid la rjes gnang ba'i thub pa klu 'jim ma gnang ste/ nang pa tsha ba grub pas sbyin bdag mdzad de/ri sa chos gling btab cing nang so 'phyong rgyas pas gdan drangs nas ri bo'i gdan sa mdzad pa'i steng nas thun mong ba'i lam rim dang / thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi chos mang du gsungs pas sa'i thig le yar klung phyogs su deng sang yang rje'i bstan pa'i gnad shugs la mnga' ba'i mkhas pa dang dge 'dun mang ba 'di/ bla ma 'di'i phyag rjes yin snangaka255
