rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyudatshug༈ de la chos rje legs pa rgyal mtshan ni/ srin 4 zhes pa shing mo yos la gtsang zhwa lur zhakhrungs/ rje 'dul 'dzin 'khungs pa'i phyi lo dang] mkhas grub rje las lo bcu bsgras/ zhwa lur rab tu byung zhing / zhwa lu grags pa rgyal mtshan dang] shangs pa kun mkhyen bsten nas mdo rgyud mang sor sbyangs nas mkhas par rgyud rje'i zhabs phyir yun mthud de byon/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang] sras kyi shu 4 gnyis dang] mkhas grub rin 4 che/ bla ma bzang skyong ba/ shar ba rin 4 che sogs la mdo sngags kyi gsung rab khrid gsan grang mang du mdzad pas yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen du gyur ba yin te/ mkhas grub rin po ches kyang brtag gnyis kyi ṭīka chen du shar ba rin ṭo che tsam las ma gsungs la/ 'di la 'dzings kyi bshes gnyen chen 4 gsungs pas shes la/ des na dga' ldan chos 'byung du/ snang tshul la mkhyen rab ha cang che bar ma grags kyang gsungs pa/ 7do'i rnam thar zhib par ma gsan pa'i rtags kho nar snang der ma zad sngar gyi dga' ldan gyi gdan rabs dag las kyangad mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug chen 4ra gyur cing]zhes pa sogs tshad ldan lung rigs las grub rgyo/ /de yang dga' ldan du/ dbu mdzad gnang pa'i skabs na dag ba rnam brgyad kyis rje'i gsol thab kyang mdzad pas mnyes pa kho nar snang/ mkhyen brtsemathu nus shin tu che bas rje rin po ches kyangaka nam zhig chos sku gcig tu ma gyur bar pungas khyod kyi bshes gnyen byed pa yin no/ /zhesadabugs dbyung ba sogs yod pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub dang] rje blo gros chos skyong lta bu la gdan sar phebs ma zhus pag grwa dgon dka' bzhi ba dang 'dul nag pa sogs mkhas grub mang pos gdan sar bzhugasara'i gse la pa btab ste/ rang lo drug cu rtsalnga ba sa mo lug la gdan sar phebs/ lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du tshogs pa bskyangs shing/ rje rin po che'i rdo rje la)gas byed skor kunadang] khyud par man ngag gsum gyi gdams pas skal ldan gyi mkhas grub du ma smin par mdzad pa yin te/ srang rdo rje 257
'jigs byed chos 'byung /'chang gi zhal nas/ 'dul nag pa semags mkhas grub rin po cher dus 'khor ṭīka chen gsan cing / mar me'i yig chung gcig gsan/ mkhas grub rin po che gshegs pa dang] zhwa lu ba chen 4 khrir bskos shing / drug cu pa'i rtsatshig dang gdams pa mtha' dag gsan gsungs la/ dge 'dun yang chos la)ga rten gnyis gas bskyangs pas dge 'dun gyi dar rgyas dang) longs spyod kyi 'du long yang 'di kho na'i dus che bar las chen kun rgyal gsungs/ gser thog gi 'phro yang lados grub par mdzad cingan mkhas shing grub pa'idabang phyug yin pa'i don gyis sde snod 'odzin pa chen po rnams kyang je gus je gus dngaka sa 'bri'i mi bsrun pa rnams la'ang mthu zlog gi rtags mtshan che ba bstan cing tshar bcad pas/ mi bsrun pa'i skye 'o rnams kyang je skrag je skrag tu song nas bzhugs gdan seng ge'i r+ṇi non nges byung bar thams cad gling / gser thog gi lugs phud la gzims khang lhasnad du/ pad+ma mkhar bas gsang bde dus gshor gsum gyi gser sku mi tshad tsam re bzhengs/ de dus lcags zam pas brag ral gyi lcags zam 'dzugs par dge ldan tshogs pas lda'i dang blangs mdzad/ sne'u gdong ba dang] 'phyong rgyas pa'i nang so tshe brtan pa thug dus nang sosadamag rgyab kyi sku bsrung phyag mdud zhus shing bzhes nas dmag la byone nas/ grog spub gcig la bkar dus phyag phyi gcig gis rta la mdung ring rgyab pas pha rir 'phyong nas srog la ma skyon/ srung bas skyab par grags/ 'phyong rgyas par bu ma byung ba la/ so sor 'brang ma'i sgo nas srid bskyed pas bu byung nas de'i gdung brgyud la sku gong ma lnga ba chen po phebs/ sku gong mas kyang / mthu stobs dbang snyog zhwa lu ba zhes bsngags brjod mdzad/ zhal bzhugs pa'i bar du 'phyong rgyas bas na bza' dang dpon slob thams cad la phog zla ngo bzhin mdzad/ rang lo don drug pa lcags rta hor zla drug pa'i nyer bzhi la chos kyidabyings su thim dus gser gyi me tog gi char babs/ zhugs su phul bas dbu klad la rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par 258
rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshul/byon pa dngul gdung gi nang gi rten du bzhugs te/ rgya gur nang na chos rje chos grags bzang po'i dngul gdung gi g.yas na bzhugs/ gshegs nas kyang chos kyi bshes gnyen pa yan la/ 'phyong rgyas nas dbyar dgun gnyis lngar khri thog tu su bzhugs la na bza' cha tshang re dang / nyer bzhi chen po'i mang ja/ sha skam gyi zug pa sogs chags med du yod la/ deng dus kyang dus mchod tsam yod/ de nas da lta'i rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing rte) bar la lo sum brgya dang nyer lnga lasas shing/ nyer drug pa shing rta 'di lags so/ /༈ de'i rjes su chos rje blo gros chos skyong ni/ sa mo sbrul la gtsang g.yag sder zhakhrungs/mkhas grub rje 'khungs pa'i lo lnga ba yin/ tshogs pa dge 'dun sgang ba la rab tu byung bas stan gcig pa byed/ rje yab sras gsum ka dang] khyad par mkhas grub rje bsten nas gsung rab la sbyangs pas mdo sngags kyi gsung rab la rigs pa'i rtsal can pa'i mkhas par gyug dge ldan gyi gdan sa mi mdzad dgongs nas mtshan mo zos byon pas/ bka' bsrung gi 'khran gyis chu mig mgron lha can gyi gzham du zhabs bsnyunganas phebs ma thub pas spyan drangs te/ rang lo drug cu rtsagnyis pa lcags pho rta nas chu lug gi bar lo bcu gsum gdan sa mdzad de/ lam rim che chung /bla ma lnga bcu ba/ 4lhung rnam bshad che chung] rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog bdun dang]rtog pa gsum pa dang/ rwa lo'i shog dril gsum/ dus pa'og 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rdzogs dang bcas pa/ brtag gnyis ṭīk+ka dang] 'dod lasdo/ rgyud bla ma sogs mdo sngags kyi chos lubor bskor bas/slob ma yang rje yab sras kyis gsal bar brton pa'i dus kyi gshor lo'i bshad srol rnam dag shub pa'i mkhas dbang chos grags pa/ rgyud chen 'jam dbyangasadage 'dun 'phel/ rab 'byams pa smon lam dpal ba/ 'phags pa ma grub chen chos grags pa/ 'jamadabyangs gzhon nu/ mkhas pa nor bzang rgya mtsho'i dpal sogs byung1 'dis mtshod khang gsar ma btab/ ston pa'i gser 259
'jigs byed chos 'byung /sku chen mo dang] dngul gdung chen po gcig bzhengs pa bzhugs/ de nas ba so ba khrir bkod de/zur bzhugs mdzad de gshegs/ de la mkhas pa chos grags dang] rje nor bzang gnyis kyis sgrub pa lhur blangs pas zhwa ser sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan mthon po 'og min par du bsgreng bar mdzad la/ rtsis kyi yi ge pad dkar zhal lung ma bu khyad par can 'di bskrun/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rtogs pa'ang grags che bzhin par chos grags dben gnas der gshegs/ nor bzang ba yangaka bshes gnyen du mar gsan spyongadang] rje blo gros chos skyong la rje'i gsung rab mtha' dag zin bris tshun chad gsan pas/ chos rje mkhan 4 paṇa chen shākya shris las slob/ rong ston blo bzang pas gsang ston mdzadade bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ bshad nyan gyi zhu ba 'gyul mi kha shas byung yang ma mdzad pas/dri 〉〉 sprapa spri k+ṣiṃ ༈ pazlo (sdi stsuzlo k+ṣiṃ n+dha dī shāla~X sprur+sha sdu shārmo gh+nā sna(sra 'dzin zab mo mngon du gyur cing] 'jam dbyangs dkar 4 pad+ma'i mtshor zhal gzigs pa/ thag ring 'onas sgra gsan pa sogs grub pa'i mtshan rtags mang/ legs bshad kyi rtsom pa yang/ dus lha'or kyi sbyo don legs pa/ rtsis kyi yig cha mang po/ gsang 'dus kyi bskyed rdzogs/ dbu ma'i stakhrid che chung sogs mdzad/ gtso sor slob ma mi skyong yang] thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshor gdams pa rgyas par gnang/ slob dpon thos 'dzin padang] slobadapon chen po gun rgyal ba/ bshes gnyen grwa'odaka' bcu sogs bstan pa 'di la gzhan dang mi mnyam pa'i dge bshes du mar bka' drin mdzad de/ mthar dgu bcu rtsagacig bzhes nas chu mo bya'i lo hor zla drug pa'i nyer lnga la dben gnas der mya ngan las 'das/ de'i tshe nam mkha' la 'ja' gur dang] me rtog gi char chen po bab cing / gdung la ring bsrel mang du byon zhing] gdung thal las bzhengs pa'i sku 'dra la deng dus kyang ring bsrel skal ldan gyis gsol pa btab na 'byon par snangaka260
rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshug༈chos rje ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni/ sna tshogs zhes ba chu pho rta ma gtsang ldog gzhung gumkhas grub rje'i gcung 4ra zhabrungs/rjekhab sras kyi zhabs la gtugs te mdo sngags la skyangs/dang por gsang phur ra ba smad pa'i 'chad nyan zhig mdzad pa bor nas lhan ba so bzung bas ba so bar grags/gdams pa zugs nyams su bstar bas thun mong ma yin pa'i bde stong gi rtogs pa thugs la 'khrangs/ de nas thugs dam dang 'gro don 'phel ba'i skabs su/ chos rje blo gros pa'i rjes su gdan sar thams cad mkhyen padage 'dun grub pa spyan 'dren du btang ba na/ 'am bu lade las re che 'bab/ 'am busadagra mkhar dgra bo'i yul du brtsigadagos/ zhes gsungasanas rje 'di nyid la lung bstan mdzad pa ltar gdan drangs/dga' ldan du phebs lam bkra shis lhun por thams cad mkhyen pa dang mjal/ de dus thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ khyed rje'i gdan sar phebs paranged phyag mdzad pas phyag lan ma gnang gsung] dgung lo 3 gnyis pa chu lug la gdan sar phebs/ mdo sngags kyi chos mang du gsungs/ zhar la dus dngor bskyed rdzogs dang] 'jigs byed rdzogs rim dang / dbu ma'i lta khrid chen mo/ snying 'o don gsum gyi khrid sogs legs par mdzad/ dga' ldan 'du khang la dri gtsang khang btod de/ rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ro'i gser sku ya mtshan can dang / gang nas gong ma na rim gyi sku 'dra yang bzhengs bzhugs su gsol bar mdzad cing / de yang dge lugs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan brgyud kyi yig chung nyer gcig che ba dang / dz+nyān kuṭi ste ye shes tshemos 'od gsal lha khang du zhus nas bskyed rdzogs gnyis lnga'i man ngag yig chung nyer gcig chung ba dang bcas pa mdzad cing / da lta'i bar du rang gzhan gyi mkhas pa dang grub chen du mas zugs nis mdzad pa 'di yin/ rje 'di dbe+en sa sprul ba'i glegs bam gyi gdul bya'i gtso 'or snang zhes rgyal ba dbe+en sa ba gsungs la/ rje 'dis grub chen chos rdo rje/ dpal ldan rdo rje/ stod lung ba rdo rje dpal ba gsum la byin zhes gsungs pas 261
'jigs byed chos 'byung /glegs bam yang gsum 81da pa ltar snang la/ snga ma gnyis grags che/ de la thegags pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i mdzad pa bskyangs pa'i dngor lo bzhi ldan gyi dge grang dngan mkhas pa mang po pad+ma'i mtsho la ra yig gnyis pa bzhin du dngor zhing / thugs dad pas 64na tan gyis bsngags pa'i klu dbyangs ba so tshos rje zhes snyan grags kyi dbyar rnga'ang skad gsang mthon por ldir ldir grags pas dbus gtsang drenags khyab pa'i mod la/ rlung gi rgyu tshul log pa mkhyen pas kun spangs mdzad de/ chos rje slo gros brtan pa gdan sar bzhugs su gsol te/ don gnyis pa chu sprul gyi lo'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga la dga' ldan byang gling du zhi bar gshegs/ zhes gdan rabs las bshad pa 'thad dam/ r+ṇi rin po che 'od zer gyis bcu bzhi gsungs pa'ang chad lhag gis yin 'gro/ /dgung zhag gi ring 'od gsal du bzhugs shingan dgun dus su me tog gi char ba la sogs pacad ra/tshar pa'i ltas khyad par du 'phags pa byon par chos 'byung dang gdan rabs dang ngag rgyun la grags che/ thugs rten gyi dngul gdung ni/ rje zhwa lu ba'i dngul gdung gi g.yas na bzhugs/ de'i sku'i skye ba'i rabs ni/ ba so sprul sku lha dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ de'i skye ba rta ṭ+wāṃ pa/ snabaspri (lha k+ti dīsna rnyi ṭ+wāṃ /pa dzopa zloXhā paX /rdzu mchi/ 9 snarnyi lha ༵ ༵ r+ṣi / rī ༈ gsum dang / ngam pa gsum dang / rgyud pa sbyin pa dpal/ se ra rje btsun pa sogs byung ba las/lta grub chen chos rdo khus 'ja' lus brnyes pa yin te/ rje ba so pa phyi skor la phebs dus/yab yum dang lhan du khams phrug byis pa gzhon nu gcig gis dad dad byas pas skal ldan yin pa thugs kyis dgongs nas rab tu byung zhing / mtshan chos kyi rdo rjer btags/ gsung chos gdams pa zab mo du mas smin par byas te/ sprul ba'i glegs bam rin po che rna ji mched gsum la gsungs shing / dzo mo lha ri sogs gtsang phyogs kyi gnas du ma dang / rgyal ba blo bzang don 262
'jigs byed chos 'byung /glegs bam yang gsum yod pa ltar snang la/ snga ma gnyis grags che/ de la sesnags pa'i bstan pa rin 4 che'i mdzad pa bskyangs pa'i dkor lo bzhi ldan gyi dge grang dang] mkhas pa mang po pad+ma'i mtsho la ra yig gnyis pa bzhin du gshor zhing / thugs dad pas yon tan gyis bsngags pa'i klu dbyangs ba so chos rje zhes stan grags kyi dbyar rnga'ang skad gsang mthon 4ra ldir ldir grags pas dbus gtsang sogs khyab pa'i mod la/ rlung gi rgyu tshul log pa mkhyen pas kun spangs mdzad de/ chos rje blo gros brtan pa gdan sar bzhugs su gsol te/ don gnyis pa chu sbrul gyi lo'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga la dga' ldan byang gling du zhi bar gshegs/ zhes gdan rabs las bshad pa 'thad dam/ khri rin po che 'od zer gyis bcu bzhi gsungs pa'ang chad lhag gis yin 'gro/ /dgung zhag gi ring 'od gsal du bzhugs shing] dgun dus su me tog gi char ba la sogs pa ngo ra/tshar pa'i ltas khyad par du 'phags pa byon par chos 'byung dang gdan rabs dang ngag rgyun la grags che/ thugs rten gyi dngul gdung ni/ rje zhwa lu ba'i dngul gdung gi g.yas na bzhugs/ de'i sku'i skye ba'i rabs ni/ ba so sprul sku lha dbang tshos kyi rgyal mtshan/ de'i skye ba rta tshag sprul sku ngag dbang chos kyi dbang phyug bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang/ de'i skye ba ngag dbang dgon mchog nyi ma dang] de'i skye ba'i bar du'o/ /chos rje de nyid la sras rdo rje mched gsum dang / ngam pa gsum dang] rgyud pa sbyon pa dpal/ se ra rje btsun pa sogs byung ba las/lta grub chen chos rdo khus 'ja' lus brnyes pa yin te/ rje ba so pa sgyi skor la phebs dus/yab yum dang lhan du khams phrug byis pa gzhon nu gcig gis dad dad byas pas skal ldan yin pa thugs kyis dgongs nas rab tu byung zhing / mtshan chos kyi rdo rjer btags/ gsung chos gdams pa zab mo du mas smin par byas te/ sprul ba'i glegs bam rin po che lda ྅ mched gsum la gsungs shing / jo mo lha ri sogs gtsang phyogs kyi gnas du ma dang / rgyal ba blo bzang don 262
rje bla ma yab sras nas brgyud tshuggrub glegs bam gyi gdul byar lung bstan mang bas/ dus 'di tsam na len par shugag gsungs nas 'ja' lus brnyes/ dpal ldan rdo rje'ang de dang 'dra ba gcig lte/ lho brag grub chen gyi slob ma ste/ rnam thar rgyas pa ma mthong] rgyal ba badrend nams rgya mtshos 'ja' lus brnyes pa'i dpal ldan rdo rje la tshe dbang zhus par gzhu khang pa'i gsung rgyun dngaka mkhar nag sogs gsungs/༈de la gtsang gi khyung 4 dge 'dun bzang 4 ni/ me bya la khyung po'i rigs su zhakhrungs/ rin so che ba'i dgung lo nyir gcig pa yin/ dbus su byon nas rin sa che ba'i drung du mdo sngags kyi chos mang po 'phral 'phral nyams su bzhes par mdzad/ de nas gtsang du/ rje dge 'dun grub yab sras la lam rim zhus te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po phu chung ba bzhin du skye 'os dben pa'i yul ldongs mang por bsgoms pas mngon par rtogs pa mthon sor brnyes shing rgyas pa'i gshis kyis snyan pa lhas sgrogs pa'i dpe ltar snyan grags 'ur nas/ gnas rnying rin 4 che khu dbon dang/bdag chen serdzogs dang] 'phags pa serdzogs bla chen dang / mi chen mang po'i gtsug gis zhabs kyi pad+mo la reg cing / skya ser grangs med 'dus par las 'bras zab mo'i chos kyi char phabs pas/sa thul rdo thul gyi rnam pas/ rab byung rnams bslab pa la gces sbras dang / khyim pa rnams dge sdig gi blang dor la nan tan byed par song bas/ bya btang sems dpa' chen po zhes mtshan gyis kyang dad pa'i spu long g.yo bar gyus mtharadon dgu bzhes pa shing mo yos lango mtshar ba'i ltas bstan te/ gnas rnying gi rgyab rir mya ngan las ladas/ de nas da lta'i shing rta'i bar lo nyis brgya dang re bdun song / sku gdung bzhugs pa'i rten bzhengs ni/ chos rje lan+dam dpal snying po dpon slob kyis mdzad snang]༈dbus kyi khyung po bya bral dge legs bshes gnyen ni/ nyo ba'i sa'i char rong bo'i rigs su sku 'khrangs/ dbus su phyon nas se 'bras gsang gsum du mdo phyogs la gnas pa rgya cher 263
'jigs byed chos 'byung /mdzad cing/rin 4 che ba so ba la gsang sngags kyi tshos mang 4'ang gsan/denas mdo khams la shāspya dh+ri twā ji]shā hūm̐ r+sha// shā ṭ+wāṃ pa/lha/ ((sna k+ta rnyi| hūm̐ shā k+ṇi shā k+ti nā/༵ n+t+wa /'i dze+e k+ti mirnyi spra rin 4 che lan cig thob pa 'dedon med du g.yengs na ci rung gsungasanas/ dang por mal gro'i tshul khrims dri ldang dang/ phyis skam brag tu bsam gtan gyi bras la rtsegacig tu rol par mdzad bas/ slob dngon klu sgrub zhal gzigs ba dang] shun mong pa stong nyid sogs/ thun mong ma yin pa lam rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa bzang 4 du ma bsam pa bzhin zugs la 'khrungs nas/ gsung mgur las/ gnas mi med khyi med kyi lung stong pu /nga pha med ma med kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /lus dpon med g.yog med 'dug lugs gsal/ /sems spros bral stong pa'ingang du nyal/ /mi gzhan dag gis sku gzugs 3 ru bzhengs/ /nga rnal 'phyor gyis sku gzugs nang du bzhengs/ /blo myur mgyog gi lha bzo klubs shing yod/ /byon gang legs kyi ltad mo lta rgyu yod/ /ces gsungs pa ni gdengs tshad bla med thob pa'i gsung ste/ phar phyin theg par mthong lam ma thob bar du spros bral mi yong bar ma zad/ sngags kyi bskyed rim la'ang spros bral mi 'ong na rgyud sde 'og ma'i so skye lta ci smos la/ sems dbe+en bas rang bzhin brgyad cu dang kun rtog brgya rtsabargyad dang rlung brgya rtsabrgyad thim pa'i mnyam bzhag la spros bral rjes mthun pa 'ong bas de yan chad thob pa'i gsung red la lhaskuyang pyi'i min par gsungs pas/ rgyud sde 'og ma dang bskyed rim gyi lngasku min zhing]sku gzugs nang nas bzhengs zhes sgyu lus man chad la dkyogs bshad tsam yang mi zub pas sgyu lus thob pa'i gsung red pas de'i yon tan shes mkhas rnams dad pas sems rang dbang med par 'phyog par 'gyug rje rin 4 ches la la'i khar mang du 'gro zhing / zhes dang / brgyad cu ma las/ 'ga' yis ma thob la las cung zad rtsungang] /phal cher tshim par gzigs/ zhes pa'i 264
rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshugskal ldan 'jig rten gsum gyi rin 4 che yin snang bas/ kho 'o'ang lag pa'i pad+ma yang yang zum par gyur te/ bdag kyang skal ba bzang por gyur cig snyam pa lags/ 'phral gyi mdzad pa rnam thar ni/ gsung rab kyi 'phel gtam la snyad pa ma gtogs/ mkhas pa su la yang gsung chos gsung ba'i ming mi 'dog/gsang sngags kyi 'dral gtam mi mdzad cing]rdo dril bgrang phreng phyag mtshan sogs gang yang phyir mi mngon/ chos dang mi mthun pa'i skya ser gyi gsung gleng byung ba na bka' bkyon che che ltar mdzad/ sdom pa gong ma blangs pa dang / thos pa mang mang 4 la bsngags pa mi mdzad pas dge tshul gyi rten bzung nas nyams len byed pa kho na la dgyes/ nged rang dge ldan pa/ khong bka' brgyud pa dngan sa skya pa zhes chos grub mtha'i thugs rus gzhan dang mi mnyam pa ltar mdzad pa zhig ste/ mtharadagung lo brgyad cu rtsa'on pa nadapen gnas de nyid pu dgos pa'i dbang gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ltar myangan las 'das pa'i tshul mdzad/ ya mtshan pa'i ltas mang la/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba dang / gdung la 〈 khu rnal 'phyor ma'i sku dang ring bsrel mang du byon pa da lta nyi ldings na bzhugs yod par snang]༈gnas rnying rin 4 che kun dga' bde legs rgyal mtshan dpal bzang 4 yang de dang cha mtshungs pa'i skal ldan bdud rtsimang du bzhes pa gcig yin te/ de yang me pho stag la la stod du yab rgyal mtshan rin 4 che'i sras su zhakhrungs shing se radonawend pa las lo gcig gis 'tshes shing] rje dge 'dun grub la thun mong pa phar phyin theg pa'i gzhungadang/ ba so rin ṭo che la theg pa chen po'i gsang sngags skorayig chungadang bcas pa zhib tu zhus pas/ thugs mos kyang mchog tu che ba 'khungs pa ste/ kho so la gnas rnying pa'i rigs su skyes snyam pa'i rlom pa ni ye med/ ba so chos rje'i grwa pa yin snyam pa'i khengs pa ni 〈snad/ ces gsungs pa yin snang/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pas mkhan po dang / chos rje 'dul dkar pas las slob gnang nas bsnyen par rdzogs 265
'jigs byed chos 'byung /pa'ang mdzad/ de nas gnas rnying gi gdan sa chen por phebs te/ byang chub lam rim la 〈snags zlo/ ṭ+wāṃ sta jidzi tsho ༵ 〉〉 lha/ dī lhag/ shā spra/༷/ ñtsha k+ṣiṃ r+sha spra dhī rnyilha ṭ+wāṃ spri| pas/ dī dzi~X bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad pa'i mod la/ chos rje 'jam dpal snying po khri thog tu bton nas/nyid rang zugs dam gong 'phel gyi dgongs pas 'gol sa snyegs pa khang gnyer gzhis kha sne'u nas spyan drangs par/ nang so sku mched kyis zog drangs/ skyed shod kyi rab byung skye bo'i tshogs mang po'i don mdzad cing / dwa bsgrengs dang / dge ldan mjal bar phebs pa na'ang] gus pa dang ldan pa'i dge 'dun rnams gsung chos kyis tsham par mdzad/ skyed 77da du bzhugs dus de khar nub gcig mnal lam du gnas rnying gi rgyab ri la/ rje btsun sa paṇa gyi sku 'dra 'bur du dod pa zhig gzigs pa rmis pas/ slo bur du gtsang la bteg ste/ gnas rnying gling gi kho ra khor yug tu rje yab sras kyi mtshan rnams rdo la bris nas/ bstan pa ring du gnas pa dang gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrig par mdzad/ slar dbus su byon nas sne'u nang rtso dpon blon gyis gus mchod sngar bzhin mdzad/ 'od gangs can gyi rgyal ba'i nyin byed bdun gyi gnyis pa thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen 4 dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rdo rje bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mkhan 4'ang gnang bas sa'i steng ma lus par deng dus bar du mkhan brgyud 'di kho nas khyab par gyur pas/ nag phyogs re gnyis kyis dkrug bsams kyang slar ches cher 'phel bar gyur to/ /mkhyen brtser ma zad nus mthu yang dga' ldan pu dngul gdung chen mo'i mdun du mchod pa rgyas par bshams shing bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i smon lam dang / mgon khang rtso sor phebs dus bstan pa 'di la sdang ba'idagra bgegs brlag pa'i 'phrin las bcol ba sogs mdzad pa ltar chos skyong rnams kyang mdzad pa zhig ste/ tshe bdag grub pa'i gnub kyi gdung rabs pyi ma 'ga' zhig dang 'gras 266
rje bla ma yab sras nas brgyud tshulpa ring po ma lon par pho brgyud rtsad nas brlag par mdzad la/ bu mo gcig lus pa snying rjes bzhag pa rgya nag tu sngags pa'i rab gra byas pas de ma thag 'od du yong lam nas gshor gyis bcom par mdzad la/ da lta'i 'di dag lho nas rus gcig tsam kyi mi/ dus phyis blangs par srad rdo rje 'chang gsung / slar yang gtsang la phebs te/ gnas rnying ri phug tu thugs dam 'phel bar bzhugs/ sku che ba'i 〈snan tan yang zugs skyo shas nges 'byung che bas/ mi ma rung pa ci 'dra zhig kyang blo sna bsgyur nus pa/ sdom pa gsum gyi tshul khrims mchog tu gtsang ba dang / de'i dri ngad zhim pos tsan dan gyi dri bzang po yang zil gyis gnon pa/ byang chub kyi sems rin 4 che 'gyongs pas gzhan sdug bsngal ba gsan pa na/ sku lus 'dar ba dang spyan chab ngang gis 'byung ba/ gsang sngags kyi gdams pas thugs rgyud gtams par mdzad pa ma gtogs/ snod min la dus nam yang mi 'doms pas/ rje btsun tsong kha ba chen po'i bstan pa kho na zugs la bcangs nas ci phan mdzad pa serdzogs ngo mtshar mchog tu che ba zhig lte/ mthar dgung lo nga gcig pa me pho 'brug la ri phug tu gshegs/ bya btang chen 4 gshegs pa'i pyi lo yin/ de nas da lta'i shing rta'i bar la lo nyis brgya dang re drug song/ ya mtshan pa'i rtags su dbu thod la thub dbang gi sku dang / bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sku gsal bor byon/ de'i dpon lajam dpal snying po dang / de'i dbon rin 4 che rdo rje ba gnyis kyang rin 4 che'i rnam par thar pa ji lta ba bzhin skyong zhing bstan pa 'di'i rgyan du che ba re byung ste/ snga ma dgung lo sum cu ma zin tsam dang] phyi ma sum cu can pa na gshegs/ snga ma'i tshems la dung g.yas 'khyil ring bsrel gyis brgyan pa dang / phyi ma'i zhun thig la gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs byon/ des na rje zhwa lu pa dngakarje blo gros chos skyong dang / ba so chos rgyan dang/ rje sher seng bzhi gang rung la ma brgyud pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang lung rgyud 'grel pa 'grel bshad bskyed rdzogs dag mi snangad rje 'dul 267
'jigs byed chos 'byung /pa 'odzin panas kyang gzhan la brgyud pa'idabang sogs yod pas rje 'dul 'edzinadang rje sher seng gnyis kyi rnam thar mtshon pa re bshad na/༈rje'i sras kyi thub 'o gnyis pa 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen 4 grags pa rgyal mtshanani/dbus stod sbrang du kun dga' zhes pa shing pho stag la zhakhrungs/ rje rin po che zhakhrungs nas lo bco brgyad dang/ rgyal tshab rje zhakhrungs nas bcu gcig song ba'i lo 3 yin/ 'bri khung nyer gnyis pa la chos gsan cing] brag tshan du 'dul bar sbyangs/ sngags kyi bla ma yang kha yar bsten nas/ bu ston gyi gzhung mtha' dag mkhyen par mdzad/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs la gtugs te yun ring du bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos mang du gsan pas sde sdod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la mkhas ba'i rtsal thon cing] lung rtogs kyi yon tan mtha' yas par dbang 'byor/ byang chub kyi sems dang 'dul ba'i bslab pa phra mo nas kyang bsrung bar mdzad/ rje 'dul 'dzin par rje'i bu slob chen po rnams kyis kyang chos gsan/ bslab bya chen mo gsung dus/ rje rin pho ches 'dul 'dzin 'de lta bu rgya gar nalangadakon zhes bsngags pa mdzad/ bla ma chen po 'dis rang nyid kyis gdan sa ma mdzad par rje rin yo che'i dgongs pa dang lung bstan dang mthun par rgyal tshab rin ṭo che gdan sar mnga' gsol/ sku gdung rin po che ma nyams par tsan dan 'ba' zhig las grub pa'i sgom du bzhugs su bcug /de yang dngul n+d+ra chen bco brgyad las grub pa'i gdung khang gi bum par bzhugs su gserdzol te/ gtsug lag khang gi slo 'bur byang mar bzhugs nas mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod par mdzad pa la sogs pa'i bya ba rnams rdzogs par mdzad nas rgyal tshab rin 4 ches dga' ldan nyid du chos kyi rgyal srid bskyangs/ 'dul 'edzin rin 4 ches btsun mo tshal gyi dgon pa btab nas tshogs pa bskyangs pas dge 'dun brgyad brgya lhag tsam 'dus/res 'ga' spangs sogs dgon gnas dang / ri 'od gzhan du'ang bzhugs te 'gro don dang 268
rje bla ma yabasras nas brgyud tshugzugs dam 'phel par mdzad/ skabs shig tu tshal gung thang du phebs te bslab bya dang lam rim legs par gsungs/ tshal gung thang gi dge 'dun thams cad dang tshugs rnam par dag pa dang/skyes bu chen po'i chos lugs la sbyar bar mdzad pas rje nyid las kyang bka' drin che bar gyur pa yin/ gsung rab rtsom pa'idabang du byas na dge slong gi bslab bya chen mo/ dge tshul gyi bslab sga gzhi gsum tsho ga /gleng 'bum ste 'dul ba'i skor dang] sngags la rje'i sgrub dkyil rnams la lhan thabs/ rab gnas kyi cho ga /gshor lo sdom pa'i phyi rol mchod pa/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod (lta ṭ+wāṃ 1 ny+pha lad n+dha dz+nyo sna 〉spya pañdzashā kyi r+shadzi ༵ ༵ kyi/ (rnyishā 〉lha'i /sna sprir+sha shā/maX ༷ (༷ mdzad kyi cho ga /sbyo4nga rgyud kyi rnam bshad/ bya rgyud rigs gsum la brten pa'i cho ga'i lag len sogs mdzad cingaka btsun mo tshal du dge 'dun gyi sde bskyangasate/ re gcig pa shing stag la chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ mkhas grub rje dgung 'odzi lnga bcu ba yin te/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam thar gsang bdag dang 'jam dbyangs kyis lung bstan pa ni/ sngon bram ze khye'u go 'phang bya bas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas log par dad sel gyi sprul ba'i rang rgyal la mchod de smon pas/de nas skye ba drug tu mtha' lhangob kyi rgyal po mdzad/ de nas mkhas pa'i dge slongadang paṇ+ḍi ta sha stag tu skye ba mang 4 blangs/ de nas lha'i bu tog ces pa dang / de nas 'dir skyes gsungs pa sogs mang yangad pyi mar dga' ldan du lhar skye/ de nas rje btsun skyabs mchog dpal bzang po zhabrungs nas sbas pa'i brtul zhugs kyis phyag rgya chen po chob par bshad pa semags dren/ /༈mkhas grub shes rab seng ge ni/ gtsang stong du sku zhakhrungs/ snar thang du rab tu byungan dang por mkhan chen grub pa shes rab dang] shangs ba kun mkhyen phyi ma dang / rong ston sogs bla ma kha yar dang / pyis su rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang / rgyal tshab dang / 'dul 'dzin gnyis dang /269
'jigs byed chos 'byung /mkhas grub chos rje bsten nas phar tshad 'dul mngon rtsa'agrel dang / dbu ma rtsa'ajug /bde mchog rtsargyud dngad bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro/mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ mngon brjod bla ma dngan'byung ba bzhi dang] gsang 'dus rtsargyud dang] 'grel ba bzhi sbrags dang / bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba/ dgongs pa lung ston/ lha mo bzhis zhus/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa sogs dang /'phags pa yab sras lnga'i gzhung kun la sbyangs shing] dmar nag gi rgyud 'grel ba bzhi dang]rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi ②rgyud rtogs pa bdun pa/ de'i 'grel ba rdo rje grub pa dang / rtso na shrī dang /slobadapon mi bskyod pas mdzad padang] ku mā ra'i 'grel ba rnamasadang sgrigs/ rol ba'i rdo rje'i 'grel ba legs kyang de gtso bor ma bshad/ bshad rgyud rtog gsum la dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi dngor lo'i bshad pa/ dus gagor rtsa'agrel tshun chad bshad nas gtan la 'phebs pa srad rgyud rdo rje 'chang gi bar byung] bskyed rdzogs chen mo sogs gsan cing / mdo sde dang rgyud lde tshig sgyi ma yin par ma zad/ go ba chags tsam la yang ma bzhag par nyams len dang sbrags pa'i rgyud sde'i don la tshig la ma stos pa'i nang byan chud pa'i mkhas grub mang sos bla ma 'di'i gsung la bstod par mdzad pa mang/de nas sa phag la rje rin 4 ches byams chen chos rje la rgyud 'dzug pa'i zhal bkod gnang nas se ra rtsenas rjes 'brang gi mkhas pa chen po shin tu mang bar bde gsang gi rtsargyud gnyis kyi dbu nas chos shun re gnang nas/ dngor mkhas mang rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus nas 'grel ba bzhi sbrags btegs nas/ 'di'i bdag thub pa su yod/ ces lan gsum 'a'od pa gnang bas su yang ldang ma nus pa la/ rje 'dis bdag gis bgyi zhes zhus te phyag gsum mdzad nas len par mdzad/ de yang sngon rgyal bdabang po'i tog gi spyan sngar rje rin 4 chedang rgyud gcig pa'i rgyal sras snying stobs chen pos gsang sngags kyi chos 'dzin par zhal gyis bzhes ba'i rgyu mthun du snang/ de yang rje rin 4 che la bla ma 'dis bdag gis rgyud pa sbrel 270
rje bla ma yab sras nasabargyud tshul/mi nus zhus pas/ zhal nas khyod skrag mid〈snas/ ngas chos rgyal la gtod pa yin la/ khyod gtsang du song dngad 'di nas dpag tshad kyi sa na ri dril bu kha sbub pa 'dra ba'i steng na gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'phyor pa yod/ des khyod kyi bstan pa srel par byed/ yang de nas rgyang grags kyi sa na ri srin mo gan rgyal du bsgyel ba 'dra ba'i steng na gnod sbyin mo yod/ des kyang khyod kyi bstan pa phel bar byed/ de nas khyod rang gis kyang shes yong zhes lung bstan mdzad/ ces rtsaba'i bla ma srad rdo rje 'chang chen 4 gsung / de yang dang por gsang phur mthong smon grwa tshang gi 'chad nyan mdzad pa phyis su dwags po grwa tshang zeg de nas slob chung du dwags 4 bkras rnam bskos pas/ mi rnams sher seng gis gtsang rtags bstan zeg sher seng dpon slob gtsang du bshad nyan dmar bar byung / skabs gcig bkras rnam pas kho 'os mi byed/ tsa rir sgrub pa byed zer nas/ dge 'dun grub gsang phu'i de'i bshad nyan la bskos nas cung zad song bar/ bkras rnam pas yang khos byed dgos/ zhes grwa tshang dge 'dun grub kyi phyag nas blangs pas sher seng ma dgyes pa'i gsung ste/ gtsang du dge 'dun grub dang yab sras gnyis kyi bshad nyan shin tu 'phel bar byung ba'i skabs gcig /sngar rje rin 4 che'i zhabs drung du rgyud srel ba'i g.yar dam phul ba thol skyes ltar dran par mdzad nas/ rje dge 'dun grub par grwa tshang gtad de/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi bshad nyan mdzad bzhin ba'i sgo nas lhun 4 rtse'i chos sder byon/ si tu bsod nams dpal dngaka bdag mo shākya dpal gyis sgyin bdag mdzad de/ rgyud kyi bshad nyan btsugs shingakachos sde'i bla ma 'phags 'ong yon tan rgya mtsho gsor bcas kyis chos zhus/ chos sder rje'i pa/dri r+nghi sgrushrī (shārnyi spyashā r+sha/sra ( n+dha shā dz+nyo ༵ 19 spyanā ༵༵ snadzo 'a/balhan da(lta sna tshi da pa bcas pa gnang ste/ da lta'i bar du der bzhugs yod/ rjes lung bstan pa'i gshin rje gshed kyi 271
'jigs byed chos 'byung /rnal 'byor pa 'phags 'od la mi mang 'dod la/ zhal 'bag la dpag na yin 'dra zhing / rgyud 'grel pa ṭīk+ka lam rim sogs kyi par brkos shing ches cher spel bar mdzad cing / srad rgyud kyi rkang bzung snang ba sogs las kyang shes nus so/ /yang gnas der rje dge 'dun grub kyis 'grel pa thog mar gsan pas rje 'di yin par rnam thar las bshad la/ rje rang nyid kyis kyang ka bstod las gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor par gsungs so/ /sngags ma gsungs/ mtshan nyid la rje 'di kho na drin che la/ 'phrin las shin tu che ba sku na rim bzhin no/ /de nas seng ge dz+nyo hūm̐ (lha/ dz+nyo shā k+ṣiṃ ṭā zloshā dī lha/ shād/ ༵ (spya nāshā padzo /sna ༵༵ shā/shā ༈ ṭ+wāṃ 'di yin snang / gnas der rje rin po che'i lung bstan las/ de nas khyed rang gis kyang shes yod gsungs pa dang mthun par rje btsun shes rab seng ge yab sras kyis ja gral gnang ba'i g.yas kyi gral mgor rje dge 'dun grub pa dang / de nas 'dul dkar pa sogs dang / g.yon gyi gral mgor 'dul nag pa dpal ldan bzang 4 bzhugs par/ rje sher seng gis 'dul nag pa la khyod kyi dgung snying gang yin gsungs pas rta yin zhus par/ de bzang 'dug /'jig rten gyi gtam dper g.yag shi sar rta 'khrab zer bas/ khyod song la g.yag shi lung pag rgyud kyi bshad nyan gyis shig gsungs nas rje'i paṇa zhwa dang gos per gnang bas/ 'de dge 'dun grub par 'os/ nga la rje'i 'grel pa bzhi sbrags dang 〈snag lhung dgos zhus nas de dag blangs nas/sradadaga' ldan pho brang du rgyud grwa tshugs pa la gtsang stod rgyud pa byung/ bla rabs kyang 'dul nag pa dpal ldan bzang 4/ rog tsho chos rje ngag dbang grags pa/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun 'phel ba/ rab 'byams pa chos dbyings pa/ lda ྅ 'chang bkra shis 'phags pa/ paṇa chen bsam grub rgya mtsho/ gnas rnying chos rje badredad nams rgyal mtshan/ rgyud chen brtson 'grus 'phags 272

rgyud smad nas brgyud tshug'dun 'phel/ dka' bcu blo gros mtha' yas/ dka' chen chu bzang ba sogs mtha' yas pa byung bas/ rgyud pa tshul khrims bzang po zhes snyan pa'i rnga 'o chedang gragasadakar gdugs mdzes zung gis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten las kyang brgalate khyab par gyur pas/ mkhas pa 'og min gyi ltargan rnams kyang gsang sngags kyi rnga 4 che 'dengo mtshar ro zhes bsngags pa dang bstod pa'i metog gi char chen 4 'bebs par mdzad do/ /༈ de'i slob chung ngu dka' bcu blo bzang pa bsko ba mdzad kyang sku tshe ma zin pas/ rje tshul bzang byang rtser phebs pa na/ mkhas pa rin chen 'od zer rgyud kyi khrir bskos/ de yang stod lung mda'i zhing bzang du chu mo bya'i lor lubrungs/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs sgo mang du chos rje rin chen byang chub las rab tu byung] mtshan rin chen 'od zer du btags/ rje de nyid la phar pyin dbu ma gsan pas legs par mkhyen cing ye shes bzang yo la dka' chen lhag ma gsan te/ mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa thob/ rgyud du phebs nas/ rgyud chen tshul khrims bzang po'i drung du 'dus pa rtsabashad kyi rgyud rnams dang] bskyed rdzogs ṭīk+ka sogs dang] gshed skor gyi rgyud 'grel ba gdams ngag dang dus gzhor la zhib par sbyangs pas 'gran bral gyi mkhas pa'i yang rtsegacig byung / nyi sdings su drung ba gzims chen pas mkhan 4 dang / 'od srung pas las slob/ slo gros chos dbang bas gsang ston mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/zhe drug pas rta la rgyud kyi khrir phebs nas rgyud kyi 'grel ba 'grel bshad bskyed rdzogasadang khrid rnams star chags su mdzad bzhin pa'ingang nas nga dgu ba lcags lug la byang rtseraphebs/ re lnga pa me glang la sgyil bu'i gdan sar bstan jis gsal pa'i skyon me zhes pa rnam dag 'khrul bral legs par brtsams/ bdun cu pa chu pho rta) lo la rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bzhugs gdan chos kyi r+ṇi chen 4 ltami thams cad kyis 'dud par mdzad pa la phebs te/ lo brgyad kyi bar du dbyaradagun 313
'jigs byed chos 'byung /gyi lam rim sogs dus chos 'chag med du gsungs pa dngasga mkhas pa dang btsun pa dang lhag bsam bzang po'i 'od bzang gis phyogs thams cad khyab pa'i gzi byin nyi ma brgyar 'bar bar gyur pas/ mkhas par rlom pa'i rgyu skar dang mi mthun pa'i mun tshogs lhag ma med par mdzad pa'i mod la/ yangs ba can du rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi gser sku chen mo rgyab mtho bcu drug pa bzhengs te/ sa glang la bsnyan pa'i gsal byed chen 4 mkhas mchog badrend nams grags pa khrir bkod de zur bzhugs mdzad/ gya gsum pa shing rta la sras khang dgon pa'i shar rtser sku gshegs par rje stag lung brag pa gsungs kyang shing rta la gya gsum mi yong bar rang nyid kyis bdun cu pa chu rtar zhal gyis bzhes pas gsal/ mkhar nag pas don brgyad pas glang gsungs pa yang rang gis bdun cu pa chu rtar gsungs pas khegs 〈sna/ /des na bdun cu pa chu rta la khrir phebs/ don bdun pa sa glang la zur bzhugs mdzad de gya brgyad pa lcags byi la sras khang dgon pa'i shar ṭā dzo sna shārnyi ra ji rdzu sbyornyi sna r+sha 3) shā/rdzu hūm̐/ ma/༷dī hā/ hā/ (spra )( lha/na pa hūm̐ shā pa shā bshad/ de'i slob ma yang yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'os pa mang 4 zhig byung ste/ rdo rje 'chang chos rlungang rgya mtsho/ rje rgyal mtshan bzang 4/ chos grags bzang ṭo zungags dge bshes che tshad phal cher de dus zhabs phyir bsnyegs par mdzad pas so/ /lta 4ba sher bzang dang rin chen 'od zer gnyis ka la/ rdo rje 'chang chos skyong rgya mtshos gsan pa yin te/ rje gshegs nas nga bzhi pa chu mo sprul gyi lo la dbus stod zhog mnga' rgya rar 'khrungs/ mkhar nag chos 'byung du rje gshegs nas lo nga bdun zer ba 'khul/ rje gshegs nas gshegs lo 'khrungs lo gnyis rtsis kyang lo skor bzhi dang nyag ma bdun las med pas nga lnga las mi 'byung bas so/ /gzhan yang rje gshegs nas nga bdun min pa r+ṇi ba so so'i khrir 314
rgyud smadanas brgyud tshugbzhugs pa'i tshad dngad phebs lo dang] khri rjes ma'i phebs lo bltas pas kyang grub 4/ /chung ngu'i dus su kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i gsung rab rnams gsan/ brag bar du rab tu byungan dbu ma gsan cing mkhas pa chos rje legs pa chos 'gyor bsten nas dka' chen rnams la legs par sbyangs pas mkhas par gyug rgyud du rje sher bzang bsten nas gsang 'dus rtsabashad kyi rgyud kun dang / 'grel pa rnams dngad bde mchog gi skor dang] dus gshor gyi skor dang] rgyud sde bzhi'i skor kun dang/ khyad par rdo rje 'dzigs byed kyi rtsabashad rgyud 'grel ba bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag rnams dang / zhakhrul gshor dang / drug cu pa'i skor kun dang] ye shes mgon po'i bsnyen smyurnyi (lhas sbya zlosnro spyashā papa ༵ r+shar+shapa dī sprismu r+shadī] ṭ+wāṃ /mi rgyusngu lha sbyo pa pa/ji ba r+shaX 'brug la rgyud kyi khrir phebs nas/ chu sprul gyi bar 'o bcu bzhi skor rgyud 'grel pa 'grel bshad dang] bshad rgyud bzhi sogs kyi 'grel bshad dang]rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtsargyud dang 'grel pa bzhir bskyed rdzogs chen mo sbyar nas gsungs pa dang / rgyud rtsa'agrel man ngag mchog tu shar ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen 4 tshig don ma lus pa 'dzin nus pa'i nges don gyi rig sngags 'chang bas bod khams ma lus pa khyab par gyur te/ gtsang du'ang rgyud chen brtson 'grus 'phags sogs kyi man ngag gi bshad rgyun da lta'i b.raspend pa rdo rje 'chang las kho 'os thob tshul bshad pa de yin la/ de ltar rgyud kyi 'chad nyan gnang bzhin pa'i steng nas byang rtser phebs te mdo sngags kyi chos rgyun chags su gsungs pa'i 'phrin las sngar las kyang gong 'phel chen por gyur cing /bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs snga phyi mang po mdzad cing/ kho bos kyang gsang 'dus kyi bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim la'ang legs pa che chung gnyis kyang mthong la/ de bzhin du gshor lo chen po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum byin rlabs bzhi ldan gyi khrid yig dang] phyag rdor gsang ba 315
'jigs byed chos 'byung /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i khrid yig /chos drug gi khrid yig rnams mthong zhing / khrid chen brgyad kyi rgyun srad rgyud la dar ba skal ba bzang pos kho mos rnyed par gyur cing / dge bshes mang po la smel yod pas da phyin chad dar rgyas 'phel mus su yod do/ /de bzhin du dus gshor gyi skor yang lang du gsungs shing / re bzhi pa me pho spre'u'i log lha dang mi thams cad 'dud par mdzad cing me tog gi phreng bas smras pa/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'dzigs med gdong lnga 'bar ba'i grags pa'i nga ros phas rgol glang 4 ma lus skrag par byed pa'i bzhugs gdan seng ge'i khri chen 4 la phebs/ bslab pa gsum gyi sum rtsen gyidabus na lhun 4 ltar bajid cing/ rim gnyis kyi nyi zlas zugs kyi mkha' ni rab tu gsal/ lung dang rigs pa grangs med pa'i rgyu skar gyi tshogs chen 4 'khrul ba'i dri ma phra mo yang med pas mu tig gi dkar pa la 'phya' ba'i bzhad pa ni phan tshul 'gran pa bzhin du mang la rab tu bkra/ nag po'i lha min la snang mig spyan stong 'bar bas phyogs bcur gzigs pa'i sdang mig gis phas kyi lha min mo'i mngal rnams cig car du ltang par mdzad/dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed gyi gsal snang nga rgyal gyi rwa rtse'og min gyi bar du bsgreng par mdzad pas nus ldan chen 4 kun kyang cig car kha sbub tu zhabs kyi 'og tu gnon par mdzad nas nag phyogs ma lus pa ming gi lhag mar byas pas rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs kyi sa gsum po ma lus pa bdag gir mdzad de/ legs byas kyi sgo brgya phye nas/ skye rgu ma lus pa mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam la zhugs shing skyed pa'i glu gar ci yang mdzad par gyur to/ /de ltar lo bzhi'i bar du zab rgyas kyi gshor lo gzhan dang mi mnyam pa bskor bas na/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtshos kyang gzhan las phul byung ma zhes pa'i bstod pa mdzad do/ /de nas re bdun pa sa mo phag gi lo la rigs ldan gyi sprul pas sham+bha la nyid du gdan drangs par dpal 'byor lhun grub gsungs pa yang sku 'des ma yin par chos dbyings su zhugs nas yin par mngon la/ mkhar nag pa shing 316
rgyud tshoganas brgyud tshul/lug la gsungs pa ltar na lo lngar khri pa mdzadanas chos gshor bskor la/ rje stag lung brag pas me sbrel gsungs pas cung 'di skor la thugs rgyus che snyam nas bkod pas dpyod ldan rnams kyis shes par bya'o/ /phyag rjes thub dbang gi gos sku chen mo bzhengs/ gshegs pa'i tshe me tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od sogs dang bcas te gshegs/ dus mchod kyi tsha bra chen mo dasan brgyud kyis chags med bzang bar 'dzin bzhin ba'o/ /sgyi rtenadangul gdung rgya guranangan mkhas grub rin po che'i dngul gdung gi g.yon zur na bzhugs so/ /rje rin po che gshegs nas drug cu skor gnyis song ba'i sa phag de yin/ gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma yang mdo sngags gnyis spu'i mnga' bdag/gzhan don byed nus pa'i rdo rje 'odzin pa shin tu mang par byon te/ chen 4 'ga' tsam bkod na/ rgyud chen rgyal mtshan bzang 4/ rgyud chen tshos grags bzang 4/ rgyud chen brtson 'grus 'phags pa/ rgyud chen dwags 4 nam grags pa/ mngon dga' ba byams pa rgya mtsho sesnags shin tu mang po byon/༈de la rgyud chen rgyal mtshan bzang po dang] chos grags bzang po/ dwags sho nam grags pa gsum gyis gsan te/ rnam thar cung zad re brjod na/ chos rje rgyal mtshan bzang 4 ni/ rje gshegs nas 'ordzo nga bzhi 〈snang ba/ chu mo sprul gyi 'og la stag rtse'i dge 'dun sgang gi ltag skya bo'i krong du zhakhrungs/ mkhar nag gis rje gshegs nas don dgu song ba'i me sbrul zer ba la/ rjes stag lung brag pas de bkag nas/ rdo rje 'chang chos skyong rgya mtsho dang dgung mnyam par bshad pas mkhyen rab dang sku na sogs kyis khong bden pa 'dra bsade gzhir bzhag /dga' ldan chos 'byung dang mthun 'gro bar snangaka rab tu byung] bshes gnyen du ma bsten nas dka' chen rnams la sbyangs pas mkhas par gyug rgyud smad du rje sher bzang dang / rdo rje 'chang chos skyong rgya mtsho sogs la bde gsang 'jigs gsum rgyud sde'i skor rnams la sbyangs pa ring du mdzad pas mdo 317
'jigs byedachos 'byung /sngags kyi bdag por rgyud rje chos skyong rgya mtsho'i rjes su rgyud kyi bshad nyan shin tu dmar bar mdzad de/ rgyud smad kyi bla ma byed bzhin pa'i ngang nas byang rtser phebs/ dgung lo don gcig pa chu yos la gdan sar phebs/ 'o dzu gsum la gdan sar tshos gshor bskor te/ don gsum pa shing sprul zla ba drug pa'i nyer drug la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas me tog gi char sogs dang bcas zhi bar gshegs zhes stag lung brag pa'i gdan rabs las bshad la/ gdung zhugs la sbyangs pas lha sku dang ring bsrel gyi phung por gyur/ de la nang rten byas pa'i gser gdung byas te rgya gur nang gi rje'i sku 'dra'i g.yon du bzhugs serdzo/ /de dag 'thad snyam ste/ snga ma'i gdan rabs rnams kyi lo dang khams nor pa stag lung brag pas bcos nas gsungs par mdzad pa'i phyir te/ gdan rabs las/ chos 'byung yid kyi mdzes rgyan dang] mkhas panor bu bzang po'i chos 'byung/ gzhan yang kha thor pa 'ga' zhig la gzhi byas/ lo'i gong 'og /khamasadang dbang thang nor ba rnams kyi 'khrul ba bsal/ mkhas pa rnams kyi legs bshad gung bsgrigs te/ zhes gsungs pas 〈sna/ /'di dang gdan rabs dang mkhar nag chos 'byung gsum la skabs 'gar mi mthun pa che bar snang yang chos 'byung yid mdzes dang / nor bzang chos 'byung khungs mar byas na legs/:rgyud chen chos grags bzang po'i/ rje gshegasanas lo gya brgyad song ba'i lcags glang la dbus stod stag phur zhakhrungs/ stag phu chos sder rab tu byung lte dka' chen sogs la sbyangs pas mkhas pa chen por gyur te/ rgyud smad du rje rgya ra ba dang / chos rje rgyal mtshan bzang por sngags skya skor ma lus pa gsan te/ mdo sngags la mkhas par gyur/ rgyud smad kyi khrir phebs/ rgyud kyi bshad nyan mdzad bzhin pa'i ngang nas byang rtser phebs/ nga bdun pa me mo bya'i lor bzhugs gdan seṅge'i khri chen por phebs te/ lo 'o brgyad du mdo sngags kyi chos kyi lhangor lo rgya chen po bskog gnas bcu'i gos sku bzhengs te mngon dgar zur bzhugs mdzad nas/ re lnga pa shing 318
rgyud smad nas brgyud tshul/sprul zla ba dgu ba'i tshes dgu la gsang sngags mkhar du gshegs/ 'phel gdung mang du byon nas dngul gdung ni rgya gur nang na grwa dgon ka bzhi'i gser gdung gi nyakhris na bzhugs/ dus mchod dang tsha bra dbon brgyud kyis chags med du 'odzin bzhin pa'o/ /༈ chos rje dwags po nam mkha' grags ni/ dwags 4 mda' ru zhakhrungs/ gzhon nu nas rab tu byung ste/ dwags po grwa tshang du slob dpon blo gros 'phel ba la phar pyin tshar gcig gsan/ slo skyed legs pa byung/ ri sgor blo gros 'phel gyi phar pyin sbyi don zhag nyi shu la zugs 'edzin mdzad de/ ser byes pa grwa tshang du phebs/ sku chas dkon kyang chos rje rje btsun chos rgyan gyis chas ga phran bu gnang ste/ rje btsun pa la dka' chen rnams legs par sbyangs/ mkhas grags kyis dbus gtsang khyab pa tsam du byung/ rgyud smad du rgyud chen rgyal mtshan bzang po la gsang 'dus 'grel ba bzhi sbrags gsan/ dga' ldan du rje chos skyong rgya mtsho la/rdo rje la)gas byed kyidabang rgyud 'grel gdams pa mnangag cha lag dang bcas pa/ khyad par dus kyi pangor lo la zhib tu sbyangs pas mdo sngags la phul du byung bar rgyudadenas rgyud smad kyi khrir phebs bshad nyan yun ring du mdzad pas mkhas grags kyi snyan pa che/ dus lusar gyi bshad pa rgyas pa zhig mdzad bzhed kyang ma grub/ mthar kun spangs mdzad de/ dga' ldan byams pa mgon po'i mdun sar gshegs par gyug༈de la rje byams pa rgya mtshos gsan pa yin te/ rje rin 'o che gshegs nas lo go brgyad 〈snang ba me pho byi ba'i lor/ zhog gi gram grur 'khungs/ rgyal ba byams pa'i sprul bar stag lung brag pa gsungs/ stag rtserin chen sgang du tho btsun mdzad/ bshes gnyen du mar gzhung lugs mang po gsan pas mkhas btsun gyi grags pa rgyas/ rgyud smad du rje chos grags dang nam grags gnyis char la rim bzhin gsang 'dus kyi rgyud 'grel pa 'grel bshad bskyed rdzogs dang bcas pa dngakardo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud gnyis rtsa'agrel dang bskyed rdzogs man ngag kun gsan pas/319
'jigs byed chos 'byung /mdor mkhas par ma zad sngags la'ang nges pa rnam dag thugs la mnga' ba'i rdo rje 'odzin pa zhig ste/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i 'jigs byed smon lam gyi ṭīk+ka rim gnyis cha tshang legs pa gcig brtsams pa bdag gis kyang langam dbyangs bla ma r+ṇi rin 4 che'i phyag dpe'i khrod nas mthong ba legs pa gcig 'dug go /sgom sde chen po sogs kyang de gzhir bzhag gi bshad par 'dug ces 'jam dbyangs bla ma khri rin 4 che dang 'jam dbyangs ko shri gnyis gsung / rgyud smad kyi khrir phebs/ rgyud gsum 'grel pa 'grel bshad bskyed rdzogs bzhi man ngag dang bcas pa ltar chags su gnang ba'i ngang nas byang tsistag rtserin chen sgang gi bla ma mdzad/ dgung lo drug cu pa shing phag la lha mi rnams kyi gtsug rgyan seṅge'i khri chen 4 la phebs shing dus chos gsungs pa dang / rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan po mang du mdzad cing] gangs can gyi mtha' mngob 'drin ba'i mgon ṭo zla med pa rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas/ sa'i tshangs pa chen po cha gan al than rgyal sos byang phyogs kyi skye 'gro mtha' yas pa'i mgon du spyan drangs/ de yang sprul pa'i glegs bam gyis/ 'od byang gi phyogs su las ba mgon med pa mang 4 'dren du las bar lung bstan pa'i skabs la babs nas phebs pa na lha sa smon lam gyi gral dbu mdzad/ dgung 'dzi re bdun pa chu rta la mngon dga' gong mar zur bzhugs mdzad pas chos rje mngon dga' bar yang grags/ stag rtse'i rin chen sgang la phag mo ba'i dmag phog pas/ chos sde gur smon du spos nas dar rgyas su mdzad/ dgung locasan lnga pa lcags ltag la zhi bar gshegs pa'i dngul gdung mchod khang gsar mar bzhugs so/ /de'i sku skye gtsang ba bkra shis dang] kham mo snyol ma'i sras su lcags yos la zhakhrungs/ rje rnam rgyaladapal bzang gis rab tu byung lte mtshanadage 'dunadapal bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba/ se ra smad du zugs gnyer mdzad/ bco lnga'i dus sog yul du phebs nas 'phrin las bzang bo byung]320
rgyud smad nas brgyudatshug༈ de la rje dge 'dun rgyal mtshan dang] rnam rgyal dpal bzang gnyis kyis gsan pasan te/ rje dge 'dun rgyal mtshan ni/ rje gshegs nas lo brgya dang bcu bzhi pa chu pho 'brug gi lo la lha sa'i lum pa gshag tu zhakhrungs/ mkhar nag gis rje gshegs nas brgya dang so brgyad pa chu 'brug ces pa'i 'das lo'i grangs nod dgung lo bcu gcig pa la sku mched gsum ka se ra'i khyi ba rje btsun chos rgyan dang byes pa dpon slob shes rab seng ge las rab tu byungan rje gdos ser byes su slob gnyer mdzad pas mkhas pa chen por gyud thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos mkhan po dang] mnga' ris pa lha btsun bsod nams dpal bzang gis las slob/ dge 'dun grangs tshang ba las bsnyen par rdzogs/ rgyud smad du yongs 'dzin bkra shis bzang po dang rje byams pa rgya mtsho gnyis bsten nas 'dus pa dang 'dzigs byed sogs la sbyangs pas/ chu 4 gaṅgā tshun la mkhas grags rgyas/ dgung 〈sna zhe gsum pa shing phag la rgyud smad kyi bla mar phebs/mkhar nag gis sa phag zer ba shin nyunor te chu 'bruganas zhe gsum pa la sa phag mi 'byung bar mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyig nga bdun pa sa glang la byang rtsedang/don gnyis pa lcagasage'os la khams gsum gyi gtsug rgyan bzhugs gdan gser khrir phebs/ 'phags pa 'dzig rten dbang phyug mi'i rol gar mdzad pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul sku yon tan rgya mtsho 'od du phebs pa'i rab byung gnang ba'i slob dpon mdzad cing stong ga'or sprul sku yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang bla mar gyur cing / la mo'i sa khog nas dga' ldan du dbyar zhal bzhes pa rnams la mang ja 'chags med du lo re bzhin yong ba'i sa cha sbyag dgung lo don drug pa la zur bzhugs mdzad de zhi bar gshegs/ sku gdung ring bsrel gyi phung por gyur pa la dngul gdung bzhengs pa dga' ldan du bzhugs rtso/ /gsung gi bdud mimyang ba'i slob ma/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i mchog gi sprul sku rgyal dbang yonatan rgya mtshodang] rigs ldan grags pa'i rnam 'phrul paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen 321
'jigs byedachos 'byung /pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang/ stong gangor sprul sku yon tan rgya mtsho dang] dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdo sngags kyi bdag po du ma yang byung ste/ mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po re rnam rgyal dpal bzang dngan gzhu khang ba dge legs lhun grub dang] rje pha 'ong kha pa dpal 'gyor lhun grub dang mkhas pa'i yang 4zla bral stag lung brag pa blo zos rgya mtsho 〈snags mtha' yas pa byung]༈ de la mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug chen 4 rje rnam rgyal dpal bzang ni/ rta nag tu lcags mo glang la 'khrangs/ rje rin 4 che gshegs nas lo brgya dang nyer gsum song / dpal dngor chos sder rab tu byung / bkra shis lhun por shar gyi grwa tshang la zhugs/ paṇ+ḍi ta blo gros legs bzang la dka' chen rnams gsan te dka' bcu'i grwa skor mdzad/ dben sar rgyal ba slo bzang don grub kyi zhabs bsten nas mdo sngags kyi lam rim gsum dang bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi zab khrid sogs mang 4 gsan te bsgom pas rtogs pa khyad par can zhakhrungs/ lan gcig bla ma'i zhal nas dka' bcu pas bkra shis lhun por byon la phu ti lhag ma rnams bslab lte rab 'byams grwa skor mdzod dang / rje rin po'i che'i bstan ba la phan pa rgya chen 4 'byung bar 'dug gsungs pa ltad bkra shis lhun por gsan bh+yong legs par mdzad nas/ ngam ring dang dpal gshor chos sde gnyis su rab 'byams grwa skor gnang / dpal gshor chos sde'i lha khang grwa tshang gi bla ma mdzad/ grwa khang la zhig gzugs mdzad pa'i dus sa men sko ba'i phug pa gas nas 'gro mi nus tshe/ rje 'dis gsung nas khyed rang rnams sa rkos ngas bzung gi gsungs te/ phug pa'i gas mtshams su zhabs bzhag ste ting nge 'dzin brtan pos mnan pas phug pa ma rdibs/ de /pa dz+nyo ny+pha rna/sna tram̐ dz+nyo ༵ hāX /(pa paX /lha snonā dīkā shā /rdzu ༷pas/ ༷/ :sna( sngu k+ṣiṃ] rje blo sgos chos skyong yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'dzigs byed kyi skor ma lus pa bshad pa'i 322
rgyud smad nas brgyud tshul/bskyed rdzogs chen mo'i bshad lung gdams spru dang bcas pa gsan/ 'grel spru bzhi sbrag gi yang lung gsan pas/ 'de dag srad rgyud kyi bskyed rdzogs dang 'grel ba'i bshad rgyun yin pas 'de nas rgyud pa zung 'tshel gyi bshad rgyunasanano/ /sngags la'ang shes 'dod cher zhakhrungs te/ dga' ldan du khri rin po che byams pa rgya mtsho'i drung pugasang 'dus bskyed rdzogs kyi zin bris 'dzin ba dang/ rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka le'u bcu bzhi ba'i bar du gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs chen mo gnyis kyi bshad lungadangadamar khrid lag rjesadang bcas pa gsananas thugs phrog ste/ 'grel pa'i bshad pa zhus pas rgyud smad du song gsungs nas rgyud smad chos grwar lo gsum byon te/ mkhas pa'i dbang 4 rje dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ 'grel pa bzhi sbrag gi zhib bshad mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog pa'i khrid dang bcas pa zhus/ de nas zhabs bsdungad mthar rgyas su lo gcig bzhugs pa'i ring la/ de'i ma〈snad gnas gnas brtan par rgyud 'bum sgya lung bzhugs 'dug pas/ de la gsar ma rgyud 'bum yongs rdzogs tshar gcig legs par gsan/ de nas gtsang la byon te gser sdings kyi bla ma mdzad de rgyud kyi bshad nyan mdzad/ der sngar ṭīka 'grel gyi srol mi 'dug kyang ṭīk+ka 'dzin pa dang 'grel ba bzhi sbrags kyi bshad pa btsugs pas gtsang phyogs kyi dge bshes thams cad 'dus te/ bshad nyan 'phel zhing sngags la blo skyed cher rgyas pa'i mdo sngags kyi mkhas grwa mang po byung/ dbus su dga' ldan du phebs te/ mchod chung la rgyud stod smadadang gser sdings pa gsum 'dzoms pas/ dge bshes gser sdings pa bzang bar 'dug ces snyan grags cher byung bas/ rje byams pa rgya mtsho dang / sde pa bkra shis pa mchod yon gnyis kyis rgyud smad kyi bshad nyan gyi zhu ba phul pas zhal bzhes mdzad nas gtsang la byon te/ mkhas dbang chen po bkra shis rin chen pa la gser sdings kyi rgyud gtad de/ sa mo glang la rgyud smad kyi khrir phebs nas rgyud kyi bshad nyan lo bcu bzhi mdzad pa las/ phebs ma thag nas grwa mang 'o brgyal bar 323
'jigs byed chos 'byung /dgongasanas snga ja'i ja tshul ma chag pa btsugs/ lo bcabazhi'i bar 'grel pa bzhi sbrag gur smon nas btsugs/ chu mig lung du rgyud 'grel tshar bar mdzad cing] rgyud mchod dang] rgyud gtad pa dngad bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba ltar gyi khro 'o bcu la gtor ma dang] rgyud skyong ba'i bka' bsgo ba sogs rje rin 4 ches mdzad pa ltar da lta'i bar dulangawend/ṭīk+ka che ba'i skya chos le'u bcu bdun ba'i mtshams spyar dang/ṭīk+ka chung ba'i bcu gsum pa'i mtshams sbyar la 'jog par mdzad cingaka'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi zin bris dngaka 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rdzogs kyang bla ma snga ma rgya ra ba dang] byams pa rgya mtshodang] dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyi bskyed rdzogs legs pa dedag gtong gi yod par snang] de dag tshar re re dang/ rgyud sde sbyi rnam sogs dang] rgyud 'bum gyi lung dang /mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras kyi 'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs chen mo'i zab bshad/lus sbrengang zhakhrul lta'or phyag lenadang bcas pa/ mgon po tshos rgyal gnyis kyi pe'u bum man ngag gi lung/ zhal shesadang bcas pa serdzogs gdamasangag gis mkhas pa rnams mgu bar mdzad pas snyan gragasadang thugs rje che bsadabus gtsang khams gsum gyidage ba'i bshes gnyen bzang ngo cog thams cad rgyud smad du 'dus pas mdo sngags kyidage bshesadangaka 'phrin las kyis kyang chu 'o gaṅgā tshun chad dkar lam gyis gtong bar mdzad/ 'jig rten gyi phyag rjes kyang/ tshal gyi rgyud khang lha'i pho brang 'dra bde dus kyi lha bris mkhas dgu khon 'dus pas phyis su 'di'i logs bris lta bu phyogs gang nas kyang ma masangan nyi 'od byung dus lha khro 'o dag gi zhal la ltami nus 'dug ces bra 'o dbu mdzad lab cingad gangs can mi shwa darma chos dbyings rgya mtshos kyang bstod par mdzad/ logs bris kyi tshe mthing yang dkon 4 byung bas/ grub rtags nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa ston ched ma grib kyi ri 'de'i rigs la mthing spang gang 'doda' da gsungasanas phebs nas gang 'dod rnyed/ de dus kyi tshol mkhan dag gi snang bar sa khra gang brkos pa dang ri thams 324
rgyud smad nas brgyud tshugcad mthing gi rang bzhin du mthong bas/rjes su len bsamanas phyin pas sus kyang ma rnyed pas grub rtags su shes/de ni rlung tsamadang mnangag res 'byung bzhi la brten pa'i rdzu 'phrul chang chung dang rigs gtan nas mi gcig pa sems la dbang chen 4 thun mong ma yin pa thob rtags yin/de bzhin du sa men ma rnyed pas/ tsa ri ri 'di'i rigs la sa men gang 'dod yod gsungs nas chos rje rang gis btsal bas snyed cing] pa'on rin po che yang sa men len par lan gnyis phyin pas sa khu gang bskos phyin ri thams cad sa men du 'dug pa mngon sum du mthong yang da lta ci yang mi rnyed 'dug gsung / de dus rdo rnams la phyag rjes dang zhabs rjes byung ba rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bris sku'i logs bris kyi jig par 〈snad pa kun gyis ma'ong / gur smon du yang 'du khang gsar du bzhengs pa'i sbyin bdag lde ba g.yul rgyal bas mdzad de mchod yon legs lam du yod/ logs bris rab gnas bar legs par gsar du grub/ rgyud kyi bshad nyan yang de dus 〈snang du 'phel zhing / chu mig lung du gar zig dbyangs gsum dang / gzhi gsum gyi phyag len mdzad cingaka rim lnga'i dmar khrid zla ba'i bar du bsgoms par mdzad pas grub thob tu grags pa yang 'ga' zhig byung / de nas skabs der lde pa skyid lhastod pa'i phyag g.yog cig rgyud par mgo gtad par byas pas sde pa g.yul rgyal pas phar gtad dgos zer ba rje 'dis srog skyabs su kli rdzu dhisnroshā oṃ ṭ+wāṃ lha sbyi rnyipa gh+nā rdormorlo snapa hūm̐ rdzu ñtsha phroṃ pas bya jisna ji rnyi spri( ༵ rnyi/ r+sha /sdu nyams yin/ zhes dbu zhwa g.yab sdebs dang dmod pa mdzad pa/ rje 'di rim gnyis mngon gyur yin pas sde srid kyi yang yul lhastor sa mthar gakhyams shang]'o brgyal nas gshegs pa dngadabu tsha rgyud la yang nad zhakhrug yang dang yang du 'ong ba dang/ chen 4 du ma dang/ rgyud pa gnyis nas kyang rim spo byas kyang mi ldog par gyugade skabs bla ma mkhas grags che ba mang yang phyis su rje 325
'jigs byed chos 'byung /yab sras kyi gsung rab rnams dang bstun na rje 'di'i gsung bshad zla dang bral bar rtogs zhes lhagan ston pa gsung] paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa gong ma yang bla ma gdo'i dus rgyud padang lhan du chos grwar 'grel pa gsan padangaka gsung chos gsan pa'i r+ṇi/ tshal gyi tshos grwar yod cing/ de dus paṇa chen rin po ches 'dzugs par mdzad pa'i kham sdong dang shug pa'i sdong po yang grwa rgan rnams kyis ston rgyu da lta'i bar du yod/ de ltar gtsang dang dbus su rgyud pa gnyis dang / dpal gangor chos lde sesnags su bstan pa'i bya ba rgya che ba legs zugs ches mang bar mdzad pa'i mthar dgung lo re gnyis pa chu pho stag gi lo/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyer bzhi la dga' ldan du rje btsun 'jam dpal snying po'i zhabs drung du gshegs rtso/ /zugasadam la bzhugasayengad par sde pa mjal du phebs pas sgo phye ma thag thugs dam grol nas mjal rgyu ma byung bar sku gong mas gsung]༈de dag ni rang gi dbang gdamasangag sogs thob pa'i brgyud tshul yin zhes gangon gyis gsungs pas/ rje de las dngon ston dpal 'gyor lhun grub kyis gsang 'jigs kyi skor dbang dang rgyud sogs gsan te/ de yang yul phyogs e gru gsum gyi dbyibs su yod pas e bar grags pa/ 'od la hor gyis lung byed skabs/ dpon 4 zog mo skam po la tshol zer nas mkhar btsan po mang du bajigs pas hor gyi lung nyakhur ma dgos par grags pa sa'i tshangs pa bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen 4 phag mo gru pa'i sde srid ces snyan pa'i rnga 'o che sa gsum du grags pa cher ldir ba'i bka'i blon 4 mtshog lha btsun 4 'od srung gi gdung rgyud/ nang so rgya ri ba'i mnga' 'bangs su gyur pa/ yul de'i skye 'o phal che ba dag yig rigs dang/ rtsis dkar nag /lha bris 'bur sogs ches dar ba'i yul de'i skyogs mkhar zhes pa'i zong du/ yab gshon gyi rigs sngags rnying ma'i grub pa brnyes pa dpon tshe dbang nor rgyas dang / yum mkha' 'gro'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rgyal mo 'dzom zhes pa'i sras su rab byung bcu pa lcags mo bya'i lor zhakhrungs shing /326

rgyud smad nas brgyud tshug'dzin zhakhrul med yid ches byung / dpon slob gnyis thugs yid gcig tu 'dres te/ gong ma'i mya ngan mtha' dag sbrul shun lpags brjes pa ltar gyur nas/ rab dga'i sa la 'gran pa'i spro ba rgyas par gyug drung nas dpon slob kyis gsung gling dang pyin rlabs rnams tshim par zhus te/'gro bar chas pa na/ khyed tsho 'gro na nga yang 'gro gsungs nas bzhengs pa dang drung nas rin ṭo ches/ da lam 'di khar bzhugs pa zhu/ mi 'khyang bar 'bras spungs sgyi so'i gdan 'drin dang bcas te/ dbu zhwa sku chos sogs khyeranas spyan 'dren la 'ong pa lags zhus pas/'o na khyer zugag gsungs nas/ drung nas dpon slob la bkra shas mnga' gsemal gyi me tog gi char phabs thag ring po'i bar du spyan gyis skyel ba sogs dpon slob 'bral mi phod pa ltar du rgyud rje gong ma'i dus kyi yi dam chos skyong gi gtor chog bskang bshags sogs 'bad med du mkhyen cing thugs dam bskang gso gtso sor mdzad cing] sku rim pa rnams kyi gral dbu la phal cher bzhugs pas mtha' dag kyang ma yongs par thugs dam shugs drag tu byed dgos pa byung / yar ngo'i tshes gsum zhig gi nyin phyag sil dkrol zhing zugs dam mdzad 'phyo la/ rje rin 4 che byon byung] ja phud mgyogs par khyer lhagag gsungs shing / phyag sil kha sbyar ba'i bar na bzhugs yod gsungs cung zad phye nas gzigs/ yang kha sbyar nasan bza'i phugs su bzhugs bcug/gces gces mdzad/rdo rje grags mo rgyalasang byung]da dung ja phud khyer shog/rnam sras kyang byung/nas phud khyer shog gsungaka nas dkar mo li sder gang phul bas/ rten gsum mchod gtor sogs la phyag nas legar ba mdzad/ de zad pa dang da dung longs shogs gsungs nas/ nas zad rim gyis phul bas gzim chung de'i mdo phug kun tu phyag nas kyi char chen 4 yun ring du 'phebs par mdzad do/ /de thams cad la rten 'brel dgos chen re yod snang/ de nas phyi dror song tsa na grags mo rgyal gyi lugar da dung bsnad 'dug gsungaka dpal ldan lha mo'i bris sku zhig gi dbu'i 359
'jigasabyed chos 'byung /thad kyi bar snang la nas 'bru gcig rten med du chags/ mda' dar zhig gi sne la nas 'bru gsum brtsegs su chags/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bshes gnyen bkra shis pas mar me chung ngu zhig lhalhashā spra ṭ+wāṃ shāshā /sprapa rnyi / dīlha spyung nākā ci spya ༵ ༵༵ dā gh+nā rnyi /lha ṭ+wāṃ /rmo sna zlo rda/ ñtsā maḥgasungs pas/ sngags snga ma 'jam dpal rtsargyud las gsungs pa de dran nas lung zhus/skabs 'gar sku bsrang mnyam bzhag mdzad nas rgyal ba tshe dpag med yin gsung) yang phyag g.yas sdig mdzubanam mkhar gdeng/ spyan hu rer mdzadanas pad+ma 'byung gnas lde brgyad 'dul ba yin gsungaka jo bo rje gangan bzhugs zhus pas/ dbu'i gtsug tu phyag mdzub gtod/ 'brom gang na bzhugs zhus na/ shangs la phyag mdzub kyis reg /spyan mjug gnyis phyag sor gyis mnan nas/ nga bla ma zhang du gyur tshe 'de 'dra zhig yod gsungs pa shin tu 'dra zeg jo mjal la 'gro gsung bag ma mas lha sa rgyus med dam zhus pas/ nga rang srong btsan sgam po byed dus btab bsan gsungs pa sogs rang gzhan gyi skyes rabs sna tshogs gsungs pa brjod kyis mi langs pa dag mkhyen tshul gsung / zengs gcig ma ma la sngar gtad pa'i gu gul de khyer zugag gsungs/ ma mas de 'dra med zhus pas/ kha sing tsa na ngas lag pa rgyab la btad nas khyod la gtad pade garasku'od gsungs pas dran nye btsalanas phul bas legs byung] nga la brjed pacand ma myong gsung des na rje btsun rin 4 che 'de ni/ 'phags ba spyan ras gzigs dang] de nyid mir sprul pa srong btsan sgam 4 dang] 'brom chos kyi rgyal ṭo dang] bla ma zhang rin po che dang/ lha rjedage ba 'bumadang] thams cad mkhyen bdage 'dun grubadang] thams cad mkhyen padage 'dun rgya mtshodang] thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho nyid/ byang phyogs mtha' 'khob chos kyi dkar 'os khyab par mdzad pa'i phyir du phebs pa 'byung 'gyur ltar yin pas 'di las lhag pa 360
rgyudagadanas brgyudatshugsangs rgyas kyis kyang mdzad pa gar rnyed/ de dus dpal ldan lha mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma sku mdog dmar mo phyag dang po gnyis kyis nyi zla bedzin cing]'og ma gnyis thal mo bdeb pa/dngor mang pos bskor ba gcig gzigs/ saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du cho ga mang po gsungs pa'i mthar 'od skad du/ srid gsum bdag mo nam gru ma/ /khyod kyi zugs dam dus la babs/ /bstan bsrung rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag gi las bcol 'grub par mdzod/ /'dir ni chos skyong phyag bzhi drug gur zhal gyi snang ba mang po dang] dpal ldan lha mo ni sku chung chung rang zhig mdzad 'dug gsungakade nas me pho rta'i lo gsar gyi dus rje gong ma'i phyag len ltar lha mo'i tshes gtor bzang rgyas btang dus/ mdun gyi bar snang la dpal ldan lha mo dngos su byon pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i gzigs snang dpag tu med pa byung ngo / /nyin gcig dbu lo la snum smyugs nas dbu skra'i 〉mo mgul bosnang du bcug pas/ grib ma dbu zlum po'i rnam par byung ba la dgyes nas/ a li bla ma dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dbu lo zhus 'dug gsung] yang nyin gcigadapal ldan lha mo chibs pa dang bcas te byon byung] 'bras spungs pa rnams de ring 'ong ba yod gsungs pa ltar chos grwa chen po'i dpon slob rnams byon pa'i bzhugs gral dus rje gong ma'i zhwa shul ngos bzung/ de skabs rgyal ri mthil gyi bkod pa dang] ma 'ongs pa na der dgon pa 'debs tshul rnams gsungs shing] sde pa so so'i yi ge la so so dad mi dad so sor gsungs pa sogs ya mtshan du ma zhig gsung/ sde pa dpon g.yog rnams rje btsun sa skya pa las gzhan la mi dad pa zhig yod par dgos dbang gis rgyal ba tsong kha ba'i yon tan mang du gsungs shing]dpon g.yog thams cad dmigs brtsema 'drin par bskul ba sogs kyi sgo nas pyis su dge lugs la'ang shin tu dad pa gcig byung /de yang rje btsun tsong kha pa dang/ rje sa paṇa gnyis la rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongasadon 'grel par mkhas mi mkhas kyi khyad par chen 4 yod pa skad yab kyi drung du gsungs shing] yab zegs 361
'jigs byed chos 'byung /pa'i shul du gzhan rnams la sa paṇadang rje btsun tsong kha pa gnyis ka 'jamadapal dbyangasadangos yin pa la khyad par med do gsung / de'i tshe gnas brtan bshes gnyen bkra shes sogs la da ni rang cag rnams 'bras spungs su gso ran/ 'a'od mi yang myur du 'ong] rnga sil 'phyar dar sogs yo byad rnams kyang phar skyol gsung ba sogs/ khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba la spro ba ni/ rgyal bu don thams cad grub pa'i rnam thar bzhin no/ /de nas drung nas rin 4 che dngaka sbyi pa gzims dpon dngan mkhan slob thams cad bka' bgros te/ bod shing sgo can gyi rgyal khab chen 4 pho brang sne'u gdong rtseg sa gzhi'i dbang phyug gong ma chen 4 la bslab ston dang zhib cha zhus te/ me rta nag pa zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa/ res gza' phur bu zla skar rgyal dang ladzom pa'i nyin/ dbu sbra lcang lo dang ldan yang paṇa zhwa sku chos sogs rab tu byung ba'i rtags dang bcas te/ rta mtshog g.yul rgyal la drung nas rin po che chibs pa'i sku pang du 'degs pa'i tshul gyis phebs/ 〉kha nas sde pa rin 4 che dngon g.yog rnams/ rtsigos/ btsugs zhwa/ shal dkar dmar/ rna cha sogs rin chen rgyan cha dang bcas pa'i skya rags/ chos sde chen po'i mkhan slob 〈snags ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa rnams kyi chibs bsu dang bcas/ chos sde chen 4 dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi nye 'dabs su phebs pa na/ dge 'dun grangs med pa chos gos snam spyar gsol te/ mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs pa'i ser sbrengs kyi bkod pas mdzes shing /bstan srung sprul pa'i chos skyong peṃ har yang sku khog tu zhugs te bsu bar byon/ skye bo'i khrom khri phrag tu nye bas zhal mjal byed par 'ongs pa dang] dar 'bag phu mda' sogs yul mi mang po'i skyes pa dang bud med rnams rgyan gos bzang pos spros te rnga shon bro gar klu gzhas sogs rtsed sna ji snyed pa dang/ dga' ldan pho brang gi 6mor 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan bsgrengs shing g.yas g.yon du bkra shis khra ring dbang bo'i gzhu ris ltar bskyangs/ dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha 362
rgyudagad nas brgyud tshugrnams kyis me tog gi char 'ja' 'od kyi gur sogs lha dang mi'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltas phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas te dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sde chen po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du phebs te/ dga' ldan pho brang gi 'jigs pa med pa'i seng ge'i khri chen 4 la zhabs zung gshor los mtshan pa bkod do/ /gzims chung nyi 'od gnyil bar dbus su seng ge'i khri gnyis bshams pa'i g.yas la paṇa chen bsesnad nams grags pa dang] ga'adzin du thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bzhugs/ g.yas gral ladapon slobadage 'dun pa'i rigs dang/ g.yon gral la sde pa yum sras dregags sbyin bdag gi tshogs dang / yar khyu'i gral la phyogs kyi mi sna sesnags gang 'os bsgrigs/ dpon slob rnams rigs lung mdzad pas/ rje 'dis thal skad mdzad nas/shes bya 'di la nga mkhas zhes gsung/ bzhugs gral krol dus/ nga'i dril bu shing kun ma dang ra log ma de longs 77ga gsungs nas/ phul bas mnyes mnyes mdzad/ de nas paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i drung du yongs su rdzogs pa dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan bsod nams rgya mtsho dpal bzang po bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba zhes ga〈snal/ tsha ba chos rje thenags kyis badre da nams grags par smad par grags/ de nas bzhugs gral chen mo bsgrigs thog /thog mar lde srid rin po che nas legs ja'i gnang sbyin bka' shog dang bcas pa/ de nas chos sde'i mkhan slob/ sku zhang chos kyi dbang phyug /gzhan yang phyogs mtha'i grwa rigs sbyin bdag mchog dman kun gyis 'bul ba sogs dga' ston rgya chen po (lha parnyi/na dz+nyo n+dha ༵ r+shadī n+d+ra nga py-i tsho snangabyi ༵ hūm̐ (sna /spya skyushā kau ma ༷ji mide spri/ji rnyipa] 'or 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang dri bzang gis kun tu khyab cing] brgya mchod chen mo dang 'grig pa'i dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkuga'abyung po'i gtor mngan slong la sbyin pa sogasadang] mtshan mo mar 363
'jigs byed chos 'byung /me'i zeng ba rgyu skar sa la rabs pa lta bu rten 'brel mtha' yas pa 'grig go/nub gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug ma zhabs thang gi tshul du phebs te/ smyu gu ring shung gnyis phyag tu phul byung ba/chos srung mang po'i sku bag 'bro dgos paradagongs te zhal bkod gnangaka khyad par dpal ldan ltamo'i 'phyaradar zhig thog mar 'bri bcug pas tshes bco lnga'i dus gtor gyi spyan 'drin skabs spyan lam du phebs pas shin tudagyesate/ gung bsangs zhig la phyag mang du 'tshal ba gnang zhing]drung du mngod pa kun la yang phyag brgya re 'tshol zhes phebs sgo gnang/ bka' las/ snga sor spyan 'drin gyi dus su dpal ldan lha mo sku tshad shin tu che ba mthing nag zhal gcig phyag brgyad pa gcig byon nas chibs kyi dre'u de bzhag /bris thang de la thim song] sil snyan rkyang ba yang nam mkhar mi shong ba tsam 'dug kyang] rang re'i 'phyar dar 'di la shong song bas 'di dpal ldan lha modangosalgen gsung/de nas chos srung gzhan rnams kyi 'phyaradar lalang rab gnas gnang bas yi shes pa rnams thim pa dngos su gzigs/ de skabs khams nas 'bul dpon pa ngag dbang bkra shis 'gyog rta khyab jadangul zangs sogs 'bul ba rgya cher phul/ 'od tshos rgyal gyi gdung brgyud gu ge bdag 4 dpon blon dang] paṇa chen shan+ti pa nas brdzangs pa'i 'bul ba gser srang stong la nye ba serdzogs skyes mtha' yas pa phul/ dgung 'o( lnga pa me lug gi log rgyal du phebs pa'i gser la brgyud phar nang gi rong du phebs pa na mi dkar 4 gcig gis mdzo mo dkar mo dang /nag mo gcig gis mdzo mo lamo la bzhos pa'i 'o ma'i skyem dang g.yu chen 4 gcig phul/ sngon dad ba brtan po'i dus kyi klu gnyis su gsungaka rim gyis bsam yas su phebs/ mdo sde mchod padang 'grig pas/ skya ser gyi khrom chen po 'dus shing] mchod rdzas 'ogs pa'i ser sbrengasadang]bstan bsrung gnod sbyin sku khog tu zhugs te byon pa sogs rten 'brel sgrigs midagos par lhun gyis grub/ mchod mjaladangad bstan bsrung sprul pa'i rgyal 4 la 'phrin las bcol ba gnang] khri 364
rgyud smadanas brgyud tshugsrong lde'u btsan du zhal gyis bzhes/ rim gyis phebs par skya ser grangs med par zugs rje chen po'i bzlas lung gnang / thams cad kyis bdog pas mtshod/ sde pa 'ol kha nas yab sras dang] rdzing phyi'i mkhan po sogs 'ol kha'i dgon pa khag rnamasadang bcas ba'i skya ser gyis bsu ba'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab padang bcas 'ol kha rtser phebs/ dus ston gyi tshe chos rje rnam rgyaladapal bzangadang chos rjedage 'dun lhun grub gnyis kyis bzo gleng byas pas zugasadagyes/thams cad la bla ma'i rnal 'gyor dngaka khom la zhal mjal dang phyag nas gnangaka gnas bcu'i thang lngar phyag nas gtor ba nam mkhar yin ring chags/ bdag cag gi ston pa zhal gzigs/hor zla drug pa'i tshes lnga la chos gabor rgyal du phebs/ dge 'dun gyi bsu ba dang bkod pa ngo mtshar bas spyan drangs/ mtshod khang rnams mjal/ byams pa'i drung du phyag mchod smon lam gnangag zhu ma dgos par gsol 'debs rgyal mdun mdang] rab 'byams rgyal ba ma gnyis gyi lung gnang] mgon khang du gtor gsos/ spyan gzigs/ 'phrin bcol rgyas par gnang] nyang long kong sogs khrom chen 'dus par bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang yig drug gi lung gnang / phyag mtshan ral sgra la gzigs rtogs gnang ba'i tshe/ lde mig nor nas gzhan zhig phul bas de ma yin pa gzhan 'di 'dra zhig yod gsungan rje sngags rams pa dge 'dun bkra shis kyis/ mchog mi /shā a+thi+-i (sad r+nghi spra/rnyi / shāsnyi ༵༵ tsho/ (sna k+ṣiṃ par+sha lhashā da(sna/sna ṭ+wāṃ dī 'khor ma zen pas de ka rang yin gsung nas/ sprul ba'i sku rang gis zen pas snyan bajid ya mtshan pa smyung / de dus 'brom chos kyi rgyal po la bka' gdams bla mas bskor ba gzigs/mtshan resna mnal lam du gshin rje chos kyi rgyal 'o lcags mkhar dang bcas pa mngon sum du mthong] rgyal byams khang gi gtsug lag khang gi steng du gtsang khang dang rgya tshad mnyam pa'i gser 365
'jigs byed chos 'byung /zog gi bzo thabs 'dzug pa gnang/ slar chos lde chen 'odapal ldan 'bras spungs su phebs/ 'di dus phyag rjes zhabs rjes gnang ba'i thog ma yin/de dasan gnyer chos grags kyis rje drung dge 'dun bkra shis kyi dad rten la khyeg sprel gyi lo gsar sogs dngaka jo shāka sogs kyi mchod mjaladangad gser chab/ dkar me/ lha bshos/ snyan dar sogs mchod pa'i sprin tshogs mdzad cingad bstod bshags dang smon lam rgya chen pos phan bde'i lam chen btod/ der lta'od rnams la jo bo'i mdun du bla ma'i rnal 'phyor gnang bas legs tshogs thams cad kyi rtsab brtan pa'i rten 'brel 'grog /'di jo mjal gyi thog ma yin/ bzhugs gnas su phebs par gnas chen thams cad kyis gsol ba btab ste /khom khri phrag du ma la yig drug gi lung dang rdor sems bsgom bzlas gnang] ra mo che'i skabs der bar gyi sa thams cad khrom gyis gang ste/ kun kyang dad pa'i sa la bkod/ slar 'bras spungs su phebs/ slar yang rgyal du chibs bsgyur/ rdo rje la)gas byed kyi sgonas gser thog la rab gnas mdzad pas/ me tog gi charadang laja' 'od kyi gur sesnags ltasal mtshan pa byung] rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsholan chad gar phebs la metog gi char ma babs dus mi snang zhes rgan 'odag gling] slar chos sde chen 4 dpal ldan 'bras spungs su phebs sa bya'i lo gsaradang dus rim rtsogs grub nas/ gsan bsam gyi rim pa la zhugs ba na/ sa ga zla ba'i nang du paṇa chen bsesnad grags kyis mkhan po/ gsang phu chos rje legs pa don grub kyis las slob/shar 〉legs padon grub pas dus rga ba mdzadade/dge tshul gyi sdom ba bzhes/sdom brtsonadam pa'i brtul zhugs kyis 'dzam gling 'gengs pa'i skya rengs legs par shag paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i drung du tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ rnam sras gser chen sogs kyi rjes gnang gsan/ gling stod tshos rje legasadon pa'i drung pu 'jigs byed gyi sngags btu/ smra ma lnga bcu ba'i ṭīk+ka lam rim che chung sogs gsan/ shar 〉legs don ba'i drung du/366
rgyudasmad nas brgyud tshug'jamadakas spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa/ mgon 4 snying zhugs/ gshor brgyad ma sogs rjes gnang du ma dang] laram dbyangs zhi kho sbrags sgrub kyi lung] gsang 'dus 'jam rdor dngaka'jig rten dbang phyug gnyis kyi dbang] bka' gdams thig le bcu drug dang / glegs bam gyi ljags lung rnams gsan/ zla ba drug par bye ri stag rtser gdan drangs/ khrom shin tu che bar zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba gnang / rim gyis mal gro mkhar skya rin chen gling / rdzing sgyi sogs su gdul bya rnams la thar ba'i sa 'on bskyed nas/ chos gshor rgyal du phebs/ glegs bam rin 4 che sesnags kyi chos char gnangam tshur lam 'ol kha bsam gtan gling du phebs/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen por dus gsum mtha' dag lung ston pa'i 'jam dbyangs zhi khro sangs rgyas byang sems grub chen brgyad cu sogs kyi byin rlabs ya mtshan pa mtha' yas kyi sgyu 'phrul mang du r+ṣi/dzad pa'i gzims phug mjal pa gnang] me tog gi char sogs dpag par dka' ba byung / der rdzing phyi nas gdan drangs te/ skya ser la chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad de/ 'ol kha rtser phebs/sde palab srasadang skye bo'i tshogs la dge legs kyi sa bon bzhag ste chos sde chen 'odapal ldan 'bras spungs su phebs/ lcags khyi'i lo/ dbyar ston zla ba drug gi ring dgon pa rtse mor sku mtshams dam par gnang lte tshe dpag gi bsnyen pa 'bum tsho bcu gsum/ rta mgrin gyi bsnyen pa 'bum tsho nyi shu rtsagacig gnang bas/ lha gnyis ka dngos su zhal gzigs shing gsung gi gnang ba stsal/ lcags phag gi log sos than pa che bag jo 4 dang klu khang du khras gsol bas ri klung thams cad mar gad kyi gos gyon/ de nas rgyal du phebs/ dge 'dun tshogs pa la lam rim gyi bka' chos gnang bas nyin re bzhin me tog gi char babs/ zla ba brgyad par 'dod khams dbang mo'i bsnyen sgrub mdzad pas/ mtshan ma khyad par can brnyes/ zla ba dgu par 'ol kha stag rtser phebs/ thub pa bdud 'dul gyi sku zhig gzigs/ rin chen sgang du sku 'dra rin po che mjal/ byin 367
'jigs byed chos 'byung /rlabs rmya mtshan ma chen 4 byung] lhargya ri bas gdan drangs/ e ri sgor phebs/ sde pa yab sras la ladod chosadang] khrom khrir brgal bar tshe dbang gnang/ 'ja' guradang me tog gi char babs/lab tu'ang de 'dra byung ba lab sgron gyi tsho 'phrul du glingam chos grwa chen 4 rtses thang du phebs/ lnga mchod chen mo'i nyin rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen 4 dkyil dngor kun gyi gtso 'or spyan drangs te/ bla na med pa'i mchod pas mnyes par mdzad/ tshogs la snying po don gsum dang] bsngo smon rgyas par mdzadade/ kunadad ba'i sa la bkod/lde srid chen mor bka' shog 'bul ba bcas drung nas byon nas/ sku na phra bas slar mjal ba sogs kyi zhal bkod phul/ sne srid nas kyang dgyes pa'i bka' lan dang/ ja 'drin rgyas par gnang/ sdon rang nyid srong btsan dus bzhengs pa'i khra'abrug mjal te rim gyis dga' ldan pho brang du phebs/ de nas chu pho byi ba'i lo la lo gsar grub rjes/paṇa chen brtsod nams grags pas zur bzhugs dang] sgyi pa dang gzims khang gong/ drung nas sogs gros zoganas pho brang sne'u gdong rtser gdan sa bsko bzhag gi bslabadon zhus shing/ gong nas kyang dgyes bzhin du legs so dang bcas pa'i bka' stsal te/ dus 'khor skya lo mgo nag pa zla ba'idakar phyogs kyi tshes bcu bzhi'i gza' skar 'phrod rgyur 'dzoms pa'i thog/dpal ldan 'bras sprungs chos kyi sde chen por 'jigs med seng ge'i r+ṇi la zhabs sen nor bu bkod/ sde srid rin 4 che nas bsko ja'i 'bul bdang/ bka' shog gi lung bsgrags/ gdung rgyud rin 4 che dngarganang so rgya ri bdanganadaga' ldan pa dpon blon gyis thog drangs/dbus gtsang gi grwa rigs sgyin bdag rnams kyis dad 'bul dga' ston gyi dpal 'byor char du bsnyil/ me tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od sogs ltas rgya chen 4 byung/ sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po yang phebs te/ dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur ji snyed cig mdzad do/ /rje bsod nams grags pa'i drung du rgyal ba tsong kha ba'i gsung 'bum thor bu/ thams cad mkhyen padage 'dun rgya mtsho'i bka' 'bum po ti lngadang/ skyes 368
