rgyud smadanas brgyud tshugpa'i mchod rten bzhengs pa la rab gnas mdzad/ chadakar nas na mo ta'i hong tha'i ji mjal bar 'ongs te/ r+ṇi 'bul byas/ 'dod chos gnang / cung zad bsnyung tshul bstan pas/ sku mngor rnams kyis re zhig mtshams gnang bar zhus kyang / gzhan phan rgya che ba'i skabs mtshams n+ma dgosnas/kho 'o 'grodon la mi skyo zhes bka' phebs padapag paradaka' ba'i rgyal sras kyi rnam tharayinate/mdo lde las/ skyo la dgra bo'i 'du shes dang / zhes pa'i dgongs pa'ang yin no/ /me phag gi lo gsar dga' ston dang / cho 'phrul mchod pa gnang / zu med kyi g.yas ru'i phyogs su phebs/gtsug lag khang la rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ du ring rgyal 4 gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi mgon du phebs/ dge ba rdzogs byang du bgros/ hal ha rdo rje rgyal 4 mjal bar 'ongs pa la/'dod tshos gnang/bu la gan gyi pags pa'i gur sogs nor sna rngam can mang du phul/de skabs sku tshe la skyon byungadogs/ sod mkhar pas gur zhal gyi gtor bzlogadang] dga' ldan pho brang du sku mdun chos mdzad pas 'bum brgya btsug /khu ring khan gyi tshos khur no yon gyis pho nya mngags pa ltar bla mchod btang lte brgyud pa'i sgo nas btul/ har chen gyi rgyal phran zhig rab tu byung bar 'ongs/ des dge 'dun gyi lde btsugs pa la phyag nas gtog mchod rten dkar po'i phyogs kyi rgyal 4 al zad mched kyis spyan drangs/ ltakhang bzhings par rab gnas mdzad/nyin gcig nags tshal tho re ba yod pa'i ri zhig la phebs pas/ dge slong na bza' hrul le ba bzhes pa gcig dang mnyam phyag mdzad/ gsung gling mang du gnang ste/ de nags gseb la yud kyis bzhud song bas/ sku gshor rnams kyis dri ba zhus bag rgyal lta'og steng nas grub chen thar pa'i rgyal mtshan/ kho bo 'gro khar zug pa la byon par 'dug/danang ganganas phebs zhus pas/ gtor ma grolanas 'ongs gsungs byungaka khong yang yun bzhugs mdog ma kha gsung / cung zhig bsnyung pa'i tshul mdzad bad mchog dman kun gyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor sku mtshams gnang ba'i 403
'jigs byed chos 'byung /skabs/ rgyal ba tsong kha pas btang pa'i pho nya yin zer ba zhig 'ongs te/ yi ge phyag tu phul ba gzigs pas re zhigadaga' ldan du shog zer pa 'dug gsungs te/ mgon 4 snying zhugs kyi 'pho ba'i zugs dam rgyun du mdzad/ snyun dwangs padangan dbus gtsang gi gdan 'drin pa rnams kyis yar phebs dgos pa'i zhu 'bul dang] har chin gyi rgyal pos pho nya mngags te/ mtha' lha'ob kyi sa phal cheran dngod pa'i gdul bya'i don mdzad zin pas/nged kyi yul du phebs dgos pa'i zhu banan gyis phul bas/ kun mkhyen zas gtsang gi sras po gyad kyi yul rnacan du gshegs pa ltadhar chin gyi yul du bzhugs sgar btegs/ hor rgyal po'i dus kyi pho brang shing to zhes pa'i shul gyi sar phyag phebs/ rgyal blon laga' zhig la bcom ldan ladas kyai rdo rje'idabangadang/ skye mang yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims la bkod/ rgyal po'i 'bul chen dudangul las grub pa'i khang pa ka gnyis ma tsam zhig tu bzhugs gdan bkod pas/ re zhig sngas pa tsam yin kyang] 'dod pa dang bstun pas tshog gsungs te/ dngul gdung gi rten 'brel du dgongs/ gser dngul gos dar rta khyab sogs 'bul ba khrir brgal ba phul/ der dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs par rab gnas mdzad/ sa byi'i lo gsar dang/ smon lam rlabs po che gnangan zla ba dang po'i mjug nas bsnyung pa'i tshul bstan/ rgya nag gong ma rgyal po'i pho brang du phebs dgos pa'i gdan 'drin gser yig pa btangadkwan ting ta'i gu shrī'i mtshan dang] las ka che ba 'de res byung /rten 'brel du dgongs nas zhal bzhes mdzad/ nag pa zla banas snyung babs lci ba'i tshul bstan te gsung mgur tha ma zung bcas gnang lte/ kun tu rgyu rab bzang ltar sku dngos kyi gdul bya'i mtha' ma rdzogs te/ nag zla'i nyer drug gi tho rangs sprul sku rags pa'i za ma tog bzhag ste/ 'o ngas skus shes kyi sgyu ma'i sku 'dzigs su phye nas rje btsun 'jam dpal snying po'i zhabs drung du gshegs so/ /gdung zhugs la phul pas bde mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sku mang 'odang/ dbu zod ril por phebs/ ring bsrel gyi 404
rgyudasmad nas brgyud tshugphung sar gyur pa phyogs thams cad du bkye bas/ so so'i gdung rten grangs med pa bzhengs pa ni/chos rgyal myangan med kyis mchod rten bye ba bzhengs pa'i mched zlar gyur to/ /cung zad mjalang ya mtshan pa kho na bris pa lags sdug/ /: thams cad mkhyen pa la sngags pa zhal snga nas gtsang ston nam mkha' dpal bzang gis gsan pa yin te/ brgyud 'debs ke ta lnga'i phreng mardzes las/ pad dkar 'odzin pa bsod nams rgyal mtsho'i sde/ /bstan pa'i bdag 4 gsum la ga36la ba 'debs/ /mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha' bzang / /lubon rigs 'jam mgon dpal 'phyor lhun gyis grub/ /ces so/ /rje 'di gtsang du zhakhrungs shing/gzhung lugs la spyangs pas mkhas shing btsun padang] lam rim sogs la sbyangs pas thugs rgyud bzang ba dang] rim gnyis dang bzlas brjod la nus pa thon nas chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi sngags pa bla ma yun ring mdzad cing] dbang rjes gnang gi dngor lo bskor bas mkhas pa dang dam pa du mas chos gsan pa zhig ste/ 'khon ston gyis sa phag la gsang bde sogs kyi dbang dang rjes gnang mang po gsan dus dang] nyis chu stag la rdo rje phag mo/ bde mchogadakar 4/ dur khrod bdag 4 sogs kyi rjes gnang gsan dus gang yin gangon gyi rnam thar dngos bstan la mthon 'dug/gsan yig ni sku phyogs rin 4 che sku bsgras tshul bstan nas/ 'dar dang rnam gling sogs kyis bsgrigs pas yin nam/ gsung snga ma mang 4 dang rgyab 'gal yang re gnyis byung bas yid brtan chub pa dka'o/ /༈ yang thams cad mkhyen pa de la mnga' ris lha btsun gyis gsan par bshad de/ ke ta spu'i phreng mdzes las/ lugs gcig la bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zug lo ka gcig po de'i rjes su/ mkhas grub lha btsun ba〈snad nams dpal bzang po/ /bya btang rnal 'gyor grub chen khyung 4 dang / /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos dkon mtshog chos 'phel lte/ /zhes so/ /lha rin po che 'de 405
'jigs byedachos 'byung /ni/ rigs mang bkur rgyal po'i rigs rgyud/ ston pa zas gtsang sogs kyi dpon po dang gdung brgyud yin cing / rtsis sesnags tha snyad kyi gzhung spru ba la lha'i bla ma shang ku lta bu dang / gsang sngags kyi gsan rgya che ba la in+da 'o nyi lta bu dang / mdo phyogs kun gsan pa kun dga' bo'i mched zla/ sngags byang sems so thar gyi sdom pa gsum gyi bcas rang gi ltang bas ma gos pa mchog zung gnyis lta bu dang/ thugs dul ba ma gtogs drag las sogs mdzad na/ brgya byin dang / tshangs pa'am/ drag po'ang tshar gcod pa mthu ldan lbi rū ba lta bu dang / rdzogs rim spros med kyi rtogs pa 'od gsal lhan skyes nam mkha' lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa grub chen 3 lo ba lta bu/ bstan pa 'dzin skyongang spel pa'i zugs khur bzhes pa la dpal gsang pa'i bdag 4 lta bu ste/ de'i don gyis dam pa kun gyis chos gsan pa'i bla ma yin no/ /༈ de la grub chen khyung 4 ri khrod pas gsan lte/ khyung 'o 'di yang / rgyal ri khrod du zugs dam lhur mdzad cing] lha du ma la ljags bsnyen dang] lam rim la gtso por zugs 'byongs pa'i grub thob yin pas thams cad 'dud pa zhig yin snangaka༈ de la rje dkon mtshog chos 'phel kyis gsan te/ rje mkhas pa chen po de ni/ 'od ru bzhir grags pa'i g.yon ru'i char gtogs pa/ nub phyogs yangs pa'i sa chen po'i bdag 4/dpal phag mo gru pa'i mdun na gdon/thon mi saṃ k+to ṭa'i gdung 'odzin/ nang so yar rgyab pa'i sa'i cha/ gra rigs pa'i 'byung gnas byams gling gi dgon 'dabs su/ yab bkra shis rnam rgyal dang /yum lha mo gnyis kyi sras su chu mo bya'i lo la zhakhrungs so/ /lo lnga drug man chad du gung thang nas bla ma zhang gi gsung las myur du shog gsung ba'i snang ba dang / gsang phu dbyar chos la 'gro gsung ba sogs gron gnas rjes dran sgya gsung mang du byon/ dgung lo lnga lon pa me mo glang gi lor yar rgyabanas sa skya bdag chen zhes pa tshar chen dang mkhyen ba〉sogs ladagrar lta ba/ zhwa 406

'bras spungs nasabargyud tshul/'dun yang dar rgyas che la dge 'dun gyi bca' khrims dam pa mthu stobs che bas phyi nang gi ma rungs pa rnams non che ba/ drang srong gi brtul zhugs brtan pa/ dka' chen rnams rgyun chags su gsungs shing dka' gnad kyi mdud pa 'grol pa sogs bstan pa'i bya ba yang dag mdzad de/sku tshe mthar phyin nas gzims khang du sku zhi bar gshegs/༈ de rjes gdan rabs bdun pa chos rje smon lam dpal legs pa'i blo gros gdan sar phebs pa yin te/ bka' gdams chos 'byung las/ 'jamadabyangs chos rje zhi bar gshegs nas gsang phu gling stod kyi gdan sa ba chos rje dpal ldan seng ge spyan drangs/ zhes pa nas/ de rjes chos rje rin chen byang chub/ chos rje rje dngon pa/ chos rje rong 4 blo bzang pa/ chos rje bla chen shākya rgyal mtshan/ chos rje rab 'byams pa smon lam dpal/ da lta ni 'jam dbyangs legs pa chos 'phyor zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ chos :snad rab gsal las/ chos rje'i rjes su smon lam brgya phrag sogs sbyar ba dang] mkhas pa la la'i chos 'byung na'ang yig nor ram de mtshungs snang ba ni nor ba kho nar shes par gyis/ de la chos rje smon lam dpal ni/ g.yas ru byang du shing pho rta lor 'khrangs/ rje dge 'dun grub pa bsten nas gsung rab la sbyangs/ rje btsun shes rab seng ge la rgyud 'grel gsan/ mdo sngags gnyis ka la mkhas/ rtsethang du po ti sum cu rtsadrug gi grwa skor mdzad/ mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum la mkhas pas rab 'byams pa'i mtshan thob/ gsang phur chos rje yon tan rgya mtsho dang 'bras spungs su 'jam dbyangs chos rje la chos 'bril re zhus nas gtsang la byon pas/ gtsang 4 lho kha'i chos grwa chen mo/ bkra shis lhun 4/ gser khang gong rnams su bshad nyan mdzad/ slar dbus su phebs/ se ra'i rgya grwa tshang] shar gyi mtshan nyid khang] thang skya rnams su 'chad nyan mdzad pas slob ma mkhas pa mang du byungan rnam 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka brtsams/ de nas shar du phebs/ khu ston gyi skye bar zhal gyis bzhes/ dgung lo re bdun pa lcags pho byi ba'i 529
'jigs byed chos 'byung /lor dga' ldan gyi khrir phebs/ de dus bstan dgra dkon mchog gi dkor la rngams pa'i sde pa kha cig gis/ dga' ldan dngul gdung gi bla re gos kha che legs khyad 'phags de len par dmag lan gnyis 'ongs pa chos rje 'dis mdon po'i gtor chen re re 'phangs pas/ dmag la nad rims kyis shi chad dang cho 'phrul che bar byunganas phyir log /da bla ma de yod ring mi de thub kyang lha de mi thub par snang smras skad/ de'i don gyis mkhan chen rgyal ba gong ma chen 'os kyang mthu stobs dbang phyug ces rgyal rabs sogs su bsngags/de'i phyi lo 'bus spungs kyi khrir phebs shingan dgon chen ṭo gnyis dar chos kyi gabor lo bskogrgyal ba byams pa'i pho brang bzhengs/ dgung lodon bdun pa lcags khyi la zur bzhugasadang/don brgyad pa lcags phag lo'i hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nyer gnyis la po ta lar sku gshegs/༈ gdan rabs brgyad pa 'jam dbyangs dga' blo ni/ sa bya la tshal du zhakhrungs/ gung ru chos slo dang slob dasan dpal blo ba la phar tshad gsan/ slob dasan gnas brtan pa la 'dul mngon dang] ba so chos rje dang / paṇa chen pa la gsang sngags rnams gsan cing mkhas pa chen por gyur/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsalnga pa la gsang phu ra ba smad pa'i 'chad nyan mdzad/ de nas mdo khams su phebs nas ring du ma bzhugs par slar dbus su byon nas blo gsal gling ba'i 'chad nyan lo nyi shu lhag tsam mdzad/ dgung lo re lnga pa chu glang la 'bras spungs kyi khrir phebs/ gzhung lugs chen mo'i bshad pa gtso 'or mdzad/ yig la(ga kyang chang chung re mang dang ko lan dar lan sogs mdzad/ zhal slob kyang thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ dga' ldan chos rje chos kyi bshes gnyen/ 6shar gyi chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta bzang 4 dang chos skyong rgya mtsho/ nyi sdings chos rje dpal ldan 'od zed go mal rab 'byams pa sku mched/ sems dpa' chen po'i sku skyes smon lam blo gros/ pyi rdzing mkhan 4 rab 'byor seng ge/ go 'o rab 'byams pa bkra shas seng ge/530
'bras sprungs nas brgyud tshul/kong po chos rje dkon mchog 'byung gnas/ 'ol kha dka' bcu pa blo gros grags ba sogs slob ma shin tu mkhas pa mang zhing sne'u nas sgyin bdag mdzad de/ 'bras sprungs byams chen gyi sku bzhengs pa sogs bya ba cher mdzad/ dgung lo don lnga pa chu phag zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad la chos dbyings su gshegs/༈gdan rabs dgu pa mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar nyung gsal gcig song]༈gdan rabs bcu pa gangs can gyi mgon 4 phyagan pad+madage 'dun rgya mtshodapal bzang 4 dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rdo rje 'di'i sprul pa'i lung bltan gsal tsam byas na/ sprul pa'i sku ji ltar 'byon dang] mtshan ci 'dra dang / grangs du 'byung dang] de dag gi mdzad pa yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa yang sprul pa'i glegs bam las lan du mar bstan te/ 'dir nyung 'dus gcig drang bar bya lte/ 'dam gyi rdze bcang gi tshoms bzhi pa las/ nga la dkon mchog 'bangs su grags/ /de yang dkon mchog skyabs 'og nas/ /dad pa brtan pas chags pa med/ /pha ma'i tshogs kyi sdig pa bshags/ /de nas mtha' gnab du ma 'grims/ /de nas 'di yi nub phyogs su/ /zugs rje chen 4 seng ge'i sgra/ /snying rje che bas rgyal bar grags/ /de nas re zhig dga' ldan 'gro/ /slar yang mtha' gabobadapag med pu /chu shel khye'u 'de skad pu /nga yi chu mig ring mo las/ /chu phul tsam zhig nub phyogs su/ /mtha' gangob ze'u 'brus spud par byed/ /de nas phyinang gsum 'dus nas/ /sdig pa'i tshogs rabs 'di bshags pas/ /ji srid mkha' yis khyab gyur pa'i//gnasan rgyud can gang zhig gi /dngos sam brgyud pas nyes gyur pa'i/ /'ching ba'i tshogs rnams 'dir bsdomasanas/ /ma lus chags pa med la bshags/ /zhes pa'i don dkon mtshog 'bangs/de rjesadad pa brtan podang]denas srong btsan sgam por phungs nas mtha' lubob du maradabang mdzadade/ pha ma'i sdigs bzhags lhaldan chos mngor sogs bzhengs padang]denas 531
'jigs byedachos 'byung /dge bshes ston par zhakhrungs nas mtha' dngob du mar 'grims nas mtha' lugab hor nang du rwa sgreng bzhengs bdang bcas bani/denas mtha' lha'ob du ma 'grimag zhes palan gyis bstan/ de nas snye thang zer kyang bshad ma thag pa'i rwa sgreng 'di'i nub phyogs su/ snar thang mkhan po zugs rje chen 4 'brom gyi sprul par grags pa seng ge skyabs su mdzad/ slar yang mtha' lha'ob dbag med du chu shel gyi khye'u spyan ras gzigs kyis gzhan don mdzad nas/ nga'i bka' gdams kyi bstan pa'i chu mig ring mo las bstan pa'i chu phul gang tsam zhig rwa sgreng gi nub phyogs su song bas 'od mtha' gshob tu bkra shis lhun po'i ze'u 'brus spud pa 'am mdzes par byed ces pa/mtha' dngob ze'u 'brus spud par byed/ ces pa yan chad kyis bstan te/ paṇa chen ye shes rtsemo'i gsung las/ sprul pa'i khye'u dkar 4 zhig gis chu phul gang tsam zhig khyer byung nas 'di byang rwa sgreng gi chu mig ring mo'i chu yin/ da gdong 'thung zer ba zhig bkra shis lhun po'i khron pa chen po bru ba'i dus su byung zhes gtan tshigs dang bcas pa gsungs/ de nas thams cad mkhyen pa dge k+ṣiṃ spyu shā k+to r+ṇi pazhu ny+pha pa~X ༷sa 53( /nā shā /bsna (shā spra (shā hūm̐ spra /( / spri /lha legs zhus pag lha'i dbang po brgya byin yin zer ba zhig gis me tog pad+ma gcig dang / ser ba'i rdog ṭo gnyis gtad byung nas 'di dor la gang du lhung ba der phyin na 'gro don 'phel zer/de rnams nam mkha' la 'phangs pas yol dkar du pa5 de babs/ pad+ma kha ma phye ba ser ba lta bu gcig dbu ru stod phyogs su babs/ gcig mdo khams su babs pa las 'dir 'ongs pa yin gsungs/ ser ba rdog po gnyis ni pad+ma kha ma phye ba yin zhes thams cad mkhyen pa rang gis gsungs pa zos zhesarwa rong chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar las gsungs so/ /pad+madakar podang ser rdog lta bu'i pad+ma ma smin pa nam mkhar 'phen mkhan mi gsalayang rje rin po che yin 532
'brasaspungs nas brgyud tshul/te/rtogs brjod dngos grub kyi sprin bzang las/ dga' ldan du byon/ byams pa dngaka nam mkha' dri med dngaka 'jam dpal snying po rnams la gdams padang rjes su bstan pa mnos/de rnams la bdag 'gro don la gang du pyinan legs zhes zhus pas/ rgyal sras 'jamadapal snying 'os pad+ma dkar podang ser ba rdog po gnyisanam mkha' la bsgyur nas 'de rnams gar song du song la 'gro don gyis gsungs pas/ me tog pad+ma dkar po de yol dkar du babs pa dang mthun par zhes /shārnyilha spra ga/ //rdzu gh+nā ṭ+wāṃ /dī gar+shadī lhar+sha trā dri // /rdzus hūm̐ rī shā k+ṣiṃ /'i ṭā ༵༵ sprad/ shā 'dun grub dang thams cad mkhyen pa 'di gnyis kyi mtshan gyi zur mdzad pa dang bcas nas bstan te/ 'chi med rdo rje'i glu las/gangs ri'i mgul du 'brom rje khyod/ /mi mngon dbyingasanas gzhan don brtson/ /bzod pa gsum gyi ko cha can/ /bdud sde'i tshogs kyis mi phyed pag /gangs ri'i khriX /hūm̐/ a+thi+-i t+t+waṃ/ ṭ+wāṃ/ nāṃ ༷ two ṭī/ ṭ+wāṃ ༷༷ dz+nyo/ / hūm̐ ༷/ shaṃ saXsli pyā ༷| 'dun gyi mtshan can gangs can skyong ba'i rgyal ba bdun sogs kyis mi rabs du ma na smon pa'i 'bus bus skyongang zhes pa yin te/ saṃ gha zhes pa'i saṃ yang dag dang kun dregags dang] gha tshogs pa dang 'thug pa sra ba sogs la 'jug pas yang dag par tshogs pasanade bdud kyis mi pyed pas dge 'dunate/ skyabs 'ju bdun cu pa las/ bdud rnams bye ba brgyalas kyangan/gang phyir skyabs dang mi phyed pa/ /de phyir dge 'dun mtshan gsol te/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na dge 'dun mtshan can gnyis kyis thog drangs rgyal ba bdun gyis 'gro don rnam par dag par mdzad pa'i lung bstan payin lte/ rwa sgreng shug pa'i mtshonadon skabs su dkon mchog 'bangs kyi le'u las/533
'jigs byed chos 'byung /wawashun pa rim pa bdunaspend pa nyidani lnga brgya dus kyi tha mar gso ba 'drin par smon lam zebs pa'i rgyal ba bdun gyis rgyun chad med par skyong ba'i rten 'byel zab mo'o//zhesadage slong bdun 'byung bar bshadado/ /rwa sgreng gi lung bstan las/pad+ma re la shun pa bdun bdun te/ /tshul khrims gtsang ma'i gos kyis brgyan par byed/ /kye de ni spong bdun gos kyis ma sa pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rje thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi gsung mgur las kyang / skye ba bdun du 'gro don legs hāzlo / snam/sa/za/ ga/da shāshā kau shā1 dzī rnyi ༈ /lhan pa ṭ+wāṃ sprad/zhes/ spyu lha (pa lha sta hā/ paX (( rje rin 4 che dang rje dge 'dun grub yab sras sku tshe dpag med nas 'brel bas 'od 'dir yang dang yang du tsan+dan dang de'i dri ngad bzhin du 'bral ba med tshul/ dkon mchog 'bangs kyi skyes rabs las/ rgyal ba yab sras bzo ba mdzad/ /sngon tshe rdo rje gdan du 'dzoms/ /da lta lku rgyan gnas su 'dzoms/ /ma 'ongs gangs ri'i khod du 'dus/ /yab sras tsaldan dri bzhin pu 'bral med 'gro ba'i phan bde 'byung/ zhes gsungs la/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyis drin che ba'i gla ma gsum 'dren dus kyang] sher seng dang / shes rab mchog grub tshe 'di'i drin can dang] rje btsun tsong kha pa chen 4 tshe rabs thams cad kyi bla ma yin/ zhes gsungs so/ /de yang 'od kyi bstan pa gzugs brnyan las med dus shar nas bstan pa'i bdag 4 rje rin po ches bstan pa btsugs pa nas bstan pa'i gsal byed sprul pa'i khye'u spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa'i rabs thams cad mkhyen pa bdun gyis 'jig rten lhar bcas thams cad la thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam rim bzhin du gsal bar byed par bstan pa'i phyigathor bu'i tshoms las/gzhan snang ma dag pas 'phel 'grib 'byung ba ltar mthong yang / shar nas zla ba'i dkyil gangor mdzes//zhun ma'i khye'us sprul pa 'gyed//'jig lten thams cad gsal byed cingan/lhadang bcas 534
'bras༄ngas nas brgyud tshugpa gsal bar byed/ /ces dang / dgon mchog 'bangs kyi skyes rabs las kyang/ u rgyan yul du ji skad smras pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang gnas der lha 'dri 'dul du 'gro/sprul pa gcig ni bal bo'i mthil du 'ju/sprul pa gcig ni mdo khams smad du 'ju/sprul pa gcig ni rgya gar gnas chen 'grims/ /dge slong nga la bden pa yod min kyang] /mi dbang khyod kyis krogs byed rtag tu dge /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i lung bstan yin/ /zhes so/ /'di grags che la dge ba'i lung bstan zhes spru rgyal ba dang po gsum gyi mtshan smos nas 'khrangs sa nub phyogs na gnas par lung bstan par bya ste/thor bu'i tshoms las/ bltan pa nub la nye ba'i tshe/ /nyi ma'i dkyil gsar nub na gnas/ /zhes gsungs shing/ 'di dgawer bar gsungs pas rgyal ba snga ma gsum ka de la ltos pa'i nub phyogs su zhakhrungs par bshad dgos/ rnam thar snga ma 'gas snye thang la sbyar ba khang sar dang mi 'grigs la/ g.yang ba chos rjes nub byang zer ba yang kho 'os snar thang gi dpe rnying khungs ma dang dpar ma gnyis sogs la bltas kyang mi snang ngo] /nyi ma'i dkyil pangor nub phyogs na gnas pa de la lte/ de'i nang nas bsod nams mchog gi mtshan mnga' ba phyin chad kyi rgyal ba'i nyi ma lngas dngos su bstan spru thams cad gsal bar byed cing / de'i sprul spru dang slob rgyud rnams kyis kyang bstan pa'i thos bsam sogs kyi zur re bedzin cing gsal bar byed pas bstan pa'i dkyil pa'or gzhan gyis bsgrib mi shub par dam pa mang 'os zhing khams mang 'o gsal zhing 'gengs par lung bstan tede'i 'phyogade nyid las/de la'ang bsodanams mchog gi mtshan/ /lnga yis dngos sam brgyud pa'i zug /dkyil gshor bsgrib par mi nus pas/ /dam pa'i zhing khams rab gsal zhing] /zhes pa nas/ nga yi rnam thar khrims brgyan te/ /don mchog bde gshegs lam sprudod pa'i/ /bsod nams mchog gis me ga〈snas te/ /lnga ldan bzang pos mi nub skyong //zhes sogs gsungs te/ gleng bslangs pa tsam lte/rang gidad pa'i gsos su bsam mo//535
'jigasabyed chos 'byung /de yang sprul pa'i sku rgyal dbang gnyis pa 'di zhakhrungs pa'i rigs ni chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan/ rje sreg po khyung bzhi/ ltajo lcam dngaka 'bangs ra slog can dang drug/bse 'a zha gnyis dang bcas pa mdo khams smad nas chad de gtsang du chags pa'i nang nas mchod gnas la snga ba sreg ston dar ma zhes pa'i rgyud las sreg ston sgom btsun dang sreg ston char 'be+ebs gnyis byung] phyi ma'i dasan rgyud yab kunadaga' rgyal mtshan zhes pa/ yab mes gong ma rnams kyi chos kyi steng purje sher seng / dge 'dun grub/ rje bzang po rgyal mtshan sogs la gsang sngags gsar rnying kun gsan cingaka rang lus lhar gzigs pa'i bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim mnga' ba/ dpal rta mgrin dang / khyung khra dang / ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa/ chos skyong theg tse sogs yi dam dang chos skyong du ma'i zhal gzigs pa de dang/ yum kun dga' dpal mo zhes pa gzhon nu'i dus sngar rgod tshang ba'i drung na sku(da pa'i 'gro ba bzang mo yin/ zhes gsungs shing / gsang bde 'jigs gsum spridī dzor+sha ༷stab ñtsā snaXr+sha dzopa tram̐ hā pa/( po/ sna tsho ༵ lha spri( ny+pha shāng k+ṣiṃ ༵༵ ( k+ṣiṃ lha rje gdan zhes bya bar hor gyi lo ltar na shing mo lug dang / 'od kyi lo ltar na me sbrel gyi lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes pa gsum gyi nyin nyi ma dros tsam na rje 'gos sogs dpa' po dang] mkha' 'gro ma ye shes mtsho rgyal zugags 'khyangs pa'i gtsang g.yas ru sa'i zig ler sku bltams te/ de yang bltams ma thag nas byis pa dang tshur mthong gi rgyud tshul mtha' dag rgyang ring du dor zhing / rje rin 4 che dang sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas byin gyis rlabs pa'i brdar spyan nam mkhar gzigs nas dbu dud dud mdzad pa zhig yod par thams cad gleng] lo gnyis gsum nas rang gzhan gyi sngon gnas rjes su dran nas smra ba gcig 〈snad pas bu rdzi gcig kyang bskos gsos skyed pas/ bag med kun spangs shing] sku la dri zhim 4 rtag tu bro ba 536
'bras spungs nas brgyudatshul/dang/ rje dang tā re rgyun du gsungs shing gaṇ+ḍi yin zer nas shing leb gcig dang/ tsha dro'i dus rje rin 4 che yin zer nas rdo smug 4 gcig sku mdun du 'jog /phud mchod 'drin/ mtshan mo lhan pa res dril nas gtsang sar lasdog/ri khod pa rnams sgar 'degs dusan bzar btum nas lus dogs mdzad pa sogs dang] de'u mang du bsags nas dgon pa rtsig pa dang] chos 'chad nyan dang / rten bzhengs kyi tshul byed/ de skabs sprin gakhrigs/ me rtog gi char dang 'ja' shar 'brug ldi ri ri grags pas/ yab kyi sku pang nas dbu bteg nga'i pha blo bzang grags pa chos gsungs pa'i sgra 'dra ba gcig byung zer phyag 'bul mdzad/ byang phyogs kyi nam mkha' la gzigs nas/ ya gi nanga'i pha blo bzang grags pa mthang sham dang / tshos gos ngur smrig dang paṇa zhwa ser 4 gcig bzhes/ phyag chos 'chad dang zhabs rdo rje skyel krung mdzad nas bzhugs 'dug gsung / pha blo bzang grags pa chos gsungs tshul ji ltabu 'ong zhus pas gsung gi dpangs bstod de/'o bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan lhag pa brtson bcas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs la smra mkhas ldan/ brtseba'i bdag nyid skyo ba spangs la brten/ /gsung gi yod gsungs nas/ sang yang chos gsungs par 'gyon par yod gsungs pa sogs sku skye ba snga ma'i yon tan cung zad kyang ma bsnyel pa 'di ngo mtshar che/ me tog gang rnyed pha blo bzang grags pa la 'bul lo zhes nam mkha' la gtor te sar lhung na/ 'di rnams ngas pha blo bzang grags par phul yod pas khyed sus kyang ma len 'gom yug ma gtong gsungs/ res 'ga' rtsed mo'i 'phyo la yang] rje rin po che phyag phebs lags sam/ bdag kyang skyed 4 byung lags gsung/ de dusanas bzung ste/ rje rin ṭo che'i dpar sku chung chung zhig dang 'bral ba med par mdzad pa yin/ zhes rje nyid kyang gsungs la/ der ma zad gsol ba nam btab pa'i tshe sku'i gzigs snang re yanganar mar 'ong ba gcig 〈snad ces gsungs par yang grag /skabs gcig grang rdul dang skrag snang 'amad pa gcig 537
'jigs phyed chos 'byung /byung bad yab kyis ci 'dug gsungs pas/ ban nye ras phya mdang sag theb gyon pa gcig gis/nga'i rkang pa nas then then byed kyi 'dug pa la dpal ldan lha mo byon byung nas dre'u las babs te kho'i lag pa la be+e rtson brgyab pas/ kho lag pa na nas phur phur byed cing zos songaka lar dang 4 nga dpe cha lta dus su yang rgyal po g.yu phreng can 'di 'ongs nas bar chad byed pa gcig yod gsungs/ gzhan yang de dag gi dus kun tu/ dpal ldan lha mo byon byung gsung zhing] zhal 'phros dir dir mdzad pa gcig yod ces yab rin 4 che gsungs/ des na rje btsun nyid kyi bstod par yangakagazhon nu nyidanas lhadang bla masas/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i snang ba rab rgyas shing/ /zhes pa'i lha dang bla ma yang 'di gnyis yin zhes rje nyid gsung ngos /yang ri khod der yab kyis sangs rgyas 'phel gos bosnan la nyol gsungs pas/ nga sangs rgyas 'phel min/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas yin/ nam mkha'i mthong 'di na jo 'o zugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar 4 zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang 4 gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ lhag ma gnyis shel dkar gyi phreng ba dang me tog pad+ma dkar 4 bsnams pa/ daradang rin yo ches brgyan cing/ pad zla'i ltengan skyel krung mdzad pa ri 'o tsam zhig bzhugs kyi 'dug /de'i g.yas na sgrol ma dkar mo dang / g.yon na ljang khu gnyis rang rang gi sngags 'drin gyi 'dug /zhabs bus g.yas kyi mdun na dbyangs can ma dkar mo zhig pi wang sgyur cing ñtsā ñtsā gsung gi 'dug gsungs pas/'on jo 'o la bdag kun dga' rgyal mtshan tshe ring zung ji ltar yod zhus shig gsungs pas/ bdun cu don gnyis thub gsungs/ phyi ma gang du skye zhus pas/ pa'or ba gsungs/ de las grol ba'i thabs zhus pas/ nyin re bzhin yig drug mang du thon gsungs pa gcig byung gsungs/ rje'i zhal nas/ skabs de dag gi tshe mig btsams byas pa na sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku la 'di 'char dang 'di mi 'char bya ba cung zad kyang med pa zhig 'char gyi 〈snad/ mig phye tshe cher mi gsal ba zhig byung/ de dus ye shes la snang ba de yin 538
'brasakhungs nas brgyud tshugpa 'dug ces gsung/ sman gcig ma'i gnyan khod na bzhugs dus shig me tog la gzigs nas bzhad/ 'de nga'i tshe snga ma'i smo ma/ a ② bu 'drin gyi skra lo dang rgyan cha 'dra na/ nga'i ming la pad+ma rdo rje zer/ rta rgod ma sngon mo rnga ma dkar 4 byas pa gcig yod/ pha spun po khyi long rdo rje zer ba gcig yod/ nged gnyis kyis lang tsho lung par rta 'tsho bar phyin/ rje'u dkar nag mang po spungs nas rtsed mo 4pas rje btsun byams pa byon byung ste/ byis pa gnyis ci byed gyin yod gsungs pa la/ rtsed mo byed gyin bdog zhus pas/ kun rdzob kyi snang ba rtsed mo 'dra/ /de la g.yengs na gsor bar 'khyams/ /las 'bras rje'u dkar nag 'dra/ /rang btsan sa zin pa'i chos gcig 'tshal/ /gsungs nas mtshode'i dkyil stod tsaman rgyab bzhi skor rdo zer pa'i ri gciga'amad pa'i rtser byon song / nged gnyis 4sa kyang rje btsun sgya phyag phyi la 'phro bar byas nas lag pa smel/gos gnya' bar khur nas mtsho de brgal bas mgo 4 man chad chu nang du thim pan rje btsun gyis bton te chu phran zhig gi 'gram du bskyal/ de nas phyin pas chu mig gcig gi 'gram gyi rdo leb dkar po gcig gi stengan rje btsun ma.ār+ya༄ re bzhugs 'dug pa la phyag phul byin rlabs zhus pas/ phyag g.yasan ut+pal ldon 4 gcig 'dug pa de mgor bzhag nas/ lhangor ba'i mtsho las byams pas bsgral/ /lesnag pa'i gling las nga yis bskyabs/ /zhes gsungs/ de'i tshe nyo gnas mtshog dpal gyi tsa ri na/ bla ma mi la bkras don bya ba bzhugs/ de nga'i tshe gron ma'i bla ma yin/rtsemo snyung ri zer ba'i ri chen 4 snyil gyi jo ṭo 'bri rdzi 'dra mo gcig yod pa yangad gadran gsungakade dus yab chos rje'i drung du dgung lo gsum bzhi nas ri khrod rnams su bka' lung gsan pa dang/ dbang rjes gnang gsan pa rags pa tsam smosan bde mchog snyanag dril gsum/ 'dzigs byed bcu gsum ma/ zhedagu ma/ ro langs brgyad skor sogs kyi dbangad mgon po'i rjes gnang dge ldan pa la grags pa bcu gsum/ de la mi ze ba'i shangs skor du ma/ mgon 4 phyag bzhi pa/539
'jigasabyed chos 'byung /gud chos bdag chen po a lhor phyinang gsang gsum/ dam can chos kyi rgyal 4/ rnam sras skyogdpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo/ chos skyongang zeg tse lcam dral sogs kyi rjes gnang yig cha rnams skya lungaka na ro dang ni gu chos drug gi khrid/ dwags shangs kyi phyag chen skor mang pho dang / su kha chos drug /zhi byed brgyud pa snga phyi bar gsum gyi chos skog khyad par brgyud pa phyi ma'i dbang //lha parnyi( / girnyi lhasatsha ༷ ṭ+wāṃ gh+nā ṭ+wāṃ ༵ ༵ dī shug/ k+ham̐ṇ+ḍu parmā lhar+sha g+ni ༵nga /rdoX ༵༵ /(smo pa mtha' yas pa zhus shing] khyad par mgon po'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel/ tshe dbang grub rgyal ma lha dgu ma 'chi klu dang bcas pa brgya tshar mang po dang / rta mgrin yang gsang khos pa'i dbang rjes gnang sogs chos skor tshang ma dang /shangs lugs kyi rta mgrin/ ṭ+wā ro mkha' spyod kyi kau spya snar ༵༵༵ rī k+ṣiṃ spyu ṭ+wāṃ/ r+ṇi parlo /shān+dha /dī sbyispri shā)lja r+sha ༵ m+b+ya dz+nyo phyag rdor gyi rjes gnang mang 4/ dngor lo chen po'i dbang/ bka' gdams ltabazhi'i rjes gnangakabcu gcig zhal gyi chos skog chos rje rgyal sras pa'i bka' 'bum/ pha rgod kun bzang/ chos rje don yod pa'i bka' 'bum/ yang dgon pa'i ri chos skor du ma/ gu ru zhi drag sogs dbang rjes gnang / man ngag ji snyed pa rgya cher gsan/ dgung lo bcu gcig bzhes dus bkra shis lhun ṭo sgyis gdan drangs/ chos sder phebs/ rta lo hor zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi yongs su grags pa'i sangs rgyas kyis chos gshor 'og mar bskor ba'i dus khyad par can la/ paṇa chen lung rigs rgya mtsho la gtsug phud phul/ dge bsnyen mdzad/ mtshan dge 'dun rgya mtsho dpal bzang po zhes gsol/ lo 3 spu'i dgun chos dus gnas der gnas rnying kun dga' bde legs zhes brtan mkhas gnyis dang mkhas grub zung 'grel gyi chen po des mkhan 4 dngaka paṇa chen lung rigs 540
'bras spungs nas brgyud tshul/pas slobadasanadangan dbu mdzad sangs tshul gyis dus godang/ gnas brtan 'dul ba 'odzin pa bcu phrag gsum gyi dbus su dge tshul bsgrubs par mdzad/ gnas rnying rin po cher ye shes mgon 4 dngor brgyad kyi bka' dngan mgon po snying zhugs thun mong ma yin pa gnas rnying pa'i gcig rgyud kyang gsan/ rje'i gsang pa'i rnam thad dge 'dun grub kyi spyan bdun ma'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa sogs gsan/ dgung lo bcu drug par 'jam dbyangasadakar po la zhag bdun bsnyen pa gnang bas bdun pa'i tho rangs 'jam dbyangs dkar 4 zhal mngon sum du gzigs pas skyes rabs mang 4 dran cing snyan ngag gi nyams sngar las shugs che ba dang] ja re'i yun la 〈sna lo ka brgya sogs 'dzin pa dang] gsung rab gzigs pa tsam nas mkhyen pa sogs byung / de nas paṇa chen lung rigs pa zur bzhugs mdzad nas/ de rjes ston chos rje ye shes tshemo mkhan sar phebs pa slob dpon du bsten nas rje 'di bas gsol ba btab ste/ thog mar rje nyid nas brgyud pa'i mgon 4 bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang zhus/ de nas dpyid snar thang du dpal dus kyi na'or lo'i dbang chen dbang hor ma dang bcas pa/ bdag 4 chen po'idabang ma gtogs pa gsan/ gzhan yang mgon po bcu gsum gyi dbang rjes gnang / yig cha rnams kyi lung /sngags rim/ bde mchog gi rgyud ṭīka chen dang bcas pa/ brtag gnyis kyi rgyud mkhas grub rje'i ṭīk+ka dang bcas ba/ dpal kyai rdo rje'i bskyed rdzogs sbyin sreg gi lung sogs sngags phyogs du ma dang / bka' gdams glegs bam cha lag dang bcas pa/ jo bo'i lam yig /rnam thar tshos kyi 'byung gnas/ chos chung brgya rtsaphal che ba'i lung) rje rin 4 chedangasga mkhas grub rje/ chos rje rgyal sras pa/ thams cad mkhyen padage 'dun grub/ 'dul 'dzin blo phros sbas pa rnams skya bka' 'bum gyi lungan dus gsar ṭīka chen gyi lung sogs mtha' yas pa/ dkyus la gtong ba'i dka' chen bzhi'i mdzub khrid rnams gsan/ de nas spyidon rigs rgyan dang] smon lamadapal pa'i rnam 541
'jigs byed chos 'gang //sprir+sha ñtsha /tsho (rdzu (3 ༵༵༵ smo snraX ༷pa /shā swā k+ti k+ṣiṃ rī/ spri/pa zloshā/rnyi k+ṣiṃ ༵ gnyis par rigs chenadang] de nas dgun chos tshun chad la rnam 'grel gyi rigs gra 'grims/de nas bzung ste dbyar dbu ma'i bsgrigs dang] dgun dpyid phar tshad spel nas bsgrigs/ bcu drugadang bcu bdun dus snyan ngag la blo zos zla bral thob nas/ rje'i bstod pa/ dpal ldan lha mo'i mngon rtogs dngaka bskang gso dang] bstod pa dngan 'jam dbyangs dkar po dngaka dbyangs can ma sogs kyi bstod pa sogs brtsams/ dgung lo bcu bdun song pa'i byi lo hor zla bcu gcig par gnas rnying chos rje 'jam dpal snying 4sa gnas rnying du spyan drangs/ zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub/ de'i tshe sku skye rin 4 che zhes snyan grags dang gdul bya 'phrin las kyi 'ur langs pas bla brang phyag gasku'og rnams kyis phrag dog gis phra ma byas shing / snar zang mkhan po sher rgyal pas kyang] mi de'i bu la thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku skyes mi 'ong zhes 'byung pos bskyed pa'i lab tshan brten cing / paṇa chen rang gis sprul sku yin pa mkhyen kyang gdul bya'i dus dang yul byang phyogs yin par dgongs sam/ gang ltar snga gong nas chos rje smon lam dpal pas dbus su cis kyang phebs pa legs dredags zhus pa dang] kha 'thor gyi tshoms las phal cher gab pa mngon phyung stos/ /bstan pa ji ltar ma nub par/ /gab pa rim gyis mngon par 'gyud /'dran las ring du mda' ma 'phen/ /ra yi sa nas rwa sgreng du/ /pad+ma'i spub can du ma hūm̐ dh+ri/ / ṣ+ṭaṃ sh+lau nāṃ ༷ /༷ phyi ༷ / / dz+nyā/ khriphyi ṭ+wāṃ twi ༷༷ ༷༷/ ༷ hūm̐/ //spya sdu two ṭ+wāṃ pas skabs kyi 'dran skye ba de'i lung bstan lhagad la/ lhag ma ma bshad ces pa mda' lhag ma mi 542
'bras spungs nas brgyud tshug'phen pa dngaka ra sa 'phrul snang nas byang du rwa sgreng gi dgon dang] de nas pad+ma'i sbyo ming me tog yin pas rgyal metog thanganas phyagan pad+ma'i yu ba bsnams pa'i chos thams cad mkhyen pa'i snang pa can gyi sprul sku drug 'byung pa'i don yin te/ 'brom gyi smon lam las kyangad pad+ma'i spubs su chos kyi snang ba rgyas/ /rgyal bas kha 'byed rgyal bas skyong bar tshesnag /ces gsungs pa'i dus la babs pas/ chos rje legs :snas pas kyang zhu yig phul bas dbus la phebs par spro zhing /dgung lo bcu dgu pa shing stag la rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi rgyal rnga chen 4 brdung pa'i gnas dpal ldan 'bras spungs su phebs te/ legs bshad kyi dga' ston len pa la chas par gyur to/ /der lo gsum du mkhas pa 'jamadabyangs dga' blo la chos gsan pa ni/ rtsasher 'jug gi bshad pa mdzub khrid dang bcas pa thog mar gsan/ rten 'brel bstod pa'i ṭīk+ka yang de dus mdzad/de nas 'dul mdzod/ mngon pa gong ma/ mdo sde rgyan/ rgyud bla ma/ 'byed rnam gnyis/ tshad ma mdo/ drang nges rnam 'byed sogs mtshan nyid kyi gzhung du ma'i bshad pa mdzub khrid dang bcas pa/ rje yab sras kyi bka' 'bum/ rje'i rnam thar che chungasga 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i rnam thad rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar sogs kyi lung mang po/ dpal gsang pa 'dus pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par zhus n+ta/ 'grel ba slon gsal ga lag dang bcas pa/ rgyud kyi mdzub khrid/ rim lnga gsal sgron/ gdan rdzogs/ bskyed rim/ ṭīk+ka sogs yig cha mang po'i bshad pa/ gzhan yang sngags rim chen mo/ bde mchog ṭīka chen gyi lung bshad/ bde mchog 'dod lasdo/ rdzogs rim rnal 'phyor chen po'i rnam bshad kyi khrid yig sogs dngakadril bu rim lnga'i khrid yig rnam bshad sogasadangaka nā ro chos drug gi khrid/ rgyal tshab rje'i dus dngor gyi khrid yig/chos je ba so ba'i dus pa'or gyi bskyed rdzogs/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa mkhas grub chos rje'i ṭīk+ka'i steng nas mdzub khrid/ 'jigs byed kyi dbang] kyai rdor gagar chen 'dzigs byed gsang 'dus sogs 543
'jigs byed chos 'byung /kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi rin thun/ rdzogs rim gyi khrid/ snying po don gsum gyi khrid/ lta khrid/ lam rim chen mo sogs mdor na sngags mtshan nyid kyi chos kyi dngor lo mtha' yas pa zhig gsan/snyan ngag me long gi bshad pa gcig kyang gsan no/ /de'i skyor mgo thams cad rje'i drung nyid kyis mdzad/ mdo sde rgyan gyi mdzub khrid kyi skabs su nyin re bzhin yig phreng bdun ma'i gzhung gi 〈snag bu phyed dang gnyis lhag tsam re'i mdzub khrid dkyus re la thogs med du skyor/ gsang 'dus rtsargyud kyi mdzub khrid sogs legs par gsan/ de ltar gsan nas gzhung lugs gdams par shar tshul/ rje 'di nyid kyi gsung las/ brgyud pa jo 4 yab sras la zug pa/ /bla ma mkhas grub gnyis tshogs dang mjal ba/ /thos bsam mdo sngags gzhung lugs la byas pas/ /rtag tu dal 'gyor don dang ldan pa 'di dga' mo snang e go/gzhung lugs thams cad gdams ngag tu shar ba/ /man ngag phran tshegs la stos pa med par/ /bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi gnad don ma lus/ /stan thog gcig tu nyams su len pa 'di dga' mo snang e 〈sna/zhes gsungs/ mkhas pa dang grub pa gnyis tshogs ni gnas rnying kun dga' bde legs/ rje nor bzang rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs dga' blo/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ ye shes rtsemo'ang gcig yin no/ /de nas dgung lo nyi shu pa shing mo yos kyi lo'i dpyid zla ra ba hor zla dang 4 tsho 'phrul gyi zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin gangs can gyi nye bar gshor gnas rnying kun dga' bde legs kyis mkhan 4/brtan mkhas kyi yon tan dang ldan pa chos rje legs pa chos 'gyor gyis las kyi slob dpon/ rwa tshag chos rje sangs rgyas bzang 4sa gsang ston/ dge 'dun grangs tshang zhing kha skong gi chos dang ldan pa'i dbus su dpal ldan 'bras snyangs phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes pas lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa lha'i mchod yon gyi rgyun gyis sa gsum legs par khyab cing/ lhar bcas gso baphungangs kyi rgyal mtshan chen 544
'brasakhungs nas brgyud tshul/por gyurato/ /lo de'i ston rwa sgreng mjal bar phebs pas jo salab sras kyis byin gyis brlabs shing] phying dkar pas gus mchod sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas byung zhing gsung chos gsungad me tog gi char chen 4 khang pa'i nang du dkar chil gyis byung / me 'brug la 'phyong rgyas su phebs/chos rje mtshog ltapa dngan nang so tshe brtan pa mchod yon zugags ri 'o bde chen pa thams cad la glegs bam rin po che dang / rje rin 4 che'i gsang ba'i rnam thar gsung / thams cad dad par bkod cing/ lha rnams kyis kyang me tog gi char chen 4 phab/de nas mkhan chen bkra shis legs pas rtses thang du spyan drangs glegs bam rin po che/ rim lnga gsal sgron rtsogs chos kyisangoms par byas/ bsnyen bkur dang mchod pa dpe med pa phul/ de nas 'phyong rgyas pas byang 'dab tu spyan drangs/ dad gus zhabs rtog lhur mdzad/ ri 'o chos rdzong du dbyar gnas mdzad/ phyogs nas byon pa dang gzhis bcas la blo bh+yong sogs pota chen bcu sogs gsungs/ rtses thang du yang dge 'dun dpag med la/ lam rim/ dpe chos rin spungs/ 'jug pa/ mdo na skyes rabs rtso bzhi drenags gsungs pas bka' gdams kyi bstan pa'i nyi ma de shar bar rgyug de nas bzung rtses thang du lnga mchod chen 4'ang rgyun du tshugs par gyur/ gong ma chos rgyal chen pos kyang bkur mthong phul byung mdzad/ de nas sa mo lug gi lor/ rje rin 4 che la sangs rgyas byang sems mtha' yas pa'i zhal ras bstan pa'i 'ol kha mjal par phebs/ gangs ri'i dbang po 'o de gung rgyal gyi mgul na/ thams cad mkhyen padage 'dun grub pa'idangos slob/ gsung gi bdud mimang du bzhes shingad mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang sgyug rje blo zos chos skyong la rje yab sras kyi pa/ r+sha rnyi twi tsho dzo/ pa~X ṭ+wāṃ ༷༷dzo //k+ta ñdzadī pa/ 〈sna ༵ pa/ shāshā/ pa (lha /du ༵༵ pa/ 'jug lag mthil na gnas pa lta bu'i mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang smyug zung 'jug sgyu ma'i gar 545
'jigs byed chos 'byung /mkhan rje nor bzang rgya mtsho'i mnal lam pu mkhar stag la thog nas nyi ma'i dkyil dngor shar bdang/ thams cad mkhyen padage 'dun grub dang mjalanas byin gyis brlabs pa'i ltas sogs kyang byung/ rje 'di dpon slob rnams spang kha chu tshan du phebs pa gsan ma thag sgo 'dag 'byar gyi mtshams hur 'don mdzad de/ rje 'di mjal par phebs te/ zhabs kyi pad+mo la gus pas phyag mdzad pa na thams cad ngo mtshar skyes shingaka grub pa'i dbang phyag 'di'i phyag gi gnas ni/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dngos yin par gor ma chag go snyam du a la la 'di 'dra'i mgon 4 bsten pa shin tu bzang zhes thams cad dad pa'i dbang du gyur to/ /rje nyid kyis rdzing phyir skya ser stong phrag du ma la glegs bam gsungs/ nam mkha' las 'ja' dang me tog gi char chen 4 babs/de nas 'gar phug tu rje'i bzhugs khri'i steng du khrom chos gsungs/ bsam gtan gling du skya ser stong sogs la rje rin 4 che'i gsang ba'i rnam thar gsungs/ de nas tshos lung du 'ol kha'i skye 'o stong sogs la snying ṭo don gsum gsungs/'ol kha rdzong du'ang gsungs/ rgya sog dang lha sdings ( rnyipa ṭ+wāṃ sprikāmi /dī lha/ pa /sna snashā sgri ༵/shā /sna( na ṭī zloshā drirdo dz+wa ༷swā r+shadri ]shāshā pa/ lo'i mjug 'bras spungs su rje legs chos pa la dus 'khor gyi dbang bdag 4 chen 4 dang bcas/ chos rgyal rjes gnang gsan/ de dus rnam pa gnyis gas chos rgyal zhal gzigs/ rje'i zhal nas/ sku mdunanas phyag dam re gnang res kyis chos rgyaladang dpal ldan lha mo'i cho 'phrul nges par 'ong] khyad par da lan phebs nyin kyang chos rgyal snga 'phyos su phebs byung gsung / rwa tshag chos rjer yang phag mo bcu gsum gsan/ rje btsun ma la zhal gser gsesnal nas gadrenal ba btab bas byin gyis brlabs rtags byung / dge ldan du dngul gdung mthong ba kun 'dren mjal/ dge 'dun la mang ja dang] rten 'brel bstod pa'i rnam bshad/ dbu ma'i lta khrid/ 'angam 546
'bras spungagenas brgyud tshul/dbyangs dkar ser gnyis kyi rjes gnang sogs chos mang du gsungs/ yer bar mjal du phebs pas/ brag ltamagon pos bsu ba'i snang ba rje rang la byung/ yir bar skya ser stong phrag lhag tsam la dgung lo nyer lnga pa lcags sprel gyi los glegs bam rin 4 che phal cher bshad nyin rer nam mkhar lan+da'adang me tog gi char babs/ de dus drang nges rnam 'byed dngan grub mtha'i rnam bzhag mdzad/ bdag gis kyang grub mtha' 'di gzhir bzhag lte/ grub mtha' chen mosna 'khul spong gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs byas ba rje'i zugs rjes phan thogs byung bar 'dug /de nas dpyid dus rtses thang sogs su chos gangor bskog dbyar sos 'ol kha rin chen sgang du mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug nor bzang rgya mtsho'i drung pu dpal dus kyi gshor lo'i 'grel chen cha lagadang bcas pa dang / sbyo don 'od rgyan/ pad dkar zhal lung cha lag dang bcas pa/ nyid kyi man ngag gsal sgron skog dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim gnyis yongs rdzogs dang / zab lam lta ba'i gnad/de yang rtsa'ajug gzhi gsum gyi zla ba'i 'grel pa dang / rje'i rnam bshad gnyis kyis bkral ba'i dka' gnas rnams dpon slob zugs gcugs pa'i 'be+el gtam gyi tshul du dpyad pas/ dbu ma'i ltab rnam paradag pa 'khrangs pa la ni lta ba rjes dpag gis rnyed dgos pas/ dpyad pa nyung ngus ltab rnam par dag pa sngon rtogs myong brjed pa mtshog zung gis rta shul mjal skabs lta bu re gnyis ma gtogs pa la lta ba bskyed mi thub rje 'di dang sngar rje rin 4 ches kyang zla ba dang sangs rgyas bskyangs kyi 'grel bas rtogs tshul bstan pas so/ /nye brgyud sgroladakarasad bzhin gshor lo'i rjes gnang dang lung sogs dngaka mdor na sngags mtshan nyid tha snyad kyi gtsug lag rtsis sogs dang / dranganges rnam 'byed kyi dka' gnas sogs mtha' yas pa gsan/ rje rang gi drang nges rnam 'byed kyi dka' 'grel gzigs 'bul mdzad pas yab sras phan tshun gyi thugs nyi mdang pad+ma bzhin nam/ zla bdang bdud rtsibazhin du ya mtshan par rgyug lar ni mdo sngags kyi 547
'jigs byed chos 'byung /don tshig spyir ma lus pa 'di 'dra dgos/ de nas rwa sgreng la gdan bteg /jo bo yab sras la mtshod de/drod pa nyul lu zer ba'i shug pa sngar nas skam pa zhig la nga dge bshes ston pa'i sprul ba yin na khyod la yal ga dang lo 'dab skye bar gyur cig /ces bden pa bdar pas lo ma gsar du skyes/ chu mig gsar ba gcig kyang rdol/ gzhan yang shug pa gser ldan sngar ngos ma zin pa langos 'dzin gyi dar yang btsugs pas rwa sgreng ba thams cad dad gus kyi nga ros pha ston pa rin po che bdag cag rnams la brtsebs gzigs shig ces ga〈snal ba btab/ zhag bcu skor bzhugs/snying 4 don gsum sogs chos gsungs pas de dag gi tshe yang 'ja' tshon gyi dra ba dra phyed kyi dbus nas me tog gi char chen 4 yang babs/ de nas rim gyis 'ol khar phebs/ lo'i brag gdong du dgun mtshams bsdams pa de'i tshe mnal lam du lung ba sngar mthong ma myong pa'i ne'u sing srang grongs bde mo la brag dkar 4 tsho le ba yod pa gcig 'dug /brag de rnams la phyag gis reg pas rjes lam lam 'ong pa gcig byung / 'di dkon mchog gi zugs rje yin zer ba gcig rmis/ de phyis kyi rgyal gyi da〈snan pa zebs pa'i ltas red gsungs/ lcags bya la gnyal sde drug 'dus pa'i tshogs dbu mdzad/ tsa ri mjal/ ye shes mkha' 'gro bcu gsum gyi nyams snang shar/ lho brag tu rin ṭo che'i sku gdung mjal/ phyag na rdo rje dang grub chen gnyis spu'i snang ba gzigs pas sngar rgyal gdonagyi bsgyung zhig yod pa'ang zhi song gsung/ grub chen gyi rnam thar thang ka shadas mtshal gyis bris pa'i byin can yangade dus phul/ bya lor zangs 4 chedangangang rgyal du phebs/ mgon po lho nub pa lusadang sgrab ma bzhin 'brang bar grags pa bden gsung/ dgung lo nyer drug gi dus gnyal lde drug gi tshogs dbu mdzad/ de nas 'phyos rgyal mtshan rtser chos (lhanga~X sdu r+sha rdor+sha spri ༵༵ / ṭ+wāṃ rnyi/ ( hūṃ sbyo/ /drisan: ༵ chi/ra :sna nga〉(shāshā/ da/sra 548
'brasasangs nas brgyud tshuggyi dbang] legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes gnang/ zhakhrul lubor rnam bshad dang phyag len/ rwa 'od/ me+e ring mched lnga'i rjes gnang sogs mang du gsan/ bkra shis lhun por mang ja dang] paṇa chen drung du phyag 'bul phul tshog pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus kyang ma smin/ rta nag tu skye 4 stong zag gsum tsam la 'dod chos gnang1 de nas er phebs/ rwa sgreng du lan gsum tsam phebs kyang rgyun ring ma bzhugs pas/ thog gcig bzhugs nis kyis thog mar dga' ldan du phebs/ mang ja dang rgyud pa'i grwa mang la chos mang ṭo gsungs/ rwa sgreng du phebs/ mang ja dang dkon mchog mchod/ jo bo'i sku la gsesnal ba btab pas/ dge bshes ston pa'i sku zhal gzigs/ gtsang dang 'o dwags gnyis su 'phrin las kyi sgo yod par lung bstan/ de dus lha mang 4ra bsnyen pa mdzad pas/ bka' gdams lha bzhi/ rta mgrin lcags ral/ sgrol ma 〈snags zhal gzigs/ nang gi rten skoradang] phyi'i shug skor yang mang du mdzad/nang gi rten dang phyi'i shug par byin rlabs khyad med gsung/ shug pa'i khyon thams cad sangs rgyas byang sems kyis gang bar gzigs par grags/de nas rdo rje gdan du yab gshegs pa mkhyen nas phebs shing dgongs rdzogs mdzad/ gdung zhugs 'bul mdzad pa sogs dam pa'i mdzad pas dus yol bar gnangad dgung lo so bzhi pa sa lngasna sprul gyi 'o(/ hor zla lnga pa'i yar tshes la rgyab ri rgyal 4 gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra ba la chos rgyal srong btsan sgam 'os/ rgyal ri byang chub semasadapar mtshan gsol pa da lta rgyal du grag /de'i mdun na ri dang chu dang] thang gi chos 'byung gsum phrag yod pa'i dbus na/ thang pad+ma 'dab brgyad rma bya'i gdugs lta bu la/ dbyar me rtog shang shang dkar 4 dang / ser 4 sogs rigs mi 'dra ba bcu gsum lasar pas metog thang du grags pader rje nyid la bshesaganyenadam pa chos dpal sogs zhabs phyi du ma dang bcas te sto 'tshe'i zig sogs sa chog dang sa 'dul mdzad/ gtsug lag khang ka ba bdun cu'i sar rtsig 'gram btings/ me tog gi char nyin re bzhin 549
'jigs byedachos 'byung /babs/ lcags mo lug la dpal ldan ltamo'i bla mtshor grags pa khyad par can 'di rnyed/ 'de dag gi gnas gang zag dang bcas pa yang dkon mchog 'bangs kyi skyes rabs las/ mkha' 'gro ma gcigan re/ byang rgyal po chen po'i mdun drung na/ /thang sngon po g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal la/ /rtsibs mu tig stong gis brgyan pa de/ /rje rgyal ba stong gis byin rlabs pa'i/ /g.yu dri ma med pa'i mchod rten yod/ /nged mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dga' ba'i tshul/ /zhes sogs gnas dang / khong pha ma grangs med 'dren slad du/ /mi rgyal ba khyod kyis der bzhugs te/ /zugs slas pa'i tshul gyis gzhan don rgyud/ /ma 'gro ba mang 4 smin par byed/ /ces pas gang zag dang thams cad mkhyen pa rnams bstan la rang gis gsar rnyed 'khul bral 'de yang yin/ pha chos kyi rdze bcang dang po'i tshoms las/ pad+madakar 4 rab mdzes pa/ /'dab ma brgya stong mdzes pas phyug/rtsab gser gyi sa las gabrungs/ yu ba shel dkar mdzes pas btegs/ /ze'u 'bru rin chen lhun pos spungs/ /'dab mdzes bar mtshams dpag med kyangaka yan lag brgyad ldan bdo ba yi/ /chu bo chu phran jing bu dang / /chu mig khron pa mdzes pas gtams/ /ldon pa yal ga steng ldan pa'i/ /'dab ma me tog shing thog mjes/ /gang de'ang shin tu mardzes pa yi/ /gseradang g.yu dang shel dang ni/ /mar gad pad+ma ra ga serdzogs/ /mdzes pa'i gzugs can bya tshogs rnams/ /snyan pa'i sgra 'byin khyu yis bsten/ /yan lag brgyad ldan rdzing bu na/ /ngang pa skad snyan yid 'ong 'gyo/ /rje'u seng spang ldongs metog bkra/gangade'i gzhinang bde lasaspo/ /'phyor padapag med 'bru chags 'khrangs/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma'ingos la yangaka /chu mig dwangs pa'i zil ba 'phyo/ /zhes pas rgyal gyi gnas rmya khyad par sbyor bltan cing] pad+ma dkar po ni/ dgon gnas dkar so dang 'dab ma spyil bu dkar po brgya stong dang spyag lhag ma sgras zinamong rungad bye brag dus bzhi'i sgo nas bsngags pa yang] de nyid las/ dgun dus shel gyi mchod rten 'khrangs/ /dpyid dus g.yu yi spu rab langs/ /dbyar dus 550
'brasasangs nas brgyudatshugut+pal nyid 'gyurate/ /de la'ang rin chen snalngasas//mdzes pa'i me togadapag med zhakhrungs/ /chu mig shel gyi za ru can/ /tsha dus nyidan rab tu bsil/ /sus bsten sgom pa'i gdung ba sel khu byug dung dung dga' bas lding/ /bya yi tshogs kyang khrims la gnas/ /skye bo'i tshogs rnams yid phebs 'gyud /ston du gser gyi me tog nyid/ /shākya'i dkyil gzhur ci 'dra ba/ /snying ṭo thams cad rab ldo zhing/ /rin chen lnga yi me rtog kyangaka /'dab ma sa 'bras bu rgyas par 'gyug /dpal 'byor lha yi zhing khams bzhin/ /dbul pa'i skabs med mchog rab bde/ /bar mtshams dag kyang rjes su 'brangs/ /zhes pas bstan/ yang de nyid las/ khyad par du yang 'di lta ste/ /mtsho mo rdzing bu dbyar dus tshe/ g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal gser byas brgyan/ /dgun dus shel gyi maṇ+ḍal te/ /ston dpyid mjes pa'i kho gnyer can/ /gangor lo bye ba dbus nas 'tshed/ /rba rlabs chen po mtha' nas g.yo/ /rang las byung zhing rang la rim/ /sgra med zab chos ston pa yod/ /ces pas lha mo'i bla mtsho mu le ting bstan te/ rgyal ba gong mas kyang mu le ting du gsungs la sgra med kyang mtsho mjal dus dgon pa dang / skye 'gro'i bya byed ston pa kun la grags shing zab don ston par yang byed danas/ gang zag dang chos lung ston pa ni/ de'i 'phyo nyid las/ bang rim thams cad 'phags pas brgyan/ /thugs tshol mi byed bka' rab gdams/ /bang rimadang shor skyabs su 'gro/ /bang rim gnyis par smon sems bskyed/ /bang rim gsum par 'jug sems bskyed/ /bang rim bzhi par nyes dmigs lta /bang rim lnga par rnam byang rdzogs/ /gnas dang gnas la brten pa rnams/ /dri mas ma gos phyi nang gsal/ /zhes pa'i bang rim lngar 'phags pas brgyan pa ni/ lnga ldan bzang pos mi nub skyong / /zhes pa ltar rgyal ba pyin lnga bstan/ gnas zhes pas mkhan por bstan/gnas la brten pa zhes pas slob brgyud bstan cing / gnas mkhan po dang gnas ba slob ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos pa shel dang sa lta bu yin par bstan cingam chos 551
'jigs byed chos 'byung /tshig zin ltar dang] yang de nyid las/ bya ba rgyu 'bras chos la rgyud/ /gos ni tshul khrims mjes bas brgyan/ /ska rags ngo tsha khrel yod cing/ /zhwa ni rnam dag ltab gyon/ /zas ni dam chos bsam gtan za/ /spyod lam thabs shes zung du 'jug /grogs ni lha dang drang srong bsten/ /chos ni lhag pa'i rin chen gsum/ /pha ni snying rje chen po bsten/ /ma ni gnyis med sher phyin yin/ /bu ni rnam rtog rang krolasan//ci byedadam chos zab mo lte//dam chos rgyu 'bras 'brel chagasayin/ /'brel ni tshul khrims gzhi ma lte/ /ngos ni rnam dag dad pas skyabs/ /zur ni tshad med bzang 4sa slon/ /ka ba gnyen po dpag med de/ /phug ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin/ /bla gab bla na med pa'i chos/ /pad ni kun mkhyen nor bus sbras/ /pad zur yan lag drug cus brgyan/ /rgya ni las bas gar khyab pa/ /'phang yang de tsam nyid du zad/ /sras ni nor bu rin chen te/ /bran ni brtson 'grus ladzangs ma yin/ /byang sgo gtong ba'i rgyal bos bsrungs/ /shar sgo dbang sdud rgyal pos bsrungs/ /lho sgo snyan grags rgyal 4sa bsrungs/ /nub sgo don grub rgyal pos bsrungs/ /bsam mi khyab kyi gzhal yas khang / /mtshungs pa med pa'i pad 'dab dbus/ /rgyal pa stong gi 'od zhakhrigs pas/ /shes rab yum gyi gur nang na/ /shel gyi khye'u mkhar ba can/ /mkhar pa'i rtsel pad sdong bzung / /dbus na mtshan dpes brgyan pa yi/ /sprul pa'i sangs rgyas stong phrag bzhugs/ /pad re'i 'dab stong sras kyis brgyan/ /lung bstan bzhin du lung mchog gsungs/ /shel gyi khye'u'i sku mchog la/ /bde gshegs gshor bcas lham mer shag /phyi na ci 'dra nang na yang / /'gyom du mi gda' r+ghaṃ du gda'/ /zurade ma bcag zung de skyon/ /zhes bas gang zag gi rgyud pa chos dang sbyar zhing] hūṃ ni gzhal yas khang gi sa pon yin pas rgyal ba rnams gzhal yas khang gi zur de slob rgyud kyis ma gcog par zur de sgron zhes pa yin te/ lnga yis dngos sam brgyud pas zug zhes pa ltabu la rgyal ba phyi ma de dag thams cad kyang rin po che'i 552
'bras spungasanas brgyud tshugmtshan can dang / dge 'dun dpag med 'phel ba dang] rgyal ba'i dbang 4ra yang brjod pa dang]rgya mtsho'i mtshan can kyang gis chen 4 gnadang stong gsum dulapa sprul pa 'gyed cingadagos legad stsol par lung bstan pa ni/ de nyid las/ 'de ni rin chen sa 'on yin/ /'de las rin chen dpag med lubrungs/ /rgyal ba zhes kyang rab brjod de/ /'byung gnas nyid kyang 'di nyid yin/ /rgya mtsho mtshog kyang 'di nyid de/ /sa chen nyid kyang 'di nyid do/ /'dod dgu thams cad 'di las 'byung/ /khye'u 'di yi ba sbru yi/ /bu ga gcig kyang rgyal pa yis/ /dbyad par mi nus nyan 'phags ci/ /stong gsum mang yang bu ga gcig /'di ni la)ga rten kun gyi rje/ rgyu rje khyod kyi mtshan brjod la/ /khye1da la bdag gis gdul bya gtad/ /e ma khyod kyi gagor lugs bzang] /zhes pas bstan cing] sprul pa'i gnas yig las kyang/ yul ma lung pa'i shar phyogs na/ /zhes pa nas/ nub byang mtshams na lha lung yod/ /bdag po lha gnyan mthong mdzes yin/ /zhes pa yan chad kyi gnas sbyor bstan/ byang shar mtshams na mdangs brag phug /gsang ba thugs kyi phur gcig ma/ zhes pas gnas bdag srog sgrub phur gcig ma bstan cing dmag zor ma dang rgyud gcig kyang so sor phye tshe rang byung rgyal mor grags pa de yin 'dra zhingaka gnas kyi bsngags pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing khams yin/ /ri 4 po ta la dang mtshungs/ /ma dang mkha' 'phyo 'du ba yin/ /ma bsgom ting 'dzin ngang gis 'phel/ /de ru bsnad tshad ngan song med/ /ces gsungs pa'i gnas der gtsug lag khang dgon lde dang bcas pa btabs/ lcags mo lug la dpal ldan lha mo'i bla mtshongo mtshar can 'de rnyed/ de dus bkra shis lhun po'i bla brang pa dpon slob lusar bcas kyis nyon mongs pa'i ri bsnyil/ gdan sar phebs dgos pa'i pho nyadang bcas pa gnang bag lan gyi chab shog 6 paṇa chen la che brjod dang bcas te dgongs pa nan zhus phul na'ang / sbre'u lo'i ston chos rje nub ra ba dngon slob nan chen 'odang bcas byung bas phebs par brtsam dus/ dbus phyogasanas grwa slob 553
